# Warframe & weapon build guides

A structured, standardised set of **394** Warframe and weapon build guides, each rendered against a fixed template so the same information is always in the same place.

**Provenance:** compiled from public build editor data (mod loadouts, forma, and any written notes). All author identity, profile links, build IDs, cross-links, and video references have been removed. Where a build shipped without a written guide, or the guide did not cover a template section, that is stated explicitly rather than filled in with invented analysis.

**Section order is fixed.** Warframe guides: overview → assumptions box → mod configuration → intended content → core concept → key stats → modding notes → helminth → arcanes/aura/exilus → archon shards → survivability → energy → playstyle → variants → strengths/weaknesses → additional notes → who it's for. Weapon guides follow the parallel weapon order (identity/damage engine → crit-status mechanics → elements → status weighting → mods → galvanized/faction → arcane/exilus → incarnon → melee mechanics → synergy → external buffs → riven → playstyle → steel-path scaling → variants → strengths/weaknesses).

Polarity symbols: **V** Madurai · **D** Vazarin · **–** Naramon · **=** Zenurik · **Ω** Umbral · **⊙** Precept · **r** Unairu.

Counts: Warframes 193 · Primary Weapons 61 · Secondary Weapons 45 · Melee Weapons 72 · Archwing 3 · Companions 20.

### 1. Revenant Prime — The Lich King Revenant | General Use/Endurance Steel Path | Mesmer Tank and One-shot Reave

**Type:** Tank · **Difficulty:** Advanced · **Investment:** Extreme

**Build overview**

High strength Revenant build for high mesmer skin charges to stay invulnerable and status immune, reave to one shot enemies and optional Roar in helminth to boost reave and general weapon DPS.

**Mod configuration**

- Mesmer Shield — R3 — = · Zenurik
- Thrall Pact — R3
- Transient Fortitude — R10 — V · Madurai
- Blind Rage — R10 — V · Madurai
- Equilibrium — R10 — – · Naramon
- Primed Flow — R10 — – · Naramon
- Primed Continuity — R10 — V · Madurai
- Umbral Intensify — R10

*Aura:* Corrosive Projection
*Exilus:* Ice Spring
*Arcanes:* Molt Vigor (R5), Molt Augmented (R5)

*Resulting stats:* Armor 135 · Energy 641.246 · Health 370 · Shield 925 · Sprint Speed 1.1 · Ability Range 1 · Ability Duration 1.275 · Ability Strength 2.98 · Ability Efficiency 0.45

**Intended content — best at / less suited for**

Designed for: Level Cap, Steel Path endurance, Bossing. The source guide does not spell out where it underperforms; as a tank build the usual tradeoff applies (see Strengths & weaknesses).

**Core build concept**

A **tank** Revenant Prime setup: high Strength (2.98×), neutral Duration (1.275×), neutral Range (1×), negative Efficiency (0.45×). Its engine is the combination in the mod configuration above — Mesmer Shield, Thrall Pact, Transient Fortitude, Blind Rage, Equilibrium, aura Corrosive Projection, Molt Vigor + Molt Augmented. See the written sections below for the intended damage/defence loop.

**Key stats & breakpoints**

**Duration**

Positive duration is helpful for reave travel duration, enthrall and mesmer skin stun, as well as for your helminth ability uptime eg roar. Duration also affects Danse Macabre drain.

**Efficiency**

You can adjust this to preference. Negative efficiency is fine if you're mostly focusing on Mesmer Skin since it only needs to be recast once every half a minute or so. Neutral to positive efficiency would make it easier to spam Reave and even Danse Macabre if you like, but Equilibrium gives plenty of energy regeneration. Enthrall cost is basically free since it spreads and is free on an enemy stunned by mesmer skin.

**Range**

Range is only needed for Enthrall and Reave and neutral range is mostly sufficient. You could add more range to improve Reave radius if you preferred, e.g by adding Stretch over a strength mod.

**Strength**

Very high strength helps maximise the Mesmer Skin charges (19 at 313% or 22 at 373% str after Molt Augmented, and even more with additional strength sources such as Growing Power, Zenurik or Madurai), Reave and Roar. You need to hit certain Strength breakpoints to gain additional mesmer skin stacks as the mesmer skin count is rounded up when decimal. Every multiple of 16.6667% strength gives one additional mesmer skin charge and every 50% strength gives exactly three charges. General breakpoints above 300% strength:

- 301% to 316%: 19 charges
- 317% to 333%: 20 charges
- 334% to 350%: 21 charges
- 351% to 366%: 22 charges
- 367% to 383%: 23 charges

**Modding notes**

The guide does not break down individual mods. Defining picks appear to be: Mesmer Shield, Thrall Pact, Transient Fortitude, Blind Rage, Equilibrium. Slots holding basic drift/utility or resistance mods are the flexible ones.

**Helminth**

Subsume over either Enthrall or Danse Macabre:
1. Roar - boosts general weapon DPS, thrall DPS and reduces amount of viral status needed to one-shot non-enthralled enemies with reave (2 viral procs at 313% strength or 1 viral proc at 373% strength or even 0 viral proc at 500% strength).
2. Xata's Whisper - void themed ability that has bonus against overguard and best for raw damage weapons
3. Pillage - armor strip improves weapon DPS against armored enemies
4. Silence - decent option for endurance in Steel path, particularly to prevent Violence from dispelling all your mesmer skin at once and making you vulnerable. You can leave range around 79-100ish e.g. just have stretch, or add augur reach too.
5. Mind Control - can create an invulnerable thrall that does more damage (shoot it to apply damage multiplier) and converts other enemies to thralls. Can add Primed Continuity
6. Grouping - You can use Ensnare/Larva/Coil Horizon or Airburst as a form of grouping so you can reave multiple enemies at once. You will want to increase range by swapping Narrow Minded and Fleeting Expertise for Primed Continuity and Overextended.
7. Sentient Wrath - provides both crowd control and damage vulnerability, which also increases the damage of reave allowing one-shot at only 1 viral proc at 313% strength.
8. Nourish - boosts thralls with viral damage, adds viral to your weapons and multiplies energy gained

**Arcanes, Aura & Exilus**

Flexible:
Molt Augmented - if you want even more strength up to 60% after 250 kills, for mesmer skin stacks
Arcane Power Ramp - can give up to 36% strength if you cast different abilities
Molt Vigor - gives up to 45% strength if you use operator ability first, which is snapshot into your mesmer skin stacks
Molt Efficiency/Arcane Concentration - more duration for reave, thrall and roar uptime
Arcane Energize/Steadfast - helps energy economy if needed
Arcane Avenger - use in combination with Combat Discipline only

**Archon Shards**

Amber Cast Speed Shard: at least 2 regular cast speed shards or 1 tauforged cast speed helps with mesmer skin refresh and reave spam
Crimson Strength Shard: as many +strength as you prefer for more mesmer skin and reave damage. Having 4 tauforged lets you hit 500% strength when used alongside Madurai.

**Survivability & failure conditions**

Not detailed. Survivability comes from whatever defensive mods/abilities are in the configuration above; the guide does not state what breaks it.

**Energy economy**

Efficiency sits at 0.45× per the stats line. The build/guide references an energy source — see mods/overview.

**Playstyle & rotation**

1. Activate Mesmer Skin (2) at start of mission and refresh just before you lose all charges.
2. Enthrall (tap 1) enemies and let it spread and keep enthralls capped at 7 as needed. Note you can Enthrall acolytes as long as you have free thrall space so that you can Reave them easier (takes about 3-4 shots to kill).
3. Cast Reave and aim through Enthralled enemies to one-shot them and regain mesmer skin charges. Reaving also provides companion with a 1 single mesmer skin stack.
4. For non-enthralled enemies, prime with viral status and reave to one-shot (only need exactly 2 viral status to one-shot at 313% str with roar, or 9 viral status to one-shot without roar)
5. Use Danse Macabre for mob clearing if you like. This works well for non-SP but also works for very high level SP (level 1000+) where enemy damage outscales their eHP significantly. If you have energy issues, consider swapping Blind Rage for Streamline.

**Strengths & weaknesses**

- **Strengths:** high effective health / sustained survivability; forgiving of mistakes.
- **Weaknesses:** lower ability- or weapon-damage ceiling; can still fall to gaps in the defensive layer.

**Patch / update history (from the guide)**

**Update**

The new augment Mesmer Shield gives a bonus 50% strength towards Mesmer Skin and allows you to give allies 5 mesmer skin charges.

**Additional notes from the guide**

- Corrosive Projection for armor reduction which boosts damage against armored enemies by 1.8x
- Growing Power gives one additional mesmer skin charge but requires aura forma
- Enemy Radar helps track enemies from even further away adding onto universal radar
- Sprint boost for run speed (which now affects reave)

Up to personal preference, use whatever u like.
- Ice Spring/Parkour mods : better mobility
- Power drift: one more mesmer skin stack
- Preparation: For quick missions, allows speed reaving/dansing through a mission

**Reave Specifics**

Reave one-shot strength threshold calculator (made by mineturtleofdeath) :
Reave one-shot spreadsheet (by me, to use click file -> make a copy, do NOT ask for edit permissions):

Reave at base removes 8% of an enemies health regardless of level. This is boosted by enthrall, viral status and roar. Note this does NOT work against acolytes, demolysts and bosses such as liches/archons due to their innate damage reduction. An enthralled enemy takes 5x more damage from Reave meaning only 250% strength is required to one-shot an enthralled target. Viral increases damage by 4.25 at 10 stacks, meaning 295% strength is needed to one-shot a non-enthralled enemy after applying 10 viral status effects.

Alternatively, if you add Roar, you need 500% strength to oneshot without any viral and 320% strength to oneshot with 1 single viral status.

**To one shot with NO viral, roar or enthrall you need 1250% strength.**

**To oneshot with ROAR but NO viral or enthrall you need exactly 500% strength. This can now be hit with external buffs such as strength shards (e.g. 4 tau str = 60%) and Madurai (40%). A Nidus specter will reduce the strength requirement further and make it easier to hit, only needing 391% strength provided you stay in range**

**Flexible Options/Slots**

Thrall Pact gives over +600% primary weapon damage at max thralls but is additive to other damage mods, nice damage boost if using primary weapons.

Natural Talent is good quality of life since it speeds up casts of Reave as well as allows you to refresh Mesmer skin in between casts and within the i-frames given by shield gating. This is however more optional now since you can run cast speed amber shards and you now gain 1s i-frames upon losing a mesmer skin stack.

**Focus School**

Madurai: Power transfer gives +50% cast speed and +40% strength for up to 20s, which is amazing for Mesmer skin and Reave, in addition to general damage boost

A consistent AOE viral primer is the best tool to apply viral procs which will allow Reave to oneshot without enthrall.

### 2. Khora Prime — Thunderdome Khora | Steel Path Endurance Survival and Looting

**Build overview**

Welcome to the Thunderdome. This is a standard Khora Whipclaw farming build for endurance survival/looting missions (e.g. steel essence farm, arbitrations e.t.c.). Accumulating Whipclaw and Pilfering Strangledome are standard augments to enable Whipclaw DPS and Strangledome looting respectively.

Infinite scaling survivability is via extreme crowd control from strangledome, ensnare, as well as shield gating using the combination of Brief Respite, augur mods and Catalyzing Shields. Venari Bodyguard is a further optional backup plan that negates death. At neutral efficiency with Brief Respite and ONE augur mod, every cast of Whipclaw generates 47.5 shield which gives about 0.6s shield gate. Exactly two casts of Whipclaw therefore caps max shields (93 with Catalyzing Shields) and gives the maximum 1.33s shield gate. If you add another two augur mods on your secondary, you can generate 67 shields which is approximately 1s shield gate from a single cast of 1.

**Mod configuration**

- Streamline — R5
- Equilibrium — R10 — – · Naramon
- Catalyzing Shields — R3 — D · Vazarin
- Primed Continuity — R10 — V · Madurai
- Primed Flow — R10 — – · Naramon
- Accumulating Whipclaw — R3 — = · Zenurik
- Pilfering Strangledome — R3

*Aura:* Brief Respite

*Resulting stats:* Armor 345 · Energy 641.246 · Health 465 · Shield 465 · Sprint Speed 1.05 · Ability Range 2.05 · Ability Duration 1.55 · Ability Strength 0.4 · Ability Efficiency 1.3

**Intended content — best at / less suited for**

Designed for: Steel Path endurance, Arbitrations, Survival, Farming / loot. The source guide does not spell out where it underperforms; as a farming build the usual tradeoff applies (see Strengths & weaknesses).

**Core build concept**

A **farming** Khora Prime setup: low Strength (0.4×), long Duration (1.55×), wide Range (2.05×), neutral Efficiency (1.3×). Its engine is the combination in the mod configuration above — Overextended, Streamline, Equilibrium, Catalyzing Shields, Primed Continuity, aura Brief Respite, Arcane Aegis + Arcane Fury. See the written sections below for the intended damage/defence loop.

**Key stats & breakpoints**

**Duration**

Duration is mainly used to keep strangledome active so you don't have to keep recasting it. Duration is otherwise not useful for Whipclaw, Ensnare or Venari. Primed Continuity and Molt Efficiency give duration.

**Efficiency**

Efficiency can be neutral to positive as long as you run Equilibrium with Synth Deconstruct on a companion such as Diriga, Panzer or a Hound, and play sufficiently high density maps such as Steel Path Survival. Getting kills on enemies tagged by Synth Deconstruct as well as Eximus can produce health orbs which are converted into energy orbs at a pretty rapid rate. If you don't spam Whipclaw and only kill enemies when they are sufficiently captured by strangledome, you can also reduce your energy expenditure. Primed Flow/Flow is needed in order to make Violet Crit Damage shards have double effect. If you still have energy issues, consider using an energy subsume such as Lycath's Hunt, Dispensary, Nourish or Spectrorage.

**Range**

Range is the most important stat for Khora, since it benefits the cast range and explosion radius of Whipclaw (note this caps at 200% range), pull radius of Ensnare and finally the size and pull radius of Strangledome.

**Strength**

This is the least important stat since it does not affect ensnare and we do not rely on the damage of Strangledome. While strength does scale into the base damage of Whipclaw, the augment *Accumulating Whipclaw** makes up for the negative strength by allowing you to stack an extra +350% damage which is additive to the bonus provided by ability strength. Since the total amount of damage is capped at +350% and is not affected by strength, we can drop strength completely to minimum.

**Modding notes**

The guide does not break down individual mods. Defining picks appear to be: Overextended, Streamline, Equilibrium, Catalyzing Shields, Primed Continuity. Slots holding basic drift/utility or resistance mods are the flexible ones.

**Helminth**

Usually we subsume over Venari since it is the least useful ability and Venari is still technically around even if you subsume over it. If you are NOT looting, you could consider subsuming over Strangledome and just using Ensnare to group.

Lycath's Hunt - Kills from Khora's Whipclaw counts as melee kills for Lycath's Hunt, giving each Whipclaw kill a 50% chance to drop health orbs. With Equilibrium, each health orb gives 55 energy, meaning every 10 kills gives on average 275 energy. This is the highest amount of energy you can generate, and is basically overkill unless you plan on spamming Whipclaw non-stop while NOT using Strangledome. You could therefore subsume this over 4 on a pure DPS build.

Spectrorage - Spectrosiphon augment allows each kill to have a 50% chance to drop energy orbs, meaning every 10 kills gives on average 125 energy.

Dispensary - creates empowered health orbs that give 100 health as well as normal energy orbs. Each empowered orb is converted into 110 energy by equilibrium.  This is an excellent way to make energy independent of enemies and spawn rates.

Nourish - adds Viral damage buff to Whipclaw AND boosts energy gain from energy/health orbs via equilibrium. Requires more strength, so add Molt Augmented and more strength mods:

Roar - boosts damage and triple dips influence, but does not give any energy and requires you to build strength.

Silence - shuts down annoying acolyte, eximus and thrax abilities.

**Arcanes, Aura & Exilus**

Arcane Fury - boosts Whipclaw damage
Arcane Aegis - optional for lazy survivability
Molt Efficiency - more duration for Strangledome
Arcane Energize - optional for more energy
Arcane Avenger - adds flat 45% crit chance to Whipclaw

**Archon Shards**

2 Amber Cast Speed speeds up Whipclaw/Strangledome/Ensnare
3 Violet Melee Crit Damage to boost Whipclaw further

**Playstyle & rotation**

1. Cast up to two strangledomes at choke points on the map (e.g. doorways, hallways entering into a room). Rotate your kills between these, allowing time for new spawned enemies to run into and be captured by the dome.
2. Spam Whipclaw at enemies or onto the strangledome to hit all enemies in the dome and kill them.
3. Cast Ensnare onto select targets such as acolytes, as ensnare increases Whipclaw damage
4. Keep Venari on heal mode if you prefer to keep your team topped up on health.

_None described._

- **Strengths:** loot / resource throughput.
- **Weaknesses:** not built for raw combat performance.

**Patch / update history (from the guide)**

**UPDATE MARCH 2025**

Whipclaw no longer uses statsticks on a regular melee and is now an exalted that can be modded and use arcanes. While technically the potential maximum raw damage has reduced (due to lack of incarnon bonuses and rivens), the nuking and KPM potential has increased due to the ability to use acolyte mods/galvanized mods and melee influence arcane. If you don't like faction mods, swap Primed Smite for Primed Reach (just note faction mods do TRIPLE DIP melee influence procs meaning they boost influence by a 1.55^3 = 3.72x multiplier. Primed Reach can add a flat 3m to the 10m maximum range of Whipclaw and surpass the cap to 13m.

**UPDATE JULY 2024**

Due to armor and health scaling changes, Khora Whipclaw can now scale into endurance without armor strip or slash, relying purely on raw damage.

I have removed Spectrorage as the primary subsume as energy is not really an issue these days with Equilibrium + Synth Deconstruct on Steel Path Survival density missions in addition to the host of possible energy regeneration methods such as Grimoire Xata Invocation, Glaxion Photon Overcharge, Primary Exhilirate, Emergence Dissipate and Zenurik. In addition, Khora basically one-shots all enemies quicker than before meaning you don't need to spam Whipclaw as much.

**Additional notes from the guide**

- Brief Respite - best for endurance runs where you want to stay alive using shield gating. Two casts of whipclaw at neutral efficiency caps max shields with catalyzing shields on
- Corrosive Projection - if running catalyzing shield with Augur stat stick you can use corrosive projection to maximise DPS against armored enemies
- Swift Momentum - good option if you don't own dexterity arcanes to increase combo duration to maintain whipclaw combo
- Steel Charge - gives extra mod capacity to save forma and small boost to Whipclaw (+60% melee damage is additive to dmg mods on statstick, so may not actually contribute that much to overall whipclaw damage, particularly if you have a +dmg riven).
- Combat Discipline - Only run if you use Dispensary and drop Arcane Energize for Arcane Avenger

Completely flexible slot.
Cunning drift is used to hit the range cap on Whipclaw.
Primed sure footed - best in slot prevents knockdowns. Handspring is next best alternative. Not needed if you run Unairu Poise or Wrym
Vigilante pursuit helps increase enemy radar to track enemies

**Melee Vortex**

Best for looting, this is because influence can kill enemies outside of the dome while vortex will pull enemies into the dome quicker and only kill enemies in the dome. NOTE: use ARCHON CONTINUITY for corrosive procs

**Flexible Slots**

Pilfering Strangledome - Use this in endurance SP survival missions where you want loot and oxygen e.g. steel essence, kuva survival and resource farming. For non-looting missions, you can replace this with either an efficiency mod (streamline/fleeting expertise), more range (stretch) or more survivability mods (Rolling Guard)

Venari Bodyguard - completely OPTIONAL mod for extra backup survivability. Prevents death once every 150s, but you can reduce this cooldown completely by simply getting about 30 to 40 kills. which should take only 20-30s. If you don't find this useful or are subsuming over Venari, simply drop this for Augur Reach or Streamline.

Catalyzing Shields - This is needed to reduce shields and give more effective i-frames per cast of whipclaw. For non-endurance or if you feel you don't need the safety of i-frames and status cleanse, swap this for either augur reach (more range) or streamline (better efficiency). Flexible for Rolling Guard.

**Build overview**

Standard AFK Octavia build utilising mallet to attract, multiply and release enemy damage for AOE nuking, metronome for essentially permanent invisibility as well as speed and multishot buffs and amp to boost your weapon damage and mallet range. Resonator is the subsume slot if you want to helminth, but can also pick up mallet and follow you around if you prefer.

Rolling Guard is optional due to Eximus abilities eg fireblasts, as well as if you are dispelled by Violence. This can be flexible for more range, duration or strength.

**Intended content — best at / less suited for**

Designed for: Level Cap, Steel Path endurance, Survival, Farming / loot. The source guide does not spell out where it underperforms; as a ability dps build the usual tradeoff applies (see Strengths & weaknesses).

**Core build concept**

A **ability dps** Octavia Prime setup: moderate Strength (1.39×), long Duration (2.54×), wide Range (1.84×), negative Efficiency (0.45×). Its engine is the combination in the mod configuration above — Rolling Guard, Primed Flow, Equilibrium, Stretch, Overextended, aura Corrosive Projection, Arcane Crepuscular + Arcane Concentration. See the written sections below for the intended damage/defence loop.

**Key stats & breakpoints**

**Duration**

High duration allows easier upkeep on all abilities and buffs, all of which have decent base durations. Any duration of 200% to 250%+ is good.

**Efficiency**

Since duration is so high and each ability only needs to be cast roughly once every minute, we can drop efficiency completely. You only need to spend about 300 energy to refresh all skills, which can be easily regenerated with arcane energize combined with the rate at which enemies die from mallet. Primed Flow is necessary to store a large amount of energy. Also remember that Octavia regenerates energy on ability cast with her passive (30 energy over 30s per cast which can be refreshed but does not stack higher than 1 energy/s).

**Range**

High range is used to scale the range of mallet, which is further doubled by amp, almost to a 40m radius. Any range between 145 to 200% is fine.

**Strength**

High strength scales the damage multiplier on mallet (approx 5x) so enemies receive much more damage, the multishot/speed/armor/melee bonuses from metronome and the damage multiplier from amp. Any strength between 150-200+ is fine.

**Modding notes**

The guide does not break down individual mods. Defining picks appear to be: Rolling Guard, Primed Flow, Equilibrium, Stretch, Overextended. Slots holding basic drift/utility or resistance mods are the flexible ones.

**Helminth**

Subsume over resonator for camping playstyle, subsume over amp for mobile playstyle:
- Nourish - add free viral to weapons and boosts energy generation (could allow you to drop Equilibrium)
- Silence - turns off eximus abilities and acolyte abilities for even more AFK time
- Wrathful Advance - add flat cc to melee weapons, which synergizes with amp
- Pillage - armor strip, status cleanse and shield regen for shield gating - doesn't cause knockdown or reduce enemy DPS onto mallet
- Dispensary - good for camping gameplay for energy regen, may need equilibrium for optimal use
- Bright Bonnet - more strength and energy
- Rage (from rest and rage) - If you subsume rest & rage over resonator, add calm & frenzy augment:
- Breach Surge - double dips Amp damage boost
- Xata's Whisper - can only be subsumed over Amp, but is a mobile buff that can double dip melee stealth multiplier (+700% dmg additive to crit multiplier, active with invisiblity)

**Arcanes, Aura & Exilus**

Arcane Crepuscular - 30% strength and +3 flat crit multi while invisible
Molt Efficiency - Bonus duration while shields active which is easy to maintain while invisible
Aegis - decent backup survival tool
Weapon fire rate/ damage - as needed depending on what weapon you want to use
Status resistances -e.g. toxin for infested missions, slash for grineer endurance

**Archon Shards**

Completely up to personal preference.
- ONE cast speed shard helps the feeling of recasting each buff

- TWO or more duration shards

**Patch / update history (from the guide)**

**UPDATE JULY 2024**

With the armor changes, Octavia mallet can now kill levelcap enemies nearly instantly with zero armor strip. Instead of subsuming Pillage, we can consider alternatives like Rage to increase enemy movement and DPS to boost mallet damage, Silence to shut down eximus and acolytes, Nourish to further boost weapon damage and give more energy.

**Additional notes from the guide**

Corrosive Projection reduces armor and effectively increases all damage against armored enemies by 1.8x without external strip
Brief Respite is useful for shield gating in case of acolytes or random damage that hits your through invisibility
Enemy Radar is good to monitor enemy movements and optimise casts of mallet to hit areas of highest density
Growing Power for more strength

One cast full strip Pillage variant:

**Flexible Slots**

Rolling Guard - this is personal preference, but there will be times where you may be accidentally visible, disrupted by Violence, hit by an eximus fire blast or surrounded by nullifiers and you just need little breathing room with i-frames + status cleanse. I find Rolling Guard is highly valuable particularly in endurance, and you can replace either Augur Message or Stretch for rolling guard.

Partitioned Mallet - can come in handy for blocking off two chokepoints or defending two different sides of an objective. Note you cannot place two mallets within range of each other.

**MANDACHORD**

Octavia's Mandacord is a looping song in 4/4 time signature with 4 bars (or measures) arranged in a wheel with each bar separted by thick white lines. Each bar has 4 beats divided by thick grey lines and each beat is further divided into 4 smaller notes (sixteenth note or semiquaver). The Mallet is powered by Percussion which is separated essentially into the Kick, Snare and Hihats. The resonator is powered by the Bass which runs on a D pentatonic minor scale with the notes D0, F0, G0, A0, C0. The Metronome is powered by Melody with runs on the same notes as bass but one octave higher.

Thanks to research by u/StygianFrame (see reddit post  the optimal Mandachord setup involves a large period of rest for percussion in order to **charge** up a damage multiplier. Having 41 rest and 23 percussion filled maximises the damage multiplier to about 480x to 800x, however this leaves a long period without dealing damage and also makes an unusual sounding song with huge break in percussion. The alternative is to have 17 rests and 47 percussion slots which results in about 200x to 400x multiplier instead (about half the effectiveness).

For Metronome/Melody, you can run 3 sixteenth notes in a row followed by breaks of alternating 8 and 7 rests to improve efficiency of activating invisibility, however if you want to also activate the multishot buff with fully automatic guns you may want to fill all melody.

For percussion you basically want to fill the first 47 percussion slots. I'm alternating the Kick on the 1 and 3 beats and Snare on the 2 and 4 beats for a classic easy pattern, then fill in hihats but drop the first on each beat to create a "ducking" effect (makes the kick and bass pop clearer). Put a bass note on the first of each beat and play around with moving the bass up and down, or you can match bass beats to the melody.

Instruments Used:
Percussion - Beta
Bass - Epsilon
Melody - Alpha

![](

[[ streamable id="kg9m0u" ]]

You will want to use crit based weapons due to Arcane Crepuscular buffing crit damage.

Octavia's metronome actually plays 8 notes per second when the mandacord is filled as above. Hitting fire one of these 8 notes builds progress on the Opera multishot buff and missing a note makes you lose progress. This means if you want to spam an automatic weapon and activate the Opera multishot buff effortlessly, you will want the fire rate to be exactly 8 (or maybe close to 8). A fire rate of 4 also works but takes about four times as long to activate the buff. Many other fire rates also seem to work fine but also just take longer since it might fluctuate, but generally the faster and non-even numbered the fire rate becomes the harder it will be to proc. **Core build concept**

A **tank** Saryn Prime setup: high Strength (1.83×), long Duration (1.55×), wide Range (2.5×), negative Efficiency (0.45×). Its engine is the combination in the mod configuration above — Umbral Intensify, Primed Continuity, Venom Dose, Catalyzing Shields, Equilibrium, aura Brief Respite, Arcane Sculptor + Molt Augmented. See the written sections below for the intended damage/defence loop.

**Key stats & breakpoints**

**Duration**

Duration allows easier upkeep of Venom Dose and toxic lash, and prolongs molt's speed buff. Duration is otherwise not particularly requred for spores or miasma. This is flexible depending on preference, either keep it at neutral at 100% or positive at 155% with Primed Continuity. Archon Continuity is a fine alternative, especially if you can't even get Primed Continuity, just note that it only applies corrosive status from molt and spores already caps corrosive status at 10 constantly.

**Efficiency**

Efficiency can be negative or near neutral as abilities do not need to be cast too often. Spores only needs to be cast once at the begginning or ocassionally if it wears off. You also occasionally cast molt for survivability and miasma to spread spores when the count is low, or for crowd control/viral procs. Toxic lash/Venom Dose only needs to be cast about once a minute.

Saryn does however have a very high base energy meaning Primed Flow gives a huge energy pool. You can add Primed Flow over Transient Fortitude if you prefer.

**Range**

High range greatly benefits spore spreading and miasma radius.

**Strength**

High strength greatly benefits buffs from Venom Dose and toxic lash, spore growth and decay and miasma damage.
You can add more strength by swapping Transient Fortitude for Blind Rage, or using both together.

**Modding notes**

The guide does not break down individual mods. Defining picks appear to be: Umbral Intensify, Primed Continuity, Venom Dose, Catalyzing Shields, Equilibrium. Slots holding basic drift/utility or resistance mods are the flexible ones.

**Helminth**

Subsume over molt OR miasma (molt is more useful in endurance for shield gating, miasma is more useful in low level nuking):

- **Shooting Gallery** with augment gives amazing crowd control through walls, but requires an augment (put muzzle flash over augur reach). Blinded enemies also take bonus melee stealth dmg (+700% crit damage)

- **Resonator** provides wide area crowd control and doesnt use a mod slot, but doesnt work on acolytes or overguard.

- **Roar** to triple dip on Toxic Lash toxin proc damage and increase spore damage for even more DPS. At 200% strength and using primed faction mod, Toxic Lash status procs therefore gains 8.6x multiiplier.

- **Nourish** over 4 provides bonus viral damage, boosts toxic lash procs indirectly and magnifies energy gained, and also provides viral AOE proc when you take damage

- **Spectrorage** with spectrosiphon augment produces tons of energy to fuel miasma spam, and also CCs enemies including acolytes:

- **Pillage** is a viable alternative without green shards since it allows full armor stripping and provides shield Regen for survivability and status cleanse. If you use pillage, don't run brief respite since pillage provides shields already. Can use another aura like enemy radar e.t.c.

- **Terrify** gives crowd control AND full armor strip at only 167% strength, if not using green shards (137% strength needed with corrosive projection)

- **Breach surge** synergizes with the build stats due to building for high range and strength, as well as spores stripping armor so surge sparks do a little more damage. Breach surge also provides line of sight crowd control for slightly cheaper cost than miasma and is spammable for shield gating.

**Arcanes, Aura & Exilus**

Molt Augmented gives a bonus +60% str after 250 kills, easy to get with spores/weapons
Molt Efficiency gives some free duration to help toxic lash uptime
Arcane Aegis helps with passive survivability/shield gating

**Archon Shards**

Very flexible depending on preference:
- 1 Tauforged Amber Cast speed shard is optional but nice quality of life, making Miasma cast much faster and any other helminth abilities.
- 1 Tauforged Emerald Shards (+max corrosive stacks) - allows 13 corrosive status effects on a regular enemy, which strips armor by 98%.
- 3 (or 4) Tauforged Emerald Shards (+toxin damage) - applies multiplicative increase to toxic lash procs (i.e. 2.35x with 2 tauforged shards).

**Patch / update history (from the guide)**

**UPDATE AUGUST 2026**

Arcane Sculptor allows you to run 45% efficiency with no Flow while spamming Molt to lock at 175% efficiency. This allows you to shield gate easily without worrying about energy.

**UPDATE JUNE 2024**

With armor changes, a single Tauforged Emerald shard is sufficient to allow up to 98% armor strip. Reaching 100% armor strip with two emerald shards is in comparison only a 14% DPS increase on armor capped enemies. In comparison, a single Tauforged +toxin status damage shard gives 18% or more DPS increase to toxic lash STATUS when running 2-3 Tauforged Toxin shards already, meaning the ideal shard configuration is 1 Tauforged +corrosive stack shard, 3 to 4 Tauforged +toxin status shard and 1 Tauforged Cast Speed shard (Optional).

**Additional notes from the guide**

- Brief Respite: Best for shield gating using Molt without augur mods. Having a single augur mod on a pistol or burst laser prime would allow you to drop Brief Respite.
- Enemy Radar: Great for tracking enemies, but will need multiple augur mods in place of Stretch, Venom Dose or Primed Flow as well as augur mods on your secondary in order to reset shield gate (3 augur mods are needed for full reset at 75% efficiency, 4 augur mods at 100% efficiency).
- Corrosive Projection: globally reduces armor

- Primed sure footed is best in slot but is locked behind login. Handspring is next best alternative for knockdowns.
- Cunning Drift for more range
- Parkour velocity mods eg Toxic Flight

In Steel Path you will want to stay out of gunfire completely when possible, by employing cover (stay behind walls and let spores kill in the distance) and a combination of molt and miasma to crowd control enemies if you need to be mobile. Molt draws enemy fire away from you and clears status effects, while miasma creates a brief 2 second radial stun. **Crowd Control** subsumes also makes surviving much much easier, e.g. resonator, shooting gallery (with Muzzle Flash)

You will additionally employ Shield Gating while using Catalyzing Shields. When your shields break, you will gain up 1.33s of invulnerability frames (i-frames) aka the 'shield gate'. Within this short time, simply tap 2 to regenerate 75 shields, which fully resets max shield capacity (74 with catalyzing shields) giving you another 1.33s i-frames the next time shields break.

Here is a sample video demonstrating some Steel Path survival gameplay:

Video showing gameplay in SP circuit levelcap with Muzzle Flash (note Muzzle Flash has since been nerfed and no longer works on eximus):

.

**Flexible Options**

- Venom Dose and Augur Reach: These are both flexible slots. Can add primed flow for more energy, more strength, augur reach for more range or another augment depending on helminth.

**ACID SHELLS / SOBEK**

- Kuva Sobek (one-shot thrax variant for cascade):
- Kuva Sobek Nuke (maximum trash clear damage):

Acid Shells on Sobek is a mod that allows Toxic Lash to spread across a map via a chain reaction while scaling off %HP. This is because kills made via Toxic Lash can trigger Acid Shells which explodes in a 15m radius and deals 45% HP (currently bugged to not account for steel path modifier meaning its much weaker than it should be), and enemies caught in the 15m radius take a Toxic Lash damage instance which scales off the %HP as 'base damage' which subsequently kills them. They then explode again in a 15m radius and triggers Lash on all enemies in range, chaining forever as long as there are enemies standing within 15m of each other (requires line of sight).

**VULCAN BLITZ / JAT KITTAG**

Jat Kittag (Slam):

If you want to slam, Jat Kittag with Vulcan Blitz has the same chaining mechanic but a MUCH lower radius of 6m, which means it basically cannot chain very far.

**THERMAGNETIC SHELLS / TENET DETRON**

- Tenet Detron (Thermagnetic Shells):

This is basically the secondary version of Acid Shells but with MUCH lower range pf 6m instead of 15m meaning enemies must be extremely close together (within 6m of each other) in order for the effect to chain.

**NIGHTWATCH NAPALM / KUVA OGRIS**

- Kuva Ogris:

Kuva Ogris is a very weak weapon by itself, but the augment Nightwatch Napalm creates lingering AOE fields of heat damage over 6s, which can trigger Toxic Lash on all enemies that walk into the field and thus continue killing enemies throughout the map. This makes it the highest trash clear KPM possible in the game when paired with Saryn since it can be dispersed throughout a tile continuously to kill new spawns almost the moment they spawn in.

**SENTIENT SURGE / OCUCOR**

- Ocucor:

Ocucor is the most 'lazy/comfortable' Saryn weapon because it creates seeking tendrils that effectively auto-aims for you and has an augment called Sentient Surge that makes it auto-reload on kill while also boosting critical chance and status chance. Ocucor by itself is also very weak but with Saryn level buffs it can be made to kill up to levelcap enemies without trouble. The arcane Secondary Fortifier also steals overguard meaning you can just hold down the fire button running around the map while Ocucor auto aims, auto reloads and auto regenerates overguard without worrying about survivability.

*COMBUSTION BEAM / VERMISPLICER**
- Primary Vermisplicer:

Primary Vermisplicer is a kitgun that has an auto-aiming beam that chains when it hits enemies and also has access to the mod Combustion Beam. Combustion Beam is like an extremely weak version of Acid Shells in that it can trigger an explosion on death with 600 base damage in a huge 18 m radius (vs Acid Shells which is 450 + %45HP in 15m radius), which can then trigger toxic lash in 18m but scaling off the 600 base dmg only. Therefore in order to make it usable, the strongest possible buffs/debuff are required e.g. exactly what Saryn + roar can offer. This would be made more viable alongside AOE armor strip (e.g. spores or corrosive procs) and viral status (e.g. from panzer/hound). Other beams can utilise Combustion Beam too e.g. Tenet Glaxion but Vermisplicer feels the best since you don't have to aim, can use Pax Charge for passive reload and fits thematically as a 'toxic' weapon.

**SPINNEREX**

Spinnerex is like a weaker melee version of Combustion Beam, where enemies killed after being hit by Spinnerex explode for 450 toxin damage in a 10m radius, which can trigger further Toxic Lash scaling off the 450 dmg, allowing this to chain in 10m intervals. AOE viral and armor strip are required.

**Key stats & breakpoints**

**Duration**

Higher duration gives longer uptime for all buffs (specifically Triumph, Wordwarden, Pageflight) so you don't need to refresh as often, lasting approximately 1 min. Note that Noctua can equip Ris Invocation giving a free 60% duration. Archon Shards and Molt Efficiency are additional sources to improve quality of life.

High strength affects the damage of Noctua, damage of Dark Verse, overguard from Light Verse/Triumph, multiplier of Tragedy and the damage/status boost of Pageflight, making this the most important stat. The guide does not break down individual mods. Defining picks appear to be: Umbral Intensify, Equilibrium, Primed Continuity, Blind Rage, Constitution. Slots holding basic drift/utility or resistance mods are the flexible ones.

You can only really subsume over 1 since his 2,3,4 are required to cast pageflight and wordwarden, which are very important parts of his kit (specifically pageflight). If you substitute over 1 this means you can ignore noctua DPS and just use a pure wordwarden build, and rely on a combination of weapons or tragedy for damage.

- ROAR: This double dips on DoTs like Slash, which is dealt by Dark Verse and ultimately boosts the damage of Tragedy as well as other statuses such as Electric, Heat, Toxin, Gas, Blast which you could mod on your weapons. At 300% strength, a 90% roar buff increases final Tragedy damage by about 3.61x.

- SHOCK WITH SHOCK TROOPER: Swap augur message for Shock Trooper augment, allows you add additional non-combining electric damage and therefore status onto weapons. Particularly good more melee influence weapons.

**Survivability & failure conditions**

**Energy economy**

**Efficiency/Energy Economy**

Dante is a very cast heavy frame and each rotation of Final Verse costs 100 energy to enact at base. Triumph, Wordwarden and Pageflight each last about 1 minute meaning you need to spend 300 energy each minute to keep them active, while Tragedy costs 100 energy to nuke each time. The final efficiency is up to personal preference but you could sit beween 100% to 160% efficiency for a cast heavy Tragedy spam playstyle (without Arcane Steadfast), or 45% (with Equilibrium +/- Arcane Impetus +/- Arcane Steadfast/Mystic Bond +/- Netra Invocation) on a more weapon focused playstyle. To restore energy, use a combination of Equilibrium and Xata Invocation (10 energy/s). Primed Flow gives a high energy pool to cast Tragedy frequently. Arcane Steadfast is a great option that gives free casts. Noctua also allows you to equip Netra Invocation which gives a free 60% efficiency and even procs Seismic Bond on a companion for another free 30% efficiency. As a final bonus Archon Stretch is OPTIONAL but can be triggered via either Noctua OR Wordwarden when it is modded for Viral Electric. Mystic Bond is also optional on your companion.

**Playstyle & rotation**

1. Keep Triumph buff active at all times (cast Light Verse twice followed by Final Verse: 2, 2, 4) to grant Overguard as well as Overguard with kills.
2. Keep Wordwarden buff active (cast Light Verse, followed by Dark Verse then Final Verse: 2, 3, 4) to summon a Noctua companion which helps deal passive DPS or priming.
3. Keep Pageflight buff active (cast Dark Verse followed by Light Verse, then Final Verse: 3, 2, 4) to summon three Paragrimm companions which draw aggro, deal slash status and boost status DPS.
4. Activate Noctua (press 1) and either use it to deal DPS or as a primer/utility depending on your preference. If you are focusing on Tragedy for AOE nuking, use Noctua as a viral primer/ability buffer.
5. Use Tragedy to nuke enemies in approximately 40m cone range (cast two Dark Verse followed by Final Verse: 3, 3, 4). This will force a total of four slash statuses before compressing approx 4-6s of remaining slash status into one instance, then multiplying it.

**Variants**

_None described._

**Strengths & weaknesses**

- **Strengths:** squad-wide value (buffs / heals / CC); safe to play.
- **Weaknesses:** low solo kill speed; contribution drops in a squad that doesn't need it.

**Build overview**

General use Steel path Harrow build using his full kit to provide shield regen for shield gating, high range of crowd control, energy regen for the team, reload/fire rate buffs and long duration covenant for both invulnerability window (i-frames) and crit buff.

Update 34: Harrow has indirectly been buffed by shield gating changes, since Condemn allows you to gain overshields basically every cast, meaning you can gain more shield gate i-frames than previously allowed. Currently Overshields count meaning hitting 1150 overshield with Condemn gives 2.5s shield gate, even WITHOUT Primed Redirection. Once this is fixed, Harrow will instead get 2s of gate unless you slot Redirection. Having Augur mods allows you to generate small amounts of shields for a tiny gate (about 0.5s) even if enemies are out of range of Condemn, for extra backup gating.

Designed for: Steel Path endurance, Survival, Farming / loot. The source guide does not spell out where it underperforms; as a support build the usual tradeoff applies (see Strengths & weaknesses).

**Core build concept**

A **support** Harrow Prime setup: high Strength (1.99×), long Duration (2.07×), wide Range (1.75×), negative Efficiency (0.45×). Its engine is the combination in the mod configuration above — Blind Rage, Augur Reach, Stretch, Primed Flow, Augur Message, aura Corrosive Projection, Arcane Concentration + Molt Augmented. See the written sections below for the intended damage/defence loop.

**Key stats & breakpoints**

**Duration**

Duration benefits all abilities meaning less energy is spent overall, less time spent micromanaging ability casts to refresh buffs and longer i-frames from covenant.

**Efficiency**

Minimum efficiency paired with Primed Flow is fine for Harrow since Thurible will give us a consistent source of energy regeneration and most abilities will have a long duration.

**Range**

High range is useful for crowd control from Condemn and the aura of Thurible so your team can benefit from energy Regen. This is the most flexible stat based on your preference. You can add Narrow Minded over Augur Reach if you prefer much longer duration in low level missions where crowd control is not as necessary.

**Strength**

High strength benefits all of Harrow's abilities but there are no strength breakpoints required to make each ability function well. Having higher strength makes it slightly easier to cap overshields with 1, give a higher penance buff, give slightly more energy from thurible and makes it easier to Reach critical cap of 50% on Covenant.

**Modding notes**

The guide does not break down individual mods. Defining picks appear to be: Blind Rage, Augur Reach, Stretch, Primed Flow, Augur Message. Slots holding basic drift/utility or resistance mods are the flexible ones.

**Helminth**

Harrow's kit is generally full and synergistic so helminth is usually unnecessary. Here are some interesting options to try nevertheless:

**Arcanes, Aura & Exilus**

Completely flexible and up to you. Arcanes that proc off headshots synergize well since Harrow is all about getting headshots.

Warframe arcanes:
Molt Efficiency gives free extra duration with shields active, which is easy to maintain with Condemn.
Molt Vigor/Molt Augmented gives free extra strength to boost penance/thurible.
Arcane Pistoleer gives ammo efficiency on headshots with your secondary
Arcane Consequence gives lots of parkour velocity on headshots
Arcane Rage/Precision

**Archon Shards**

Totally up to personal preference, but adding 2 or more Amber shards allows you to drop Natural Talent for one of the other flexible options.

**Survivability & failure conditions**

Not detailed. Survivability comes from whatever defensive mods/abilities are in the configuration above; the guide does not state what breaks it.

**Energy economy**

Efficiency sits at 0.45× per the stats line. No dedicated energy source is called out.

**Playstyle & rotation**

1. Channel Thurible when you have enough starting enough pool to hit higher energy regen per kill. You want to hit at least 30-40 energy/kill (e. .about 3 seconds), so each headshot kill gives you about 100 energy, but leave enough leftover energy to cast Condemn at least once for safety. When you need to refresh Thurible in the middle of battle, simply use i-frames from either Rolling Guard (3s) or Covenant and channel while invincible. You can also press 3 and 4 at the same time, so you are immortal while channeling Thurible, and you can fit two full rotations of covenant (33s) into roughly one thurible time (64s+3s channel).
2. Spam Condemn whenever possible for crowd control and overshield generation, which also makes getting headshots much easier.
3. Use Penance when at high overshields while invulnerable (with Rolling Guard or covenant) then immediately regenerate shields with Condemn OR cast Condemn first and immediately cast penance, which will use up your overshields while condemn refills your shields simultaneously so you never drop down to zero shield.
4. Use Covenant when near enemies and absorb damage to convert into crit chance buff. You only need to prevent approximately 2000 damage to hit maximum buff.
5. Land headshots whenever possible to regenerate more energy and see red crits.

**Variants**

_None described._

**Strengths & weaknesses**

- **Strengths:** squad-wide value (buffs / heals / CC); safe to play.
- **Weaknesses:** low solo kill speed; contribution drops in a squad that doesn't need it.

- Streamline- if you have issues with energy economy despite Thurible

- Narrow Minded - significant increase duration so less reactivation of abilities is required. if you use narrow minded, need to add overextended to counterbalance range drop and maybe umbral intensify to counterbalance strength drop.
- Tribunal augment - use this if you also want to play a support role for your team by sharing the buffs of penance and thurible.

*Rolling Guard* - preferred in high level/SP missions for status cleanse and more i-frames in addition to covenant. If you don't like this or need it, can swap for:

*Aura*

This is only recommended in lower levels where crowd control is not as crucial to survival. You can drop range if you subsume away condemn for pillage.

- Silence - universally useful crowd control that stuns enemies for 2s, which can be refreshed on rentering range, giving you breathing room before casting condemn. Also disables special abilities of enemies, including acolyte abilities (even violence).
- Gloom - doesn't actually synergize well with Harrow's kit since you cannot regenerate energy from Thurible while gloom is draining, and slowed enemies shoot you less for covenant. You can however turn gloom off when you need to regenerate energy on demand and use Lasting Covenant to keep the crit buff activate at all times.

Weapons that have special bonuses on headshots or weapons with extreme critical multipliers synergize well with Harrow's need for headshots and covenant's flat crit chance boost.

**Build overview**

This can be used in general starchart, base steelpath or endurance steel path/arbitrations.

Nourish, Eclipse or Roar are the best general DPS helminth options to use. Nourish in particular applies bonus Viral damage to both weapons AND breach surge sparks while also also giving energy multiplier to sustain a shield gating playstyle while at 45% effficiency.

**Core build concept**

A **support** Wisp Prime setup: high Strength (2.67×), long Duration (2.07×), wide Range (1.45×), negative Efficiency (0.45×). Its engine is the combination in the mod configuration above — Augur Message, Umbral Intensify, Augur Secrets, Equilibrium, Blind Rage, aura Worthy Comradery, Arcane Concentration + Arcane Crepuscular. See the written sections below for the intended damage/defence loop.

**Key stats & breakpoints**

**Duration**

Keep duration high (at least 150% or more) so you can stay invisible for longer. Adding molt efficiency is optional but increases final Duration to 187%. This helps with uptime of Mote buffs, invisibility duration of Wil-o-Wisp and Nourish/Eclipse which are most important. The duration for Breach Surge stun is less important due to its very long base duraiton.

**Efficiency**

All of Wisp's abilities apart form Sol Gate have a relatively low cost so you can get away with negative efficiency (45-75%). Primed Flow or Equilibrium are both optional and up to preference. If you run Nourish, Arcane Energize or Emergence Dissipate, you will be able to fill Wisp's large base energy pool easily allowing you to have many more casts. You can also alternatively just run Streamline or even neither energy mods depending on your preference.

**Range**

Range can be positive to very high (145-235%) so Breach Surge has a high stun radius (especially on open maps like Circuit), shock motes have a high stun radius and Nourish retaliation covers a wider area. Adjust this to your preference. If you prefer maximium duration for wil-o-wisp you could put narrow minded over augur secrets.

**Strength**

Strength is the main stat to build high (250-350%) for high Haste mote buff, health mote buff, Breach Surge multiplier and helminth ability multiplier.

**Modding notes**

The guide does not break down individual mods. Defining picks appear to be: Augur Message, Umbral Intensify, Augur Secrets, Equilibrium, Blind Rage. Slots holding basic drift/utility or resistance mods are the flexible ones.

**Helminth**

- Nourish: Has multiple benefits
1. Gives around raw viral damage boost to you and your teammates, which is additive to other elemental mods on your weapons. This means you can drop viral mods on many of your weapons.
2. Gives around raw viral damage boost to Breach Surge (semi double dipping it) and Breach Surge sparks now deal viral damage which further receive a 1.5x multiplier against corrupted enemies
3. Getting hit or causing self damage via Combat Discipline activates an AOE forced viral status with brief stagger (for mild crowd control) with a 2s cooldown with approximate radius of 14 to 28m.
4. Gives an energy multiplier from all sources which allows Archon Stretch to generate more energy passively.

- Eclipse: Eclipse gives only 30% buff at base helminth strength, however, Eclipse still boosts Breach Surge sparks and also double dips melees like Glaives and Contagion meaning if you want to specifically buff a Glaive setup like Xoris, Falcor, Glaive Prime, you could still use Eclipse. At 300% strength, Eclipse double dips Contagion and Glaives for a 3.61x final damage multiplier and therefore multiplies final breach surge sparks created by Contagion by 6.85x. Use Eclipse for Exodia Contagion while using Melee Duplicate.

- Roar: More consistent multiplier that double dips DoT effects AND applies buff to your allies, but with lower maximum raw damage potential. At 300% str, Roar only has a 2x multiplier, meaning Breach Surge receives only a 4x multiplier. Roar also does not double dip Exodia Contagion or Glaives, but does triple dip melee influence procs, so use this when using Falcor/Xoris.

- Wrathful Advance: boosts melee crit chance if you choose to use contagion/glaives, but does not affect breach surge.

- Pillage: Strips Armor/Shields, Cleanses status effects and restores shields. You either need 400% strength to Reach one cast full strip armor strip OR just 328% strength with Corrosive Projection (reachable by just adding a few strength shards or power drift in exilus).

- Brightbonnet: You can bounce on it and stay invisible indefinitely while also boosting strength for motes and giving energy to the team

**Arcanes, Aura & Exilus**

Completely flexible options:
- Arcane Crepuscular: gives 30% strength and 3x flat crit dmg, requires you to keep 2 invisibility active or jump and use melees
- Arcane Arachne: boosts breach surge sparks by 2.5x and double dips exodia contagion/glaives
- Arcane Concentration: 60% duration after cast
- Molt Augmented: 60% strength after 250 kills. Good in longer missions or endurance for even bigger buffs and breach surge/eclipse multipliers.
- Arcane Avenger: flat crit +45%, can be self triggered by combat discipline
- Molt Vigor: Bonus 45% strength but only on one ability cast after going into operator and using an operator ability. Can be useful to lock higher Reservoir buffs and Eclipse buff since you don't need to cast these very often.
- Molt Efficiency: Bonus 36% duration
- Arcane Energize: If you don't run Nourish and need energy.

Amber Shards: 1 tauforged cast speed shard speeds up casts of all abilities
Rest are preference and flexible:

- Amber Shards: Parkour velocity for mobility
Personally I run 2 parkour and 2 duration shards

**Survivability & failure conditions**

Not detailed. Survivability comes from whatever defensive mods/abilities are in the configuration above; the guide does not state what breaks it.

**Energy economy**

Efficiency sits at 0.45× per the stats line. The build/guide references an energy source — see mods/overview.

**Playstyle & rotation**

**Alternate tanking playstyle**

If you prefer NOT to shield gate or be invisible and prefer passive tankiness, simply put Arcane Guardian for armor and Adaptation over Catalyzing Shield. Vitality mote provides health for eHP.

1. Cycle Reservoirs by tapping 1 (unless running Fused Reservoir) and plant one of each by holding 1. Haste motes and Shock motes will be your most important ones to use. Haste motes buff your movespeed, melee speed and weapon fire rate. Shock motes are your major source of crowd control. Vitality mote is less important in Steel Path and endurance with shield gating but the healing and health buff can be useful when required, or for team setups. Remember Reservoirs have *infinite* duration so on a static map or with camping you simply lay down up to 6 reservoirs and never cast them again, just run through to pick up motes as needed.

2. Stay invisible by either jumping or tapping 2 whenever you can. Whenever your shields break, tap Wil-o-Wisp (2) once to go invisible, create a decoy and fully reset shield gate. If you are afflicted by a damaging status (e.g. toxin, heat, slash) or are surrounded by enemies and damaging AOE effects (e.g napalm), double tap 2 to gain 3s of i-frames. You may need to repeat this to wait out the status procs (default duration 6s). This is basically Rolling Guard but without status cleanse or cooldown. With THREE augur mods on frame and TWO augur mods mod on a secondary or sentinel secondary, a single cast of Wil-o-Wisp generates 108 shield at 45% efficiency, which gives 0.8s shield gate without Catalyzing Shields, while Breach Surge gives 0.92s iframes. If you add Catalyzing Shields over Augur Message or Secrets, you can gain 1.33s now from pressing either 2 or 3, without needing a pistol. This is optional. Rolling Guard is also optional if you prefer to clear statuses instantly.

3. Cast Breach Surge to blind enemies (requires line of sight). Shoot blinded enemies (doesn't have to be in the glowing spot) to generate breach surge sparks (10% on hit and 100% on death). Each spark will take the weapon damage that caused the spark, multiply it by around 5-6x and deal that in radiation damage (with potential to headshot). Nourish will apply Viral damage to breach surge sparks. You can also teleport to motes by casting 3 on them, which will double the radius of breach surge. Casting Breach Surge while 2 is active will also duplicate breach surge at the clone location.

4. If you replace Sol Gate with Nourish/Eclipse, then simply keep Nourish/Eclipse active.

5. Take advantage of Wisp's passive by jumping repeatedly in the air to stay invisible.

**Variants**

_None described._

**Strengths & weaknesses**

- **Strengths:** squad-wide value (buffs / heals / CC); safe to play.
- **Weaknesses:** low solo kill speed; contribution drops in a squad that doesn't need it.
_(Archetype-level; the source guide gives no explicit list.)_

**Patch / update history (from the guide)**

**UPDATE JAN 2025**

**WEAPONS***
Wisp's passive of invisibility while airborne is broken by shooting primary and secondary weapons, but not broken by melee attacks. This includes ranged melee attacks that work well while jumping, including Glaives and Exodia Contagion. Note if using Contagion, you will want to subsume Eclipse for maximum damage.

**EXODIA CONTAGION ZAW**

Exodia Contagion is an arcane that can be attached on a modular melee weapon called a Zaw. A single RANK 0 copy of Exodia Contagion is all you actually need in day to day use, as increasing the rank of contagion does not really provide noticeable benefit since it only affects how much damage you do AFTER it travels 30m (which is a HUGE distance). To use contagion, you need to double jump or bullet jump into the air then aim glide then attack. This will launch a projectile that direct hits for 2x damage and also explodes on impact dealing 5x damage in 8m. The direct hit component has 'multiplicative Condition Overload' meaning Condition Overload multiplies with Primed Pressure Point and priming a single enemy before launching contagion will result in HUGE damage, and can also headshot and headcrit. The AOE component has NO benefit from Condition Overload and cannot headshot either. It is up to you whether you want to run Condition Overload for huge numbers on single targets or no Condition Overload for pure AOE.

### 8. Mirage Prime — Total Malevolence Mirage | Dual Augment Max DPS Weapon Platform | Solo Steel Path

**Type:** Support · **Difficulty:** Advanced · **Investment:** High

**Build overview**

While the classic hall of mirrors build uses the *Hall Of Malevolence* augment to increase the damage of Mirage's holograms, the often overlooked *Total Eclipse* augment actually does work on holograms and provides a much more substantial boost to hologram damage provided the lighting conditions are bright. In fact, with high enough power strength while in maximum lighting, Mirage's holograms under the effect of Total Eclipse outdamage the player under the effect of eclipse. This is further magnified by using both augments in the same build since their effects are multiplicative. At maximum lighting and maximum stacks, each hologram does approximately 9 times more damage. Since each hologram does approx 60% of weapon damage at 300% str, the total of four clones is 240% weapon damage, which is redistrbuted over 2 holograms when using primary/secondary weapons so each hologram actually does does 120% weapon damage. Boosting this by 9x means each hologram does a maximum possible of 1080% weapon damage!

**Update March 2025** - Due to the armor/health changes, armor strip from Pillage is no longer really necessary and a more passive and easy method of survivability over Pillage is passive shield recharge. This combined with staying mobile, killing fast and innate dodge from hall of mirrors helps you survive without actively casting abilities to gate. The subsume helminth is very flexible and you can tailor to your preference e.g. Nourish gives free viral for weapons and boosts energy, Wrathful Advance buffs melees, Omamori makes the passive survivability even more chill.

**Core build concept**

A **support** Mirage Prime setup: high Strength (1.99×), long Duration (1.99×), tight Range (0.34×), negative Efficiency (0.45×). See the written sections below for the intended damage/defence loop.

**Key stats & breakpoints**

**Strength**

Strength boosts Eclipse, Total Eclipse and the damage, critical chance and status chance of Hall of Mirrors. We want to hit at least 250% strength so Hall of Mirrors clones have equivalent damage and crit/status stats to your equipped weapon.

**Duration**

Decent duration achieved with Narrow Minded + archon shards allows an upkeep on both Hall of Mirrors and Eclipse of almost one minute which is very comfortable.

**Range**

Narrow Minded reduces the range to 34%, which reduces the range of Total Eclipse to 5m, enough to encompass the holograms but not enough to be helpful in co-op situations. If you want to provide a little more support in co-op play, you can increase the range with Overextended or Stretch.

**Efficiency**

While 45% efficiency seems low, keep in mind you only need to cast 1 and 3 roughly once every minute and recast Nourish if needed, while Nourish also boosts all energy gained so you should always have enough to recast your abilities.

**Modding notes**

The guide does not break down individual mods. Defining picks appear to be: Hall of Malevolence, Total Eclipse, Vigilante Vigor, Fast Deflection, Rolling Guard. Slots holding basic drift/utility or resistance mods are the flexible ones.

**Helminth**

**Subsumed Ability**

You can subsume over either 2 or 4. I have subsumed Nourish over 2 here because you can share a Nourish subsume with a Prism build.

- *Nourish* is a great choice that solves any energy issues while also providing free viral damage to your weapons (meaning you can drop viral mods if running viral HM or viral heat builds).
- *Omamori* offers an additional layer of lazy survivability that makes Mirage even harder to kill for little effort. If you run Omamori, you can drop Catalyzing Shields for Primed Continuity. This is because Omamori can refill shields on negating damage to overshields, which can give up to 2.5s i-frame instead of the locked 1.33s gate from catalyzing shields.
- *Pillage* (from Hildryn) is an amazing ability for high strength glass cannon Mirage since it provides a form of shield recovery for shield gating and FULL armor/shield strip in one cast.
- *Wrathful Advance* lets your melee red crit, e.g. espeecially when using Glaives or Contagion
- *Energized Munitions* is amazing when you want to spam something for non-stop damage, but doesn't apply to incarnon modes
- *Evade* is another survivability option but requires consistent headshot upkeep. If you run this you can drop all the shield recharge mods and catalyzing shields and pump more duration and strength (primed continuity, augur message, umbral intensify)
- *Breach Surge* gives a line of sight blind for decent crowd control and relases sparks on death that is a multiple of damage done. Eclipse double dips this spark potentially creating insane amounts of damage. If you use this, you can run a much more balanced build as follows:
- *Spellbind* gives status and knockdown immunity, particularly useful if you don't own primed sure footed but want to use AOE weapons
- *Molt* gives speed boost and draws enemy fire. Good for speedrunning.
- *Null Star* can combine with health/Adaptation for lazy tanking but needs even more duration (drop Transient Fortitude). Not really recommended since you waste lots of mod slots and need augment to refresh stars if you lose them. You can swap strength for duration (Transient Fortitude for Primed Continuity) in order to hit the 90% DR cap, which can multiply with the 90% DR from eclipse to give 99% DR to health. Add Adaptation and guardian if you like for even more DR, exceeding 99.95%.

**PASSIVE SHIELD GATING/RECHARGE**

Currently Catalyzing Shields causes any amount of shield gained to give the full 1.33s shield gate (likely bug). This means gaining even 1 shield before taking damage again should give another 1.33s gate. If you run Fast Deflection with Vigilante Vigor, you can reduce the shield recharge delay to 1s. If you take any damage during the 1.33s shield gate, it will reset the delay timer back to 1s, meaning once you come out of a shield gate you have approximately anywhere between 0s to 1s before shields start regenerating again depending on when you last got "hit". If you can avoid being hit at during that 0 to 1s time frame, you can be effectively immortal to non-toxin damage. Hall of Mirrors causes enemies to miss which significantly reduces the change of you being hit in that time frame. Additional layers of optional protection include Arcane Aegis (when this procs you get 12 full seconds of effective immortality), Omamori which has a 50% chance to block damage and restore shields to overshield, Guardian on a sentinel which regenerates shields on break with a cooldown and Secondary Fortifier on a pistol. Rolling Guard finally also gives you more i-frames to bridge that gap but with a cooldown.

**Build overview**

General Use Steel Path and Endurance viable Hybrid weapon platform + sunder Gauss build for utilising all base abilities with a focus on using weapons to deal damage, cold sunder to crowd control enemies + build redline and heat sunder to strip and deal AOE damage. Mach Rush provides fast map traversal, battery charge and light CC + AOE damage. Kinetic Plating gives complete knockdown/stagger immunity, near complete status immunity and up to 100% damage reduction to impact, puncture, slash, cold, heat and blast damage at max battery, as well as energy generation on taking damage. Thermal Sunder is an amazing ability that allows you to hard crowd control enemies with freeze (at full redline) or soft CC with cold procs/heat procs, do scaling nuking with heat sunder spam or at full redline perform full armor strip in AOE by combining one heat and one cold sunder into blast (any order). Redline gives multiple buffs to fire rate, melee speed, reload speed and holster speed in addition to several bonus synergies for the other abilities such as half cost of mach Rush, melee damage bonus and stagger bonus to kinetic plating.

**Intended content — best at / less suited for**

Designed for: Level Cap, Steel Path endurance, Farming / loot. The source guide does not spell out where it underperforms; as a tank build the usual tradeoff applies (see Strengths & weaknesses).

**Core build concept**

A **tank** Gauss Prime setup: low Strength (1×), long Duration (1.55×), wide Range (1.75×), neutral Efficiency (1.3×). Its engine is the combination in the mod configuration above — Stretch, Streamline, Thermal Transfer, Archon Vitality, Equilibrium, aura Sprint Boost, Arcane Ice Storm + Arcane Concentration. See the written sections below for the intended damage/defence loop.

**Key stats & breakpoints**

**Duration**

Duration is the most important stat since it determines how long Kinetic Plating and Redline stay active as well as all redline buffs. Duration also affects the drain of Mach Rush and the heat proc duration of Thermal Sunder, which directly translates into overall sunder damage. Primed Continuity, Augur Message, Constitution and Molt Efficiency gives a duration of 243%. Adding optional 4 to 5 tauforged duration shards can give up to 318% duration total.

**Efficiency**

We can keep efficiency neutral at 100% or add Streamline to get 130%, because you only need to recast 2 and 4 once every 1.5 minutes roughly and Mach Rush is extremely cheap to cast. Thermal Sunder spam is the only ability that has significant impact to energy economy, but Gauss also has innate energy regeneration from absorbing damage via kinetic plating. This combined with Arcane Energize means it is very easy to go back to max energy quickly. Seismic Bond on a companion can also give a consistent source of free efficiency. Streamline is then flexible for more duration (eg Nira's Hatred) or Rolling Guard.

Backup sources of energy include Equilibrium with Synth Deconstruct, Dethcube with Energy Generator, Grimoire with Xata's Invocation, Emergence Dissipate, Zenurik Wellspring.

**Range**

Range is used mainly to boost Thermal Sunders range so you can have high area crowd control as well as high area AOE armor strip + nuke. High range also slightly benefits Mach Rush impact radius which can deal minor damage but also cause knockback and light CC. Anywhere between 145 to 235+ range is reasonable depending on the tileset. If you prefer more range, simply swap Augur Message or Augur Reach out for Overextended, and use Molt Augmented. Cunning Drift is also optional over Rush.

**Strength**

We need to keep strength at or above 100% so Kinetic Plating maintains 100% damage reduction at max redline. Strength does directly affect Thermal Sunder but we don't need to go overboard since Thermal Sunder is so strong with exponential scaling and in built armor strip, it kills sufficiently fast at only 100% strength. Strength otherwise is not extremely important as it only provides minor boosts to the damage of mach Rush and redline projectiles. If you run overextended, you just need to use Molt Augmented to bring it back to 100% or the Grimoire Strength mod.

**Modding notes**

The guide does not break down individual mods. Defining picks appear to be: Stretch, Streamline, Thermal Transfer, Archon Vitality, Equilibrium. Slots holding basic drift/utility or resistance mods are the flexible ones.

**Helminth**

Roar (over 1) - general weapon damage and ability damage increase (double dips DoT effects like heat) and boosts the damage of thermal sunder again (for triple dip).
Energized Munitions (over 3) - allows weapon spam in redline without needing to reload constantly. See dedicated weapon platform build.

**Arcanes, Aura & Exilus**

- Arcane Concentration: 60% duration after casting abilities
- Molt Efficiency : adds +36% extra duration
- Arcane Ice Storm: adds 40% duration and 40% strength, can trigger with cold sunder use and even when you detonate heat with cold
- Arcane Hotshot: up to 300% crit chance for weapons can be activated by thermal sunder heat
- Arcane Pistoleer: for ammo efficiency when using with secondary weapons

**Archon Shards**

5 tauforged duration shards which boosts all of Gauss's abilities.

1 cast speed shard is OPTIONAL to increase speed of recasting redline and make up for low cast speed bonus in initial low battery levels. Once battery is near max redline will give up to 100% cast speed bonus.

**Survivability & failure conditions**

Not detailed. Survivability comes from whatever defensive mods/abilities are in the configuration above; the guide does not state what breaks it.

**Energy economy**

Efficiency sits at 1.3× per the stats line. The build/guide references an energy source — see mods/overview.

**Playstyle & rotation**

You can invert the default settings for thermal sunder so tap becomes heat sunder if you prefer.

1. Activate 2 and 4 as soon as possible and keep refreshed at all times. You can cancel and reactivate when they are close to expiring in a safe location rather than letting them run out in the middle of enemies.

2. Build up battery charge as quickly as possible by using 1 and cold 3 (tap 3 default for cold sunder) to generate +10% battery per cast until you hit 100% with Redline active (i.e. simply casting cold sunder 5 times and mach Rush 5 times maxes the battery). This will give you 100% damage reduction to IPS,cold,heat,blast on Kinetic Plating as well as allow for 100% armor strip on Thermal Sunder. **IMPORTANT NOTE:** Battery level is the blue bar in the right lower corner and does NOT have a numerical indicator. The Redline level is an entirely SEPARATE numerical number given by the percentage to the left of the battery bar. Your goal is to simply keep your battery ABOVE the horizontal red line (marks 80% battery) or ideally at 100% battery which will cause your 'Redline' % to steadily grow to 100%, with fastest growth at 100% battery. Note this rate of growth is limited by your duration (takes 1/3 of you duration minimum to hit 100%), and is not really affected by how often you spam 1 or 3 once you are already at 100% battery. Once you hit 100% redline, your battery will no longer drain at all.

3. Absorb damage to generate energy while Kinetic Plating is active, although note you will lose battery when this happens before you hit 100% redline.

4. Spam 1 and run into enemies into walls to knock enemies around for light CC and to generate battery. Melee attack to generate battery or shoot enemies to kill them.

5. When BELOW MAX REDLINE: Tap 1 to mach Rush and  ap 3 (default cold) to create zones of cold that can crowd control enemies (tap once for cold proc to slow, tap twice for full freeze or full freeze with one tap at 100% redline) and generate battery. Once you are at 100% battery, but below max redline, you can alternate casts of ONE HEAT SUNDER (-10% battery), followed by quick tapping ONE MACH Rush (+10% to bring back to 100%), followed by ONE COLD SUNDER to full strip and group enemies. The amount of armor stripped depends on the proportion of the last 20% of battery unlocked during Redline (i.e. 80% battery is 0 out of 20% meaning 0% armor strip, 90% battery is 50% strip and 100% battery is 100% strip). Since you are constantly losing battery, dropping 1% below 100%  battery before max redline means you may only be stripping 95% armor on combining cold after using heat and mach Rush. Using Corrosive Projection actually reduces the required battery level for full strip to be 82% of the last 20% of battery i.e. 96.4% of total battery, basically guaranteeing a single cast full strip everytime you perform the HEAT, MACH Rush, COLD combo. Performing this combo basically maintains near 100% battery to allow redline to continue to grow, while also offering max buffs, armor strip and grouping even before max redline.

6. Once you hit MAX REDLINE, you can no longer lose battery meanig you can now spam as many heat sunders in a row as you like. Hold (or tap if inverted) 3 multiple times to create heat procs (eg 2-3 times), followed by tapping 3 to combine heat + cold to full strip enemies, suck them towards you and convert the heat procs into blast to nuke the full-stripped enemies. Thermal Sunder has exponential scaling so that each heat sunder cast doubles all current heat procs.
