**Patch / update history (from the guide)**

**UPDATE JULY 2024**

The new Arcane Ice Storm can give +40% strength and duration and can be easily triggered by casts of Cold sunder, and even triggers when Cold Sunder combines with Heat sunder to make Blast, as long as the enemy doesn't die straight away.

**ARCHON VITALITY/VEILBREAKER UPDATE**

Archon Vitality now doubles heat procs which significantly increases the output/scaling of Thermal Sunder (since the fused blast damage increases with the number of heat procs). If you are using shield gating, you can use a rank 0 Archon Vitality to save mod capacity. If you are using health tanking, you can use a max rank Archon Vitality.

**Additional notes from the guide**

**Companion**

A sentinel with Seismic Bond can trigger a free +30% efficiency  because mach rush, kinetic plating and redline all act as a Channeled ability.

Carrier - for ammo issues when you spam weapons:
Dethcube - helps generate energy orbs:
Nautilus - helps group enemies passively:

- Corrosive Projection: Additively strips 18% armor, meaning you need to be at 82% of the last 20% battery i.e. above 96.4% to full strip in one cast. What this means is you don't need to be at exactly 100% battery while not at max redline to allow heat sunder to one cast strip after a cold sunder or for cold sunder to one cast strip after a heat proc, giving more consistent single cast strips at all times.
- Brief Respite: Optional for generating more shields for shield gating
- Sprint Boost : stacks with rush to mach rush even faster
- Enemy Radar : for tracking enemy spawns, stacks with primed animal instinct and passive radar

**Blast Expedite**

Stacking heat procs from a heat DPS weapon then using cold sunder compresses all the heat proc damage into a single blast instance and applies it after stripping armor. You can easily hit 100k - 1 million or even damage cap if the enemy doesn't die first. For example, you could use a heat DPS beam like Furis incarnon, Miter incarnon, Kuva Nukor, Phage, Phantasma to stack 500 heat procs then 'detonate' it with a cold sunder. You can even combine this with a heat inherit primer to maximise damage. This is a meme way to kill strong targets like demolysts and thrax units.

OPTION 1: Shield Gating for a hyperactive playstyle
This is recommended for steel path endurance. You will rely on a combination of 100% damage reduction to certain damage types while at 100% battery as well as shield gating with shield generation from brief respite/augur mods achieved by spamming mach Rush and thermal sunder, crowd control from cold sunder and finally increased passive shield recharge from redline. With Brief Respite, TWO augur mods on frame and up to TWO additional augur mods on a pistol, each cast of Thermal Sunder can generate up to 108 shields, which gives approximately 1.2s shield gate i-frames with Catalyzing Shields on (or about 0.6s iframes without). Without Brief Respite, we can generate about 56 shields which equates to about 0.8-1s shield gate (note, it is likely you will generate sufficient shields before taking damage while spamming 1 and 3). Catalyzing Shields is an entirely flexible addition to gain more i-frames per cast. Rolling Guard is also a flexible option for i-frames, although i prefer to use Vazarin Protective Sling for i-frames instead.

OPTION 2: Quick Thinking Tanking
This is a meme option for lazy tanking base steel path/non-endurance. Quick Thinking uses energy as health pool once you hit 2hp. Kinetic Plating converts damage into energy. This allows you to to stay practically immortal while Kinetic Plating is active since you constantly create the energy you lose. You will eventually get one-shot by an instance of damage that surpasses the total ehp pool, which can be increased with Adaptation and armor. Swap Streamline for Adaptation, Augur Reach for Quick Thinking and Arcane Energize for Arcane Guardian.

OPTION 3: Fast Deflection + Arcane Aegis (probably a bug)
Exceeding the recharge delay reduction through Gauss's passive and Fast Deflection then triggering Arcane Aegis once allows an "aegis" effect to persistently trigger subsequently, making you immortal to all non-toxin damage without hitting 100% battery. This is probably a bug and could be patched at an unknown time. If you want to use this simply drop Streamline or Augur Message for Fast Deflection and one of the Arcanes for Aegis.

**Exilius**

- Rush : sprint speed affects mach rush speed
- Vigilante pursuit : alternative to enemy radar
- Cunning Drift: for more range

Strength is required for the damage of Balefire, the strip amount of Pillage, the damage and bonus shield capacity of Haven. Note that you don't necessarily want to full strip armor in one cast because then subsequent casts of Pillage will not return shields from full-stripped enemies (which is essentially energy for Hildryn).

**BUILD VARIANTS**

- Molt Hildryn:

The two main options for surviving depend on what type of content you want to play.

1. CASUAL STEEL PATH
For base steel path and below, casual tanking should be sufficient for you. Using Adaptation will increase your effective shield HP to over 50,000 at max. Note armor does NOT affect damage reduction on shields, so there is no need to add any armor mods or shards. Arcane Aegis and/or Arcane Barrier can improve this even further allowing you to often regenerate shields faster than you take damage even without spamming Pillage.

2. ENDURANCE STEEL PATH
For endurance runs (e.g. level 500-1000 and higher), enemies can easily deplete all your shields in seconds or in one hit despite adaptation and max shields. Luckily Hildryn has a special passive where she gains 3s of i-frames when shields break. Shield recharge delay is only 1s and she can regenerate shields at approximately 300 shield/s, meaning you will be able to cast Pillage again by the third second before i-frames end. Pillage lasts either 2.6s or you can end it early. If you use Rolling Guard near the end of your 3s i-frames you will get another 3s of i-frames which should give you enough buffer time to safely cast Pillage and regain all shields to reset your shield gate. You can also stack Vazarin protective dash on top of this for 5s of i-frames on demand with NO cooldown. Running Raksa Kubrow should also passively restore shields consistently. Also consider swapping Arcane Expertise for Arcane Aegis.

**OPERATOR**

**Key stats & breakpoints**

**Duration**

Positive duration is required for the uptime of all abilities so you can adjust this to be higher if you prefer to recast things less. For example, you can swap Transient Fortitude for Umbral Intensify and add duration shards.

Archon Stretch can trigger off either 1 or 4 and gives a free bit of energy regeneration. If you decide to subsume over 4, you should just drop range for Narrow Minded.

Strength boosts the Shock Trooper buff and Speed buff and affects the damage of Discharge,  but does not affect Shield. In higher levels the damage of Discharge falls off quite a bit so strength is primarily needed for your weapon buffs.

**Core build concept**

A **ability dps** Ash Prime setup: high Strength (1.99×), long Duration (2.265×), tight Range (0.79×), neutral Efficiency (1×). Its engine is the combination in the mod configuration above — Umbral Intensify, Teleport Rush, Stretch, Transient Fortitude, Equilibrium, aura Steel Charge, Arcane Crepuscular + Arcane Fury. **Key stats & breakpoints**

**Duration**

High duration helps the uptime of smokescreen and wrathful advance so you don't have to recast as often. You can add more duration in if you prefer (e.g. Primed Continuity, Archon Shards).

**Efficiency**

Negative efficiency can be sustainable now because Smokescreen now lasts much longer and can even be renewed by casting 3 (which costs 39 energy at 45% efficiency), while Bladestorm costs 9.3 energy per mark while invisible and is a guaranteed one-shot. With 500 energy you could mark approximately 53 enemies before running draining the whole energy bar which is more enemies than can usually spawn in a room.

You will want to have some source of energy production to help with sustain:
1. Equilibrium: This converts health orbs (50 health) into energy (55 energy per orb). Every Eximius kill guarantees 2 health orb drops which equates to 110 energy. Diriga/Hound/Panzer with Synth Deconstruct can passively prime enemies and make 25% of kills drop health orbs. This means if you mark 20 companion primed enemies and spend 192 energy total to kill them, you will get on average 5 health orbs back which equates to 275 energy. If two of those 20 enemies contains an eximus you will refund a total of 495 energy which is over double what you spent.
2. Grimoire with Xata Invocation: Can give passive energy regen up to 10 energy / second
3. Energy Nexus: for missions with sparse enemies or long periods of downtime in between engaging enemies, you could consider running Energy Nexus instead of or in addition to Equilibrium for passive 3 energy/second.
4. Archon Stretch: Diriga with Arc Coil or Hounds with electric modded can proc this for free passive 2 energy/second
5. Zenurik: Wellspring can give 5 energy/second Regen

**Range**

Bladestorm has a very high base range of 50m which is enough to cover a very large room. You will most likely not need over 70 to 100 range in most tilesets. If you want to Bladestorm in openworld then you may want to increase range to over 200% by adding Overextended and dropping Narrow Minded for Primed Continuity.

**Strength**

Strength is needed for Bladestorm damage and the crit chance boost from Wrathful advance

**Modding notes**

The guide does not break down individual mods. Defining picks appear to be: Umbral Intensify, Teleport Rush, Stretch, Transient Fortitude, Equilibrium. Slots holding basic drift/utility or resistance mods are the flexible ones.

**Helminth**

Not discussed. The build references a subsume — check the overview.

**Arcanes, Aura & Exilus**

- Arcane Crepuscular: while invisible adds 30% strength and flat +3 CD which boosts all weapons and is a huge buff to Bladestorm (which has a low base crit dmg)
- Molt Augmented : boosts strength by 60% after 250 kills, which increases bladestorm damage further and boosts wrathful advance
- Arcane Trickery:  While it has a low chance of 15% and only activates on kill (and not bleed DoT), at the rate at which this build one-shots enemies, you'll find that Trickery is consistently activating every 10-20 kills, or roughly every 5-10 seconds. This provides pretty much permanent invisibility which can NOT be dispelled by nullifiers or acolytes, unlike smoke screen. If for some reason you don't have trickery active, use smokescreen as a buffer. If you want to go this route you could drop duration a bit e.g. change Narrow Minded and Stretch for Primed Continuity + Streamline
- Arcane Fury and Blade Charger both significantly increase bladestorm damage. Use Fury on a melee focused ash loadout and Arcane Blade Charger if you plan on using your primary weapon more.
- Molt Efficiency gives more duration
- Arcane Energize is great for energy Regen since silence costs nearly 100 energy and spamming bladestorm can wear out energy quite fast. Emergence Dissipate may be able to replace this depending on what happens with it.

**Archon Shards**

- Azure Energy Max : At least ONE TAUFORGED shard is needed to hit 500 energy max for doulbing Violet Melee Crit damage bonus. You can add more if you prefer more max energy.
- Violet Melee Crit Damage shard: Boosts both Bladestorm and your melee weapon further, you could add between 2 to 4 of these up to preference ( I prefer 2)
- Flexibe e.g. Crimson Duration : Put the remainder of free shard slots into duration as this improves uptime of both Wrathful Advance and Smokescreen, up to preference (I prefer 2), or into strength, parkour velocity etc

**Build overview**

This is a general use Nidus build for boosting critical chance (particularly on primary weapons), high range larva for grouping, high range link so you can be somewhat mobile and parasitic link for status immunity. Virulence spam is used for stack gain, energy gain, crit chance boost and even low level DPS. This build is best used in more stationary situations with high enemy density (e.g. Solo survival) since you need to gain stacks and constantly link enemies.

Maximum strength Roar Variant :

**Intended content — best at / less suited for**

Designed for: Steel Path, Survival. The source guide does not spell out where it underperforms; as a ability dps build the usual tradeoff applies (see Strengths & weaknesses).

**Core build concept**

A **ability dps** Nidus Prime setup: moderate Strength (1.54×), long Duration (1.55×), wide Range (2.35×), negative Efficiency (0.45×). Its engine is the combination in the mod configuration above — Teeming Virulence, Parasitic Vitality, Larva Burst, Stretch, Hunter Adrenaline, aura Corrosive Projection, Arcane Persistence + Arcane Bellicose. See the written sections below for the intended damage/defence loop.

**Key stats & breakpoints**

**Duration**

Duration is primarily for Link uptime so you don't need to recast it as often, and secondarily for Ravenous. Not useful for 1 or 2.

**Efficiency**

Lowest efficiency is fine for Nidus since 1 costs 62, 2 and 3 costs 39 and 4 costs no energy and 1 even refunds energy, gaining tons energy when efficiency is low and you hit many enemies. Hunter Adrenaline is OPTIONAL for easy energy regen in case you miss virulence or somehow run out of energy and desperately need to cast larva/virulence. However, you can always maintain your energy with careful management of the 2 +1 combo, only casting virulence when there are at least 5 enemies within the larva (Each enemy refunds 15.5 energy, so hitting 5 enemies refunds 78 energy. You only need to hit 12 enemies to fill the total capacity of your energy pool from 0 energy without Primed Flow. If you run Primed Flow, you need to hit approximately 33 enemies to refill the whole pool from zero).

**Range**

Range is essential for larva to pull as many enemies as possible from across the map. Range also helps maggot explosions and maximising the link distance on mobile missions. High range is slightly detrimental to virulence since you need to wait for it to end before casting again, but you can aim into walls if possible to shorten this and spam virulence. Once you hit max stacks, you only need to use virulence every 10s or so to refresh Teeming Virulence and any lost stacks.

**Strength**

Strength scales the damage of 1, damage of Larva Burst, parasitic vitality health bonus, strength bonus and damage boost and the crit chance boost of Teeming Virulence.

**Modding notes**

The guide does not break down individual mods. Defining picks appear to be: Teeming Virulence, Parasitic Vitality, Larva Burst, Stretch, Hunter Adrenaline. Slots holding basic drift/utility or resistance mods are the flexible ones.

**Helminth**

Nidus has a reasonably synergistic kit so is best run without helminth.
If you really want to subsume something, you will subsume over 4

- Nourish - gives viral dmg boost, viral status on damage and energy boost

- Tharros Strike - full shield and armor strip a 200% str, very good into larva since it strips in a cone which hits the entire Larva easily
- Breach Surge - minor crowd control and damaging sparks

**Playstyle & rotation**

1. Cast 2 to group enemies, making sure you catch at least 5 enemies at the minimum
2. Cast 1 into the ball of enemies to kill and build stacks, as well as generate energy
3. Once you have a single stack hold 3 to link to your companion or tap 3 on an ally. This will give you a strength boost to you and the linked ally while also boost weapon damage (multiplicative like eclipse).
4. Cast 4 when enough stacks for passive crowd control, healing and some AOE damage
5. Repeat 2 + 1 combo, until you hit max stacks
6. Recast 3 and 4 on expiry
7. Once at max stacks, cast 1 every 10-15s to refresh Teeming Virulence and and regain any lost stacks

**Patch / update history (from the guide)**

**UPDATE JUN 2026**

Nidus got a massive quality of life and health buff. You can now link moving companions and the link persists even if thefy are downed meaning you are not at risk of losing health. He can now get 500 mutation stacks with Abundant Mutation (optional for funny health memes) which paired with Parasitic Vitality gives around 35,000 health which lasts for 70s with arcane persistence. Casting Ravenous heals you and now scales with range so covers a huge area, while the optional Insatiable lets you quickly stack even up to 500 mutation stacks in a short time. Larva Burst has been buffed and can kill enemies quite well.

**UPDATE DEC 2025**

The new arcane, Arcane persistence now limits damage taken to 500 per second if your armor is above 700. Nidus has a high base armor of 525 and can hit 700 with a single Tauforged Azure archon shard (gives +225 armor) or a single armor mod. With Parasitic Vitality and Abundant Mutation you can hit close to 20,000 health at 300 mutation stacks, meaning you could potential stand still for over 30s before healing. Arcane Grace scales healing off max health meaning you can simply outheal any damage you take if your max health exceeds 8334.

**UPDATE APRIL 2024**

The new augment Parasitic Vitality now replaces Vitality, giving an equivalent amount of health after approximately 13 stacks of mutation. At rank 30, 100 stacks and 200 strength, you gain approximately +800% health giving 5850 health. If you slot Abundant Mutation for a meme only (since it is usually very hard to achieve 300 stacks outside of solo survival), you can hit +2400% health giving 16,250 health.

**Additional notes from the guide**

**Flexible Options**

- Rage/Hunter adrenaline  - can be useful if you have energy issues, but 1 can consistently return you to full energy and energy orbs spawn quickly enough. More useful in short missions where enemies are sparse.

- Primed Flow - can also be useful if you have energy issues as an alternative to hunter adrenaline, or even together with it

Augment slot (very flexible as no one augment is mandatory):
- Parasitic Vitality - gives a huge amount of health only after linking enemies or allies, but if you prefer non-conditional health, use vitality or umbral vitality.
- Teeming virulence - boosts crit chance of primary only. don't use this if you don't want to use your primary or your primary has incredibly low base crit chance. If you don't want to use Teeming Virulence, you can reduce the overall power strength to simply exceed the 90%DR threshold of 180% (e.g. remove transient fortitude).
- Insatiable augment - faster stack gain while standing on ravenous (useful if you want to hit 500 stacks asap).
- Larva Burst - allows for decent ability DPS
- Abundant Mutation - Optional for health maxing. Increases stacks to increase 1 damage and scale 3, but gives undying a cooldown, which is no longer a huge issue with arcane persistence. Allows you to maximise health gained from parasitic vitality to over 50k.

Stretch (- slot): If you don't care about such high range,
- Swap for Archon Intensify for even more power strength, which is activated by Ravenous

Exilus slot is completely flexible:
- Toxic Flight/Ice Spring - parkour mobility
- Cunning Drift - for extra range
- Primed sure footed if you don't want to rely on link for knockdown resist
- Power drift - for extra strength

Aura slot is completely flexible and up to what you own:
- Corrosive projection reduces armor by 18% which increases overall damage to armored enemies by 1.8x
- Growing Power for strength
- Steel charge for capacity
- Enemy Radar

**Duration**

Uriel can handle negative efficiency due to Gulphagor priming enemies to drop 6 health and 2 energy orbs every 4s which is equivalent to 430 energy with Equilibrium, refilling the entire energy bar. Range affects Catenachs initial chain range, Demonium's orb explosion radius and most importantly for Brimstone build, the range of Brimstone. If you are instead subsuming over Brimstone, you can effectively run negative range as Demonium orb travel is not affected by range, only the end explosion meaning you will have lower coverage of vulnerability and more single target focus.

Probably the most important stat as it affects the heat and fire rate buffs of Vythelas runes, damage of Brimstone, damage vulnerability of Demonium, shield restore of Remedium, health orb/energy orb drop rate of Gulphagor, slow of Catenach. Archon Intensify works on healing demons which occurs constantly since 3 drains their health and 2 heals health.

**PASSIVE ABILITIES**

Uriel's three passives are three demons Catenach (stays on your left), Gulphagor (middle) and Vythelas (stays on your right) which are constantly active provided they are alive, even if you helminth over their respective abilities. You will want to frequently cast 2 to revive and heal demons.

Killing chained enemies generates Brimstone charge.
2. Gulphagor: the flying demon latches onto enemies in 12m every 4 seconds and puts a huge red mark on their head. Killing this enemy will drop 6 health orbs and 2 energy orbs at 200 str, which equates to 430 energy with Equilibrium on. This means every 4s you potentially generate your entire energy bar from 0, provided you are consistently killing anymarked targets. You probably don't need to pay much attenuation to the mark unless you are desperately low on energy. Killing marked enemies generates Brimstone charge.
3. Vythelas: every 12s this demon will convert a corpse into a floating rune (star inside a circle), which is marked on the minimap as a cross inside a circle. You should aim to pick up these runes as they buff your fire rate and provide a heat damage buff that is equivalent coding wise to Cyte's Heat resupply. Note that currently, it seems the heat buff effects appears to last indefinitely and can even apply to incarnon mode, while the fire rate buff lasts for 10s at base x duration. Picking up runes generates Brimstone charge. To apply heat buff to incarnon modes, you need to interrupt the incarnon transformation by rolling or swapping weapons, then exiting and rentering incarnon form a few times. Once it sticks, its basically permanent (possibly a bug to be both permanent and apply to incarnon modes).

**ACTIVE ABILITIES**

1. Keep 1 active at all times, jump and dodge to fly around very fast. The speed of this scales with parkour velocity and dodge speed (amalgam barrel diffusion).
2. Tap 2 whenever you lose shields or need to turn immortal , and also tap 2 frequently to heal/revive demons. This makes you immortal for the duration of the cast and restores shields and health, scaling with the formula of 50% x max health x strength. In order to restore at least 1150 shield from 0 shield in order to gain the full 2.5s shield gate (not that currently, overshields count for shield gate regardless of max shield capacity), we just need to have Archon Vitality giving 1332 health and at least 173% strength OR 350% strength with no Vitality.
3. Tap 3 constantly to apply an AOE damage vulnerability to increase damage against enemies while also charging Brimstone the fastest of all other sources.
4. Tap 4 to cast Brimstone which covers a huge area with persisting damage effect with guaranteed heat status. This damage increases over time to 10 x 1500 x strength

**BRIMSTONE FOCUS**

Helminth over 1 for a camping pure Brimstone focused build.
- Bright Bonnet: gives energy which helps fuel the high cost playstyle of spamming 3 to charge 4 and also boosts strength for both vulnerability and brimstone damage
- Sickening Pulse: doubles all heat statuses on cast in huge aoe (line of sight)

**WEAPON FOCUS**

Helminth over 4 for a high mobility pure Weapon platform build.
- Thermal Sunder with Thermal Transfer: can add +heat damage if you use heat sunder, which double dips into Vythelas buff (heat mods double dip heat dot).
- Nourish: adds free viral damage and raw damage which feeds into buff, and also gives even more energy

Since Vythelas's heat buff is identical to Cyte's resupply (and a cousin of Saryn/Oraxia), we can run similar weapons used with those frames.
Note that HEAT MODS are mandatory as they double dip the heat DoT and FACTION MODS are ideal too as they TRIPLE DIP the heat DoT.
Vythelas Heat DoT = 0.5 x 30% x stregnth x base damage x (1 + HEAT MOD + other elements) x (1+ HEAT MOD) x (1+FACTION)^3

Just note, Vythelas is a pretty inconsistent buff since you need to go hunting for it and if it runs out, any weak weapons will suddenly go back to being very weak. For consistency you may want to just stick to strong weapons including incarnons even though they aren't affected by Vythelas, just so you can always kill enemies easily.

### 15. Gara Prime — Glass Storm Gara | Non-helminth Hybrid Lash Splinter Storm

**Type:** Support · **Difficulty:** Advanced · **Investment:** Extreme

| Assumption | Value |
|---|---|
| Content | Steel Path endurance · Defense · Farming / loot |
| Forma | 4 (D×2, V×2, –×2) |
| Umbra Forma | None |
| Exilus adapter | Yes — Ice Spring |
| Aura | Brief Respite |
| Arcanes | Arcane Sculptor, Molt Augmented |
| Helminth | Yes |
| Archon Shards | Yes — see guide text |
| Level-cap viable | Endurance-oriented |
| Solo / Squad | Squad / support |
| Last tested | MARCH 2025 |
| MR / rank / cost | MR 0 · rank 30 · 226 platinum / 186320 endo |

**Build overview**

MAIN HYBRID

This is a general use non-helminth Gara build utilising all base abilities with augments, focused around a combination of Shattered Lash use and splinter storm use. Shattered Lash with melee influence allows you to nuke maps by just spamming 1. Splinter storm can be stacked infinitely to create a passive zone of damage that moves with you, allowing you to even kill nearby enemies without casting. Spectrorage provides some crowd control while Spectrosiphon augment helps generate tons of energy orbs to top up energy for yourself and your squad. Spectrosiphon can be replaced with Equilibrium if utilising Synth Deconstruct and you can also just subsume over Spectrorage. Mass Vitrify can Protect objectives and also be smashed to build up splinter storm and deal AOE damage too.

**Mod configuration**

- Shattered Storm — R3
- Spectrosiphon — R3
- Catalyzing Shields — R3 — D · Vazarin
- Primed Continuity — R10 — V · Madurai
- Primed Flow — R10 — – · Naramon
- Archon Stretch — R10 — – · Naramon
- Overextended — R5 — D · Vazarin
- Blind Rage — R10 — V · Madurai

*Aura:* Brief Respite
*Exilus:* Ice Spring
*Arcanes:* Arcane Sculptor (R5), Molt Augmented (R5)

*Resulting stats:* Armor 200 · Energy 641.246 · Health 445 · Shield 370 · Sprint Speed 1.15 · Ability Range 2.35 · Ability Duration 1.55 · Ability Strength 1.39 · Ability Efficiency 0.45

**Intended content — best at / less suited for**

Designed for: Steel Path endurance, Defense, Farming / loot. The source guide does not spell out where it underperforms; as a support build the usual tradeoff applies (see Strengths & weaknesses).

**Core build concept**

A **support** Gara Prime setup: moderate Strength (1.39×), long Duration (1.55×), wide Range (2.35×), negative Efficiency (0.45×). Its engine is the combination in the mod configuration above — Shattered Storm, Spectrosiphon, Catalyzing Shields, Primed Continuity, Primed Flow, aura Brief Respite, Arcane Sculptor + Molt Augmented. See the written sections below for the intended damage/defence loop.

**Key stats & breakpoints**

**Duration**

More duration is beneficial for splinter storm giving you more leeway between casts of 4 so you don't lose all your current stacks of splinter storm. You can add more duration over range/efficiency if desired (e.g. put Narrow Minded when you want splinter storm to last much longer so you don't need to recast 4 as much).

**Efficiency**

Since you will be spamming mass vitrify and breaking it with 1, you need to maintain some efficiency for energy economy. With Arcane Sculptor we can completely ditch efficiency to 45% since we are locked to 175% efficiency and won't even need Spectrosiphon or Equilibrium. You could consider dropping Primed Flow if you feel like energy is good.

Without Arcane Sculptor, 100 to 130% is good since we are running Primed Flow and Spectrosiphon. Spectrosiphon augment generates tons of energy orbs for you and the whole squad. If you subsume over 3, run Equilibrium instead. Seismic Bond on your pet further helps give free 30% efficiency since it procs while you are expanding 4. Archon Stretch procs from electric modded on Shattered Lash.

**Range**

Range is the most important stat for Shattered Lash range and Mass Vitrify Range, allowing the mass vitrify explosion radius to Reach 37.5m and Shattered Lash to Reach 25m. You can increase this even more by adding Augur Reach.

**Strength**

Strength boosts the damage of Shattered Lash which feeds into Mass Vitrify and Splinter Storm, and also boosts the damage vulnerabilities from glassed enemies from Mass Vitrify as well as damage vulnerability from Shattered Storm.

**Modding notes**

**Flexible mod options**

Can add more duration (e.g. Augur Message), strength (Augur Secrets) or range (Augur Reach) if you prefer and have free slots,

Rolling Guard: optional quality of life for high levels to remove harmful statuses

Narrow Minded: optional addition (e.g. over Shattered Storm) that will give you much higher duration at the cost of range. This is useful in situtations where you may not want to nuke and just keep splinter storm on for damage reduction and splinter storm damage etc.

Shattered Storm - optional augment that spreads splinter storm onto enemies hit by 4, which creates a 35% damage vulnerability at base (basically acting like a universal 1.35x damage multiplier at base strength up to 1.7x at 200 strength)

Spectrosiphon - optional augment that generates energy orbs for the squad but is mainly for use in stationary situations since it cannot move on its own and needs to be recast constantly

Mending Splinters - support oriented augment for healing defense operative, pets and teammates.

**Helminth**

Subsume over Spectrorage, and drop Spectrosiphon for Equilibrium
- Roar: Boosts raw damage of Shattered Lash for Splinter Storm, double dips status damage from Shattered Lash and triple dips melee influence procs.
- Nourish: Gives additive viral dmg boost to Shattered Lash, widespread viral procs via influence (giving 4.25x multiplier to health dmg) and gives energy multiplier which helps greatly with energy sustain which is not quite as necessary now due to Arcane Sculptor
- Pillage strips armor/shields and provides shields to you, useful for both shield tanking and shield gating

**Arcanes, Aura & Exilus**

- Arcane Sculptor - locks efficiency to 175% for 12s after casting 3 or 4, solving all energy issues while at 45% efficiency
- Molt Efficiency - free 36% duration to improve splinter storm duration
- Molt Augmented - free 60% strength to further boost shattered lash damage, useful in longer missions where you expect to get 250 kills
- Arcane Fury - similar to blade charger but doesn't require a primary, is easier to proc but provides slightly less stack
- Arcane Blade Charger - if you have a good primary weapon, AOE primary or high DPS sentinel weapon (e.g verglas), you can easily get this buff, which will boost the damage of mass vitrify explosion
- Arcane Circumvent - rolling strips armor, shield and overguard and steals them for you, quite nice for splinter storm
- Arcane Aegis - If you have problems with surviving

**Archon Shards**

- Amber Cast Speed - 1 to 2 tauforged cast speed shard to improve Shattered Lash speed and Mass Vitrify casting speeds
- Crimson Duration - 3 to 4  Tauforged Duration shards to increase splinter storm duration and buff duration
OR
- Violet Melee Critical damage shards

Other options:
- Amber Parkour Velocity optional for quality of life
- Violet Melee Crit Damage shard: boosts shattered lash damage but does not affect mass vitrify for splinter storm stacking

**Survivability & failure conditions**

Not detailed. Survivability comes from whatever defensive mods/abilities are in the configuration above; the guide does not state what breaks it.

**Energy economy**

Efficiency sits at 0.45× per the stats line. The build/guide references an energy source — see mods/overview.

**Playstyle & rotation**

****PLAYSTYLE****

**Make sure to INVERT tap/hold controls for Gara so tap is the Sweeping Slash Shattered Lash version**
- Cast 2 on yourself, your companion, your allies and the defense object
- Cast 3 in front of you/nearby to CC enemies and prime them to drop energy orbs when they die. Note if you cast it around an acolyte, their AI often turns off. Spectrorage can also inconsistently crowd control eximus/overguardeed units. If this is subsumed off, use helminth ability as necessary.
- Cast 4 and press 4 again immediately to end expansion (you want enemies to be outside the wall)
- Cast 1 at the wall to break the wall, nuke the map and build splinter storm stacks
- Spam 1 at enemies to nuke them with melee influence
- Kill heavier targets (e.g. thrax, acolytes) by stacking damage into splinter storm and just standing near them.
- Use active or passive status priming to improve DPS (viral boosts damage by up to 4.25x at 10 stacks, corrosive boosts damage by up to 6x on armored enemies at 10 stacks and unique statuses boost condition overload on Shattered Lash (80% dmg per status))

**Variants**

_None described._

**Strengths & weaknesses**

- **Strengths:** squad-wide value (buffs / heals / CC); safe to play.
- **Weaknesses:** low solo kill speed; contribution drops in a squad that doesn't need it.
_(Archetype-level; the source guide gives no explicit list.)_

**Patch / update history (from the guide)**

**UPDATE JUNE 2026**

Arcane Sculptor now makes efficiency 175% for 12s after casting either Spectrorage or Mass Vitrify which allows you to run Blind Rage without penalty and have excellent energy economy now.

**UPDATE MARCH 2025**

Gara Shattered Lash no longer uses statsticks on a regular melee and is now an exalted that can be modded and use arcanes. The stats have been buffed to be both crit and status viable, making it very good with electric influence. If you don't like faction mods, swap Primed Smite for Primed Pressure Point (just note faction mods do TRIPLE DIP melee influence procs meaning they boost influence by a 1.55^3 = 3.72x multiplier.

![](

**Additional notes from the guide**

**Aura (flexible)**

- Corrosive Projection boosts damage against armor by about 1.8x but you will need an external augur mod on pistol or burst laser prime for shield gating
- Brief respite is for shield gating without external augur mods
- Steel charge provides the most mod capacity if you are short on forma and adds a minor amount to shattered lash/splinter storm damage

**Exilus (flexible)**

- Cunning Drift for range
- Primed sure footed if you own it, handspring as an alternative
- Power Drift for more strength
- Ice Spring for parkour velocity

**Shield Gating**

When you lose shields to 0, you gain a short duration of invulnerability known as the "shield gate" which scales off the highest value of shields you had before breaking. Brief Respite and Augur mods allow you to generate shields on demand by casting abilities. With Brief Respite on warframe and two augur mods on a pistol statstick, casting 1 costs 25 energy at 100% efficiency which generates 57.5 shields. Breaking 57.5 shields to 0 gives 0.64s of i-frames. Adding Catalyzing Shields locks this value to 1.33s regardless of how much shield you had before breaking. If you can get out of danger, crowd control enemies or simply kill everything on screen during this next 1.33s before casting 1 again you should be able to stay alive. Other useful additional survivability options include Rolling Guard, Arcane Aegis, Arcane Circumvent and Vazarin Protective Sling. Vazarin Protective Sling is probably the ultimate survivability tool as it gives 5s of uninterruptable immortality with 0 energy cost and 0 cooldowns.

**Tanking**

Splinter Storm gives 90% damage reduction at 134% strength, allowing you to shrug off a fair amount of damage in non-endurance scenarios. Can swap Catalyzing Shield to Adaptation. You can maximise EHP by adding in Arcane Guardian or Health Conversion for armor, Arcane Blessing or Vitality for health, or simply relying on shield tanking by using Pillage to gain overshields (since shields have a natural 50% DR).

**Sentinels**

Use a sentinel as a companion rather than a moving pet. You can cast splinter storm on your sentinel and give it 90% damage reduction as well as creating a second damage source that gains the same stacks as Gara. Since the sentinel moves with you and overlaps your splinter storm radius, you effectively do twice the damage per tick compared to when splinter storm is on Gara alone. To cast on your sentinel, point your cursor directly up and press the reverse camera key (check key bindings) then spam 2 as the crosshairs pass over the sentinel. Furthermore, since the sentinel never runs away like other pets, you can keep 100% uptime on its splinter storm whenever you cast mass vitrify. You should also equip Seismic Bond which will trigger while Mass Vitrify is expanding, giving free 30% efficiency for 12s.

Recommended sentinels:
- Diriga with Arc Coil - most consistent close range priming for splinter storm DPS and synth deconstruct health orb generation:
- Helios Prime with Vicious Bond and Deconstructor - allows you to passive armor strip enemies recently damaged by abilities, which is exactly what Gara specializes in:
- Nautilus with Cordon and Manifold bond - allows you to passively group enemies so you can kill them quicker with splinter storm.
- Wrym prime with negate - prevents status procs including knockdown, very useful if you don't own primed sure footed and want to block knockdown.
- Dethcube prime with energy generator - makes energy orbs every couple of kills, very useful for energy economy:

**Weapons**

No specific weapon synergies exist apart from having a good primary to proc arcane blade charger quickly if you are running that (e.g. Cedo which can be both primer and DPS) and a utility secondary such as Grimoire that can help with energy regen (Xata Invocation)/status boosting and survivability (Fass Canticle).

**Archgun Statstick**

Currently, primary and secondary dexterity arcanes placed on the archgun will increase your combo duration passively without even summoning the archgun in a mission. This means with 4 dexterity arcanes you can get 30s of combo duration and never run out of combo even without Naramon.

**Who it's for**

Use this if you want Gara Prime as a support option for steel path endurance, defense, farming / loot. It carries a written guide (above).

### 16. Rhino Prime — Shield of Iron | Parasitic Armor Rhino (Meme Iron Skin)

**Type:** Tank · **Difficulty:** Advanced · **Investment:** Extreme

| Assumption | Value |

| Content | Steel Path endurance · Survival · Farming / loot |
| Forma | 5 (=×2, D×2, V×4) |

| Aura | Growing Power |
| Arcanes | Arcane Battery, Arcane Expertise |
| Helminth | Yes |
| Archon Shards | Yes — see guide text |
| Level-cap viable | Endurance-oriented |
| Solo / Squad | Not stated |
| Last tested | JULY 2024 |
| MR / rank / cost | MR 0 · rank 30 · 253 platinum / 187140 endo |

**Build overview**

****INTRODUCTION****

This is a build dedicated to getting the absolute most out of Iron Skin, enough to tank early to mid Steel Path content without worrying about recasting, while also offering a usable Roar. The helminth rank 11 ability Parasitic Armor is subsumed over Rhino's 4th ability stomp and is the basis of this build. Rhino's Iron Skin scales off armor value which can be increased tremendously by stacking multiple sources including Parasitic Armor, Ironclad Charge, Health Conversion and optionally (Mecha Pulse, Arcane Tanker, Arcane Guardian, Arcane Reaper, Melee Fortification, Arcane Ultimatum)

**Mod configuration**

- Ironclad Charge — R3 — = · Zenurik
- Health Conversion — R5 — D · Vazarin
- Transient Fortitude — R10 — V · Madurai
- Primed Continuity — R10 — V · Madurai
- Iron Shrapnel — R0
- Umbral Intensify — R10
- Blind Rage — R10 — V · Madurai
- Primed Redirection — R10 — D · Vazarin

*Aura:* Growing Power
*Exilus:* Power Drift
*Arcanes:* Arcane Battery (R5), Arcane Expertise (R5)

*Resulting stats:* Armor 290 · Energy 150 · Health 370 · Shield 1553.778 · Sprint Speed 1 · Ability Range 1 · Ability Duration 1.275 · Ability Strength 3.13 · Ability Efficiency 0.45

**Intended content — best at / less suited for**

Designed for: Steel Path endurance, Survival, Farming / loot. The source guide does not spell out where it underperforms; as a tank build the usual tradeoff applies (see Strengths & weaknesses).

**Core build concept**

A **tank** Rhino Prime setup: high Strength (3.13×), neutral Duration (1.275×), neutral Range (1×), negative Efficiency (0.45×). Its engine is the combination in the mod configuration above — Ironclad Charge, Health Conversion, Transient Fortitude, Primed Continuity, Iron Shrapnel, aura Growing Power, Arcane Battery + Arcane Expertise. See the written sections below for the intended damage/defence loop.

**Key stats & breakpoints**

**Duration**

Decent duration allows easier upkeep of roar at almost 40s and high duration timers for Ironclad Charge bonus and parasitic armor to make setup easier.

**Efficiency**

Using Primed Flow allows us to tank efficiency, so about 200 energy is needed to pull off the combo. This means you will need zenurik, Preparation or energy pads when you start the mission to get sufficiency energy before using the combo. Once you have millions of iron skin, you only need to cast roar every half minute, meaning you won't be spending much energy. Every couple of minutes you may need to refresh iron skin.

**Range**

Range is untouched at 100%, giving a decent ironclade charge distance to hit multiple enemies, and decent roar radius.

**Strength**

Strength is the single most important stat in this build, since the formula for calculating iron skin uses power strength as a multiplicative factor three times (creating a cubic function). This is because Parasitic Armor scales with strength, providing 6185 armor at 398% strength, Ironclad Charge scales with strength providing 199% increase on total armor per enemy hit and Iron skin itself scales with strength as a direct final multiplier. Finally it also affects the Roar buff.

Here are some example Iron Skin numbers based on 398% power strength in this build:
- Basic Iron skin (direct cast) : 7950
- After charging into 1 enemy : 14k
- After charging into 20 enemies : 131k
- After Parasitic Armor and no charge : 74k
- After Parasitic Armor and charging into 1 enemy : 217k
- After Parasitic Armor and charging into 20 enemies with Health Conversion: 3.18 million
- Parasitic Armor, Health Conversion, Mecha Pulse (20 enemies), Ironclad Charge (20 enemies) and Melee Fortification (assume 5 kills): over 5 million

For reference, in base steel path (<5min in Grineer survival), 1 million iron skin will last approximately 5 minutes of getting shot while standing completely still and not defending.

**Modding notes**

**Why no umbral fiber/armor mods?**

Umbral Fiber provides 130% extra armor (when paired with Umbral Intensify) scaling off base armor, which is only 290, giving a measly 377 armor as well as a measly 11% strength. This gives LESS final Iron Skin than both Amar's Hatred or Augur Secrets while requiring you to spend one or even two Umbral forma.

**Helminth**

- Parasitic Armor is the star of this build, providing 6185 armor when at full shields (1554 with Primed Redirection) with just one press of a button. Compare this to other sources (1200 from arcanes, 1350 from Health Conversion, 378 from Umbral Fiber, 123 from Gladiator Aegis) and you will see how significant this is for Iron Skin. You could boost this even further with Primed Vigor but strength is more valuable to slot.

- Elemental ward (Cold) is the next best alternatives, providing approximately 1291 extra armor at 313% strength. Defy is the next providing 750 armor at max cap. Warcry is the worst alternative giving only 430 armor, but provides the best additional utility from slow and melee attack speed. Note that since you don't need Redirection with these subsumes, you can slot health conversion so elemental ward + health conversion actually gives 2641 total armor.

- Empower can also be used, but you will need to cast before each ability use which makes it a little more clunky to use, and provides less total boost compared to Elemental ward. Empower does however also benefit roar.

- Ensnare or Larva are useful for grouping to help Ironclad Charge, although there are non subume alternatives for grouping including Zenurik's void singularity, Arcane Magus Anomaly and Exodia Hunt.

**Arcanes, Aura & Exilus**

Arcane Battery provides up to 1000 energy max (compared to only 427 energy max with Primed Flow active) when at max possible armor ratings. Even without Parasitic armor or Ironclad Charge active, just 3 stacks of Health Conversion alone gives 492 energy as a baseline.

Arcane Expertise turns your strength into shield, so at 300% strength we get 200% shield which adds to the 180% from Primed Redirection

Molt Augmented gives 60% strength after 250 kills. If you don't plan on getting this many kills in a mission,

Other alternatives
- Arcane Tanker: requires calling an archgun
- Arcane Ultimatum: requires performing a finisher, which you can initiate by using knockdowns, aero mods, bronco dizzying rounds or exodia hunt
- Arcane Reaper: requires melee kills which works well alongside Melee Fortification
- Arcane Guardian: requires taking damage

**Archon Shards**

**Archon Shards (updated for Veilbreaker)**

One or two amber cast speed shards to improve cast speed and quality of life
Put as many Crimson +Strength shards as want since strength TRIPLE DIPS Iron Skin.

**Survivability & failure conditions**

Not detailed. Survivability comes from whatever defensive mods/abilities are in the configuration above; the guide does not state what breaks it.

**Energy economy**

Efficiency sits at 0.45× per the stats line. The build/guide references an energy source — see mods/overview.

**Playstyle & rotation**

****PLAYSTYLE****

1. When you begin in the mission, cast Parasitic armor followed by Iron Skin to get 30k iron skin for buffer and hit 1000 energy max from Arcane Battery
2. Regen your energy with energy generating methods eg zenurik, Grimoire Xata Invocation, Tenet Glaxion Photon Overcharge.
3. Perform any additional OPTIONAL armor buffings methods (collect health orbs for Health Conversion, melee kills for Melee Fortification and Arcane Reaper, Archgun for Arcane Tanker, Finisher for Arcane Ultimatum, Mecha marked kills for Mecha Pulse)
4. Find a group of enemies and use a grouping skill (Magus Anomaly, exodia Hunt, vazarin snare)
5. Cast Charge into the group of enemies (or out of the group of enemies if they are surrounding you for best results) to get Ironclad Charge bonus (lasts 12s). This will set your total current armor value to it's highest possible value but only for 12 seconds.
6. Cast Iron skin twice, first to dispel it and again to recast it while the Ironclad Charge bonus is active to *lock* in the current armor value into the Iron Skin value.
7. Keep Roar active as required

For even more meme bonus armor, use sources of increasing max shields such as Shield Charger, shield osprey specter and Hildryn's Haven (not sure if specter can cast this).

**Variants**

_None described._

**Strengths & weaknesses**

- **Strengths:** high effective health / sustained survivability; forgiving of mistakes.
- **Weaknesses:** lower ability- or weapon-damage ceiling; can still fall to gaps in the defensive layer.
_(Archetype-level; the source guide gives no explicit list.)_

**Patch / update history (from the guide)**

**Augments**

Ironclad Charge: mandatory for scaling the armor to affect iron skin
Iron Shrapnel: OPTIONAL for allowing you to cancel iron skin and recast at a time that suits you, i.e. before you completely run out. You can leave this unranked since we are only using it for the ability to cancel. If you don't care about cancelling, replace this with either more duration (e.g. Augur Message to help roar uptime), more strength (Augur Secrets, niras hatred) or Equilibrium for better energy economy.

**Alternatives/Flexibility**

- Aura - Growing Power is great when it procs to get another 25% strength, but any aura is fine (e.g. steel charge if you need mod capacity), enemy radar is nice quality of life, mecha empowered for full mecha memes

**Mod configuration**

**Intended content — best at / less suited for**

Designed for: Level Cap, Steel Path endurance, Farming / loot. The source guide does not spell out where it underperforms; as a tank build the usual tradeoff applies (see Strengths & weaknesses).

**Core build concept**

A **tank** Sevagoth Prime setup: high Strength (2.14×), short Duration (0.725×), wide Range (1.45×), neutral Efficiency (1×). Its engine is the combination in the mod configuration above — Shadow Haze, Dark Propagation, Stretch, Umbral Intensify, Equilibrium, aura Brief Respite, Molt Augmented + Arcane Concentration. See the written sections below for the intended damage/defence loop.

**Key stats & breakpoints**

**Duration**

Duration affects both Reap and Sow but is not that important since Dark Propagation allows Sow to self propagate and Reap has a decent base duration (6s flight time, 10s debuff)

Duration also affects the drain of Gloom (to a lesser extent than efficiency), and is particularly important when efficiency is not 175% or higher. Duration does not affect Shadow but could be useful for helminth abilities with durations such as Silence, Nourish etc. You would want to keep this around 80 to 130%.

**Efficiency**

At least some efficiency is useful for reducing the drain of Gloom, although Equilibrium + decent kill rate and Synth Decontruct on a companion can deal with the drain of Gloom, meaning we can just sit 100% efficiency. Other methods to boost energy economy include Arcane Energize, Equilibrium with Diriga and Synth Deconstruct, Dethcube with Energy Generator, Grimoire with Xata Invocation, Tenet Glaxion with Photon Overcharge, Primary Exhilirate, Emergence Dissipate

**Range**

About 145-175% range is the sweet spot for Gloom. Any higher and you run the risk of potentially getting enemies stuck beyond your visible range (i.e. in adjacent rooms) so they end up draining your energy unnecessarily while also reducing over kill rates. A bit of range is also needed for the radius of Death harvest debuff from Reap and Sow radius.

The true damage component only affects enemies hit DIRECTLY by shadows. The radial component is blast damage and doesn't scale with range either. Range does affect Sow but since Dark Propagation allows it to self propagate, you don't need much range to get this going. Range is needed for Gloom so keep range at least 145, can go up to 175 if you prefer.

**Strength**

Strength is needed for the damage vulnerability from Reap, flat CC buff from Shadow Haze and the slow from Gloom. The slow cap of 95% is reached at 272% strength, which can be hit with several different combinations. Strength does NOT affect the % health from Reap however will affect Reap's damage vulnerability and roar if you subsume this, which both in turn affect % health damage. You need a minimum of 255% strength to one-shot 100% of the enemies health after an initial reap contact.

For Roar builds, to hit one-shot you can use the following options:
- FULL shards NO kills to buildup: Transient Fortitude (55%) + FOUR Tauforged Strength (60%) + Madurai (40%). This is the best option for quick missions where you don't want to build up Molt Augmented before achieve one shot
- FULL shards, needs kills to buildup: Molt Augmented (60%) + FOUR Tauforged Strength (60%) + Madurai (40%). This is the best option for endurance where you will get 250 kills easily, and can free up the Transient Fortitude slot for additional quality of life like Rolling Guard.
- NO shards, needs kills: Transient Fortitude (55%) + Molt Augmented (60%) + Molt Vigor to snapshot Roar (45%) + Zenurik (20%) (cast from within Wellspring zone) OR Madurai (40%)

**Modding notes**

The guide does not break down individual mods. Defining picks appear to be: Shadow Haze, Dark Propagation, Stretch, Umbral Intensify, Equilibrium. Slots holding basic drift/utility or resistance mods are the flexible ones.

**Helminth**

If you DON'T use Shadow, subsume any of the following over 4:
- Roar: boosts Reap %HP, allowing one-shots without viral at 255% strength after an initial Reap
- Silence: Silence creates a 2s stun which can be prolonged by Gloom up to a ridiculous 40s giving insane crowd control. Silence also blocks annoying eximus abilities (like arson fireblast and leech), annoying acolyte abilities (like violence/malice) and annoying enemy abilities (like disruptor ancient hooks).
- Nourish : boosts energy Regen to sustain gloom, taking damage releases brief stun which is prolonged by gloom and applies viral status to amplify damage

If you want to specifically use Shadow with a helminth, you are basically forced to subsume over 3 since Dark Propagation and Shadow Haze with Reap/Sow nuke is too good to give up:
You would want to pick an ability that provides some sort of boost TO shadow. This significantly limits the available options because you cannot cast buffs like Roar or Nourish while Shadow is separated from Sevagoth, so only passive aura type abilities work:

- Silence with Savage Silence augment: Adding the Savage Silence augment forces a 700% stealth melee multiplier (additive to final crit multiplier) which affects Shadow's Claws as long as silence is active and you remain in range of Sevagoth's main body. Replace Catalyzing Shields or Primed Continuity with Savage Silence.

- Eclipse with Total Eclipse augment: Normally eclipse will only buff the caster. The augment buffs applies an aura so Shadow also receives the buff as long as it is active on Sevagoth and Shadow remains in range.

**Arcanes, Aura & Exilus**

Molt Augmented gives 60% strength after 250 kills, greatly boosting strength without taking up mod slots but needing 250 kills to build up.
Molt Vigor gives another 45% strength which can be snapshot by Gloom and Roar. Optional in case you don't own any shards yet.
Arcane Energize helps significantly with energy economy since it basically provides an additional 600 energy/min (note Gloom drains 240 energy/min at maximum at these stats).

**Archon Shards**

1 tauforged cast speed shard - speeds up animations to make frame feel more fluid
4 tauforged crimson power strength shards - gives 60% strength allowing you to hit both Gloom threshold (272%) and one-shot Reap/Sow threshold (255%) with roar, while freeing up a mod slot (Transient Fortitude) or arcane slot (Molt Vigor).

**Survivability & failure conditions**

Not detailed. Survivability comes from whatever defensive mods/abilities are in the configuration above; the guide does not state what breaks it.

**Energy economy**

Efficiency sits at 1× per the stats line. The build/guide references an energy source — see mods/overview.

**Playstyle & rotation**

1. Activate Gloom (can use either Molt Vigor + Zenurik to boost strength before casting for higher slow, or build up kills with Augmented then recast Gloom once max)
2. Cast Sow to mark enemies
3. Cast Reap to kill enemies marked by Sow (through dealing true damage and causing blast explosions) and mark them with damage vulnerability and flat crit chance buff from Shadow Haze.
4. Using Reap and/or Sow and killing enemies will build up your Death Well. Once full, you can enter Shadow at any time.
5. Optional: Enter Shadow mode and press 1 to group enemies as well as 3 to give damage vulnerability. You can either use light attack melee spam or heavy attack spam to kill groups of enemies.
6. If Shadow dies, simply use Sow + Reap again to recharge Death Well and re-enter Shadow mode.
7. If you die, aim toward enemies and press 2 to consume. You have 5s of initial invulnerability and 20s of total time to consume 5 enemies to revive. Rolling Guard can give an additional 3s i-frames.

To one-shot with Reap and Roar active, you can either press 1 2 1 or 2 1 1.
To one-shot a single target with only Roar active, you can use a primer to prime 3 viral then press 2 followed by a single 1.
To one-shot a single target without Roar, use a primer to prime 1 viral then press 1 2 1 to 2 1 1.

**Variants**

_None described._

**Strengths & weaknesses**

- **Strengths:** high effective health / sustained survivability; forgiving of mistakes.
- **Weaknesses:** lower ability- or weapon-damage ceiling; can still fall to gaps in the defensive layer.
_(Archetype-level; the source guide gives no explicit list.)_

**Patch / update history (from the guide)**

**REAP AND SOW MECHANICS - UPDATE JUNE 2024**

Sevagoth is currently one of the strongest zero effort nuke frames that can nuke up to levelcap. Enemies affected by Sow who are then subsequently hit by Reap take true damage equal to 25% of their CURRENT health while also dealing 25%HP of current health as BLAST damage to surrounding enemies in a 4m radius (but not to themselves). This value is NOT affected by ability strength, but is affected by Reap's vulnerability buff (50% at 100% strength), Viral (2x at 1 stack and 4.25x at 10 stacks) and Roar (30% at 100% strength).

In order to one-shot a single enemy, you need to be able to deal 100% of current health which can be achieved with some combination of using a Reap first to debuff, Viral to prime or Roar to buff. The final requirement drops when enemies are densely packed because of the radial blast damage. For example, if there are 4 armor capped enemies standing in a 4m radius of each other and you deal 80% current HP,  each enemy will be dealt 80% HP true damage from the direct reap and then 8% HP from the radial blast component (attenuated by 90% DR of armor) from each of the other three enemies, receiving a total of 80 + 3*8 = 104% damage.

Shadow Haze produces multiple shadows at once while Dark Propagation allows Sow to self-propagate and thus allows the nuke to spread itself across a map. Note, Dark Propagation also allows Shadow's 3 to create Sow, and Shadow Haze allows new shadows to be produced on kills, meaning you can perform this same nuke while in Shadow form too, although it is limited by the lack of access to on demand Reap casts.

WITH ROAR (over 3 or 4): You need at least 255% strength with both Reap vulnerability and Roar active on an enemy to allow the next Sow+Reap combo to trigger a 100% current health loss to one-shot an enemy, without needing viral status. Without Reap vulnerability, you can use at least 3 viral status with Roar at 255% strengh to one-shot with Sow+Reap. This means to save energy casting 1 twice, you can just prime 3 viral status and cast Sow then Reap.

Use this build for an Endurance focused Sevagoth pure nuke build with Roar and maximum archon shard investment:

WITHOUT ROAR: You will need at least 200% strength on Reap vulnerability with exactly 1 viral status on an enemy to oneshot on the next Reap without Roar. This can be achieved with AOE primers (e.g. Cedo, Epitaph, Bubonico), Panzer or Hounds.

**Additional notes from the guide**

Completely flexible but Brief Respite is required for shield gating using Reap.
Other good options include Growing Power (to hit Gloom slow cap), Steel Charge (for capacity).

Completely flexible but Primed Sure Footed prevents knockdowns, Power Drift helps hit gloom cap, Cunning Drift for slightly more range.

**SHADOW**

Using Shadow has its pros and cons and is mostly up to personal preference in the end.

PROS:
- Interesting mechanic that basically gives you a "second" frame with 3 more abilities to try
- While you are using Shadow, you are technically "immortal" since Sevagoth cannot be damaged and dying as Shadow just knocks you back into Sevagoth who should have full shields for a shield gate and you can just return to Shadow almost immediately.
- Shadow Claws are a very strong melee weapon that can now make use of Melee Influence to clear large groups of enemies easily
- You can still somewhat use the Reap + Sow mechanic to nuke because Death's Harvest can spawn Reap Shadows via Shadow Haze augment but this requires you to manually get a kill with Shadow Claws after tagging with Death's Harvest. Shadows spawned by kills also apply Sow due to the Dark Propagation augment meaning you will get the spreading effects of Reap + Sow while in Shadow too.

CONS:
- Interrupts flow of the simple Reap + Sow combo
- Embrace is a bit slow and frustrating to use as it makes them ragdoll slowly towards you and only affects enemies in a cone
- Consume feels mostly useless
- Many helminth abilities become useless in Shadow, or do not directly affect shadow (e.g. roar, nourish, warcry)
- Takes another 5+ extra forma to maximise due to being a whole frame + melee you need to consider.

If you want to use shadow:
Shadow:
Heavy Spam Claws:

If you DON'T want to use Shadow, use this Shadow build dedicated for reviving only during the passive:

**Shield gating**

Sevagoth has 335 base shields so Catalyzing Shields will reduce that to 67 shield. Reap costs 25 energy and Brief respite alone generates 37.5 shield, which is equal to approximately 0.7s i-frame while Sow costs 50 energy generating 75 energy fully resetting 1.33s shield gate. Adding augur mods onto your pistol can give you additional i-frames per cast. Simply spamming Reap and Sow constantly will keep you alive without much thought.

**Secondary Fortifier**

Using a secondary primer or DPS with Secondary Fortifier arcane allows you to steal overguard from eximus and thrax. Overguard makes you immune to status, clears any existing status upon gaining overguard and gives an additional 0.5s i-frame gate on breaking. This is excellent quality of life and can make you even harder to kill.

**Crowd Control**

Gloom is one of the best crowd control abilities in the game, particularly as it gets close to slow cap as it basically prevents enemies from shooting. This affects demolysts and acolytes, but does NOT affect eximus/thrax who have Overguard active. Gloom will prolong any stuns created by other abilities (such as silence) or status effects (such as cold/heat/electric) which will further prevent enemies from shooting. This allows you sufficient breathing room to shield gate once every while or roll out of harms way.

Additional sources of crowd control include a sentinel such as Diriga with Duplex Bond and modded with radiation status, specters and on-call crew.

**Shadow**

Shadow sort of presents a get out of jail card when you have exhauted options eg you have run out of energy to shield gate and Gloom has deactivated, entering Shadow will give you an additional layer of shield gate/health with a crowd control ability. Shadow does not cost any energy to enter and also spawns with full energy due to Preparation. You can mix Shadow into your playstyle since its basically free to cast, gives some grouping, AOE damage vulnerability and can DPS with claws.

**Passive**

If you take fatal damage as Sevagoth, you will activate your passive where Shadow pops out and you need to collect 5 souls as quickly as possible before shadow dies or the timer runs out. Basically spam 2 and target enemies as quickly as possible. You should be able to consume 2-3 souls within the initial i-frames and shield gate if-frames. Once you are vulnerable, use rolling guard and try to consume the remaining 2-3 souls within the i-frames of Rolling Guard. If arcane aegis procs, you're basically immortal for that duration so you can consume souls at leisure.

**Tanking Alternative**

If you strongly dislike shield gating playstyles and never plan on playing endurance (i.e. >level 500), you can swap Catalyzing Shields for Adaptation, run Arcane Blessing instead of Molt Vigor and swap Brief Respite for Growing Power. Gloom will constantly heal you as you take damage but enemies in higher levels deal more eHP per shot than you have resulting in a one-shot.

**Flexible Slots**

Transient Fortitude is flexible for Rolling Guard in solo endurance against Grineer, up to personal preference, as long as you have four Tauforged Strength shards.

Shadow Haze boosts flat critical chance meaning it has a good synergy with weapons with either low crit chance and/or very high critical multipliers:

**Intended content — best at / less suited for**

Designed for: Level Cap, Steel Path endurance, Base Star Chart, Defense, Farming / loot. The source guide does not spell out where it underperforms; as a farming build the usual tradeoff applies (see Strengths & weaknesses).

**Core build concept**

A **farming** Xaku Prime setup: moderate Strength (1.39×), long Duration (1.55×), wide Range (2.8×), negative Efficiency (0.45×). Its engine is the combination in the mod configuration above — Primed Flow, Equilibrium, Blind Rage, Catalyzing Shields, Augur Reach, aura Corrosive Projection, Molt Augmented + Arcane Concentration. See the written sections below for the intended damage/defence loop.

**Key stats & breakpoints**

**Duration**

Vast Untime freezes ability timers which means you effectively only need to recast 4 once every 30s - 40s. Having more duration helps reduce the frequency you need to recast 4.

**Efficiency**

Adjust your efficiency between 45% and 100% depending on how you play and how often you want to cast abilities. If you are running Shade for invisbility or Vazarin Protective Sling, you may not need to shield gate much and find 45% efficiency fine. If you have poor enemy density and need to shield gate frequently you may want to keep neutral efficiency.

 Primed Flow gives you higher energy capacity and Equilibrium allows you to convert health orbs into energy. Each eximus kill guarantees 2 health orbs which is equivalent to 110 energy and Synth Deconstruct on a companion such as Diriga/Panzer/Hound contributes to more health orb production. Archon Stretch is an optional addition that can be activated by certain companions (Diriga with Arc Coil, any sentinel with Coolant Leak and electric modded weapon + Manifold Bond, beast with Shock Collar and Hounds with Synergized Prospectus) giving free passive energy Regen. Additional energy sources if you find energy difficulties include the following: Arcane Energize, Tenet Glaxion, Grimoire with Xata Invocation, Emergence Dissipate, Zenurik Wellspring, Primary Exhilarate.

**Range**

Range is Xaku's most important stat because it scales the number of guns stolen by Grasp of Lohk, the radius of Gaze, Accuse and Deny and the radius of Vast Untime. Because Grasp of Lohk scales with base 6 guns x range, and rounds down, the cut-offs of range required for guns are 250% range for 15 guns and 267% range for 16 guns. Cunning Drift is optional.

**Strength**

Strength is required primarily for the armor strip from Gaze, which reaches 100% at 200% strength OR 164% strength when Corrosive Projection is equipped, as well as the damage of Grasp of Lohk and enemy limit for Accuse if you want to use it.

**Modding notes**

The guide does not break down individual mods. Defining picks appear to be: Primed Flow, Equilibrium, Blind Rage, Catalyzing Shields, Augur Reach. Slots holding basic drift/utility or resistance mods are the flexible ones.

**Helminth**

**Non-helminth**

While Xata's Whisper doesnt have much synergy with Xaku's other abilities, Xata's Whisper has some synergies with weapons including:
- Miter Incarnon: Xata bubble sucks the additional discs (up to 3) back into the same enemy until they are dead
- Latron Incarnon: Xata bubble sucks the bouncing projectile back into the enemy until they are dead, where normally it would bouncy far away potentially not hitting another enemy
- Prisma Angstrum: Xata bubble sucks in Angstrum projectiles

**Arcanes, Aura & Exilus**

Molt Efficiency - gives even more duration
Molt Augmented - can build up 60% strength after 250 kills
Energize - optional if you own for more energy economy
Arcane Aegis - gives extra passive survivability

**Archon Shards**

2 Amber Cast speed - reduce cast speed of The Vast Untime to reduce time loss of 2 as well as cast speed of quiver
3 Crimson Strength Shards - strength boosts the amount of enemies you can accuse, the damage of Lohk, the buff of Xata's Whisper

**Survivability & failure conditions**

Not detailed. Survivability comes from whatever defensive mods/abilities are in the configuration above; the guide does not state what breaks it.

**Energy economy**

Efficiency sits at 0.45× per the stats line. The build/guide references an energy source — see mods/overview.

**Playstyle & rotation**

1. Tap 4 (Vast Untime) first to freeze all timers BEFORE you cast other abilities to maximise their respective timers. Every time you recast 4, each ability ticks down a tiny bit. Vast Untime slows enemies in radius and also applies a 50% vulnerability to void damage (i.e. affects Xata's and Lohk).
2. Activate 1 (Xata's Whisper) to buff your weapons with void damage which good against Thrax (1.5x bonus) as well as Overguard (a further 1.5x bonus). Void status also creates void bubbles that attract projectiles into the bubble.
3. Activate 2 (Grasp of Lohk) when there are enemies around to 'steal' guns'. This will summon a number turrets that auto target enemies and SCALE with enemy level. Strength affects the damage of each gun and range affects the number of guns. At maximum range you will have 16 guns. Each turret deals 50 x strength x enemy level. This means at 200% strength and at level 9999, each turret deals approximately 1 million damage per shot at a rate of 1 shot per second. At 15 guns, this equates to 15 million damage per second which enough to kill most enemies at levelcap very quickly, even when divided among several enemies, especially with armor strip from Gaze or viral priming.
4. Make sure to INVERT Tap/Hold controls. Hold 3 to cycle to Accuse, then tap 3 to convert a whole bunch of enemies into allies (minimap will be filled with blue dots).
5. Hold 3 to cycle to Gaze and Tap 3 ideally on up to TWO accused enemies about 15-20m apart. This will create a passive zone of armor strip in 22m. Note: Casting Gaze on an Accused enemy is ideal so other accused enemies dont waste time trying to attack the Gazed enemy.
6. If you take damage and lose shields, tap 1 to gain a little shield for gate OR tap 4 gain a bigger gate as well as apply radial slow (approx 50%) and void damage vulnerability.

_None described._

- **Strengths:** loot / resource throughput.
- **Weaknesses:** not built for raw combat performance.

**BUILD VARIATIONS:**

More comfortable energy/survivability 100 efficiency version:
Pillage Xaku:

**UPDATE

Xaku has an innate 75% dodge passive while Vast Untime is active, which combined with active Shield Gating and Crowd Control, will allow you to survive reasonably easily at any level.
1. Active Shield Gating: When shields break you will gain a certain amount of i-frames prevent all damage to health depending on the maximum amount of shields reached prior to breaking. Casting abilities with Brief Respite and Augur mods present will regenerate shields allowing you to reset your shield gate on demand. Catalyzing Shields is OPTIONAL and simply improves the efficiency of i-frames so each cast of Xata's Whisper gives 1.33s i-frame with only a single Augur Reach mod. Alternatively, at 45% efficiency with Brief Respite + THREE augur mods (one on frame and two on Burst Laser Prime), casting Xata's Whisper costs 39 energy which generates 104 shield which equates to about 0.8s i-frames. Casting Vast Untime generates 418 shield which equates to 1.45s i-frames. I would generally recommend casting Xata's Whisper for active gating since it is MUCH cheaper and faster to cast than Vast Untime. Rolling Guard gives additional 3s i-frame and status cleanse which is quite useful as backup but is also OPTIONAL and dependant on your preference.
2. Passive Shiled Gating: If you prefer a much lazier approach not reliant on casting abilities on shield break, you can combine the passive dodge from vast untime with shield regeneration delay reduction mods like Fast Deflection and Vigilante Vigor. Adding Omamori subsume makes this even more foolproof and nealy impossible to die. Swap catalyzing shield and Augur Reach
3. Crowd Control: Accuse (from The Lost) is a vastly underrated ability which converts around 15 and more enemies into allies which draw aggro from other enemies, meaning you will even more rarely take damage. Vast Untime also slows enemies (up to 100% freeze at 400% strength, which is NOT really required).

**Flexible Options**

Blind rage - if you have energy issues, consider dropping Blind Rage for Transient Fortitude
Catalyzing Shields - optional addition to gain slightly more i-frames per cast, interchangeable or can combine with rolling guard, or can swap out for passive regen mods
Natural Talent - very useful if you don't have one or two amber cast speed shards equipped

**Quiver Arrow**

Subsume over1. Quiver Arrow can be used for a lazy afk camping playstyle. Cloak Arrow creates a 6+m radius bubble at the point of contact that makes everything inside invisible so you never get shot at, even by acolytes and eximus (note, the invisibility affects humanoid defense targets but does NOT affect defense pod or excavation cryopods). This is the extreme lazy approach to AFK Xaku, similar to how Octavia is played, but possibly even lazier since you don't need to spam crouch.

**Pillage**

Subsume over 3. Pillage is excellent for a more mobile playstyle, as you can replace 3 and strip armor on the move, while also gaining extra survivability and status cleanse. You can use basically the same build but swap Brief Respite for Corrosive Projection and Molt Efficiency for Arcane Steadfast. Augur Reach is also flexible for Streamline. Arcane Steadfast with Mystic Bond on your sentinel will also significantly improve your energy economy.

**Terrify**

Subsume over 3. Terrify is an alternative mobile armor strip option that also provides simultaneous crowd control, but unfortunately does NOT work on acolytes and has a target limit.

**Nourish**

Subsume over 1 or 3 depending on preference. Boosts energy economy and Nourish applies to accused enemies.

**Roar**

Can only subsume over 1. Roar is the only buff that boosts Grasp of Lohk.

**Omamori**

The ultimate lazy survivability option for Xaku, combine with passive shield Regen mods (Fast Deflection and Vigilante Vigor) and vast untimes dodge and you will basically be unkillable without needing to active shield gate or use invisbility.

A viral + radiation primer such as Kuva Nukor or Epitaph allows you to viral prime enemies to take more damage from Lohk guns while radiation status converts accused "allies" into enemies again so they can be targeted by Lohk guns AND Gaze armor strip.

**Build overview**

This build focuses on Avalanche to achieve 100% armor strip and Biting Frost augment to boost weapon damage further, as well as allowing Breach Surge sparks to red crit.  Survivability mostly relies on shield gating and amazing crowd control from avalanche, which also gives Overguard via Icy Avalanche. Globe offers an additional layer of defense/survivability, or even a way to one-shot enemies with viral status.

**Mod configuration**

- Icy Avalanche — R3
