**Build overview**

General Use Loyal Merulina based Weapon Platform Yareli build for steel path and endurance, with a focus on using secondary weapons WITHOUT riding Merulina.

**Mod configuration**

- Energy Nexus — R5
- Loyal Merulina — R3
- Boreal's Hatred — R5 — D · Vazarin
- Fast Deflection — R5
- Stretch — R5 — – · Naramon
- Umbral Intensify — R10
- Streamline — R5
- Primed Continuity — R10 — V · Madurai

*Aura:* Corrosive Projection
*Exilus:* Ice Spring
*Arcanes:* Arcane Precision (R5), Molt Augmented (R5)

*Resulting stats:* Armor 105 · Energy 315 · Health 370 · Shield 1072.526 · Sprint Speed 1.1 · Ability Range 1.45 · Ability Duration 1.55 · Ability Strength 1.44 · Ability Efficiency 1.45

**Intended content — best at / less suited for**

**Immortality for Endurance: Merulina Gating + Shield Gating**

Loyal Merulina allows you to gain 4s of invulnerability EVERY TIME you double tap 2. Normally if you double tap while on the board without the augment, you only have about 1s of i-frame. If you double tap while Loyal Merulina is active, you will deactivate and reactivate instantly giving the full 4s i-frame. If you Double Tap while Loyal Merulina is not active, the activation animation will prevent you from cancelling immediately and you will gain the full 4s i-frame too. Note, having a very high cast speed can sometimes cause the activation animation to speed up so fast that double tapping 2 can cancel your iframes compeltely.

This means you can basically survive to level cap by just consistently double tapping 2.  You can reduce the frequency of needing to do this by adding additional survivability factors such as passive shield gating. For example, slotting Fast Deflection allows you to start regenerating shields after 2.2s rather than 4s, meaning if shields break and you immediately double tap 2, you will start regenerating shields again during the i-frames. Once you are vulnerable again, you will therefore have a reasonable amount of shields equating to another 1 to 2s of shield gate as a safety net, rather than potentially coming out with 0 or only a tiny amount of shield e.g. 0.33s gate. Adding Boreal's Hatred is optional and increases the max possible shield gate from 1.7s to almost 2.5s adding another 0.8s potential i-frame to your safety nets.

Furthermore, Sea Snares provide passive crowd control by lifting and disabling enemies which reduces the frequency you taking damage.

**Core build concept**

A **tank** Yareli Prime setup: moderate Strength (1.44×), long Duration (1.55×), wide Range (1.45×), neutral Efficiency (1.45×). Its engine is the combination in the mod configuration above — Energy Nexus, Loyal Merulina, Boreal's Hatred, Fast Deflection, Stretch, aura Corrosive Projection, Arcane Precision + Molt Augmented. See the written sections below for the intended damage/defence loop.

**Key stats & breakpoints**

**DURATION**

At least neutral to positive duration is useful for letting Sea Snares bubbles linger a bit, Aquablades (if you use it) and if you have a helminth ability (e.g. Nourish, Xata's Whisper, Roar e.t.c). Duration has no effect on Merulina and no real effect on Riptide since it doesn't really group new enemies after the initial 2s grouping duration.

**EFFICIENCY**

Maximum efficiency is required to maximise the frequency that Loyal Merulina casts it's own Sea Snares. At 175% efficiency it will cast Sea Snares once every 0.5s, while at 100% efficiency it will cast every 2s. Having high efficiency also means all abilities are very cheap to cast (Sea Snares and Merulina only cost 6.25 energy), and Yareli has a very high base energy pool meaning you don't even need Flow. Gaining a single energy orb will provide enough energy for 4 casts of Sea Snares or Merulina.

175% efficiency can be hit in a number of ways:
Rank 4 Fleeting Expertise (50%) + Rank 4 Streamline (25%) - this saves you 10% duration penalty
Rank 4 Fleeting Expertise (50%) + Seismic Bond (30%) - this saves you 10% duration penalty and a mod slot on frame, but relies on your companion being alive dealing damage while you are on Merulina
Rank 5 Fleeting Expertise (60%) + Boreal's Hatred (15%) - this has max duration penalty but also gives extra shield which increases max shield gate from 1.7s to 2.2s, also extra damage reduction while jumping (stacks with merulina to give 92% DR).
Rank 5 Streamline (30%) + Boreal's Hatred (15%) + Seismic Bond (30%) - this has no duration penalty but even more heavily relies on your companion being alive

Small sources of energy regeneration that are usually pretty negligible have a much higher impact on Yareli's economy if running max efficiency. For example, energy Nexus generates 3 energy/s,  Archon Stretch generates 2 energy/s (can be activated via companions) and Primary Exhilarate gives 3.6 energy/s. If every 10s you can generate 50 energy, this is enough for 8 casts of Sea Snares/Merulina. You can play around with how much energy source you require depending on how often you cast Riptide too. If you use Riptide sparingly you might be able to sustain Yareli by just picking up energy orbs from getting kills (or boost it via Dethcube). If you cast very frequently you might want to slot Energy Nexus +/- Archon Stretch.

**RANGE**

Range is only required for the grouping radius of Riptide which starts at a pretty large starting radius of 15m, so having 145 to 175 is decent enough giving 22m to 26m. Compare this to other grouping abilities like Coil Horizon which only has a base radius of 12m and requires 200 range to hit 24m grouping. If you don't care much for Riptide's grouping you can just run neutral range. Sea Snares already has an extremely high base range of 30m and range has no effect on Merulina or Aquablades so you really don't need to invest much into range. Archon Stretch is **OPTIONAL** since it can be activated by a companion running electric damage (e.g. Arc Coil Diriga, Synergized Prospectus Hound, Coolant Leak Sentinel)

**STRENGTH**

Strength affects Sea Snare's damage vulnerability but is only additive to the base 200% by the formula (200% + current strength% over 100%). This means the overall effect of strength on a single Sea Snares instance is not as large as other buff abilities. For example 200% strength increases a single Sea Snares multiplier from 200% to 300% which is a 1.5x increase, while 300% strength increases it by 2x. However, if you consider Sea Snare stacking from Loyal Merulina, then the effect of strength does become MUCH more magnified. For example at 200% strength, we go from 4x total multiplier to 9x total multiplier (which is a 2.25x increase), while at 300% strength we go from 4x multiplier to 16x (which is a 4x increase).

**Modding notes**

The guide does not break down individual mods. Defining picks appear to be: Energy Nexus, Loyal Merulina, Boreal's Hatred, Fast Deflection, Stretch. Slots holding basic drift/utility or resistance mods are the flexible ones.

**Helminth**

Subsume over 3 as Aquablades is pretty useless without fully building for it

DAMAGE (If you want to further maximise your DPS):
- Roar: double dips damage over time effects such as heat, electric, toxin, blast, gas
- Xata's Whisper: good for raw damage particularly with headshots (double dips headshot multi 3x3=9) and against thrax (1.5x effectiveness against overguard and another 1.5x effectiveness against Thrax faction)
- Nourish: adds free viral to weapons boosting raw elemental damage, can proc viral for up to 4.25x multiplier, and also boosts energy economy
- Shock (with Shock Trooper augment): boosts raw electric damage and electric status DPS (additive to electric damage mods)
- Airburst (with Airburst Rounds): groups and also can boost secondary damage by up to 500%

SURVIVABILITY (if you want an even more chill time with surviving):
- Silence: enemies entering silence range get stunned for 2s, and silence turns off all special abilities including eximus, thrax and acolytes
- Omamori: has a 50% chance to block damage and regenerate shields

**Arcanes, Aura & Exilus**

- Arcane Pistoleer: adds ammo efficiency to pistols after headshot
- Arcane Velocity: gives more fire rate

**Archon Shards**

Shards are quite flexible and up to personal preference on Yareli since she doesn't REALLY require anything specific:
2 to 4 Crimson Strength Shards helps maximise Sea Snare vulnerability and helps any buff subsumes as well
2 to 4 Topaz Secondary Crit Chance shards are also optional to maximise secondary weapon crit chance but this is additive to the Critical Flow passive and crit chance mods

A single Violet Equilibrium shard could be helpful for energy sustain without using a mod slot

NOTE: If you run Madurai with Power Transfer which gives cast speed, do NOT add a cast speed shard because casting too fast can make a Double Tap of 2 while it is off immediately cancel merulina and lose the 4s iframe

**Energy economy**

**Playstyle & rotation**

2. Double Tap 2 whenever shields break or whenever you need protection for 4s immortality, and try to keep Merulina up at all times
3. If you have something subsumed over 3, keep that up as needed
4. Occasionally tap 4 to group enemies if needed

**Variants**

_None described._

**Strengths & weaknesses**

- **Strengths:** high effective health / sustained survivability; forgiving of mistakes.
- **Weaknesses:** lower ability- or weapon-damage ceiling; can still fall to gaps in the defensive layer.
_(Archetype-level; the source guide gives no explicit list.)_

**Additional notes from the guide**

Very flexible depending on preference.
- Growing Power fits the default polarity and gives more strength upon dealing status with a weapon
- Corrosive Projection requires changing the polarity or using Omni forma, but gives the highest technical DPS boost against armored enemies

Very flexible depending on preference.
- Power drift for more strength
- Proton pulse for more mobility
- Primed Sure Footed to prevent knockdowns in between casts or downtime of Merulina. Note that Merulina doesn't completely block all knockdowns in the game.

**WHY Loyal Merulina?**

Loyal Merulina augment is the focus of this build because it allows you to have normal frame mobility while benefiting from damage reduction and status immunity (but not complete knockdown immunity). Loyal Merulina also has a unique effect where Merulina follows you around like a companion and automatically casts unique instances of Sea Snares. The important factor is that Sea Snares cast manually by 1 and cast automatically by Loyal Merulina **stack multiplicatively**. For example at 200% strength, Sea Snares has a 300% damage vulnerability which equates to a 3x damage multiplier to all damage on affected enemies. A single enemy affected by BOTH instances of Sea Snares therefore takes a 3 x 3 = 9x damage multiplier, which is equivalent to Eclipse on a Mirage running 400% strength.

In essence, Yareli has one of the strongest damage buffs in the games when double stacked while also providing a passive bonus 200% critical chance to pistols while moving (which is additive to mods like Pistol Gambit).

**Tanking for Casual/Base Steel Path**

Having Merulina active gives 90% damage reduction. You can add Adaptation to make this 99% damage reduction and even add more shields, health or armor to further improve EHP. This is a very valid playstyle if you prefer less overall button pressing and just staying in Merulina forever.

**FLEXIBLE OPTIONS**

- Energy Nexus: gives passive energy regen but is flexible if you have Archon Stretch, Dethcube, Primary Exhilarate, equilibrium shard or other options
- Fast Deflection: allows you to start regenerating shields before the merulina gate time is up which effectively extends the total available i-frames upon double tapping 2. Could even add Vigilante Vigor to this if you like
- More Strength: more sea snares damage buff
- More Duration: better upkeep of a helminth or aquablades

It also has an evolution that stores combo on holster meaning you can build to x12 and keep it whenever you swap back to pistol making it the perfect accompanying weapon for pistol platform Yareli.

### 42. Dagath — The Faceless Rider | Dagath SP General Use and Endurance (Non-helminth and Variants)

**Type:** Tank · **Difficulty:** Advanced · **Investment:** Extreme

**Build overview**

This is a build focused on Spectral Spirit which makes you immortal for over 30s at a time with a short cooldown in between (about 5s in practice), apply Doom with all abilities and weapons, apply viral with Wyrd Scythes and strip armor/damage with Rakhali.

If you prefer not using the augment Spectral Spirit, use this non augment variant where you cast abilities alot more often to shield gate rather than stay immortal:

**Mod configuration**

- Catalyzing Shields — R3 — D · Vazarin
- Spectral Spirit — R3
- Constitution — R3
- Equilibrium — R10 — – · Naramon
- Primed Flow — R10 — – · Naramon

- Blind Rage — R10 — V · Madurai

*Aura:* Brief Respite
*Exilus:* Primed Sure Footed

*Resulting stats:* Armor 125 · Energy 641.246 · Health 666 · Shield 250 · Sprint Speed 1.1 · Ability Range 0.34 · Ability Duration 2.82 · Ability Strength 1.99 · Ability Efficiency 0.45

**Intended content — best at / less suited for**

Designed for: Steel Path endurance, Bossing, Farming / loot. The source guide does not spell out where it underperforms; as a tank build the usual tradeoff applies (see Strengths & weaknesses).

**Core build concept**

A **tank** Dagath setup: high Strength (1.99×), long Duration (2.82×), tight Range (0.34×), negative Efficiency (0.45×). Its engine is the combination in the mod configuration above — Catalyzing Shields, Spectral Spirit, Constitution, Equilibrium, Primed Flow, aura Brief Respite, Arcane Concentration + Molt Augmented. See the written sections below for the intended damage/defence loop.

**Key stats & breakpoints**

**Duration**

Duration has been maximised for maximum Spectral Spirit uptime. At 300% duration we get at least 30s of invulnerability. With Arcane Concentration or Molt Efficiency and Duration Archon Shards or even Grimoire duration mod, we can increase this even further over 40s. Duration also sets Scythe and Doom duration to excessive levels and even Rakhali to almost 10s which increases the total amount of damage.

**Efficiency**

We can now completely drop efficiency because Dagath has TWO methods of improving energy generation. With Spectral Spirit, you now have a 100% chance to generate health orb on kill, while Equilibrium converts each health orb into 55 energy. This means you are guaranteed 550 energy every 10 kills while Spectral Spirit is active, which is simply insane. In addition, Dagath has the Abundant Abyss passive that has a 35% chance of QUADRUPLING orb effectiveness, i.e. increasing energy orb effect from 25 to 100. That means for every 10 energy orbs dropped, instead of getting 250 energy, Dagath on average gains 537 energy (nearly double energy). Note Equilibrium does NOT appear to allow the health orb boosts to translate into energy gain i.e. health orbs do not give 200 health/220 energy when Equilibrium is equipped. It is uncertain if this is intentional or not.

**Range**

Range is actually NOT as important as you would initially think. This is because hitting a single doomed enemy with Wyrd Scythe causes the effect to spread to surrounding enemies within a base range of 15m (approximately 5m at min range). This means as long as enemies are standing within a short distance (about 5m) of each other, you should be able to spread the effect throughout a crowd regardless of range. In most maps, enemies do not stand that far apart so 100% range is sufficient. What range really affects then is simply how close you need to be to affect the first enemy with Doom, although this is also no longer important with the augment Spectral Spirit since it allows weapons and Rakhali itself to self apply doom and therefore strip from any range.

**Strength**

Strength affects the slow of 1, the stored damage on 2, the crit dmg buff of 3 and the armor strip and damage of 4. A strength of 272% is required to hit the 95% slow cap on 1 while a strength of 286% is required to hit both the 100% damage storage of 2 as well as the 100% armor strip per horse. Note that a single horse can actually hit multiple times so the threshold of 286% is not crucial to hit, in fact even just running around 140% str allows consistent full strip.

**Modding notes**

The guide does not break down individual mods. Defining picks appear to be: Catalyzing Shields, Spectral Spirit, Constitution, Equilibrium, Primed Flow. Slots holding basic drift/utility or resistance mods are the flexible ones.

**Helminth**

Helminth on Dagath is extremely flexible and can go over either 1 or 4 depending on the focus.
For pure weapon platform, subsume roar, eclipse, xata's whisper, wrathful advance or energized munitions over 4.
If pure Rakhali or Hybrid ability/weapon focused, subsume roar over 1 and use a companion or weapon to apply viral status instead
Note you should NOT subsume over doom, as while you will still be able to apply doom due to Spectral Spirit, you lose the strength scaling meaning it will be fixed at 35% bonus.

**Arcanes, Aura & Exilus**

Arcane Concentration and/or Molt Efficiency for even more duration
Molt Augmented for more strength
Arcane Icestorm, use with a cold status weapon like epitaph for 40% str and duration

**Archon Shards**

- ONE Violet Equilibrium Shard lets you replace equilibrium for augur message
- ONE Amber Cast shard - speeds up cast of Rakhali
- ONE to TWO Tauforged Crimson Duration shards - to help maximise duration further for spectral spirit
FLEXIBLE:
- ONE to TWO Parkour Velocity for mobility

**Survivability & failure conditions**

Not detailed. Survivability comes from whatever defensive mods/abilities are in the configuration above; the guide does not state what breaks it.

**Energy economy**

Efficiency sits at 0.45× per the stats line. The build/guide references an energy source — see mods/overview.

**Playstyle & rotation**

1. Activate Grave Spirit (tap 3) at the beginning of the mission and whenever it is off cooldown to stay invulnerable.

2. Cast Wyrd Scythe (tap 1) to throw out 7 sickles that auto target enemies within 40 m after a 1s delay. Enemies hit get slowed and receive a forced viral status

3. Cast Doom (tap 2) within the 1s delay of Wyrd Scythe on nearby enemies in front of you (only need to tag at least one enemy). Doomed enemies hit by Wyrd Scythe will spread the Doom effect to nearby enemies, basically propagating the effect through the map. Damaging Doomed enemies triggers "Phantom Wrath" which appears as a sickle above their head, storing all damage dealt in the next 2s then dealing that damage again as true damage (bypassing armor). Think of this as a "total damage multiplier" with a base effect of 1.35x.

4. Cast Rakhali's Cavalry (tap 4) to strip and nuke enemies marked by Phantom Wrath, in front of you over a fixed distance.

The general ability rotation will be to spam 1 + 2 followed by 4 in that order to constantly kill enemies, while keeping 3 active at all times as possible.

**Variants**

_None described._

**Strengths & weaknesses**

- **Strengths:** high effective health / sustained survivability; forgiving of mistakes.
- **Weaknesses:** lower ability- or weapon-damage ceiling; can still fall to gaps in the defensive layer.
_(Archetype-level; the source guide gives no explicit list.)_

**Patch / update history (from the guide)**

**UPDATE 2025**

The wrathful advance infinite stack bug has been nerfed. The build in the video below still works but you will just not get overflow crit anymore and it is more ideal to subsume over 4.

**UPDATE JUNE 2024**

The new augment Spectral Spirit which allows you to forcefully enter Spectral Form, allowing you to become invulnerable, gives 100% health orb drop chance on kill (meaning 55 energy per kill via Equilibrium) and force applies Doom via weapons or abilities. Finally, the augment allows you to reduce the 25s cooldown by 1s per kill, meaning you can reset Spectral Form completely every 25 kills, which can be achieved in under 5 seconds with just Rakhali's Cavalry or shooting weapons.

**Additional notes from the guide**

Brief Respite matches her innate polarity and allows her to shield gate effectively in between Spectral Spirit cooldown.
Corrosive Projection would be best in slot if you apply forma and run an augur mod in addition to catalyzing shield to shield gate (you get 1.33s gate regardless of shield value on break).

Completely flexible. Use Primed Sure Footed if you own it, otherwise just use Power Drift or Cunning Drift.

**Invulnerability + Shield gating + Crowd Control**

Spectral Spirit gives you about 30s of invulnerability at 300% duration whenever you activate Grave Spirit, and getting kills reduces the 25s cooldown by 1s per kill meaning you only need to stay alive with regular shield gating during a short window while getting 25 kills to reset Spectral Spirit. With the Catalyzing Shields mod on, whenever your shields break from maximum you will have 1.33s of i-frames to basically recast 2 or 4 to fully reset your shield gate. Catalyzing Shields sets Dagath's max shields to only 50, meaning a single cast of either 2 or 4  gives the max gate time with Brief Respite and an Augur mod. Casting 4 is preferred because it has inbuilt i-frames and tends to kill or knockback enemies. Note in general play, just the ability rotation of constantly pressing 2,1 and 4 will naturally allow you to shield gate without needing to actually keep track of your shields.  Finally, most enemies should either be SLOWED by Wyrd Scythes that gets spread throughout the map everytime you use 2,1 combo, or DEAD from 4 so you shouldn’t even be getting damaged that frequently.

**Flexible Options**

Natural Talent: at least ONE source of Casting Speed is MANDATORY for casting 4 since it has such as slow cast time. This can be either from Natural Talent, Madurai power transfer or Amber Archon Shards.

Catalyzing Shields/Rolling Guard: Either or both are OPTIONAL if you have issues with surviving in between cooldowns of Spectral Spirit. This is especially useful if using weapons to kill rather than Rakhali to kill, since Rakhali normally has inbuilt i-frames. If you don't have issues are using vazarin protecting sling you can swap this for Augur Message/Nira's Hatred for even more duration.

**Ability Nuke**

For a 4 nuke and ability spam based build:
- Roar: Boosts Rakhali damage and weapon damage
- Breach Surge: Crit damage buff from Grave Spirit applies to Breach Surge spark separately, thereby semi "double dipping" when created by a weapon. Breach surge also applies the melee stealth multiplier (7x additive to crit multi). If you want some range for Breach Surge, swap Narrow Minded for Stretch or Nira's Hatred

**Weapon Platform**

For a weapon platform based build:
- Wrathful Advance: Flat crit chance buff to melee weapons
- Roar: double dips DoTs
- Eclipse: for raw damage
- Energized Munitions: for spamming guns
- Xata's Whisper: for raw damage especially if headshotting or using blast status
- Nourish: free weapon viral and energy boost
- Warcry: for melee attack speed
- Molt/Infested mobility: for speed boost

**Reave DPS**

For an alternative Reave nuke build, subsume Reave over 4. Reave normally requires 295% strength with 10 viral status to oneshot any non-boss enemy. With Dagath, since Doom stores the damage of Reave and deals it again, you can effectively reduce the total strength required to oneshot. In addition, Wyrd Scythes spreads viral status. With Doom and 10 viral, you only need 181% str to one shot. With Doom and 1 viral, you need 304% strength to one shot.

Similar to Breach Surge variant, swap Narrow Minded for Stretch or Nira's Hatred.

**Weapons**

IMPORTANT NOTE: Doom can steal kills and prevents activation of on kill effects like Galvanized mods and Merciless as well as certain gimmicks such as Ocucor Sentient Surge. If you notice difficulty building or maintaining these, consider swapping Galvanized Mods out for the regular variants and using Arcanes that do not depend on kills (e.g. Primary Blight/Frostbite/Plated rounds, Secondary Encumber/Flare etc).

### 43. Gyre Prime — Flux Dancer Gyre | Steel Path AOE + Weapon Platform + Passive Shield Gate

**Type:** Tank · **Difficulty:** Advanced · **Investment:** High

| Assumption | Value |
|---|---|
| Content | Level Cap · Defense · Farming / loot |
| Forma | 3 (=×1, D×2, –×2, V×1) |
| Umbra Forma | None |
| Exilus adapter | Yes — Lightning Dash |
| Aura | Corrosive Projection |
| Arcanes | Arcane Aegis, Arcane Circumvent |
| Helminth | Yes |
| Archon Shards | Yes — see guide text |
| Level-cap viable | Claimed in guide |
| Solo / Squad | Solo-tested |
| Last tested | DEC 2025 |
| MR / rank / cost | MR 0 · rank 30 · 69 platinum / 105410 endo |

**Build overview**

General Use steel path build allowing Gyre to fry enemies with a combination of weapons and abilities. Coil Horizon can be used to group enemies which greatly boosts the effectiveness of electric status since they chain to another 5 enemies within a short range of 3m. Coil Horizon also deals electric damage + status innately AND triggers Rotorswell discharges for more damage. Cathode Grace gives some slow energy Regen (approximately 180 energy per minute) but also boosts crit chance of both weapons and abilities. The augment Cathode Current is used to Extend the duration of Rotorswell indefinitely and provide an additional discharge for more damage.

Rotorswell is a source of passive AOE damage, dealing damage passively in approximately 9m aura (requires line of sight) and also chaining electricity to enemies damage by a critical hit dealt by either your weapons OR abilities such as Coil Horizon (also requires line of sight). Note this damage falls off quite quickly in steel path so you should primarily be relying on weapons to deal damage, particularly to stronger enemies.

**Mod configuration**

- Conductive Sphere — R3 — = · Zenurik
- Cathode Current — R3
- Overextended — R5 — D · Vazarin
- Catalyzing Shields — R3 — D · Vazarin
- Vigilante Vigor — R5
- Fast Deflection — R5
- Archon Stretch — R10 — – · Naramon
- Blind Rage — R10 — V · Madurai

*Aura:* Corrosive Projection
*Exilus:* Lightning Dash
*Arcanes:* Arcane Aegis (R5), Arcane Circumvent (R5)

*Resulting stats:* Armor 105 · Energy 240 · Health 445 · Shield 740 · Sprint Speed 1.05 · Ability Range 2.35 · Ability Duration 1 · Ability Strength 1.39 · Ability Efficiency 0.45

**Intended content — best at / less suited for**

Designed for: Level Cap, Defense, Farming / loot. The source guide does not spell out where it underperforms; as a tank build the usual tradeoff applies (see Strengths & weaknesses).

**Core build concept**

A **tank** Gyre Prime setup: moderate Strength (1.39×), neutral Duration (1×), wide Range (2.35×), negative Efficiency (0.45×). Its engine is the combination in the mod configuration above — Conductive Sphere, Cathode Current, Overextended, Catalyzing Shields, Vigilante Vigor, aura Corrosive Projection, Arcane Aegis + Arcane Circumvent. See the written sections below for the intended damage/defence loop.

**Key stats & breakpoints**

**Duration**

Roughly neutral duration is all you need to give Cathode Grace about 8 to 10s initial duration. Once you get kills within that time frame, duration doesn’t matter at all since you can Extend both 3 and 4 indefinitely as long as you continue getting kills. Coil Horizon does not scale with duration and most of the helminth options do not need much duration either, but you can add Primed Continuity for Roar/Nourish if you like.

**Efficiency**

Gyre can generate approximately 300 energy per minute with Cathode Grace + Archon Stretch, and once 3 and 4 are up they never need to be cast again. You will only need to occasionally cast 1 and 2. You can add more passive energy regeneration if you want, i.e. via  Zenurik, Energy Nexus, Equilibrium, Grimoire Xata Invocation, Primary Exhilarate or Emergence Dissipate.

**Range**

Range is an important stat since it affects the range of Arcsphere, range of Coil Horizon's grouping and range of passive Rotorswell aura to about 9m and range on on crit rotorswell discharge to over 20m. We can use Overextended + Archon Stretch to hit this. Archon Stretch is also nice because it triggers from electric damage and gives 200 energy/min on top of cathode grace. If you need mod slots you could consider dropping Overextended.

**Strength**

Strength is another important stat since it affects the damage of her electric dicharges from Rotorswell, damage of Coil Horizon as well as energy Regen and crit chance boost from Cathode Grace and boost of Conductive Sphere.

**Modding notes**

The guide does not break down individual mods. Defining picks appear to be: Conductive Sphere, Cathode Current, Overextended, Catalyzing Shields, Vigilante Vigor. Slots holding basic drift/utility or resistance mods are the flexible ones.

**Helminth**

Either Arcsphere or Coil Horizon could be subsumed over, depending on if you like to use Conductive Sphere or not. I usually prefer to remove Coil Horizon due to how annoying it is to actually use, as it often bounces to the wrong place and requires a second key tap to actually group, but would consider using Roar over 1 for a pure ability DPS setup.

**Arcanes, Aura & Exilus**

Highly flexible.

Survivability:
- Arcane Aegis (only RANK 0 is sufficient): RNG passive survivability but when this procs you effectively get 12s invulnerabilty to non-toxin damage
- Arcane Circumvent: if you dash around with Gyre's cool fluxing animation, you will strip armor/shield/overguard from enemies while simultaneously stealing and gaining armor/shield/overguard. If you cast coil horizon you can even dash through the group and simultaneously strip a whole group of enemies.

Strength:
- Molt Augmented: need 250 kills to get 60% strength

Weapon buffing:
- Arcane Rage/Acceleration: for buffing primaries
- Arcane Fury/Strike: for buffing melees
- Arcane Precision/Velocity: for buffing secondaries

**Archon Shards**

1 Amber cast speed
OPTIONAL : 1 to 2 Parkour Velocity for mobility
OPTIONAL : 2 to 4 Violet +ability dmg on electric status if focusing on Ability DPS
OPTIONAL : 2 to 4 Violet +electric damage on primary if focusing on primary weapon platform

**Survivability & failure conditions**

**DAMAGE REDUCTION**

For base steel path levels (e.g. 100 to 500ish) you can stack Reverse Rotorswell, Adaptation and innate shield DR and also add overguard from secondary fortifier (since Reverse Rotorswell) to simply tank lower levels of damage. Swap Fast Deflection, Vigilante Vigor and Catalyzing Shields for Reverse Rotorswell, Adaptation and Primed Flow/Equilibrium for more energy.

**Energy economy**

Efficiency sits at 0.45× per the stats line. The build/guide references an energy source — see mods/overview.

**Playstyle & rotation**

**HOW TO PLAY**

1. Press 3 to activate Cathode Grace at the beginning of the mission. You will have approximately 10s to start getting kills to Extend the duration of 3, which caps at 60 seconds after approximately 13 kills, so don’t activate this when there are zero enemies around to kill otherwise you will enter a long cooldown. As long as you get kills you will not need to recast 3 (unless you get nullified or silenced by Violence). This combined with Archon Stretch will keep you constantly regenerating energy at approximately 5 energy/s or 300 energy / min.
2. Press 4 to activate Rotorswell once you have eneough energy. As long as you get kills with Cathode Grace active, Rotorswell will also Extend its duration indefinitely and you not need to recast 4.
3. Press 2 to throw orb and tap 2 again to initiate grouping whenever there are lots of enemies nearby. This will exponentially magnify the damage from electric status due to the chaining mechanics. This is usually the subsume slot in my opinion due to how annoying the bouncing mechanic is and the need to Double Tap 2.
4. Press 1 to manually shield gate (optional) and shoot through the orb to apply Conductive Sphere buff (forced electric procs and added electric damage). You probably want to spam this constantly to cover the map

**Variants**

_None described._

**Strengths & weaknesses**

- **Strengths:** high effective health / sustained survivability; forgiving of mistakes.
- **Weaknesses:** lower ability- or weapon-damage ceiling; can still fall to gaps in the defensive layer.
_(Archetype-level; the source guide gives no explicit list.)_

**Patch / update history (from the guide)**

**UPDATE DEC 2025**

Arcane Circumvent is a nice new addition that lets you steal enemy defenses by 50% upon rolling through them and Melee Careen can be attached to a melee to freeze enemies on rolling. Gyre's cool custom fluxing animation adds additional flair, meaning you can constantly dodge through the map while stripping armor/shields/overguard, freezing enemies for CC and flat crit damage and simultaneously gain shields for shield gate and even overguard from eximus/thrax.

**Additional notes from the guide**

Corrosive Projection reduces armor by 18% which is effectively a 1.8 x damage multiplier on armored enemies.
Brief respite is required for active shield gate (unless you have augur mods on secondary/burst laser prime)

Completely flexible and up to preference:
- Lightning Dash for mobility and thematic fit
- Power Drift for more strength, Cunning Drift for more rante
- Primed Sure Footed is best for preventing knockdown

**ALTERNATIVE BUILDS:**

Pure Ability DPS (Mecha Set):
Activate Gate Platform variant:
Persistence tank variant:

**SHIELD GATING**

Since Gyre doesn’t have much health, armor or damage resistance at base, she relies heavily on crowd control and either passive shield gating or active shield gating in order to survive up to levelcap.

- OPTION 1 PASSIVE SHIELD GATING:
Fast Deflection + Vigilante Vigor reduces the shield recharge delay to 1s meaning if you avoid getting shot for 1s, shields will automatically start recharging giving you another 1.33s iframe on next frame after only 1 shield regenerated. When Arcane Aegis procs which is RNG, you get 12s of effective immortality to non-toxin damage. This gives you a less active method of surviving but requires Rotorswell to be active to stun enemies to help bridge the 1s delay time.

- OPTION 2 ACTIVE SHIELD GATING:

Whenever your shields break, you can immediately tap 1 to reset your shields manually. Currently Catalyzing Shields gives the FULL 1.33s shield gate regardless of how much shield you hit before breaking. If you prefer full manual gating make sure to run at least single Augur mod on your pistol OR sentinel Burst Laser rifle, and you can drop Fast Deflection and Vigilante Vigor for any combination of Rolling Guard, Primed Flow, Equilibrium/Energy Nexus, Umbral Intensify.

OTHER
- Arcane Circumvent: Arcane Circumvent is a neat optional addition that steals overguard, shield and armor on rolling, which also simultaneously strips armor, shield, overguard by 50% which helps with DPS too. This basically means you get full shield gate when you dodge through corpus enemies too.
- Crowd Control: Coil Horizon and Rotorswell both provide soft CC which doesnt affect eximus/overguarded enemies. Coil Horizon drags enemies into a ball preventing them from shooting while Rotorswell is able to passively stun enemies briefly due to electric procs. This should reduce the frequency of you getting shot.
- Invulnerability: As final backup, you could run Vazarin protective sling for 5s iframe with no cooldown. Rolling Guard is also optional for 3s iframes and status cleanse over either shield Regen mods or Overextended.

**GLOOM PERSISTENCE**

Arcane Persistence can limit health loss to 500hp/s but requires lots of armor shards to hit 700 armor threshold. Gloom allows all damage from abilities to heal including rotorswell and reverse rotorswell. Rever Rotorswell reflects damage back on getting shot and will therefore always heal more than the 500hp damage/s that you take.

**Flexible Options**

If you don't own any of the above mods, don't want to use passive gating (swap out fast deflection, vigilante vigor) or don't need so much range (swap out Overextended):
Rolling Guard - iframes and status cleanse for even more survivability
Energy Economy - Primed Flow, Equilibrium
More Strength - Transient fortitude, Umbral intensify, Augur secrets
More Range - Augur Reach

**Nourish**

Subsume over 2 for a weapon platform focus. Gives free viral to your weapons and also multiplies all energy gained via Cathode Grace and Archon Stretch. The base energy gain is approximately 5 energy per second at 200 str. WIth Nourish this increases to approximately 13 energy per second or about 800 energy per minute.

**Omamori**

Subsume over 2 for a weapon platform focus. Makes survivability really easy with passive shield regeneration.

**Roar**

Subsume over 1 for pure ability DPS or over 2 for hybrid ability/weapon platform. Roar applies faction bonus which double dips DoTs like electric created by both Conductive Sphere and rotorswell.

**Shock**

Shock Trooper applies +electric damage which multiplies with the buff from Conductive Sphere, and adds with other modded electric% on the weapon. This does require you to use another mod slot which is already tight.

**Armor Strip**

This allows the electric procs to scale best against steel path armored grineer and corrupted as armor reduces damage by up to 10x. Note that due to armor changes, the effect of partial strip is often good enough so it isn't mandatory to full strip now. In fact, there are even other external sources of armor strip such as Grimoire + Jahu Canticle, Latron Incarnon, Amalgam Argonak + Innodem/Contagion that mean you don't need to waste a helminth purely on armor strip. Eventhe new Arcane Circumvent gives you on demand partial strip (50% on dodging through enemies).
- Tharros Strike: My preferred option because it is cheap to cast, full strips both armor and shields at only 200% strength and works on Acolytes and Demolysts. Tharros Strike's main issue is the lower range and non-radial area of effect, requiring you to aim towards enemies and missing any enemies behind you. This is somewhat overcome by grouping abilities such as Gyre's Coil Horizon, which groups enemies radially so you can strip all enemies in one cast. Tharros Strike also heals you.

- Pillage: Another great option, but requires 328% strength with Corrosive Projection to full strip armor, which means you need either Blind Rage or external strength boosts such as Madurai, Archon Shards etc. Pillage also provides shields/overshields back to Gyre allowing you to shield gate without Brief Respite + augur mods, as well as cleansing status. Pillage cannot strip both shields and armor simultaneously, so when facing an acolyte, you must remove shields first (takes 2 casts of pillage, or just shoot with a weapon), then cast pillage.

- Terrify: Terrify has the best radial non-line of sight armor strip for regular enemies and only requires 167% strength for full strip, but is NOT permanent and does NOT affect Acolytes or Demolysts. It also does provide crowd control but makes enemies run away from you which can sometimes be more frustrating than helpful, depending on the mission.

**Sickening Pulse**

This creates an expanding pulse with line of sight that effectively multiplies the total electric status damage currently on an enemy by 10x. This works very well when cast into a group of enemies all affected by electric status from rotorswell.

Conductive Sphere applies FORCED electric status per shot (scaling with multishot) and multiplies the electric status damage but additively to elementalist mods/multiuplicatively to +electric mods (which is unlike most other similar buffs e.g. Lavos Valence Formation). This means weapons with high multishot work well and any weapon you do use, you MUST still mod +electric mods (e.g. stormbringer/Shocking Touch).

### 44. Oberon Prime — Hallowed Fairy King Oberon | Smite and Reckoning Nuke SP Endurance

**Type:** Tank · **Difficulty:** Advanced · **Investment:** High

**Build overview**

The author gave no summary paragraph. **Duration**

**Mod configuration**

- Umbral Intensify — R10
- Overextended — R5 — D · Vazarin
- Blind Rage — R10 — V · Madurai
- Augur Reach — R5

*Resulting stats:* Armor 450 · Energy 755.245 · Health 465 · Shield 370 · Sprint Speed 1 · Ability Range 2.65 · Ability Duration 1.55 · Ability Strength 1.98 · Ability Efficiency 0.45

**Intended content — best at / less suited for**

Designed for: Steel Path endurance, Circuit / Duviri, Farming / loot. The source guide does not spell out where it underperforms; as a tank build the usual tradeoff applies (see Strengths & weaknesses).

**Core build concept**

A **tank** Oberon Prime setup: high Strength (1.98×), long Duration (1.55×), wide Range (2.65×), negative Efficiency (0.45×). Its engine is the combination in the mod configuration above — Umbral Intensify, Overextended, Blind Rage, Augur Reach, Stretch, aura Brief Respite, Arcane Universal Fallout + Molt Augmented. See the written sections below for the intended damage/defence loop.

**Key stats & breakpoints**

**Duration**

Positive duration mostly helps uptime of roar and hallowed ground so you don't have to recast as often.

**Range**

High range sets Smite's AOE component to 15 to 16.8m allowing you to maximise kills per cast. Max range also gives both hallowed ground and reckoning a huge 40+m range allowing you to affect a very large number of enemies per cast. Keep in mind however, Reckoning now has a line of sight requirement so you cannot affect enemies behind walls, and sometimes misses enemies on different levels.

**Strength**

Reckoning only needs 167% strength to full strip, but there are certain strength thresholds required for Smite to deal 100% current HP to single targets and AOE.

Use this calculator made by mineturtleofdeath to check individual breakpoints with specific build variations:

For this current build iteration, i have chosen two breakpoints, 185% strength for killing single targets with smite + roar with NO viral or radiation which you hit before building up any Molt Augmented stacks and 249% strength for killing enemies in the AOE with smite + roar + reckoning + ONE viral + ONE topaz shard, which you hit after getting about 200 kills for molt augmented. What this means is at the start of the mission you can oneshot all single enemies without using any priming but to oneshot in the AOE, you may need to shoot you primer (e.g. Epitaph) more than once to apply at least FIVE viral statuses. Once you get 250 kills and max out molt augmented, you now only need to apply a SINGLE viral status i.e. one shot of Epitaph.

The more topaz shards you add, the less reliant on viral status you are, but alternatively you can also still nuke effectively with no shard investment in case you don't own any shards, but simply improving the consistency of viral application. This can be done by using a combination of AOE companion primers (tazicor, hound, panzer) and an AOE weapon primer (cedo, epitaph).

**Modding notes**

**Flexible Mods**

- Hallowed Reckoning - OPTIONAL augment to take advantage of grouping and passive damage zones that can actually deal some DPS when enemies are full-stripped, and helps kill stragglers with very little HP left after a smite nuke. Also gives additional armor bonus that feeds into Arcane Battery energy.

- Smite Infusion - OPTIONAL augment that gives bonus radiation elemental damage for improving raw weapon damage.

- Natural Talent - If you don't own Amber Archon shards, good quality of life to make the long casting animation of Reckoning much more bearable. Can offload with Amber Archon Shards and Madurai school.

**Helminth**

- Roar: boosts damage of smite and reckoning/hallowed reckoning and weapons
- Breach surge: blinds enemies, creates cascading damage sparks scaling from smite damage and hallowed reckoning damage, can apply radiation status
- Marked for Death
- Blood Altar
- Decoy

**Arcanes, Aura & Exilus**

- Arcane Universal Fallout : killing enemies affected by radiation status applied by abilities give a chance to drop a LARGE universal orb. This orb gives 50 energy, 50 health (converts to 55 energy by equilibrium) and counts for Oberon's passive.
- Molt Augmented: Free strength after 250 kills, helps you hit oneshot thresholds with even less viral statuses
- Arcane Battery: gives energy max based on current armor rating. Reckoning gives up to 1000 flat armor based on how many enemies you hit and how many radiation procs they had, but overwrites it each time you recast reckoning meaning you cost potentially lose 300 energy if you first hit 20 enemies then hit only 1 enemy on a next cast. If you add Hallowed Reckoning or Renewal, you get even more armor for more energy max.

**Archon Shards**

- ONE to TWO Amber Cast Speed shard to speed up cast of smite and reckoning, which you will be spamming alot, as well recasting of Roar and Hallowed Ground
- ONE to FOUR Tauforged Topaz +ability damage on radiation status to boost smite and reckoning damage, lowering strength and viral requirements for AOE oneshots. You would want to tailor this to your needs and specific build. Personally I am running ONE Tauforged Shard along with a 249% strength breakpoint, in order to free up shard slots for other useful shards
FLEX SHARDS:
- Parkour Velocity for mobility
- Equilibrium shards free up equilibrium in mod slots, e.g. for hallowed reckoning or smite infusion

**Survivability & failure conditions**

Not detailed. Survivability comes from whatever defensive mods/abilities are in the configuration above; the guide does not state what breaks it.

**Energy economy**

**Efficiency and Energy Economy**

At 45% efficiency, Oberon will consume ALOT of energy per ability rotation e.g. casting 4 and 1 costs a whopping 194 energy while refreshing 2 and 3 occasionally also costs about 194 energy.

Thankfully he has multiple means of recovering energy and improving energy economy, allowing you to spam all abilities with zero care in the world:
- Arcane Universal Fallout: enemies affected by radiation status (created by abilities) have a chance of dropping a universal orb (60% at 10 radiation). Both Smite and Reckoning forces one radiation status on cast while Hallowed Ground forces 1 radiation status every 0.5s, meaning it would take about 4s + reckoning + smite to hit 10 radiation status. On average you will probably be killing enemies afflicted by about 4 to 5 radiation status meaning at least 30% chance to drop orbs all over the map. Each universal orb restores 50 energy meaning if you kill about 20 enemies you could be getting on average 300 energy back. If you also have equilibrium, the universal orbs also restore 55 energy (from health), meaning a total of 630 energy.
-  Enemies simply damaged once by Reckoning also have a 50% chance to produce health orbs on death, which can be converted into energy by Equilibrium so each orb makes 55 energy. If you kill those same 20 enemies on average 10 of them will drop orbs and produce 550 energy. All up, you can spend about 200 energy killing 20 enemies and receive about 1180 energy back. This is absolutely overkill but also means you can spam both 4 and 1 with zero reservation.
- Primed Flow and high base energy: With Primed Flow Oberon hits 755 energy max. You could potentially replace this with just Arcane Battery to save a mod slot, or run only Primed flow to save arcane slot, OR even run BOTH simultaneously for extreme energy reserves.
- Arcane Battery (OPTIONAL): This increases maximum energy with armor rating BUT is highly fluctuatant. Oberons base armor makes Battery give 135 energy. Reckoning provides up to 1000 flat armor bonus based on enemies hit and how many radiation procs are on them (you need to hit 18 enemies with 10 radiation status each to cap this), which results in approximately +435 max energy (to total of 700). Using both Arcane Battery AND Primed Flow can result in 1190 energy max. Adding Hallowed Reckoning provides even more armor bonus for a total of 1335 max energy. If you decided to keep Renewal you finally get a whopping 1755 energy! Keep in mind however, casting Reckoning each time REWRITES the armor gained from the previous buff. This means if you were sitting at 700 energy from a 1000 armor buff, then cast Reckoning and only hit one enemy for a tiny armor buff, you will effectively LOSE almost 300 energy.

**Playstyle & rotation**

1. Cast 2 whenever necessary to cover the entire map with Hallowed Ground. This will give you and allies status + knockdown immunity while confusing enemies with radiation status, which also feeds into universal fallout and armor from reckoning.
2. Cast 4 to full strip enemies, slam them to the ground for crowd control, apply radiation damage and status.
3. Spam 1 everywhere to kill enemies by dealing current %HP damage everywhere
4. Keep Roar active if subsumed (OPTIONAL).

**Variants**

_None described._

**Strengths & weaknesses**

- **Strengths:** high effective health / sustained survivability; forgiving of mistakes.
- **Weaknesses:** lower ability- or weapon-damage ceiling; can still fall to gaps in the defensive layer.
_(Archetype-level; the source guide gives no explicit list.)_

**Patch / update history (from the guide)**

**UPDATE OCT 2025 - NEW SMITE MECHANICS**

Oberon rework now allows Smite to deal up to 75% current HP of the targetted enemy as radiation damage on the single target (while simultaneously stripping armor and overguard on that one enemy) as well as up to 30% current HP as radiation damage in an AOE with 6m at base and 16.8m at maximum range. Smite will auto-target the strongest enemy if there are multiple enemies close together (e.g. the eximus) but since this is now RADIATION damage, it has a 50% effect on Orokin enemies (e.g. found in conjunction, fissures, circuit) meaning you will need alot more viral priming to overcome the penalty.

If you want to oneshot a single target before they are affected by radiation status, viral status etc - you just need exactly 185% strength with Roar.

If you boost the AOE to 100% we can potentially nuke enemies in up to 16.8m. The base value of the AOE damage is 10% CURRENT HP and is affected by strength but caps at a maximum of 30% at 300% strength. In order to make this useful, we need to get it 100% HP or higher as well as strip armor (which Reckoning does for you now in a single cast).

The things that can boost the Smite on Oberon include:
1. ROAR: Subsumed Roar gives +30% ability damage scaling with strength
2. TOPAZ ARCHON SHARDS: Each Tau Topaz Shard gives +15% ability damage for up to +75% with five tau shards
3. VIRAL STATUS: A single viral status doubles all damage done to health and 10 viral statuses increases all damage by 4.25x

Different combinations of the above three factors give arise to varying strength breakpoints for 100% HP in AOE, for example:
WITH ROAR ACTIVE:
FIVE TOPAZ SHARDS + NO VIRAL: 302% strength (very hard to hit this threshold while maintaining range and uses up all shard slots)
FOUR TOPAZ SHARDS + ONE VIRAL STATUS: 197% strength
THREE TOPAZ SHARDS + ONE VIRAL STATUS: 212% strength
TWO TOPAZ SHARDS + ONE VIRAL STATUS: 229% strength
**ONE TOPAZ SHARD + ONE VIRAL STATUS: 249% strength** (this is what I run in this iteration)
NO TOPAZ SHARDS +  ONE VIRAL STATUS: 275% strength
NO SHARDS + NO VIRAL: 778% strength

WITHOUT ROAR ACTIVE:
NO SHARDS +  10 VIRAL : 276% strength (very hard to consistently and quickly get 10 viral status exactly where you need)
ONE SHARDS + 7 VIRAL: 249% strength

In practice, it is extremely easy to have a companion or manually prime viral status and you usually apply much more than one viral stack, so you probably don't actually need much strength at all. However, for consistency sake we should assume we are only able to apply a single viral status due to RNG e.g. from Epitaph, Bubonico, Cedo and try to hit the breakpoint for that.

If you want to check breakpoints for your own setup, use this neat desmos calculator made by the player mineturtleofdeath:

**UPDATE APR 2025**

Arcane Universal Fallout gives amazing energy economy when you kill enemies affected by radiation status, which alot of Oberon's abilities can apply.

**Additional notes from the guide**

**Companion**

Companions that can AOE prime viral are ideal to help boost the AOE of smite. Companions are much less consistent than manual priming but offer a viable 'hands-off' alternative if you prefer:

Nautilus for passive grouping :
Shade for Invisibility:
Make sure to run Tazicor or Helstrum as weapon for viral priming:

Hound:
Panzer:

Optional:
- Brief Respite gives backup shield gating in addition to Oberon's passive immortality.
- Growing power gives extra 25% strength when you apply status via a weapon

OPTION 1: Righteous Negation, Shield Gating and Crowd Control
Oberon's new passive Righteous Negation provides up to three protective charges on picking up health orbs or universal orbs. Reckoning makes a 50% chance to drop health orb on kill while Universal Fallout creates up to 60% chance to drop universal orb on kill (at 10 radiation), meaning by combining these two you will be spewing orbs all over the place provided you upkeep kills. Each charge negates damage and gives 0.25s i-frame, with 0.5s i-frame on the final charge, meaning a total of 1s effective i-frame when you have 3 charges. This is effectively passive immortality as long as you get kills and pick up orbs. If you cannot get sufficient kills to drop orbs in a timely manner, you also have Shield Gating as backup, where breaking 370 shields to zero gives about 1.37s of i-frames. Casting Reckoning with Brief Respite + Augur Reach costs 155 energy which is converted into 294 shield on cast, which is equivalent to 1.23s iframe on shield break. This means even if you run out of Negation charges, just spamming abilities like Reckoning will give you backup survivability. Simultaneously, radiation procs from Hallowed Ground and slamming from Reckoning gives crowd control which reduces the frequency of even taking damage in the first place.

OPTION 2: Health Tanking and Renewal Healing
If you prefer not to think too hard, cast too often or rely on orb pickups, or just want to utilize his whole kid including Renewal, you could always do the old fashioned method of health tanking and healing via Renewal. Phoenix Renewal even adds an additional layer of protection. Oberon is very good at it due to high base armor, free flat armor bonuses from Renewal/Reckoning and the innate healing from Renewal. You can help increase EHP by adding health e.g. Umbral Vitality + Arcane Blessing. You should not need to slot armor due to all the innate bonuses.

**PRIMER**

For the most consistent 'nuking' with smite, you will want an AOE viral primer that roughly matches the radius of smite (which is about 16.8m at max) and can apply at least 1 to 2 viral statuses in one shot.
- Epitaph: quickshot has 14.4m radius with very high status chance : , can run fortifier for extra overguard and amalgam barrel diffusion for faster rolling. This range nearly matches smite's AOE radius so is the perfect fit.
- Bubonico: alt fire projectiles have 7m radius with very high status chance:
- Cedo: alt fire shoots homing glaive that has high status chance and spreads through a large area:

Rakta Dark Dagger is a melee that regenerates shields on hit when used against enemies affected by a radiation proc. This synergizes somewhat with Oberon since three of his abilities cause radiation procs:

**Who it's for**

Use this if you want Oberon Prime as a tank option for steel path endurance, circuit / duviri, farming / loot. It carries a written guide (above).

**Build overview**

This is a DPS Limbo build focused on buffing weapon damage with the Rift Torrent augment and combining this with Breach Surge to create 'double dipped' surge sparks which can do damage in the billions or even negative billions (due to integer overflow). This is possible because Breach Surge spark damage scale off your weapon damage which is multiplied by the Rift Torrent bonus, but each spark itself is also counted as a weapon, so it is multiplied by the Rift Torrent bonus a second time when it hits. In addition, Limbo's stasis and cataclysm abilities allow you to get easy headshots in the absolute safety of the rift. If up against acolytes however, since stasis doesn't freeze them, you will have to use cataclysm + stasis to freeze other enemies allowing you to focus on the acolyte, Magus Lockdown to shut them down and rely on Rift Torrent to get the insane damage bonus to kill them quickly.

**Key stats & breakpoints**

**Duration**

Positive duration is required so stasis, rift surge and cataclysm don't need to be recast so often.

**Efficiency**

Efficiency can be negative since we don't need to spam abilities, and Limbo's passive also returns 10 energy for every enemy killed in the rift, meaning killing a room of 30 enemies returns 300 energy. This combined with arcane energize means you can sustain your energy as long as you get lots of kills, which is the whole point of the build. If you feel energy becomes an issue, you can drop Augur Secrets for Streamline.

**Range**

High range is needed so rift surge and cataclysm covers a large amount of enemies and to give you the maximum bonus on Rift Torrent. Range is also beneficial for breach surge range.

**Strength**

Strength is the most important stat since it scales both the Breach Surge damage multiplier and Rift Torrent multiplier, the latter of which scales again into breach surge sparks, meaning strength essentially 'double dips' breach surge. At about 200% str, we hit approximately 4x breach surge multiplier and 60% Rift Torrent bonus for each enemy affected by rift surge.

**OLD Damage Calculations**

For example, if you rift surge 50 enemies you can hit a Rift Torrent bonus of approximately 3000%, which is additive to your other +dmg sources like Serration and merciless arcanes (but multiplicative with galvanized overload mods on certain weapons like Bubonico, Quellor), and equates to approximately 30x more damage. Applied twice means each breach surge spark actually receives a multiplier of 900x damage. Adding the breach surge multiplier of 4x makes this about 3600 x weapon damage. Theoretically, if you can make a weapon do 1 million damage by itself, then each spark potentially does 3.6 billion, which exceeds the games damage cap of 2.14 billion and can even become negative. Furthermore, surge sparks can headshot and are affected by headshot multipliers.

### 48. Mag Prime — Breach and Crush | Magnetize Nuke and Full Strip Crush | Steel Path Endurance

**Type:** Ability DPS · **Difficulty:** Advanced · **Investment:** High

**Build overview**

Magnetize is Mag's most versatile and powerful ability and can be used to crowd control/group enemies, block enemy projectiles, shred a single target (bosses/acolytes) or grouped enemies, AOE nuke (line of sight) and finally disarm enemies (with the augment). Magnetize works by creating a bubble around an enemy and redirecting all projectiles/bullets into the centre. This will allow weapons with punch through to rapidly kill enemies in the centre by hitting them multiple times as they orbit around.

Additionally, 25% of your weapon's damage will be absorbed into the bubble (counts multishot but not crits or DoT effects). This absorbed damage will then be dealt as magnetic damage over time (50% absorbed damage per 1/2 second tick) to every enemy in the field for the remaining duration of the bubble. Finally once the bubble destabilizes (either manually with augment or on expiration once the initial enemy is dead), all the absorbed damage will be multiplied by the total number of damage ticks experienced by each enemy (essentially 2 x duration in seconds x enemies in bubble) and released in a massive AOE explosion (requires LINE OF SIGHT).

**Mod configuration**

- Magnetized Discharge — R3
- Counter Pulse — R3
- Stretch — R5 — – · Naramon
- Primed Flow — R10 — – · Naramon
- Fracturing Crush — R3

**Intended content — best at / less suited for**

Designed for: Level Cap, Steel Path endurance, Circuit / Duviri, Survival, Defense, Bossing, Farming / loot. The source guide does not spell out where it underperforms; as a ability dps build the usual tradeoff applies (see Strengths & weaknesses).

**Core build concept**

A **ability dps** Mag Prime setup: low Strength (0.95×), short Duration (0.725×), wide Range (2.5×), neutral Efficiency (1×). Its engine is the combination in the mod configuration above — Magnetized Discharge, Counter Pulse, Stretch, Primed Flow, Fracturing Crush, aura Growing Power, Arcane Arachne + Molt Augmented. See the written sections below for the intended damage/defence loop.

**Key stats & breakpoints**

**Duration**

Keep duration as close to neutral since it will affect the blind duration of breach surge and the duration of magnetize (all of which have a decent base duration of about 15s).

**Efficiency**

Mag's playstyle requires constant casting of abilities. We can supplement this with Equilibrium + synth deconstruct on companion to produce health orbs which are converted into energy, as well as a combination of arcane steadfast +/- Mystic Bond to give free ability casts. Primed Flow would be nice to slot, but you can also use the surplus of azure shards to supplement energy capacity.

**Range**

Range is the most important stat for magnetize. Overextended and Stretch hit a range of 235%. The augment Magnetized Discharge adds a further 45% to give 280% effective range to magnetize, giving a total radius of 11.2m and explosion radius of 42m. High range also affects the range of crush which gives more shields/overshields.

**Strength**

While we ideally want the strength to be high to scale the breach surge multiplier and pull speed of magnetize, strength is not that important as the magnetize 'damage multiplier' only applies to the single targeted enemy rather than all the enemies, and strength does NOT affect the absorption of weapon damage into the bubble. The strength multiplier also does not bypass the 5 million damage cap of breach surge meaning if you use strong single hit weapons that deal more than 5 million damage already (e.g. heavy Glaive, exodia contagion), strength will have little effect on the final surge damage. Fracturing Crush only requires 134% power strength for full strip in a single cast. We require either Precision Intensify + Growing Power for 4 to hit 134 str, or run Umbral Intensify and Molt Augmented to offset the strength penalty from Overextended and hit this benchmark. Other alternatives like Blind Rage or Transient Fortitude have too much drawback and Augur Secrets has too little boost. If you don't like or own molt augmented, consider dropping overextended for augur reach, or simply dont run fracturing crush

**Modding notes**

The guide does not break down individual mods. Defining picks appear to be: Magnetized Discharge, Counter Pulse, Stretch, Primed Flow, Fracturing Crush. Slots holding basic drift/utility or resistance mods are the flexible ones.

**Archon Shards**

- Strength shards to boost breach surge

**Survivability & failure conditions**

Not detailed. Survivability comes from whatever defensive mods/abilities are in the configuration above; the guide does not state what breaks it.

**Energy economy**

Efficiency sits at 1× per the stats line. The build/guide references an energy source — see mods/overview.

**Playstyle & rotation**

Main ability rotation:
1. Use Breach Surge (1 or 3) to blind enemies for crowd control and prime them for spark production.
2. Cast Magnetize (2) on an enemy to draw enemies into the center - choose positions where the bubble will block incoming enemies or gunfire (e.g. corridors)
3. Cast Crush to full-strip enemies and immobilize enemies.
4. Shoot weapon slightly off to the side of centre to create an orbiting path
5. Enemies will either die instantly or produce surge sparks that then feed back into the bubble
6. Let the bubble expire or detonate bubble by casting 2 again near the bubble for big line of sight explosion
7. OPTIONAL (if not subsumed over): Cast Polarize constantly to restore shields and crowd control if running counter.
8. OPTIONAL (if not subsumed over): Cast Pull while standing inside a bubble to pull additional enemies quicker into magnetize.

Survivability:
If shields deplete, either cast polarize (3) or crush (4) combined with or without rolling guard. Polarize is one-handed and has a short animation, meaning you can reload and run/dodge while doing this, but does not offer any crowd control (without the augment). Crush is two handed and locks you into an animation, but does offer a short period of knockdown for breathing room, while also costing a little more energy. If possible, try to use polarize since it is quicker. When surrounded you can cast crush for more overshields and breathing room while you reposition.

**Strengths & weaknesses**

- **Strengths:** strong add-clear and burst from abilities; low weapon dependence.
- **Weaknesses:** falls off against single tough targets / very high armor without strip; energy-hungry.

**Build overview**

Utilise the power of the Mecha Set, Archon Mods and Heat + Gas Catalyze to nuke enemies as Lavos, the Full Mecha Alchemist. Lavos's Catalyze is a strong through the wall nuke that applies elemental damage and a forced status effect, applying heat damage at base and a second element that you can 'infuse'. We infuse Gas into catalyze because Gas procs linger across the map dealing damage in a small AOE, lasting longer than usual due to Lavos' passive, and works well with both grouping and optionally the Sickening Pulse helminth.

**Core build concept**

A **tank** Lavos Prime setup: moderate Strength (1.39×), long Duration (1.55×), wide Range (2.05×), negative Efficiency (0.45×). Its engine is the combination in the mod configuration above — Overextended, Adaptation, Blind Rage, Swift Bite, Valence Formation, aura Mecha Empowered, Arcane Impetus + Arcane Blessing. See the written sections below for the intended damage/defence loop.

**Key stats & breakpoints**

**Duration**

Duration provides status duration to all of the statuses created by Lavos's abilities. At 155% duration, every proc is increased to approximately 9s increasing the overall damage potential of a status. We can add Grimoire Ris Invocation (up to 60%) and three tauforged duration shards to help boost this up to 260% final which makes statuses last 15s. Archon Continuity can be used because Toxin procs created by Ophidian Bite can then proc corrosive which boosts Catalyze in two ways, due to both minor armor strip (up to 80% at 10 corrosive) and because Catalyze scales with number of elemental statuses (2^status).

**Efficiency**

Efficiency does not affect Lavos cooldowns directly however do affect how much cooldown reduction is generated by Swift Bite and Lingering Transmutation. Arcane Impetus can hit 10 statuses which gives a bonus of 30% efficiency which is very easy to upkeep as you only need to cast a single ability once every 20s after you have performed every elemental combo at least once. Seismic Bond also procs whenever your companion damages an enemy while you are casting Vial Rush meaning you could potentially have another free 30% efficiency, bringing you back to 105% final efficiency.

**Range**

Range is essential for all of Lavos's abilities as it increases the range at which Ophidian Bite can hit, the travel and explosion of Vial Rush, the radius of Transmutation Probe which affects how quickly you can reduce cooldowns and the range of Catalyze, including certain helminth options such as grouping abilities and Sickening Pulse.

**Strength**

Strength is mainly is needed for the damage of Catalyze so we can benefit from Precision Intensify if you want. WIth Blind Rage, Precision Intensify and Arcane Impetus ( or Molt Augmented) we could hit 289% final strength for Catalyze damage.

**Modding notes**

**ARCHON MODS**

Archon mods work well with Lavos, but are NOT compulsory (the regular versions work fine too):
- Archon Vitality adds an additional heat proc created by Catalyze, but only one extra proc even if you infuse heat into heat.
- Archon Continuity adds corrosive status upon being hit by toxin procs via Ophidian Bite, which slightly helps with Emerald shard armor strip and any additional elemental statuses boost Catalyze.
- Archon Intensify activates upon being healed by Ophidian Bite, giving a total of +60% strength (compared to only 44% from Umbral Intensify). Precision Intensify is however straight up better since it gives 90% strength to 4.

Archon Stretch and Archon Flow are NOT usable on Lavos since he has NO energy and does not benefit from energy orbs.

**Helminth**

In most cases we subsume over Vial Rush, unless you really enjoy the mobility of vial Rush or are doing weapon platform, you could subsume over 1 or 4 instead.

**Arcanes, Aura & Exilus**

These can be flexible based on preference.

Survivability:
- Arcane Aegis - when this procs (based on RNG) you could get 12s of relative immortality to non-toxin damage (see below for Fass Canticle bug to abuse this further)
- Arcane Persistence - limits health loss by 500 hp /s as long as armor is over 700 and you are not affected by magnetic, bleed, heat, corrosive.
- Arcane Blessing - gives up to 1200 more health which is an additional 2s of survivability with persistence
- Arcane Guardian - extra armor to help ehp

For Catalyze damage
- Arcane Impetus - up to 60% strength and 30% efficiency from Lavos potential elements, just need to cast each combination at least once in the mission then you will be able to constantly refresh it by casting any element
- Molt Augmented - up to 60% strength after 250 kills
- Arcane Ice storm - 40% strength and duration, but can be difficult to keep maxed and highly dependent on density, so could sit around half stacks around 20% strength/20% duration

**Archon Shards**

ONE regular Azure armor shard for Arcane Persistence OPTIONAL to hit 700 armor and free up aura slot
ONE to TWO Amber Cast Speed Shard to speed up cast animations
TWO or THREE Crimson Duration Shards helps increase the duration of gas procs from catalyze and all other statuses
Other flexible shards include Parkour Velocity for mobility

**Playstyle & rotation**

NON-HELMINTH PLAYSTYLE
1. Try to group enemies with Magus Anomaly/Ensnare/Nautilus Cordon/Melee Vortex.
2. Infuse Corrosive (hold 1 and 3) and cast Vial Rush (Tap 2) to charge through groups of enemies, dropping vials that rapidly stack corrosive status for full strip on enemies standing in the pools (14 procs in 3-4s).
3. Shoot your primer (e.g. Cedo altfire, Grimoire Alt-fire) to inflict more unique statuses, especially viral and heat, then hold 1 and 4 to infuse GAS, before immediately casting Catalyze (4).
4. Tap 3 immediately after to reduce the cooldown of 4, and ideally before enemies all die
5. Tap 1 ideally into the group of enemies. This will reduce cooldowns of both 3 and 4 further

**Sickening Sublimation (Gas and Sickening Pulse)**
