.

**MECHA SET**

The mecha set provides many benefits:
- Mecha Empowered gives +150% damage (2.5x damage multiplier) to a marked enemy (marked every 12s), which doubles dips on status effects for a final 6.25x on heat/gas DoT
- Mecha Pulse gives +60% armor for each enemy in 30m upon killing the marked enemy. In a dense map like survival you can easily get 1000-2000% armor bonus, which scales extremely well with Lavos' high base armor, allowing you to hit between 3000 to 10,000 final armor. This is optional if you would like to health tank instead of shield gate.
- Mecha set bonus causes status effects to spread upon killing a marked enemy which basically applies whole additional set of boosted catalyze procs to 30m radius every 15s.

1. **Health Tanking (for lower levels <500)**
Since Lavos does not spend energy, he is unable to reset shield gate with the normal methods using Brief Respite/Augur mods. For non-endurance content, you can commit to full eHP tanking using a combination of armor, health and adaptation and using Ophidian bite to heal.

Lavos has a high base health so Archon Vitality/Vitality boosts health to 1480. Transmutation Probe converts all orbs into universal orbs which activate Arcane Blessing so you can gain an additional 1200 health very quickly for a total of 2680 health.

Lavos also has a high base armor of 675, meaning Mecha Pulse after affecting just 10 enemies in a 30m radius gives a 600% armor boost for 3150 extra armor for 20s. Compare this to Steel Fiber which only gives +100% for another 675 armor. Since Mecha set has a cooldown of only 15s you should be able to upkeep a large armor buff permanently provided you kill dense crowds consistently. If you affect 20 enemies, you can get 1200% armor or 5850 armor for 95.6% DR. This multiplied with Adaptation gives 99.56% DR and applied to 2680 health gives an effective HP of 609,090. Additional useful sources of ehp include Arcane Reaper, Melee Fortification, Arcane Guardian, Health Conversion, Arcane Doubleback.

2. **Arcane Persistence (for higher levels >500 but needs external healing)**
The new Arcane Persistence prevents taking more than 500 health damage per second (applying after damage reduction from armor or abilities) while armor is above 700, meaning if you have high health and/or can heal 500 health back quickly/consistently you can be survive without shield gating or classic health tanking all the way up to levelcap. Lavos Prime has a very high base armor which almost meets the 700 armor threshold (675 at rank 30), meaning you could run a single normal azure armor shard to hit the threshold. You can then run Archon Vitality for health and don't require any additional armor or DR sources. All you need is consistent healing which you could source from a combination of Ophidian Bite, Life Strike on a melee and other weapons with health steal (Syam + Daikyu Amalgam, Coda Hirudo, Sancti Magistar).

3. **Shield Gating (for higher levels > 500)**
3a. **Active Gating**
You can subsume a shield regenerating ability like Pillage or Condemn, and swap Adaptation for Rolling Guard. Pillage gives armor strip which is very beneficial to Lavos's damaging abilities, while Condemn gives crowd control which is very useful in Endurance and preventing you from getting hit in the first place. You will also want to run Vazarin protective sling for additional i-frames as well as Huras Kubrow or Shade for invisibility.  Shade has the added bonus of having Guardian + Manifold Bond which allows it to constantly refill your shields passively whenever you get kills on enemies affected by multiple statuses, which is Lavos's specialty. An Endurance oriented variant using Pillage:

3b. **Passive Gating/Recharge**
Another niche method is to use multiple sources of shield recharge delay reduction mods like Fast Deflection and Vigilante Vigor to reduce the recharge delay to approximately 1s (4s down 75%). Catalyzing Shields is currently bugged to force a 1.33s gate on any amount of shield regenerated, which means if you DON'T GET HIT during the shield gate you will regenerate shields before the iframes end. However, if you get hit during the 1.33s gate the delay timer will be reset meaning after the end of i-frames you may have anywhere between 0s to 1s of delay before you start getting shields again. If you stay mobile and continue killing things, and try not to get hit during the gate time it is possible to passively maintain your shield gate indefinitely. You can add additional sources of invulnerability such as Vazarin Protective Sling, Rolling Guard or Omamori helminth if you prefer. When you combine this setup with Arcane Aegis and Fass Canticle you become completely immortal for 15s (see near the beggining for explanation)

3c. **Fass Canticle Immortality Bug**
Currently, there is a special bug that occurs when you run a combination of Fast Deflection + Vigilante Vigor + Arcane Aegis and trigger Fass Canticle from the Grimoire. Whenever Fass Canticle is active (for 15s each time), you will have an arcane aegis like effect which renders you effectively immortal to all NON-TOXIN damage. In order to activate Fass Canticle however, you must be HOLDING Grimoire as your currently equipped weapon AND kill an enemy that is currently being damaged by Grimoire. However the source of damage that KILLS the enemy does not need to come from Grimoire it self and can be an ability or even from status from another weapon so long as you swap to Grimoire the moment they die. Luckily Lavos specialises in killing enemies with abilities and can very easily and consistent proc Fass Canticle. So all you need to do is just spam Grimoire alt-fire everywhere once every 15s which also gives your choice of bonus 60% of duration, efficiency or strength (personally would set this to duration at default OR efficiency if you don't have arcane impetus).

![](

**Sickening Pulse**

This sends a spreading wave that basically doubles heat DoT, doubles toxin DoT, adds 10 stacks of corrosive (to help with full strip from 2 green archon shards) but multiplies gas and electic DoT by 10x. This is the best subsume for smaller maps with tight corridors or where you can force enemies to naturally group up as they come in, or if you have an alternate form of grouping like Magus Anomaly, Vazarin Snare, Telos Boltace, Nautilus Cordon, Melee Vortex etc. This also double dips Valence Formation meaning you can multiply the single Gas proc created by catalyze effectively by 90x.

**Roar**

Boosts all DoT status effects and double dips the roar bonus. Less spammy and applies passively to all damage from both your weapons and abilities.

**Ensnare/Grouping**

Grouping is great on Lavos as it lets Gas procs from Gas infused Catalyze overlap and create exponential damage on groups of enemies, and also allows more enemies to get hit at once for both Swift Bite and Transmutation Probe in order to reduce cooldowns more efficiently.

Ensnare is a bit slower than the other grouping abilities but provides longer crowd control by keeping enemies locked in place for longer durations. This is ideal on Lavos as you often need to perform an ability rotation before you can nuke with catalyze, so you need to keep enemies in place for at least a few seconds. Coil Horizon is a good alternative as it provides electric status procs in case you didnt cast 3.

There are however alternative methods of grouping that don't use a subsume e.g. Nautilus Cordon, Scyotid alt fire, Magus Anomaly

**Expedite Suffering**

Compresses the total duration of slash and toxin procs and deals it in one instance, then applies a multiplier. This is a great tool for disruption when paired with a good natural slash weapon such as Flux Rifle, Convectrix, Spectral Vandal or any decent slash Melee weapon (e.g. nikana prime, dual ether, kronen prime etc).

For a specific Expedite build, use this:

**Pillage**

Pillage lets Lavos shield gate more effectively and also strips armor which allows status effects to scale more effectively against armor.

**Omamori**

Good option of lazy survivability and pairs well with passive gate because it gives a 50% chance to basically ignore damage and restore shields but has a cooldown.

**Evade**

Another good option for survivability since it makes you invisible but requires a headshot chaining weapon to upkeep ideally (e.g. Dual Toxocyst, Vadarya Prime). Lavos can reduce the innate cooldown of Evade with transmutation probe in case you come out of invisibility early and reenter evade instantly after using 3.

**MECHA SET KUBROWS**

The mecha set requires a kubrow, ideally Huras kubrow which will allow you stay invisible as long as you don't shoot:

Pharoah Predasite is a reasonable alternative:

**SENTINELS/OTHER**

Sentinels are capable of using Guardian and Manifold Bond, which is highly effective at keeping Lavos alive via shield gating.
Nautilus can be a useful passive grouping tool and can prime elements with Tazicor:
Diriga can consistently prime in a small radius of 10m around you:
Helios can provide passive armor strip if you don't use emerald shards or pillage:
Hounds can perform the widest AOE priming for Catalyze:

**PRIMER**

An AOE primer can spread status procs to enable Catalyze even further (the missing status procs are viral, magnetic, blast, cold, because corrosive is provided by Archon Continuity):

Bubonico allows you to prime for both Viral AND Corrosive, which allows green shards to full strip much quicker:

Cedo is able to proc the most unique status effects in an AOE to boost Catalyze:
Kuva Ogris is also able to proc alot of unique status effects in an AOE:

The Grimoire is a useful utility weapon that can triple as an encumber primer, stat buffer from Invocation mods and even immortality source (Fass Canticle) or armor strip (Jahu Canticle)

**MELEE WEAPONS**

Telos Boltace - this weapon has a special ability where slide attacks group enemies with a 14m radius and 6s cooldown. Telos Boltace is also a Tonfa meaning it deals significant damage due to neutral combo on Sovereign Outcast and has very high status chance meaning it is a very strong user of Melee Influence.
Telos Boltace:

Dual Ichor Incarnon - this is currently the strongest light spam melee weapon in the game. You can pair this with Melee Vortex for grouping (use magnetic primer such as kuva nukor or infuse magnetic into abilities) or Melee Influence for AOE nuking.
Dual Ichor:

**GAS GROUPING CATALYZE CALCULATIONS**

Using a Cedo Primer giving blast, viral, rad, tox, electric, cold with heat and gas from catalyze gives about 8 unique status effects. If you apply this to a mecha marked enemy with 10 viral statuses, the highest gas proc that can be spread is

2000 x 1.45 x 0.5 x 2^8 x 4.25 x 6.25 = 9,860,000 gas damage per second

If you then apply this to 10 enemies ensnared together within 3m, each enemy will deal this amount of damage per second to each other enemy in a 3m radius, meaning each enemy actually takes about 99 million gas damage per second.

If you apply Sickening Pulse and use another form of grouping, we can max this to 10 gas procs which deals 99 million damage/s per enemy but in a 6m radius i.e. 990 million damage/s if 10 enemies grouped or about 2 billion damage/s at 20 enemies.

Without Mecha Empowered active, we deal about 1.6 million gas dmg/s per enemy, or 32 million gas dmg/s in 6m area if 20 enemies are ensnared.

**Who it's for**

Use this if you want Lavos Prime as a tank option for level cap, steel path endurance, disruption, survival, farming / loot. It carries a written guide (above).

### 50. Koumei — Threads of Fate | Koumei General Use and Steel Path Endurance

**Type:** Tank · **Difficulty:** Advanced · **Investment:** High

**Build overview**

Koumei is a frame that is slightly geared toward endurance as it takes a while to accumulate sufficient decrees via Omikuji before you feel like are getting a significant benefit to gameplay. If you want to run quick missions then you may not be bothered using Omikuji at all. Koumei's decrees are also slightly weighted toward a melee focus due to the number of melee decrees while her Kumihimo and Bunraku abilities produce lots of status effects that work well with Condition Overload on melees and similar mods on guns (e.g. Galvanized Aptitude). Just note there are number of weapons that do NOT really benefit from such effects (e.g. Melee Slam, Glaives, AOE guns, several incarnons).

**Mod configuration**

- Catalyzing Shields — R3 — D · Vazarin
- Rolling Guard — R10
- Vigilante Vigor — R5
- Fast Deflection — R5
- Overextended — R5 — D · Vazarin
- Omikuji's Fortune — R3
- Equilibrium — R10 — – · Naramon
- Archon Continuity — R10 — V · Madurai

*Aura:* Aerodynamic
*Exilus:* Mobilize
*Arcanes:* Arcane Impetus (R5), Arcane Aegis (R0)

*Resulting stats:* Armor 444 · Energy 222 · Health 444 · Shield 222 · Sprint Speed 1 · Ability Range 1.9 · Ability Duration 1.55 · Ability Strength 0.4 · Ability Efficiency 1

**Intended content — best at / less suited for**

**Shield Gating for Endurance (up to level 9999)**

Since many of Koumei's abilities do not really require stats we can invest many mod slots into "lazy" shield gate survivability which allows you to scale in endurance. One issue with standard active shield gating on Koumei is the possibility of rolling the Envious Economy decree which causes certain ability casts to cost 0 energy, which means Brief Respite and Augur Mod shield generation will not work consistent. As an alternative, Fast Deflection with Vigilante Vigor reduces the shield gate recharge delay to 1s. Catalyzing Shields currently gives max 1.33s shield gate after losing ANY amount of shield, despite not generating max shield capacity (likely unitended bug). For example regaining 3 shield via casting her 1 with Augur Reach or 1 shield via Fast Deflection/Vigilante Vigor (which occurs 1s after not taking damage) gives a full 1.33s i-frame upon breaking. Getting hit during the 1.33s i-frame resets the shield recharge delay so depending on when you take damage, you could have a 0 to 1s vulnerability window until you shield gate is fully reset. Omamori basically has a 50% chance to Negate damage which makes it harder for you to take damage during the vulnerability period. If you also stay mobile and utilise crowd control you should have no problems surviving up to levelcap without actively pressing buttons to shield gate.

Rolling Guard is OPTIONAL but clears harmful statuses and gives additional i-frames on demand, which can be life saving in the right circumstances.

As a final layer of gambling, Arcane Aegis is RNG but when it triggers it effectively gives you 12s of immortality to non-toxin damage.

**Health Tanking (also endurance viable)**

Koumei has about 4 decrees that can boost armor to ridiculous levels, a damage reduction decree and a decree that boost strength to further boost elemental ward subsume for even more armor/health. The amount of ehp gained is actually sufficient to tank up to levelcap provided you have a consistent form of healing e.g. from decree, from arcane reaper, Healing Return, Sancti Magistar e.t.c.

Since you have so many free slots you can also run multiple mods to health tank i.e. swap Fast Deflection, Vigilante Vigor, Rolling Guard and Catalyzing Shields for Mecha Pulse (if running Kubrwo), Health Conversion, Adaptation, Archon Vitality and Primed Flow. You can swap arcanes for Arcane Reaper, Guardian or Blessing.

HEALTH TANK KOUMEI (COLD WARD):

**Core build concept**

A **tank** Koumei setup: low Strength (0.4×), long Duration (1.55×), wide Range (1.9×), neutral Efficiency (1×). Its engine is the combination in the mod configuration above — Catalyzing Shields, Rolling Guard, Vigilante Vigor, Fast Deflection, Overextended, aura Aerodynamic, Arcane Impetus + Arcane Aegis. See the written sections below for the intended damage/defence loop.

**Key stats & breakpoints**

**DURATION**

Duration only affects her 1 and 4, and both have a decent base duration.

**EFFICIENCY**

Some efficiency lets you cast 1 and 4 on demand for shield gating and priming without needing significant energy investment, but energy economy only gets better once you get energy economy decrees e.g. Bounce Back, Morale Boost, Envious Economy. Equilibrium is therefore optional but helps sustain economy before you roll the decrees.

**RANGE**

Range is needed for 1 and 4, both have extremely high base range but 200 range is required to cap the number of threads from 1.

**STRENGTH**

Boosts the passive status damage of 1 and 4, but is completely optional to invest in considering they don't deal that much damage and you can get strength back via arcane impetus as well as fortifier's will (up to 500%) and armor decrees.

**Modding notes**

The guide does not break down individual mods. Defining picks appear to be: Catalyzing Shields, Rolling Guard, Vigilante Vigor, Fast Deflection, Overextended. Slots holding basic drift/utility or resistance mods are the flexible ones.

**Helminth**

Most subsumes will require a bit more strength investment so you may want to give up some survivability mods for more strength (i.e. swap Fast Deflection/Vigilante Vigor/Strike) for Umbral Intensify, Transient Fortitude, Augur Secrets, Molt Augmented.
1. Pillage - subsume over 1. Pillage gives armor strip which boosts damage against both shielded and armored enemies, cleanses statuses and allows you to consistently shield gate even if you roll Envious Economy.
2. Wrathful Advance - Gives flat melee crit chance boost giving your melee easy red crits
3. Eclipse - double dips specific melees like contagion and glaives if you want to use those specifically
4. Nourish - gives free viral and boosts energy multiplier
5. Grouping - airburst, pull, coil horizon can drag enemies through your Kumihimo wires and create multiple procs. You would need to subsume this over 4.
6. Sickening Pulse - multiplies all status effects, can be used to make 4 deal more DPS, subsume over 1
7. Breach Surge - benefits from certain decrees

**Arcanes, Aura & Exilus**

Completely flexible
- Arcane Impetus gives up to 78% strength and 39% efficiency
- Arcane aegis is optional and gives additional passive survivability but based on RNG (which almost fits her theme). **NOTE** ANY Rank arcane aegis is fine e.g. Rank 0.
- Molt Augmented for strength
- Arcane strike/fury to boost melee
- Arcane Precision to boost pistols
- Arcane battery gives huge energy pool with armor decrees although this is largely unnecessary

**Archon Shards**

At least ONE to TWO Amber Cast Speed shards would be recommended to make casting Bunraku feel nicer.
Rest are flex and can go into Azure Energy Max, Parkour Velocity or Violet Melee Crit Damage shards (will require Primed Flow)

**Survivability & failure conditions**

Not detailed. Survivability comes from whatever defensive mods/abilities are in the configuration above; the guide does not state what breaks it.

**Energy economy**

Efficiency sits at 1× per the stats line. The build/guide references an energy source — see mods/overview.

**Playstyle & rotation**

1. Keep 3 (Omamori) active at all times as this has a 50% chance to block damage. If you roll a triple 6 you will have a 100% chance to Negate all damage which is effectively immortality until all current charms are consumed.
2. Press 2 and perform a challenge to unlock a decree. You will want to keep some utility weapons to help with certain decrees e.g. (Scourge for headshots, Cedo for elemental kills)
3. Constantly tap 1 to shield gate and apply status effects. This is the only ability that can consistently be spammed for shield gating.
4. Press 4 whenever on cooldown and enemies are present. This will lock down a group of enemies and apply many statuses.

**Variants**

_None described._

**Strengths & weaknesses**

- **Strengths:** high effective health / sustained survivability; forgiving of mistakes.
- **Weaknesses:** lower ability- or weapon-damage ceiling; can still fall to gaps in the defensive layer.
_(Archetype-level; the source guide gives no explicit list.)_

**Patch / update history (from the guide)**

**UPDATE MARCH 2025**

Arcane Impetus gives up to 39% efficiency and 78% strength due to all the status effects from Bunraku and Kumihimo.
New augment Omikuji's Fortune reduces cooldown of Omikuji by killing with weapons affected by her rotating passive

**Additional notes from the guide**

Completely flexible
- Aerodynamic gives bonus wall latch and aim glide for decrees
- Mecha empowered if running Kubrow with mecha mods, allows status effects to spread and deal DPS
- Swift momentum gives extra wind up and combo duration
- Growing power fits the default polarity and gives strength
- Brief respite for shield gating
- Steel Charge for more capacity and minor melee damage

**MELEE PLATFORM**

Koumei can utilize any weapon but there is a larger proportion of decrees that can benefit melee overall. For example there are NINE melee-specific decrees and SEVEN general damage buffing decrees out of a total of 42 decrees, meaning you have a roughly 36% chance of rolling any single decree that will benefit melee, versus a 17% chance of rolling a decree that will buff guns.

Melee decrees (9)
	- Majestic Strike - duplicates melee hits but is affected by follow through
	- Sweeping Blow - heavy attacks create shockwaves similar to Exalted Blade that travel 35m
	- Venomous Touch - every third melee attack deals Toxin damage and status (makes separate status to modded elements)
	- Royal Wrath - each hit increases crit chance by up to 30% for 3s
	- Smoldering Strike - add heat damage and status chance (does not combine with modded elements)
	- Rising Agony - melee crits give critical damage for 7s (up to 150%)
	- Dueler's Outburst - on crit gain melee attack speed for 3s (up to 90%)
	- Killer's Confidence - on  melee kill gain overguard
	- Salted Wound - heavy attacks deal extra corrosive hit with status

General damage decrees that affect melee (7)
	- Shattering Frost - deal extra damage to enemies affected by cold status (similar to secondary shiver, additive to base dmg mods)
	- Deadly momentum - moving gives increased damage (additive to base dmg mods)
	- Twofold Torment - double status damage (is actually +100% status damage additve to melee elementalist so not as good as it really is)
	- Fearsome Bonanza - gain damage for every enemy affected by status in 20m (addtive to base dmg mods)
	- Critical Roll - after roll get critical damage for 4s (up to 120%)
	- Vicious Barb - double crit damage (actually +100% CD additive to mods and shards i.e. much worse than it should be)
	- Critical Frost - crits deal extra cold damage and status

Choose weapons that help you do decree challenges quickly.
The challenges include:
- Headshot - hitscan guns (e.g. cedo prime, dual toxocyst), innodem
- While sliding - light attack melees
- While wall latching - cedo prime, dual toxocyst
- Within 10 meters - light attack melees
- From 20 meters away - hitscan guns (e.g. cedo prime, dual toxocyst)
- While you are airborne - light attack melees (particularly innodem), contagion
- While they are affected by a status effect - cedo alt-fire + light attack melees

**MELEE WEAPONS**

Melee builds that benefit from Condition Overload are mostly light attack/hybrid tennokai melees, heavy projectile weapons and contagion zaw.

Rakta Dark Dagger is a very nice non-incarnon mid game pick since it also helps with passive shield gating.

**UTILITY**

Cedo Primer: Even though Koumei's 1 and 4 are both primers, they do not consistently proc heat,electric,toxin or cold as often as Cedo does, which is very useful to completing four of the decree challenges. Each alt fire of Cedo is basically guaranteed to proc all four base statuses. In comparison each cast of 1 only procs a single status out of the 13 existing statuses and requires a triple 6 roll to proc all base statuses. Each cast of 4 is even more random as it applies different statuses to different enemies.
Tailor the Cedo elements to your preference:

### 51. Garuda Prime — The Sanguine Heart | General Use/Nuke Garuda (non-helminth and helminth variants)

**Type:** Tank · **Difficulty:** Advanced · **Investment:** High

**Build overview**

General Use non-helminth Garuda build which is steel path endurance viable and great to use in the open world. Use Garuda's airborne acrobatic abilities to leap across the map with Dread Mirror and Blood altar, nuke from the skies with Dread Heart, heal with Blood Altar, regenerate energy on demand with Bloodletting and get shield gating, brief stun and insane scaling slash procs from Seeking Talons.

Up to date with changes to Garuda's abilities (March 2022). Now that Garuda's passive has changed from being based on missing health to the number of kills, there is now no reason to run a traditional 2hp/quick thinking/tank build. The addition of invulnerability frames to both Dread Mirror and Seeking Talons makes shield gating much easier and in combination with status cleanse from Bloodletting means you can even drop rolling guard.

**Mod configuration**

- Primed Flow — R10 — – · Naramon
- Primed Continuity — R10 — V · Madurai
- Stretch — R5 — – · Naramon
- Overextended — R5 — D · Vazarin
- Transient Fortitude — R10 — V · Madurai
- Umbral Intensify — R10
- Blending Talons — R3
- Augur Reach — R5

*Aura:* Brief Respite
*Exilus:* Kavat's Grace
*Arcanes:* Molt Reconstruct (R5), Arcane Arachne (R5)

*Resulting stats:* Armor 420 · Energy 911.994 · Health 370 · Shield 370 · Sprint Speed 1 · Ability Range 2.65 · Ability Duration 1.275 · Ability Strength 1.39 · Ability Efficiency 1

**Intended content — best at / less suited for**

Designed for: Level Cap, Steel Path endurance, Farming / loot. The source guide does not spell out where it underperforms; as a tank build the usual tradeoff applies (see Strengths & weaknesses).

**Core build concept**

A **tank** Garuda Prime setup: moderate Strength (1.39×), neutral Duration (1.275×), wide Range (2.65×), neutral Efficiency (1×). Its engine is the combination in the mod configuration above — Primed Flow, Primed Continuity, Stretch, Overextended, Transient Fortitude, aura Brief Respite, Molt Reconstruct + Arcane Arachne. See the written sections below for the intended damage/defence loop.

**Key stats & breakpoints**

**Duration**

Positive duration helps maintain uptime of Dread mirror, blood altar and seeking Talons mark. Use a combination of Primed Continuity and Constitution or Augur Message to offset Transient Fortitude.

**Efficiency**

Neutral efficiency is suggested because the amount of energy returned from bloodletting scales positively with efficiency, meaning you get 364 energy per 50% health at 100% efficiency (2.5 casts to refill whole energy bar from 0), compared to only 228 energy per cast at 45% efficiency (4 casts required to refill whole energy bar from 0). This means you need to spam bloodletting much less often (less vulnerable periods) and one cast provides enough energy to perform multiple combos of Seeking Talons and Dread Mirror/Blood Altar. Neutral efficiency also means you can channel Dread Heart more efficiently and get more damage for less drain. Primed Flow is essential to hold more energy for chaining combos. If you run Nourish then you could drop efficiency to 45%.

**Range**

High range is used to increase the pounce range of dread mirror/blood altar, the size of the Dread Heart explosion, Blood Altar heal radius. Use Overextended with either Augur Reach or Stretch to hit above 200% range.

**Strength**

We only need to hit the 134% strength breakpoint to give Seeking Talons a 100% chance to cause slash procs. This can be achieved with Transient fortitude and Umbral intensify to offset overextended.

**Modding notes**

The guide does not break down individual mods. Defining picks appear to be: Primed Flow, Primed Continuity, Stretch, Overextended, Transient Fortitude. Slots holding basic drift/utility or resistance mods are the flexible ones.

**Helminth**

Garuda does still lack a good crowd control option which is where helminth can come into play. We always replace Blood Altar as it is the weakest component of her kit:

**Arcanes, Aura & Exilus**

- Molt Reconstruct - gives you healing on spending energy, particularly useful if you subsume something over blood altar that doesn't heal you e.g. breach surge and expedite suffering
- Arcane Arachne - gives 2.5x damage to Dread Mirror explosion, can be dropped if you run Vigorous Swap
- Arcane Eruption - good passive crowd control choice to help since Garuda doesn't have very good in built passive crowd control
- Molt Augmented - more strength
- Molt Efficiency - more duration

**Archon Shards**

Two or more amber cast speed shards allows you to drop Natural Talent for a flexible option like an augment or Rolling Guard
Can use Azure shardswith HP Regen as an alternative to running molt reconstruct.
Fill remaining slots with duration, strength or energy max based on preferece.

**Survivability & failure conditions**

Not detailed. Survivability comes from whatever defensive mods/abilities are in the configuration above; the guide does not state what breaks it.

**Energy economy**

Efficiency sits at 1× per the stats line. The build/guide references an energy source — see mods/overview.

**Playstyle & rotation**

**General Ability Rotation**

1. Cast Bloodletting (tap 3) twice at beginning of a mission to hit near max energy (240 energy per 50% health consumed), and recast whenever needed e.g. energy drops below 300
2. Cast up to three Blood Altars (aim at enemy and tap 2) and either spread out circles evenly throughout an area for maximum coverage or concentrate in one location for maximum heal rate.
3. Keep Dread Mirror (aim at enemy and tap 1) active at all times and face direction of enemies to block frontal damage, while absorbing damage into dread heart. Dread Mirror also prevents knockdown/stagger. Leap onto additional enemies (trying to target heaviest units) to build up more Dread heart damage.
4. Charge Dread Heart (hold 1) and release to nuke, ideally keep at least 100 energy so you can still cast 4 on demand. If you built up sufficient damage via leaping and absorbing prior to charging, you can just charge for a very short time and release it immediately so you don't stay in a vulnerable charging state for too long.
5. Cast Seeking Talons (Double Tap 4 for narrow cone, tap 4 and allow it to expand for maximum cone) to cause slash procs and mark enemies to take slash procs from damage from any source, including Dread Heart. If you're running Blending Talons augment, you can just simply tap 4 once for full shield gate.

**Variants**

_None described._

**Strengths & weaknesses**

- **Strengths:** high effective health / sustained survivability; forgiving of mistakes.
- **Weaknesses:** lower ability- or weapon-damage ceiling; can still fall to gaps in the defensive layer.
_(Archetype-level; the source guide gives no explicit list.)_

**Additional notes from the guide**

Brief Respite - Essential for good shield gating.
Swift Momentum - Good for melee/talons focused build for maintaining combo and heavy attacks
Combat Discipline - Only for activating arcane avenger

Primed Sure Footed/Handspring - not needed for most weapons as Dread Mirror blocks knockdown, but still has inconsistent stagger resist for certain AOE weapons
Kavat's Grace - prevents hard landings which is very common when using Garuda, as all her abilities cause you to launch into the air
Vigilante Pursuit - if no enemy radar
Cunning Drift - maximum range

**ALTERNATIVE BUILDS**

Breach Surge max range variant:
Gloom high strength variant:
Run and Gun / Weapon Platform / Speedrun variant:

**TALONS BUILDS**

Light Attack Combo Talons:
Heavy Spam Talons:
Hybrid combo x12 heavy Talons:

We rely on a combination of shield gating, crowd control and invulnerability frames (i-frames) to survive.
- Shield gating: Whenever you deplete shields you gain a certain number of i-frames based on how much shield you had. Brief Respite and two augur mods allows a single cast of seeking talons generate 230 shield, which is approximately 1s of i-frames (can equip more augur mods on pistol).
- Crowd control: Both Dread mirror and Blood Altar create an 8m radial stagger on landing and Seeking Talons both knocks nearby melee enemies back and the slash procs create a brief stagger animation.
- I-frames: Both dread mirror and seeking talons now have inbuilt i-frames, meaning Rolling Guard's i-frames are no longer necessary when you can simply cast seeking Talons once to get full shield Regen, rather than rolling followed by either Dread mirror or seeking Talons. Status cleanse from bloodletting also lets you quickly get rid of damaging status procs or annoying cold procs.

**Combos and Aerial Combat**

Garuda's abilities can be linked together in certain 'combos'. Garuda's 3 and 4 abilities also launch her into the air particularly when cast while already airborne. The combination of the two can cause you to Reach very high altitude without even bullet jumping. There are many benefits for aerial combat. You become a harder target to hit while airborne and moving, melee units cannot hit you, ground based damage sources cannot hit you e.g. mines, toxic sludge, grenades, you have a better overview of enemies allowing for easier targeting of dread mirror, dread heart and seeking talons.

-  **Heart to Heart (Aerial Chain Nuke Combo)**: With Dread mirror active, while in air, tap 4, aim glide, hold 1 to hover and release dread heart to nuke, aim glide, tap 1 on enemy before they die to refresh dread mirror for new dread heart.
- **Clean Energy (Status Cleanse)**: When you are afflicted with a damaging status, cast 4 and immediately start tapping 3 to fit a cast of Bloodletting within the last few i-frames of 4 to get a safe status cleanse as well as regenerate energy safely. You get 1.75s of i-frames from the beginning of casting 4 and become free to move/cast new abilities for the last 0.5s. Bloodletting takes 0.8s to finish casting.
- **The Ascension**: With Dread mirror active, while aiming down sights, tap 3 to ascend into sky. This means you don't need to bullet jump to achieve air time and can keep dread mirror facing enemies the whole time
- **Honing Altar**: Attack a blood altar enemy with melee to build up melee combo to x12 without killing the enemy, great for x12 heavy attacks.

**Breach Surge**

Gives a wide range blind for crowd control and surge sparks have a positive feedback loop with Seeking Talons, creating self propagating sparks that deal infinitely increasing slash procs over time. Garuda's passive also double dips on Breach Surge sparks (i.e. 4x damage to spark). Max range variant for breach surge:

**Expedite Suffering**

Expedite suffering compresses all existing slash procs and their remaining duration and deal them in one instance of true damage. This new damage instance can also create a new big bleed proc on enemies afflicted by seeking Talons. Casting expedite suffering again compresses the 6s of the new bleed proc into an even bigger instance of damage, which again can feedback into seeking Talons creating an infinitelyscaling feedback loop. No change to build except maybe Brief Respite in aura.

**Gloom**

Provides both passive healing (with infinite range) and insane crowd control with a radial slow field (up to 95%). Slightly different build with overextended swapped for stretch and augur message swapped for augur secrets or blending talons:

**Molt with Regenerative Molt augment**

Gives speed boost, quick cast for shield gating, draws aggro, explodes with damage in wide radius (which can become slash with seeking talons) and the augment gives 50hp/s at base to 500hp total over 10s which is not dependant on the presence of enemies. Great choice for speedrunning, particularly when used in combination with Blood Forge. A dedicated molt build uses mostly duration and strength:

**Nourish (UPDATED Dec 2022)**

Nourish now gives double energy from all sources including Bloodletting, meaning you always gain full energy in a single cast AND infused viral damage/procs into both Dread Mirror explosion AND Seeking Talons. If you run Combat Discipline, you can also proc forced viral in an AOE every kill. See this build:

**Reave**

Reave heals health to power bloodletting AND the true damage triggers bleed procs on enemies afflicted by seeking Talons. You can also reduce enemy health by an exact %, which works well with Dread Ward augment.

**Augments**

All augments are optional and can be placed over Augur Message depending on preference (means you need to use Brief Respite in aura or add one augur mod on pistol for shield gating) and there is really only room for one augment at a time:

Blending Talons - Tapping 4 gives a radial area of seeking Talons and also helps build combo quicker. This is more a quality of life change and up to personal preference, as you can get a quick shield gate in one tap rather than Double Tap of 4, as well as being able to target enemies behind you with no animation lock. You can still hold to charge 4 to cover the original 60m range.

Blood Forge - Allows you to reload your weapon by casting bloodletting. Great with certain weapons hampered by insanely long reloads e.g. Strun, Kuva Zarr,  Trumna, Sepulcrum, Tenet Envoy, Quellor, Gorgon, Komorex, Kuva Chakkhurr, Tenet Arca Plasmor, Akarius. Note: this does NOT work with Hata-Satya on Soma Prime as it counts as a proper reload.

Dread Ward - gives a long duration of invulnerability if you either kill directly with Dread mirror (requires health < 40% threshold) or kill with a slash proc just as the Dread mirror leap animation occurs even if they die before you land. Pairs well with Reave which harvests a set % of health per cast, but the micromanaging of the invulnerability period and enemy health values can become tiresome and is overall inconsistent compared to just shield gating. The other issue is if you run Panzer Vulpaphyla, matryr symbiosis will trigger BEFORE Dread Ward prevents your death and your Panzer will Sacrifice itself for no reason. In my opinion, it is safer and more fluid gameplay wise to rely purely on shield gating and crowd control.

**Other**

- Natural talent is MANDATORY on Garuda if you don't have any archon shards for cast speed
- Vigorous Swap - optional for a more controllable 2.65x multiplier to Dread mirror damage, but requires you do swap weapons while charging her 1 and just before releasing at it only has a 3s duration on swap

Weapons that have AOE spread and have high base damage or damage source are very deadly in combination with Seeking Talons. Remember that bleed procs do not scale off elemental mods, only +damage mods, +faction mods and crits.

**Build overview**

Subsume Gloom over 4

This is a gloom Banshee (or gloomshee) build that combines the extreme slow offered by gloom to lengthen the stun of silence while allowing you to carefully target sonar spots for extreme damage. Silence has an innate stun duration of 2s, which can be extended up to a maximum of 40 seconds at 95% slow. Sonar is a huge multiplier to damage as long as you can hit the spots, and up to two sonar spots can overlap to multiply together (e.g. at 200 strength, two sonar overlapping gives 100x damage multiplier). Resonance augment is optional but nice quality of life allowing Sonar to self propagate as you get kills via sonar spots, meaning you don't need to recast Sonar very often. Sonic Boom is also optional but helps armor strip priority targets eg (acolytes, demolysts, thrax) for even faster kills.

**Mod configuration**

- Resonance — R3
- Stretch — R5
- Catalyzing Shields — R3 — D · Vazarin
- Precision Intensify — R5 — V · Madurai
- Sonic Fracture — R3
- Primed Flow — R10 — – · Naramon
- Equilibrium — R10 — – · Naramon
- Primed Continuity — R10 — V · Madurai

*Aura:* Brief Respite
*Exilus:* Primed Sure Footed
*Arcanes:* Molt Vigor (R5), Molt Augmented (R5)

*Resulting stats:* Armor 135 · Energy 755.245 · Health 370 · Shield 370 · Sprint Speed 1.15 · Ability Range 1.45 · Ability Duration 1.55 · Ability Strength 1 · Ability Efficiency 1

**Intended content — best at / less suited for**

Designed for: Steel Path, Bossing, Farming / loot. The source guide does not spell out where it underperforms; as a hybrid build the usual tradeoff applies (see Strengths & weaknesses).

**Core build concept**

A **hybrid** Banshee Prime setup: low Strength (1×), long Duration (1.55×), wide Range (1.45×), neutral Efficiency (1×). Its engine is the combination in the mod configuration above — Resonance, Stretch, Catalyzing Shields, Precision Intensify, Sonic Fracture, aura Brief Respite, Molt Vigor + Molt Augmented. See the written sections below for the intended damage/defence loop.

**Key stats & breakpoints**

**Duration**

Positive duration gives decent sonar and silence durations and helps reduce gloom drain costs.

**Efficiency**

Maintain neutral efficiency for shield gating, so a single cast of Sonic Boom can restore 37.5 shield giving 0.7s i-frames while a single cast of Sonar can restore 75 shield giving 1.33s iframes (without augur mods)

**Range**

Positive range is nice to Extend the range of gloom, but too much range is actually detrimental for silence since the stun only lasts 2s outside of gloom and about 8s in gloom, and you need enemies to exit then re-enter silence range so they can be restunned. This is made easier by having a lower range. Since silence has a longer range than gloom, enemies will always be subjected to silence first before gloom meaning gloom has a slightly reduced effect on the stun, particularly if you travel slowly.

**Strength**

Strength affects both the sonar multiplier and gloom slow so we do want this as high as possible without losing too much functionality. Gloom 95% slow cap is achieved at 272% str and Full Strip from Sonic Fracture is achieved at only 143% str. Resonance augment allows self propagating Sonar to benefit from the strength of the inintial cast, meaning you can use Molt Vigor and conditional strength boosts to lock in strength values.

**Modding notes**

The guide does not break down individual mods. Defining picks appear to be: Resonance, Stretch, Catalyzing Shields, Precision Intensify, Sonic Fracture. Slots holding basic drift/utility or resistance mods are the flexible ones.

**Helminth**

Not discussed. The build references a subsume — check the overview.

**Arcanes, Aura & Exilus**

Either Molt Vigor and/or Molt Augmented to provide strength to hit max gloom slow (need 272% str), and boost sonar

Since headshots become much easier with gloom, arcanes that trigger on headshot are good:
Consequence - faster parkour
Pistoleer - ammo efficiency
Precision - pistol damage
Rage - primary damage

**Archon Shards**

2 Amber Cast speed shards makes spamming of Sonar and recasting of Silence extremely quick.
3 Crimson Strength shards gives up to 45% strength with Tauforged, meaning you can drop Molt Vigor or Molt Augmented for something like Arcane Aegis/Energize

**Survivability & failure conditions**

Not detailed. Survivability comes from whatever defensive mods/abilities are in the configuration above; the guide does not state what breaks it.

**Energy economy**

Efficiency sits at 1× per the stats line. No dedicated energy source is called out.

**Playstyle & rotation**

1. Activate both gloom and silence (optional - get headshot to activate pax bolt for +30% str +/- Growing Power for +25% then activate gloom for higher slow values)
2. Keep silence active at all times for stun and preventing special enemy abilities
3. Whenever shields break, roll and cast sonar to regenerate shields completely to reset shield gate
4. Stack multiple casts of sonar when fighting an enemy with damage resistance e.g. lich/sister/acolyte

Dethcube with Energy Generator is the recommended companion so you are able to generate an energy orb roughly every 10 kills. Build:

The augments Resonance and Sonic Fracture are both flexible options that are interchangeable for Streamline or more strength eg Transient Fortitude/Augur Secrets.

**Secondary**

Pax bolt is great for giving a bonus 30% strength outside of mods, which can be snaplocked by gloom. Note that channelling abilities like gloom do NOT snapshot efficiency. This can be used on secondary kitguns like Tombfinger, Catchmoon or Gaze.

**Build overview**

This is a Grendel build designed for general Steel Path endurance and even endurance with a focus on scaling ability DPS via Regurgitate. Feast is required to power his abilities. Nourish provides AOE viral procs and stun, applies free viral damage to both your guns and also provides energy multiplier to all energy sources so you should never have energy issues even at 45% efficiency and with no Arcane Energize. Pulverize strips armor and heals you passively. Regurgitate slows enemies by 80%, full strips armor and deals scaling damage.

**Mod configuration**

- Umbral Intensify — R10 — Ω · Umbral
- Umbral Vitality — R10
- Hunter Adrenaline — R5 — V · Madurai
- Blind Rage — R10 — V · Madurai
- Umbral Fiber — R10
- Hearty Nourishment — R3 — = · Zenurik
- Gastro — R3 — = · Zenurik
- Primed Flow — R10 — – · Naramon

*Aura:* Growing Power
*Exilus:* Catapult
*Arcanes:* Arcane Persistence (R5), Arcane Bellicose (R5)

*Resulting stats:* Armor 1120.007 · Energy 712.495 · Health 3626.023 · Shield 95 · Sprint Speed 0.95 · Ability Range 1 · Ability Duration 1 · Ability Strength 2.76 · Ability Efficiency 0.45

**Intended content — best at / less suited for**

Designed for: Steel Path endurance, Base Star Chart, Farming / loot. The source guide does not spell out where it underperforms; as a tank build the usual tradeoff applies (see Strengths & weaknesses).

**Core build concept**

A **tank** Grendel Prime setup: high Strength (2.76×), neutral Duration (1×), neutral Range (1×), negative Efficiency (0.45×). Its engine is the combination in the mod configuration above — Umbral Intensify, Umbral Vitality, Hunter Adrenaline, Blind Rage, Umbral Fiber, aura Growing Power, Arcane Persistence + Arcane Bellicose. See the written sections below for the intended damage/defence loop.

**Key stats & breakpoints**

**Duration**

You need positive duration for the uptime of Nourish so you don't have to recast as often. Archon Continuity is OPTIONAL but allows both Regurgitate and Feast to apply Corrosive procs which can be an extra status for Condition Overload and Galvanized Aptitude/Savvy/Shot on weapons. This is absolutely NOT necessary and you can simply use Primed Continuity if you own it.

**Range**

Range benefits the viral retaliation from Nourish, strip range of pulverize and range of regurgitates aoe.

**Strength**

Higher strength benefits the energy multiplier on Nourish but a negligible component of damage of Regurgitate, because regurgitate scales off enemy health. Regurgitate only needs 134% strength to full strip. Pulverize requires 250% strength to hit 500hp heal per second in the first 5s, and 500% strength if you stay in Pulverize after 5s. In order to hit 500% strength for permanent lazy immortality you will need lots of modded strength and conditional bonuses i.e. Triumbral + Blind Rage + Arcane Bellicose + Growing Power + 5 tauforged strength shards gives 77% + 99% + 72% + 25% + 75% = 448% strength. If you Snap Shot one more conditional like Velox Conclusion or Grimoire Invocation (60%) you can cast Pulverize and now be completely immortal. Combining multiple conditionals e.g. Velox + Madurai (40%) would let you reduce the other strength requirements.

**Modding notes**

The guide does not break down individual mods. Defining picks appear to be: Umbral Intensify, Umbral Vitality, Hunter Adrenaline, Blind Rage, Umbral Fiber. Slots holding basic drift/utility or resistance mods are the flexible ones.

**Helminth**

Pulverize will be your helminth slot and you will need to heal with Nourish instead or external weapons.
1. Breach Surge - needs line of sight but blinds enemies, creates sparks that scale with damage that created it e.g. regurgitate
2. Roar - double dips forced tox DoT from regurgitate
3. Resonator - shuts off enemy AI in huge radius, doesnt affect acolytes/eximus
4. Grouping eg Pull, Airburst, Ensnare, Larva. - brings enemies into group to be hit by regurgitate

**Arcanes, Aura & Exilus**

**Option 1: Arcane Persistence**

Arcane persistence prevents you taking more than 500 damage per second while armor is higher than 700. Grendel has high base health and armor as well as a passive that gives armor with each enemy swallowed. With Stand United in aura you hit 500 armor which means all you need is 200 more armor to activate arcane persistence. This can be achieved by either swallowing a single enemy (each enemy gives 250 armor), by slotting a tauforged Archon Shard (gives 225 armor) or running Unairu (gives 200 armor passively). Using the armor shard is maximum safety/consistency since you will still be safe even if you expel all enemies from the stomach and aren't running Unairu.

With Vitality on you have about 5s of time to heal back damage before you hit 0 health. Both Nourish and Pulverize heal you. Nourish heals about 2000 health at 200 str on cast while Pulverize heals above 400 health per second over 5s at 200 str. If you can somehow reach 250 strength Pulverize will hit 500 health/s which exactly matches the rate of health loss from persistence. The only things that can stop Persistence are violence, nullifiers, magnetic status, corrosive/heat status (which reduce armor below 700). Hearty Nourishment augment makes you status immune which removes the vulnerability from statuses at least.

Bellicose is ideal to give bonus strength of 72%
Arcane Persistence lets you have easy survivability
Molt Efficiency is an alternative to give bonus duration.
Arcane Avenger is option to boost your weapons crit chance if you like. This does not affect breach surge or regurgitate.
Arcane Arachne gives a 2.5x multiplier boost to Breach Surge sparks if you want to focus purely on ability damage, but requires you to occasionally perform a wall latch.
Arcane Energize for even more energy if you have energy issues.

**Archon Shards**

1 Amber Cast Speed Shard optional
1 Tau armor shard optional helps you hit 1400 armor with Stand United and umbral mods so heat procs don't break arcane persistence
4 strength shards to help hit 500% strength
Note that Emerald +Toxin status damage doesnt affect Gastro DPS much since it produces gas procs with only one toxin proc at the end.

**Survivability & failure conditions**

Not detailed. Survivability comes from whatever defensive mods/abilities are in the configuration above; the guide does not state what breaks it.

**Energy economy**

**Efficiency/Energy Economy**

Negative efficiency is sustainable due to the energy multiplier from Nourish and Primed Flow + Hunter Adrenaline or Equilibrium. If you still feel like you have energy issues, you can add any of the following into your loadout: Arcane Energize, Dethcube with Energy Generator, Emergence Dissipate, Primary Exhilarate

**Playstyle & rotation**

1. Tap 1 to feast on enemies until you have 5 enemies ingested, always try to top this up whenever empty or low.
2. Tap 2 to activate Nourish, which will give you energy, viral damage and 10 viral status in an AOE with brief stun every 2s whenever you take damage. Keep this activated at all times. Can also use for emergency heal button.
3. Tap 4 to Regurgitate enemies to slow enemies, strip armor, deal scaling damage and produce breach surge sparks.
4. Optional: Hold 1 to expel all current feasted enemies to deal even more scaling damage and produce breach surge sparks.

**Variants**

_None described._

**Strengths & weaknesses**

- **Strengths:** high effective health / sustained survivability; forgiving of mistakes.
- **Weaknesses:** lower ability- or weapon-damage ceiling; can still fall to gaps in the defensive layer.
_(Archetype-level; the source guide gives no explicit list.)_

**Patch / update history (from the guide)**

**UPDATE DEC 2025**

Arcane slot for arcane persistence which prevents you taking more than 500 damage per second while armor is higher than 700. Grendel has high base health and armor as well as a passive that gives armor with each enemy swallowed. With the passive and umbral set you can pretty consistently exceed 1400 armor meaning even heat statuses wont make you lose arcane persistence.

With over 3500 health on you have about 7s of leeway time to heal back damage before you hit 0 health. Both Nourish and Pulverize can heal you to max. Nourish heals about 2000 health at 200 str on cast while Pulverize heals 500hp/s at 250% strength for only the first 5s. If you can somehow reach 500% strength Pulverize will hit 500 health/s permanently which exactly matches the rate of health loss from persistence. The only things that can stop Persistence are violence, nullifiers, magnetic status, corrosive/heat status (which reduce armor below 700). Hearty Nourishment augment is optional and makes you status immune which removes the vulnerability from statuses at least.

**UPDATE OCT 2024**

Empty slot is for new Augment Gastro which lets Regurgitate bounce up to 4 times, effectively increasing ability DPS 4 times. I removed Breach Surge as the subsume and kept Pulverize since you can cast feast more seamlessly while in Pulverize.

**Additional notes from the guide**

Mecha Empowered helps nuking when used alongside a Kubrow.
If not using Kubrow, just slot Corrosive Projection

**REGURGITATE/Gastro**

Regurgitate deals 2000 damage x strength + 10% of the launched enemies current health. For example, if you were to swallow a level 9999 SP Corrupted Heavy Gunner a with 10 million health and immediately regurgitate it, you would deal approximately 1 million raw gas damage in 6m base AOE (with Gastro), with two subsequent forced Gas procs dealing a total of 1 million gas damage per second in a small radius (starting at 3m and adding 0.3m for every additional proc), which deal their full damage amount since you full strip armor. With 10 viral (due to Nourish viral retaliation), this is multiplied by 4.25x so 4.25 million damage on raw hit which may kill enemies directly in one hit while also boosting gas clouds to deal  4.25 million damage per second for 6s. Gastro causes a second bounce dealing 25% of the initial hit, so another 250k raw gas damage and 250k gas proc damage in 3m range, and finally a third bounce dealing 6.25% so 62.5k damage, 62.5k gas status damage/s and finally one more 31k toxin proc. The grand total damage over a 7s period from a single enemy launched is therefore about 1,312,500 million initial raw damage then 7,875,000 dealt over 7s. Adding maximum viral this gives 5,578,125 raw dmg and 33,468,750 over a whole 7s. This is effectively enough to kill enemies at any level as long as you are spitting enemies of a similar HP, even without damage buffs. You can maximise this by swallowing 5 enemies and immediately regurgitating all five at once dealing a huge amount of overall damage and many times over the hp of enemies. The only issue is that this does not handle overguard well as overguard is often bigger in value than health.

**ROAR**

Roar multiplies the initial raw hit, then multiplies the subsequent Gas proc a second time so from the above example at say 100% roar, the initial hit deals 2 million while the two gas procs deal a total of 4 million/s (and therefore 17 million/s with 10 viral).

**BREACH SURGE**

An enemy affected by Breach Surge has a 10% chance per damage instance (and 100% chance on kill) to spawn a spark that deals the damage that caused it but multiplied by a multiplier and crit multiplier. If we assume the multiplier to be about 5x, a spark created by the initial 1 million damage becomes 5 million damage which is the cap. Breach Surge has special quirk in that it is coded as a 'weapon' and universal weapon boosting effects like Nourish and Arcane Arachne/Naramon Lethal Levitation/Vigorous Swap actually applies their respective damage bonus to it and allows it to exceed the 5 million cap. For example a 200% nourish means a 5 million damage spark becomes 15 million damage, and adding arcane arachne multiplies this again by 150% (2.5x) to 37.5 million. Crit multipliers boost the further if the spark headshots which occurs randomly, meaning they get a headcrit bonus (2x CD), headshot bonus (3x total) and worth comradery (100% cc to 175% cc). A tier 2 headcrit is a further multiplier of 3 x (1+2 x (2 x 1.5 -1)) = 15x, so 37.5 million now becomes 562 million. Adding 10 viral to that we could potentially get theoretical 2.38 billion damage (limited by damage cap of 2.14 billion)

**Mecha Set Option**

Mecha Set with Huras or Raksa Kubrow (wearing the cool Lunar new year skin) is a further option to massively increase the damage and AOE potential of Regurgitate. Mecha Empowered double dips status procs and multiply damage on marked enemies by 6.25x, so 95,000 toxin proc becomes 590,000/s. This can be spread to all enemies in 30m if they die.

Huras as the additional bonus of making you invisible so you barely get hit, while Raksa passively provides shield gate for you as you take damage. If you want to use the Mecha Set, swap aura for Mecha Empowered and Catalyzing Shields for Mecha Pulse

**Option 2 : Shield Gating + Crowd Control**

For an active playstyle, utilize shield gating and crowd control to allow Grendel to survive any level up to level 9999. Use Catalyzing Shields to drop max shields to 19, meaning a single cast of Nourish or  Regurgitate will reset shield gates with a single Brief Respite or Augur mod active, giving 1.33s iframes. This will allow you to survive any instance of non-toxin damage. Combine this with the stun from Nourish and slow from Regurgitate. Adding a form of invisibility from Huras Kubrow or Shade would also make surviving much simpler.

**Option 3: Casual ehp Tanking**

Casual Tank Grendel Build:

For a more laid back playstyle, Grendel can absolute passively tank base SP and about up to level 500ish easily. Swap Catalyzing Shields for Adaptation, Hearty Nourishment for Gourmand and Vitality over Augur Reach. Arcane Avenger can swapped for Arcane Blessing and Molt Augmented can be swapped for Guardian (both optional)

Grendel has a passive that provides 1250 flat armor after swallowing 5 enemies, or 2000 armor with Gourmand. Combine this with his high base health pool and Adaptation to get a decent eHP of approximately 300,000. For reference, a solo full tank Inaros has a max of approximately 1 million ehp while Trinity has approx 1.5 mil ehp, and the maximum possible ehp by Baruuk is about 9 million.

**Flexible Options**

Hearty Nourishment : optional but important augment that gives status immunity from each cast of Nourish with duration scaling with duration% and enemies in gut. This is excellent quality of life meaning you dont need Primed Sure Footed to prevent knockdown and dont get affected by heat procs from Arson eximus, magnetic procs or toxin procs. Can swap this for more range if you prefer.

Catapult: allows you to speed around in Pulverize, lots of fun

### 54. Chroma Prime — Immortal Slumbering Dragon | Persistence Tank Weapon Platform

**Build overview**

Chroma can now health tank to levelcap with Arcane persistence as long as you have a source of healing e.g. Gloom, Remedium or lifesteal from a weapon.
Keeping Vex Armor active gives enough armor to surpass the 700 needed for Arcane Persistence, but if you prefer an absolute safety net even if vex armor is not active you could put Umbral Fiber or two archon armor shards. Guardian Armor can provide innate healing as kills by your or your teammate heal 5% of your health over 3s scaling with strength. At around 300% strength and about 2500 hp you will be able to heal 375 hp over 3s per kill (non-stackable) which is equivalent to 125hp/s.

**Key stats & breakpoints**

**Duration**

Needed for elemental ward uptime and initial vex armor uptime, but guardian armor prolongs vex armor indefinitely.

**Range**

No real effect on anything. Gloom heal range does not require range. Effigy credit drop range is fixed at 10m.

**Strength**

Most important stat as it boosts vex armor and elemental ward health boost. You want approximately at least 221% strength for heat ward. This is because Umbral Vitality + Arcane Blessing gets you to 2051 health, meaning to hit 2500 you just need another 449 health which is achieved at exactly 221% strength.

**Modding notes**

The guide does not break down individual mods. Defining picks appear to be: Umbral Intensify, Umbral Vitality, Guardian Armor, Primed Flow, Hunter Adrenaline. Slots holding basic drift/utility or resistance mods are the flexible ones.

**Helminth**

Subsume over 1, make sure to set EMISSIVE COLOUR to red so elemental ward is HEAT.

1. GLOOM: Gloom allows you to run basically any weapon and setup and still heal consistently and easily even without meetign the kill criteria for Guardian Armor. If you have a specific setup that can heal you faster than 500hp/s e.g. high KPM AOE weapons, Life Strike heavy spam (Falcor, Xoris, Magistar), Sancti Magistar, Daikyu with Syam (and amalgam Daikyu mod), Coda Hirudo, Coda Hema then you won't need gloom.

2. SPELLBIND: Gives you status immunity for a fixed duration, meaning you cannot be susceptible to the things that can normally break persistence e.g. magnetic, bleed (bypasses persistence), heat, corrosive. This also makes you immune to self knockdown from Glaive and contagion explosions which is very good if you don't own Primed Sure Footed.

3. WRATHFUL ADVANCE: Even more damage to boost melee weapons.

4. NOURISH: Viral damage and energy multiplier

**Arcanes, Aura & Exilus**

Arcane Persistence: mandatory here for survivability
Arcane Blessing: optional for extra health for persistence, effectively giving an extra second of i-frames before you die

**Archon Shards**

1 cast speed optional
2 Parkour Velocity
2 to 3 Melee critical damage

Not detailed. Survivability comes from whatever defensive mods/abilities are in the configuration above; the guide does not state what breaks it.

**Efficiency/Energy**

Don't really need energy as Hunter Adrenaline keeps you completely topped up constantly, and you never need to recast Vex Armor due to Guardian Armor. You only need to recast Elemental Ward. Effigy does drain alot of energy. Gloom at minimum range barely has any drain. We do need to run Flow to hit 500 energy for violet melee crit damage shards.

**Playstyle & rotation**

1. Activate HEAT Elemental Ward (2) and recast whenever it ends
2. Activate VEX ARMOR (3) and get kills with melee and ranged weapons to build the armor and damage bonuses respectively.
3. Activate GLOOM (optional if subsumed) so every damage you deal with weapons heals you

**Patch / update history (from the guide)**

**UPDATE Aug 2024**

Due to armor cap, Danse Macabre no longer requires full armor strip to perform and in fact can even nuke up to levelcap due to the damage absorption mechanic. Danse deals damage equal to enemy damage absorbed, but this decays rapidly over time unless you continue to take damage. Danse Macabre also has innate armor strip since it procs corrosive status on any armored enemies. By levelcap, enemies typically deal up to 1 million damage per shot, meaning each revolution of nine lasers deals 9 million damage after just one shot. If you absorb damage for a few seconds, you could absorb upwards of 10 to 50 million damage meaning each revolution deals 450 million damage total, enough to oneshot all enemies at levelcap without armor strip.

You can subsume roar or nourish over 1. Roar helps scaling Danse at lower levels while Nourish helps with energy economy.

Reave is kept not to actually use Reave to kill, but for mobility since it allows you to travel around the map very fast. Reave is currently bugged with Danse as spamming reave allows you to continuously build momentum and become even faster than Titania.

If you need to kill a specific enemy with Reave before Danse can ramp up e.g. a Thrax or enemies that do not attack you, you just need to use a primer with viral and magnetic e.g. Kuva Nukor, Coda Catabolyst, Kompressa Prime then use Reave

**Additional notes from the guide**

**Flexible**

Mesmer Shield helps allies in affinity range gain mesmer skin.

**Who it's for**

Use this if you want Revenant Prime as a tank option for level cap, farming / loot. It carries a written guide (above).

Well of Life creates an invulerable floating target that you can spam headshots onto to trigger the explosion of Concentrated Arrow, nuking a room repeatedly without having to find a new target to headshot. Once you release the target or the 12s duration is up, the target will die and create 4 health orbs due to the augment Pool Of Life, which will be converted to 220 energy due to Equilibrium. **UPDATE MARCH 2025**

Concentrated Arrow now has 20% base status chance which means you could now mod it for a status effect to deal damage. Electric is the best option due to the existence of Violet Shards which give free up to +600% electric damage to Artemis Bow and other primaries. **UPDATE JAN 2025**

Use Arcane Crepuscular gives flat cd boost

**COMPANION**

Ideally use a pet that can passively prime viral status AND use Reinforced Bond + Tenacious Bond for you since Artemis Bow has low overall status chance:
Panzer (can prime and use Reinforced Bond + Tenacious Bond):
Hound (can prime but not use reinforced/tenacious):

Corrosive Projection - effective 1.8x multiplier against armored enemies without other sources of armor strip
Growing Power can be snapshot by prowl to gain additional headshot bonus, and also snapshot by artemis bow to get additional base damage multiplier.

**NOTE ON CREPUSCULAR AND Spectral Serration**

Currently, Spectral Serration is bugged to not apply if you activate Artemis Bow while invisible. However normally if you activate Artemis outside of Prowl, Artemis Bow will not benefit from the +30% strength from Crepuscular.

The workaround is to do the following:
1. Turn on Artemis Bow (tap 4) FIRST while visible and NOT in Prowl or Cloak Arrow
2. Select CLOAK ARROW and cast arrow in front of you and walk inside bubble
3. Turn on Prowl (tap 3) which will now lock both crepuscular and Spectral Serration buffs

**Why use Concentrated Arrow and not just a Bramma?**

Concentrated Arrow produces explosions with the highest AOE radius in the game, of up to over 20m (compared to 13.8m from Kuva Bramma + Primed Firestorm). It also is the only weapon that produces forced impact procs in an AOE meaning Internal Bleeding allows you to create slash procs on all enemies in range at a rate of 70% (compared to 30% from Hunter Munitions). Furthermore, the explosion damage has NO drop off, is completely silent and does NOT stagger you. The main drawbacks are it unfortunately has half the base damage of Kuva Bramma, cannot run primary arcanes and cannot self-proc statuses like viral (due to 0% status).

**Key stats & breakpoints**

**Duration**

Primed Continuity is required to offset Transient Fortitude and give decent duration so that iron clad charge lasts over 15s, giving a long window to setup, roar lasts almost 1 minute and stomp lasts over 10s.

**Efficiency**

Low efficiency can be maintained due to high energy from Arcane Battery, high energy regeneration from Equilbrium + Synth Deconstruct and energy generation methods. If you feel like you have energy issues with quick missions, simply swap Blind Rage for Transient Fortitude.

**Range**

Just a bit of range gives a huge stomp and roar radius of over 30m. You can either run 100, 145 or 175 range, up to preference.

**Strength**

Strength is the most important stat for iron skin since it scales This scales into iron skin twice due to boosting ironclad charge bonus and as a final multiplier on iron skin.

Approximate iron skin values achieved with about 300 Strength:
- Base iron skin: 6000
- After charging into 1 enemy : 10k
- After charging into 20 enemies : 80k
- With max health conversion stacks : 15k
- With max health conversion and charging into 1 enemy: 40k
- With max health conversion and charging into 20 enemies :  480k

**Modding notes**

The guide does not break down individual mods. Defining picks appear to be: Ironclad Charge, Equilibrium, Blind Rage, Stretch, Reinforcing Stomp. Slots holding basic drift/utility or resistance mods are the flexible ones.

**Helminth**

Stomp will be the ability that is replaced most of the time on an iron skin focused build:

Options to increase base armor for maximising iron skin:
- Parasitic Armor can provide the biggest possible armor boost but doesn't do much else. With redirection you can gain 3747 armor, but you will need to drop health conversion
- Elemental ward (Cold) provides the next biggest armor boost at 1291 extra armor but also provides passive damage reflection and free cold status procs
- Defy is the next providing 750 armor at max cap and a bit of knockback/damage on cast
- Warcry is the worst giving only 430 armor, but provides melee attack speed boost and an initial slow wave.

Options to increase both iron skin and roar:
- Empower can also be used, but you will need to cast before each ability use which makes it a little more clunky to use, and provides less total boost compared to Elemental ward. Empower does however also benefit roar.

Options for grouping (for ironclad charge) and crowd control
- Ensnare - can be spammed onto multiple targets but requires a target to cast, highest range but slowest pull
- Larva - can be cast without enemy to target, very fast pull
- Airburst - can also deal some damage, as well as both push and pull

If you want to keep stomp, highly recommend Nourish over 1.

**Arcanes, Aura & Exilus**

- Arcane Battery gives up to 1000 extra energy max
- Molt Augmented gives +60% free strength after 250 kills. Molt Vigor can be an alternative.
- Arcane Guardian now builds on taking damage to iron skin, so a good option to increase iron skin values.
- Arcane Tanker / ultimatum increase your armor even further but are probably unnecessary and reasonably difficult to consistently activate
- Can use damage boosting arcanes depending on your weapon of preference

**Additional notes from the guide**

**Augments**

The *Ironclad Charge* augment is absolutely essential to the build, giving a **massive** boost to base armor after charging into enemies with 1. Once your base armor is boosted, you can 'lock' this value into iron skin by casting 2.  The *Iron Shrapnel* augment is less essential and has now been replaced with **Reinforcing Stomp**, which lets you constantly refresh iron skin without needing to redo the iron skin again.

**Why Health Conversion and no armor?**

Health conversion is better than traditional armor mods like Umbral Fiber, Steel Fiber, Armored agility or Gladiator/Carnis mods. This is because Health Conversion at 3 stacks provides 1350 additional base armor, compared to a measly 378 from Umbral Fiber and 123 from Gladiator aegis/Armored Agility. This is because armor mods scale off Rhino's tiny base armor value of 290.

**Patch / update history (from the guide)**

**UPDATE DEC 2025**

Arcane Persistence now allows Wukong to take lazy tanking all the way to levelcap. Persistence stops you from losing more than 500hp per second if your armor is over 700. At 3000 health, this means you can stay alive without doing anything for at least 5s before dying. As long as you can heal back the damage you can stay alive pretty effortlessly compared to shield gating. Cloud Walker heals quite slowly and other methods are a little inconsistent but reasonable to use e.g. Healing Return or Life Strike on Iron Staff, Magus Elevate, Hunter Recovery on Panzer. The most consistent and fastest heal is Gloom. The only danger you can face is if heat and corrosive status reduces your armor, but having Defy active gives you over 2000 armor which is a nice buffer in case that happens. Magnetic status and Violence are the main two things that will prevent persistence from working so you need to be very careful there.

**UPDATE MARCH 2025**

Wukong Iron Staff has been mega buffed due to now being able to use Acolyte mods (Blood Rush and Weeping Wounds) as well as Arcanes (Melee Influence). Since Iron Staff has a good base damage, very high range (3.5m base + 5.5m at max combo bonus + 3m from Primed Reach = 12m range) and 1 Follow Through, Iron Staff is now one of the strongest 'standard melee' influence weapons in the game. This build below forgoes attack speed due to Arcane Strike on the frame. If you do NOT have Arcane Strike, you should add an attack speed mod (e.g. Quickening, Berserker Fury or Primed Fury) over either Smite or Galv Elementalist slots.

**Build overview**

Both augments are mandatory. Shadow Haze is required to create 3 roaming shadows that can each trigger the true damage. Dark Propagation allows enemies killed to self spread Sow, meaning it can spread across a wider area without recasting Sow.

Enemies affected by Sow who are then subsequently hit by Reap take true damage equal to 25% of their CURRENT health. This value is NOT affected by ability strength, but is affected by Viral (2x at 1 stack and 4.25x at 10 stacks) and Roar. You need exactly 255% strength on both Reap and Roar to one-shot enemies without viral status. You may be able to get away with using Precision Intensify if you have enough strength on reap to save forma.

Hitting a backbeat on either 1 or 2 will improve energy cost of casting that ability, fuel ammo for the exalted Lizzie, Extend the duration of Ripper's Wail, increase the heat bonus of Ripper's Wail, increase the Pillars from 1 and double the crit chance boost of 2, meaning it is absolutely crucial for you to hit backbeats pretty consistently.

**Core build concept**

A **tank** Temple setup: high Strength (2.54×), neutral Duration (1.275×), wide Range (1.45×), negative Efficiency (0.45×). Its engine is the combination in the mod configuration above — Rolling Guard, Primed Flow, Archon Vitality, Equilibrium, Archon Continuity, aura Corrosive Projection, Arcane Hot Shot + Arcane Impetus. See the written sections below for the intended damage/defence loop.

**Key stats & breakpoints**

**DURATION**

Duration is not a particularly important stat because Ripper's Wail has a base duration of 30s and is extended by each backbeat cast of 1 or 2 and can be refreshed indefinitely. Additionally if you use Ripper's Wail for invulnerability at all, you may be frequently recasting Ripper's Wail manually anyway. Duration has no effect on Exalted Solo and Overdrive already has a long base duration of 20s, meaning after casting you just need to kill affected enemies before approximately 15s. Archon Continuity is used here specifically for combination with Blast Toxin modded on Lizzie to get corrosive status.

**RANGE**

Temple's 1 and 2 require range but both have a decent base range of 25m and 20m respectively. You will want to increase this dependent on the tileset but approximately 145 to 175 range is sufficient in most cases. Note that Lizzie has a maximum range of 26m with Sinister Reach and Overdrive at 145 range reaches exactly 29m which will cover the entire range of Lizzie. NOTE: Archon Stretch is OPTIONAL of regular Stretch if you are running a companion such as Diriga or Hound that can proc it for you for some passive energy Regen.

**STRENGTH**

Strength is the most important stat as it scales the damage of 1, 2 and 4 and the critical chance bonus from 2. At 350% strength a backbeat cast of Overdrive can give a flat 175% crit chance bonus. Strength has no lasting effect on Ripper's Wail since it is capped at 750% maximum heat bonus regardless, with strength just speeding up the ramp up to get there.

Strength acts like a +damage mod for Lizzie, with the formula: 1.25 x STRENGTH%. This means at base 100% strength, strength is equivalent to a +25% damage mod. At around 350% strength, this is equivalent to a 337% damage mod (i.e. almost matching Primary Merciless).  Other sources of +damage such as Arcane Rage, Serration, Galvanized Aptitude and Primary Merciless are all 'additive' to this strength component.
