**Energy economy**

**EFFICIENCY AND ENERGY**

Efficiency is not required on Temple as Exalted Solo does not continuously drain energy and instead spends fuel which requires backbeat casting of 1 and 2 to charge. Casting 4 on a backbeat also spends 0 energy. Backbeat casting 1 and 2 also grants a 50% efficiency bonus meaning it basically costs the base energy cost of 25 each cast. Ripper's Wail is infrequently cast and is also cheap. Seismic Bond on a companion can easily activate while Exalted Solo is active giving a further free 30% efficiency. Equilibrium is sufficient to sustain any energy requirements and Primed Flow is optional.

**Playstyle & rotation**

1. Tap 1 and 2 on crowds of enemies in front of you making sure to hit backbeats as much as possible to charge fuel for Lizzie.
2. Tap 3 on a backbeat to become invulnerable for a short period and gain raw heat damage buff
3. Cast 4 making sure to time a backbeat so you consume no energy to summon the Exalted. The exalted runs on fuel rather than energy which is fueled by hitting backbeats on 1 and 2. Shoot enemies.

**Variants**

_None described._

**Strengths & weaknesses**

- **Strengths:** high effective health / sustained survivability; forgiving of mistakes.
- **Weaknesses:** lower ability- or weapon-damage ceiling; can still fall to gaps in the defensive layer.
_(Archetype-level; the source guide gives no explicit list.)_

**Additional notes from the guide**

**COMPANION**

Wyrm Prime (can run both Reinforced Bond and Tenacious Bond to boost Lizzie, Seismic Bond optional for efficiency, Coolant Leak + Synth Deconstruct for energy source/priming):

Panzer (can run Reinforced + Tenacious Bond, viral prime/tag for synth deconstruct, seismic bond optional):

- Corrosive Projection: increases damage against armored enemies by about 1.8x before applying heat and corrosive procs
- Growing Power: gives another 25% strength

Completely flexible
- Firewalker for more parkour velocity in matching style
- Power Drift for more strength
- Cunning Drift for more energy
- Primed Sure Footed to avoid knockdown if you own it

**BUILD VARIANTS**

- Lazy Gating Exalted DPS Variant (Silence/Omamori/Nourish):

**Option 1 : Shield Gating/Invulnerability**

This is a HIGH activity playstyle requiring frequent casting and high mobility, but is the best option if you want to take Temple into higher levels over 300 to 400 e.g. (EDA, ETA, endurance cascade/disruption). Tapping 3 on a backbeat will also give you approximately 7s of invulnerability and also restores shields to over 1100 shields which gives another 2.5s shield gate. Rolling Guard is also OPTIONAL for additional i-frames and status cleanse while spamming 1/2. Heat procs from 1 also add additional layer of crowd control, but you could swap this for better layers of survivability e.g. Omamori, Silence, Pillage etc.

**Option 2: Health Tanking**

If shield gating just isn't your cup of tea or if you are only playing non SP or low level SP missions and don't feel like gating, feel free to swap Catalzying Shields and Rolling Guard for Adaptation and Health Conversion, and use a fully ranked Archon Vitality.

**FLEXIBLE SLOTS**

- Archon Vitality: This works on Lizzie and gives an addition heat proc whenever heat status occurs, effectively doubling the heat status DPS. If you are shield gating you will not need this at maximum rank so to save capacity we can run this unranked. If you are NOT using Lizzie at all, you can swap this out.

- Rolling Guard: Useful for additional backup i-frames but particularly for the status cleanse. Flexible for catalyzing shields if you prefer to use 1 or 2 for active shield gating rather than rely on 3 for i-frames, or for more strength mods.

**ARCHON SLOTS**

ONE Amber Cast Speed Shard: This reduces the animation time of Ripper's Wail from 3s to approximately 2s making this slightly more bearable while also speeding up casting of 2 which you will use on basically every new enemy. Note : this also reduces the actual invulnerability from a non-back beat cast of 3, but does not reduce the invuln window of a backbeat cast.
To maximise Lizzie DPS: up to THREE Crimson Primary Status Chance shards: boosts status chance on Lizzie and other Primary Weapons and ONE Tauforged +Corrosive stack to improve damage against armored enemy
For General Use: The other shards are flexible and up to preference e.g. energy max shards allow you to remove Primed Flow, parkour shards to improve mobility,

**EXALTED DPS**

For 4 DPS build, given how much you need to focus on pressing 2 to prime enemies for crit chance AND hit backbeats, I would prefer a PASSIVE ability over 1 that doesn't need casting simultaneously with 2. Temple's main weakness is a lack of crowd control and survivability:

- **Nourish**: gives passive viral status without needing to use any alt-fire and maximises energy economy, although neither of these are REALLY required, can be a very comfortable choice
- **Silence** : creates an aura around you that briefly stuns enemies for 2s while also preventing special eximus/acolyte/thrax abilities which can be a very nice passive source of crowd control and survivability:
- **Omamori**: independent of duration and creates charms that have a 50% of blocking damage. This could be even better if you ran a full passive gating setup e.g. Fast Deflection+vigilante vigor+catalyzing shield + arcane aegis. You could do this by swapping out Rolling Guard and Transient Fortitude.
- **Resonator**: gives passive area crowd control and has fits the musical theme, nice for non-mobile missions

If you are happy with more active abilities you can try grouping e.g. Pull, Airburst, Ensnare

**MECHA ROAR NUKE**

Roar is a special case because unfortunately you can only subsume Roar over Ripper's Wail, which is reasonable in a special Mecha setup with a specific focus on boosting heat status from Pyrotechnics, which Ripper's Wail doesn't do anyway.

**LIZZIE BUILDS**

Blast Tox LIzzie (best for general use and mixed crowd clearing e.g. regular missions, cascade):
Pure Heat Lizzie (best for heavy single target e.g. disruption):

Use this if you want Temple as a tank option for steel path endurance, eda / archimedea, void cascade, disruption. It carries a written guide (above).

**Key stats & breakpoints**

**Duration**

Chyrinka Pillar has a base duration of 35s so having a bit of negative duration still gives over 20s duration. Duration doesn't affect 2 or 3, but does affect the drain of Fused Crucible

**Range**

Range affects the radius of 1 as well as the range of 2 grouping and 4 explosions. We want to maximise this.

**Strength**

Strength most importantly affects the damage of 4 and the damage vulnerability of 2. Containment wall augment requires 200% strength to full strip in one cast and 164% strength with Corrosive Projection. You can further use external sources like Madurai (+40%), Zenurik (+20%), Grimoire (+60%) if you like.

**Modding notes**

The guide does not break down individual mods. Defining picks appear to be: Wrecking Wall, Primed Flow, Fused Crucible, Precision Intensify, Overextended. Slots holding basic drift/utility or resistance mods are the flexible ones.

**Helminth**

Subsume over Disometric Guard since Fused Crucible makes you invulnerable and status immune already

1. OPHANIM EYES: Strips armor slower but works without needing to exit Fused Crucible mode, and means you can drop Wrecking Wall augment for more strength. Feels prettty thematic for Qorvex too.

2. ROAR: Further boosts the damage of Fused Crucible as well as weapons if you use them

3. NOURISH: If you still feel energy is an issue, you can use Nourish to help with energy sustain since it boosts the energy gained via universal fallout.

4. BREACH SURGE: Blinds non-overguarded enemies and damage/kills releases sparks which deal radiation damange/status which is sort of thematic for Qorvex

**Arcanes, Aura & Exilus**

Universal Fallout is pretty much MANDATORY for energy economy. You will need Equilibrium otherwise.
Molt Augmented provides free 60% strength after 250 kills
Molt Efficiency provides free duration with shields active
Arcane Energize is optional for energy economy

**Archon Shards**

1 to 2 Amber Cast Speed shards
3 to 4 Topaz +Ability Damage on Radiation Status

**Survivability & failure conditions**

Not detailed. Survivability comes from whatever defensive mods/abilities are in the configuration above; the guide does not state what breaks it.

**Energy economy**

**Efficiency and Energy Economy**

Arcane Universal Fallout causes enemies afflicted with radiation status from abilities to have a chance to drop a universal orb which restores energy. On Qorvex this results in a huge amount of energy provided you are getting sufficient kills to offset energy drain. In the right type of map this is enough even to offset 45% efficiency, but if you feel like you have energy issues or don't own Universal Fallout you may need to add Equilibrium or Streamline to further help costs. Seismic Bond on a companion adds a bonus 30% efficiency while chanelling Fused Crucible.

**Playstyle & rotation**

1. For stationary missions (eg survival): Tap 1 to plant two Chyrinka Pillars and keep active whenever one wears off. You want the Pillars to occupy separate areas to cover the largest possible area, but be within line of sight so you can hit them both with your 4.
2. Tap 3 to cast Disometric Guard for status immunity
3. Tap 2 to group enemies in a line and apply radiation procs with Containment Wall
4. Tap 4 and try to focus the beam groups or lines of enemies as well as simultaneously hitting a Chyrinka pillar (hitting a pillar empowers it for 5s, allowing it's pulses to inherit the chain reactions of Crucible Blast). Hitting the Pillar basically allows you to damage any enemies within the range of Pillar but without actually aiming at them with the beam. Try to hit both Pillars in each beam.

- **Strengths:** high effective health / sustained survivability; forgiving of mistakes.

**Casual EHP Tanking**

Since Qorvex has a very high base armor rating, he is able to casual tank Starchart and base SP (< level 300) somewhat. You will want to slot an armor mod (e.g. Umbral Fiber or Steel Fiber). Umbral Fiber adds 1137 additional armor (compared to say 900 from Guardian or 1350 from Health Conversion at max stacks), but will probably require an Umbral Forma to fit and you will need to drop Augur Reach. You can also swap Catalyzing Shields out for Adaptation as well as Molt Efficiency out for Arcane Blessing. This will give final stats of 1900 health, 2012 armor and 90% damage reduction potentially, for a final EHP of 146,427. For reference, a full tank Inaros has 800k EHP and a regular Grendel tank build has about 300k ehp while Citrine and Trinity sit can around 2 million EHP.

**Modding notes**

The guide does not break down individual mods. Defining picks appear to be: Precision Intensify, Augur Secrets, Catalyzing Shields, Narrow Minded, Equilibrium. Slots holding basic drift/utility or resistance mods are the flexible ones.

**Helminth**

**Arcanes, Aura & Exilus**

**Archon Shards**

Flexible depending on preference:
- 1 Tauforged Amber Cast speed shards is nice quality of life, making Roar recast faster even without external cast speed active. This is flexible for another emerald +toxin shard.
- 2 to 3 Tauforged Emerald Shards (+toxin damage) - applies a multiplicative increase to toxic lash procs (i.e. 1.9x with 2 tauforged shards).
- 1 Tauforged Emerald Shards (+max corrosive stacks) - allows you to apply 13 corrosive statuses instead of the usual 10. At 13 this is 98% armor strip which is equivalent to a 8.8x damage multiplier against armored enemies. If you compare this to the usual 10 stacks (80% armor strip is equivalent to 6x damage multiplier against armor), then the relative boost is 8.8/6 = 1.4667x. If you run two regular +corrosive shards to get 14 corrosive stacks, full strip is equivalent to a 10x damage multiplier against armored enemies, but as a relative difference this is only a 10/8.8 = 1.1364x or 14% damage difference which only applies to armored enemies. In comparison running a third Tau +toxin status shard gives a multiplier of (1+ 3 x 0.45)/(1 + 2 x 0.45) = 1.2368x or 24% difference, which applies to both armored and unarmored enemies. Even if you are running an elementalist mod (which is additive to +tox shards), the relative difference of a third tox vs two tox shards is 16%, still higher than full strip.

_(Archetype-level; the source guide gives no explicit list.)_

**Additional notes from the guide**

**OPTION 1: ACTIVE GATE**

If you don't mind pressing more buttons constantly, you can use active gating by pressing 2 whenever shields break. This is more consistent than relying on passive gate but requires you to actually pay more attention to the state of your shields. Molt has an instantaneous cast and fully resets shields with catalyzing shield. Make sure you have a single Augur mod somewhere on the loadout. If you are running Wyrm Prime with Burst Laser Prime with Augur mods or a pistol with Augur Pact, you can swap Augur Secrets for more duration or strength. Arcane Sculptor allows you to run 45% efficiency and no Primed Flow. Without Sculptor, swap Blind Rage for Primed Flow.

**OPTION 2: LAZY GATE**

Use a combination of passive shield Regen from arcane aegis + Vigilante Vigor + Fast Deflection (+Grimoire or vazarin optional) and active shield gating from molt + Brief Respite.
Catalyzing Shield is currently bugged to always give 1.33s gate regardless of shield amount regenerated, meaning even if shield recharge regenerates 1 shield you will get the full 1.33s gate. Double shield recharge mods reduces delay to approximately 1s meaning you have a vulnerability window of anywhere between 0s and 1s after shield gate ends depending on if you got hit during the shield gate. Bridge this vulnerability window by active movement (parkour, running), killing stuff before they kill you, molt drawing Aggro and also sources of Overguard such as secondary fortifier Ocucor or Dante specter. Further passive gating can come from a sentinel running Guardian with Manifold Bond which restores shields. Molt also cleanses statuses.

**Roar**

Roar and faction mods DOUBLE DIP the toxic lash damage and TRIPLE DIP the gauranteed toxin status from toxic lash. At 350% strength, we get a Roar of approximately 100% which means with a Primed faction mod on the weapon, Toxic Lash is boosted by a total of (1+1+0.55)^3 = 16.5x. Adding 2 tauforged emerald Toxin Status dmg shards makes this 16.5 x 1.9 = 31.35x.

Toxin mods also DOUBLE DIP the Toxin status.

Say we take a weapon with 100 base damage and put two toxin mods on (+150% total), activating 350% Venom Dose, 105% Roar and Toxic Lash with 2 tauforged Toxin shards will boost damage to:
Raw damage: 100 x 2.05 x  (1 + 3.5 + 1.5) x (1 + 0.3 x 3.5 x 2.05 ) = 3877 total damage. This is approximately a 1550% damage buff.
Toxin status: 100 x 2.05 x (1 + 3.5) x 0.3 x 3.5 x 2.05 x 2.05 x 0.5 x (1+1.5) x 1.9 = 9667 toxin dmg / second over 7.5s. This is approximately a 7734% damage buff.

**Expedite Suffering**

Saryn's passiive increases status duration by 25%, meaning a normal 6s duration for toxin becomes 7.5s, directly boosting the amount of toxin damage compressed through Expedite Suffering by 25%.

If we take a primary weapon buiild with 100 base damage, 1 fire rate, add Galvanized Chamber, Serration + arcane, two toxin mods, primed faction mod, Vile Acceleration, we can apply 218,347 toxin status dmg in about 1 second of shooting. Casting Expedite suffering compresses the 7.5s of these procs into a single instance of toxin damage, and multiplies it by strength, giving 5.7 million damage. Adding crits and viral priming onto this could push this further by an order of 20x to 114 million damage from just a single second of dealing damage.

**SOBEK**

- Kuva Sobek (one-shot thrax variant for cascade):
- Kuva Sobek Nuke (maximum trash clear damage):

Acid Shells on Sobek is a mod that allows Toxic Lash to spread across a map via a chain reaction while scaling off %HP. This is because kills made via Toxic Lash can trigger Acid Shells which explodes in a 15m radius and deals 450 damage + 45% max HP (currently bugged to not account for steel path modifier meaning its much weaker than it should be), and enemies caught in the 15m radius take a Toxic Lash damage instance which scales off the %HP as 'base damage' which subsequently kills them. They then explode again in a 15m radius and triggers Lash on all enemies in range, chaining forever as long as there are enemies standing within 15m of each other (requires line of sight).

**JAT KITTAG**

Jat Kittag (Slam):

If you want to slam, Jat Kittag with Vulcan Blitz has the same chaining mechanic but a MUCH lower radius of 6m, which means it basically cannot chain very far.

**KUVA OGRIS**

- Kuva Ogris:

Kuva Ogris is a very weak weapon by itself, but the augment Nightwatch Napalm creates lingering AOE fields of heat damage over 6s, which can trigger Toxic Lash on all enemies that walk into the field and thus continue killing enemies throughout the map. This makes it the highest trash clear KPM possible in the game when paired with Saryn since it can be dispersed throughout a tile continuously to kill new spawns almost the moment they spawn in.

**OCUCOR**

- Ocucor:

Ocucor is the most 'lazy/comfortable' Saryn weapon because it creates seeking tendrils that effectively auto-aims for you and has an augment called Sentient Surge that makes it auto-reload on kill while also boosting critical chance and status chance. Ocucor by itself is also very weak but with Saryn level buffs it can be made to kill up to levelcap enemies without trouble. The arcane Secondary Fortifier also steals overguard meaning you can just hold down the fire button running around the map while Ocucor auto aims, auto reloads and auto regenerates overguard without worrying about survivability.

**VERMISPLICER**

- Primary Vermisplicer:

Primary Vermisplicer is a kitgun that has an auto-aiming beam that chains when it hits enemies and also has access to the mod Combustion Beam. Combustion Beam is like an extremely weak version of Acid Shells in that it can trigger an explosion on death with 600 base damage in a huge 18 m radius (vs Acid Shells which is 450 + %45HP in 15m radius), which can then trigger toxic lash in 18m but scaling off the 600 base dmg only. Therefore in order to make it usable, the strongest possible buffs/debuff are required e.g. exactly what Saryn + roar can offer. This would be made more viable alongside AOE armor strip (e.g. spores or corrosive procs) and viral status (e.g. from panzer/hound). Other beams can utilise Combustion Beam too e.g. Tenet Glaxion but Vermisplicer feels the best since you don't have to aim, can use Pax Charge for passive reload and fits thematically as a 'toxic' weapon.

**TENET DETRON**

- Tenet Detron (Thermagnetic Shells):

This is basically the secondary version of Acid Shells but with MUCH lower range pf 6m instead of 15m meaning enemies must be extremely close together (within 6m of each other) in order for the effect to chain.

**SPINNEREX**

Spinnerex is like a weaker melee version of Combustion Beam, where enemies killed after being hit by Spinnerex explode for 450 toxin damage in a 10m radius, which can trigger further Toxic Lash scaling off the 450 dmg, allowing this to chain in 10m intervals. AOE viral and armor strip are required.

**Patch / update history (from the guide)**

**UPDATE DEC 2025**

Arcane Persistence now allows Inaros to basically be immortal even up to levelcap. Arcane Persistence prevents enemies dealing more than 500 damage per second as long as you have over 700 armor. Since Inaros has between 4000 to 8000 health depending on how many health mod sources you have, you essentially could stand still for 8 to 16s without healing. Sandstorm heals back 50 health per second for each enemy trapped, scaling off strength, and also makes you invulnerable for the whole sandstorm period. Scarab Shell also makes Inaros immune to magnetic, heat and corrosive statuses which are things that can make persistence fail meaning you only need to worry about violence and nullifiers. To hit the armor cap, we have a few options:
1. Stand United + Umbral Fiber + Umbral Vitality + Umbral Intensify: always active non-conditional but takes highest investment (needs TWO umbral forma) but also gives highest stats
2. Stand United + TWO Tau Armor shards: always active non-conditional and saves forma
3. Scarab Shell: conditional, requires it to be active and charged so least safe method but saves multiple mod and archon slots

**Additional notes from the guide**

**Primary**

You can run Primary Bulwark arcane on primary weapons when Scarab Shell is charged up giving a total armor of 1500 to maximise 500% primary damage.

Coda Hema: This has lifesteal on headshots with is nice to heal Inaros without being in sandstorm AND has multiplicative Galvanized Aptitude (meaning it multiplies with Primary Bulwark/Serration rather than adds). Sandstorm could also prime additional elements for you.
General Use Build:
Thrax Killer Variant:

Torid Incarnon: Blast Torid works well with grouping

**Melee**

The elemental mods placed on your melee and the melees base IPS/elemental distribution affects the elemental weighting of Elemental Sandstorm, and changes how often a status is activated. Melee arcanes such as Melee exposure appear to work, while Melee influence has no specific interaction. Melee mods such as damage, crit, attack speed, status duration do NOT affect Sandstorm at all.

Primer:
If you want your sandstorm to be a pure condition overload/viral primer, simply place viral + heat/electric + radiation + magnetic mods on a weapon with innate corrosive, such as Caustacyst. This will allow sandstorm to proc 6-7 statuses (IPS, corrosive, viral, heat, radiation), which can feed into certain guns that work well with priming and grouping e.g. weapons with multiplicative condition overload effect: Coda Hema, Nataruk/Cinta, Lex incarnon, Tenet Arca Plasmor.

Blast:
If you want to use Sandstorm alone to passively kill enemies, you can mod a weapon with pure blast and run Diriga with Arc Coil priming viral and magnetic.
Silva and Aegis Prime is a weapon with pure heat meaning you can mod it for 100% blast with a single cold mod to maximise blast DPS.

Electric Influence:
If you are running a priming companion such as Panzer/Diriga that can prime viral for you and would like to do a combination of sandstorm DPS and direct melee DPS, you can simply run a pure electric melee with Melee Influence, which doubles as an Elemental Sandstorm DPS statstick AND a DPS melee. Once sandstorm ends, enemies are often grouped and knocked down, making it very easy for the next few melee hits to naturally perform ground finishers. Weapons in the fist, sparring and claws category have the highest ground finisher multiplier of 30x, followed by tonfas at 20x.

Okina Prime is one of, if not THE strongest influence light attack melee in the game and has the bonus of boosting movement speed by 30% which affects sandstorm movespeed.
Okina Prime Incarnon:

Furax Wraith is the strongest fist melee in the game and can use both melee influence and perform ground finishers for 30x multiplier
Furax Wraith Incarnon:

Prisma Ohma is the strongest tonfa melee for melee influence (and one of the strongest non-incarnons too) and is innate electric meaning the effect on electric weighting for sandstorm damage is highest. Tonfas also have a 20x ground finisher multiplier.

**Patch / update history (from the guide)**

**Update June 2024**

Healing Flame now gives overguard which makes you status immune while overguard is active and clears existing statuses on cast. Overguard also gives you 0.5s i-frames on breaking, meaning every cast of fireblast can generate approximately 1.5s of i-frames (about 1s from shield gate and 0.5s from overguard). This effectively allows Healing Flame to replace Catalyzing Shields, Rolling Guard and Primed Sure Footed.

**Additional notes from the guide**

**Flex/alternative options**

- Exothermic: Exothermic can make energy orbs independently of your companion and eximus spawns. Equilibrium is flexible for this as it can actually generate even more energy particularly when paired with synth deconstruct on a companion and eximus kills.
- Augur Reach: can be stretch if you run an augur mod on a pistol or burst laser prime
- Catalyzing Shields: optional but allows a single fireblast to give 1.33s i-frame from shield gate, in addition to the 0.5s overguard gate.

Due to a mechanic called "heat inherit", using heat status weapons is often a BAD idea on Ember. This is because heat status inherits the +heat mods and +faction mods from the first stack applied. If you cast fireblast or inferno first and apply a heat status THEN shoot with a heat status weapon like Furis incarnon, all subsequent heat procs applied will NOT use any of the heat or faction mods equipped on the furis (i.e. upwards of 3x less heat dot dmg). For this reason it is probably best to just use raw damage weapons (non-DoT) or non-heat status weapons. We also want them to have decent crit stats to take advantage of arcane hot shot.

**Build overview**

This build is for casual solo farming for resources by punching your way to all the loot, specifically for use in survival missions below level 500ish (i.e. 2-3 hours survival). Above level 500 for endurance, you may need more shield gating and armor strip. Rubble Heap augment allows you to cast landslide for free and boosts landslide damage/speed, while Path Of Statues petrifies enemies that walk into where you once slid. This combination allows you to spam Landslide infinitely and gain rubble to maintain maximum rubble without even casting petrify. Finally, the addition of Ore Gaze can increase the drop rate of additional loot by approximately 60% (which already matches Nekros and nearly matches Khora drop rates). This means you can collect more loot while smashing the enemies petrified by either Path Of Statues or Petrify.

Nourish is an optional subsume over 2 that boosts Landslide damage further with Viral damage, gives you an energy multiplier so you never run out of energy even at 45% efficiency and creates AOE viral procs and stuns whenever you get hit.

**Duration**

Minimum efficiency can be used in this build since Ore Gaze produces loot and increases the likelihood of energy orbs dropping, which combined with Nourish or Arcane Energize will ensure you stay at full energy after every couple of kills. Landslide also becomes free to cast at max rubble, and Path Of Statues petrifies enemies so you may not even need to spend energy to cast petrify. This means you only need to refresh Nourish every half minute and occasionally cast Petrify when you have good enemy density or for crowd control. If you end up dropping Ore Gaze AND Path of Statues for a non-survival mission, you will need more efficiency by either swapping blind rage for transient fortitude, or adding streamline/Fleeting Expertise.

Strength is important for both Landslide damage and petrify loot drop chance. At 250% strength, you have approximately a 63% drop chance from Ore Gaze, exceeding both Khora and Nekros. This can be further boosted to 100% by adding more strength mods or using Madurai + Nidus specter.

You will need to adjust this to the tileset as range affects the ricochet range and Seek range/punchthrough bonus. If enemies are frequently in dense groups or the map is small i.e. in corridors on many Grineer maps then you could be fine with 70 to 100 range. If enemies are bit more spread out or the map has huge rooms, then you will want a bit more range i.e. 145 to 175. If it is open world and enemies are very spread out you may want to try 235 to 280 range even.

**Strength**

Strength boosts the weakpoint multiplier from 1, damage buff from 2 and damage multiplier of 4, meaning strength basically triple dips overall Neutralizer DPS. You want to pump this as high as comfortable.

This combined with natural energy orb generation is enough to fuel all energy costs without Primed Flow or other energy production. If you feel like you need a bit more energy generation just add Energy Nexus.

**Additional notes from the guide**

Growing Power gives bonus strength on creating status with weapon
Worthy Comradery is worse than Growing Power for Neutralizer damage as it is just regular additive crit chance like Primary Acuity and Crit Delay. It is only special and multiplicative on headshots for certain weapons that are bugged with Biting Frost (e.g. tenet diplos, angstrum) - see wiki page for full list

**Flexible Slots**

Rolling Guard is OPTIONAL but helps cleanse statuses that may still affect you while invisible (e.g. heat from arson/blitz eximus, bleed from trokarians, toxin from eximus) and gives some bridging room in case Evade goes into cooldown.

**ELECTRIC**

Electric is a good general element because the status procs instantly, has a small AOE effect and also activates Archon Stretch when produced by Neutralizer. Primed Convulsion on secondary weapons also boosts electric DoTs even further, even if combined with other mods on the secondary to form a different element (e.g. magnetic/corrosive). Electric is also the preferred element against murmur. Primary weapons also have access to electric damage violet shards to maximise electric DoT. Missing a headshot causes enemies to become stunned and raise their head, making subsequent headshots even easier. Bodyshots can also kill enemies pretty quickly with electric DoT even at levelcap.

**GAS**

Gas has a persisting AOE that is excellent for maximising KPM (kills per minute) on camping tiles like survival/defense etc. Works fine with both bodyshots and headshots.

**BLAST**

Blast has the best rapid AOE clearance but absolutely requires headshot kills, bodyshots fizzle and do nothing. This would be nice for mobile missions where you require high KPM e.g. exterminate.

**TOXIN**

Toxic may be good against corpus as it bypasses shields.

**NEUTRALIZER**

Neutralizer Raw Damage Oneshot (Use this for strong single targets eg thrax):
Neutralizer Electric DoT trash clear:
Neutralizer Gas DoT lingering trash clear (for camping KPM):

**SNIPERS**

Cyte has synergy with other Sniper Rifles since Resupply gives bonus damage to snipers. Just note Resupply does NOT apply to incarnon modes of any weapon.
Perigale:

**SCOURGE + PISTOLS**

Scourge is a speargun that has an alt-fire which creates a zone of headshot attractors bubbles that force headshots. This is very useful when paired with a pistol. Good non-incarnon pistols include:
Scourge:
Knell Prime:
Tenet Diplos:
Zymos:

**OTHERS**

Sobek: similar to Saryn, Acid Shells can ferry resupply but is not limited to toxin, meaning you can use electric instead which is a stronger status.

**Who it's for**

Use this if you want Cyte-09 as a weapon platform option for level cap, steel path endurance, survival, defense. It carries a written guide (above).

Huras Kubrow:

**Mecha Empowered Aura**

This is optional, but if you use a Kubrow you can utilize the Mecha Set bonus which transfers status procs from a marked enemy to all other enemies in 20+ meters, once every 15 to 30s depending on whether Mecha Pulse is equipped or not. If you want the maximum mod set effect, replace Primed Continuity with Mecha Pulse. If you DON'T want to use Mecha Set at all, swap aura for Growing Power or Corrosive Projection.

**MOBILE (with Roar)**

Make sure to have Protea tap/hold controls INVERTED. This will make tapping 4 to cancel instead of rewind.
1. Tap 4 to initiate Temporal Anchor. Casting 2 while 4 is active will lock its timer despite the duration on the UI ticking down.
2. Cast 3 (roar) while the 100% strength passive is active to snapshot a bigger Roar
3. Just before 4 runs out, you should Double Tap 4 to terminate so you don't rewind and immediately recast 4 to relock the timer on your 2.
4. Depending on what you subsume over, you can tap 1 to gain a large shield gate or cast 3 for on demand energy

**CAMPING**

1. First you need to find a room in a decent tileset with ONE entrance where enemies funnel in through a narrow corridor or door. Pick a spot as your DPS LOCATION where you will camp and pop turrents, making sure the turrets are able to target all the enemies entering the area from that spot. Then pick another spot in the room that is AT LEAST 15m away from this camping spot and designate this as your DISPENSARY LOCATION. This is because Vacuum/Fetch radius is 13.5m maximum and any energy/health orbs you pick up during temporal Anchor are basically "wasted" since you revert back to near max energy at the end. The orbs from dispensary will basically be your "backup" pool of energy in case you run out somehow outside of Temporal Anchor.
2. Use 2 to trigger Protea's 100% str passive before casting roar to get a 299% str roar.
3. Use 2 three times again to trigger 100% str passive then pick up health orbs from your dispensary spot to refill energy to max, before casting Temporal Anchor.
4. Once you cast temporal anchor, make sure NOT TO MOVE from this location, and just cast three turrets every 8-10s when they expire. Staying completely stationary will cause the resulting rewind to be nearly instantaneous.
5. Turrets cast while Temporal Anchor is active will automatically strip enemies as they take damage, in a few shots per enemy. Huras will keep you invisible as long as you don't attack with your weapon.

**Build overview**

Utilise the power of the Mecha Set, Archon Mods and Heat + Gas Catalyze to nuke enemies as Lavos, the Full Mecha Alchemist. Lavos's Catalyze is a strong through the wall nuke that applies elemental damage and a forced status effect, applying heat damage at base and a second element that you can 'infuse'. We infuse Gas into catalyze because Gas procs linger across the map dealing damage in a small AOE, lasting longer than usual due to Lavos' passive, and works well with both grouping and Sickening Pulse helminth.

**Mod configuration**

- Lingering Transmutation — R3
- Valence Formation — R3

**Intended content — best at / less suited for**

Designed for: Level Cap, Steel Path endurance, Disruption, Survival, Farming / loot. The source guide does not spell out where it underperforms; as a tank build the usual tradeoff applies (see Strengths & weaknesses).

**Core build concept**

A **tank** Lavos setup: low Strength (1×), long Duration (1.55×), wide Range (1.6×), neutral Efficiency (1×). Its engine is the combination in the mod configuration above — Lingering Transmutation, Valence Formation, Adaptation, Mecha Pulse, Stretch, aura Mecha Empowered, Arcane Impetus + Arcane Guardian. See the written sections below for the intended damage/defence loop.

**Key stats & breakpoints**

**Duration**

Duration provides status duration to all of the statuses created by Lavos's abilities. At 155% duration, every proc is increased to approximately 9s increasing the overall damage potential of a status. Archon Continuity is used because Toxin procs created by Ophidian Bite can then proc corrosive which boosts Catalyze in two ways, due to both minor armor strip (up to 80% at 10 corrosive) and because Catalyze scales with number of elemental statuses (2^status).

**Efficiency**

While efficiency technically has no effect on Lavos's base cooldowns, efficiency is still very important because it affects the amount of cooldown reduction granted by both Transmutation probe and Swift Bite per enemy hit. At 100% efficiency, Transmutation probe reduces cooldown by 1.5s per enemy hit and Swift Bite reduces cooldown by 4s when at least 4 enemies are hit. This means casting a combination of Swift Bite (4s) followed by Transmutation probe hitting at least 15 enemies, allows you to reset Swift Bite for immediate recast. In total this combo reduces total cooldown by at least 30s, which allows Catalyze to be recast almost immediately after an initial catalyze cast. The second Swift Bite cast also reduces Transmutation probes cooldown so it is basically available for recast as soon as Catalyze finishes casting so you should be able to do the combination almost immediately again, provided there are enough enemies nearby and not dead.

**Range**

Range is essential for all of Lavos's abilities, including his helminth options such as grouping abilities and Sickening Pulse.

**Strength**

Strength affects the damage of all abilities so we want to keep this positive and as high as possble allowing for the other stats.

**Modding notes**

The guide does not break down individual mods. Defining picks appear to be: Lingering Transmutation, Valence Formation, Adaptation, Mecha Pulse, Stretch. Slots holding basic drift/utility or resistance mods are the flexible ones.

**Helminth**

In most cases we subsume over Vial Rush, unless you really enjoy the mobility of vial rush.

**Arcanes, Aura & Exilus**

For health tanking:
- Arcane Blessing - gives health
- Arcane Guardian - gives armor
- Arcane Reaper - gives both armor and healing when paired with melee

For shield gating:
- Arcane Aegis - when this procs you are effectively immortal for 10s

For Catalyze damage
- Arcane Impetus - up to 60% strength and 30% efficiency from Lavos potential elements, just need to cast each combination at least once in the mission then you will be able to constantly refresh it by casting any element
- Molt Augmented - up to 60% strength after 250 kills
- Arcane Ice storm - 40% strength and duration, but can be difficult to keep maxed and highly dependent on density, so could sit around half stacks around 20% strength/20% duration

**Archon Shards**

ONE to TWO Amber Cast Speed Shards to speed up cast animations
THREE to FOUR Crimson Duration Shards helps increase the duration of gas procs from catalyze
ONE Tauforged Emerald archon shard is OPTIONAL for 13 corrosive stacks which improves armor strip from 80% to 98% which is roughly a 1.5x dmg buff.

**Survivability & failure conditions**

**Energy economy**

**Playstyle & rotation**

NON-HELMINTH PLAYSTYLE
You can achieve great results with the same exact build but without Sickening Pulse or Ensnare subsumed. You will just need to infuse corrosive more often to achieve full strip, or simply use a corrosive primer eg Bubonico (which can prime both viral and corrosive). Since you now have Vial Rush, you can even infuse Magnetic into abilities which can help proc Melee Vortex on a melee focused Lavos.

1. Try to group enemies with Magus Anomaly/Ensnare/Nautilus Cordon/Melee Vortex.
2. Shoot your primer (e.g. Cedo altfire) to inflict more statuses then hold 1 and 4 to infuse GAS or hold 4 to infuse HEAT, before immediately casting Catalyze (4).
3. OPTIONAL: Infuse corrosive (Hold 1 and 3) into every cast of 1, 2 and 3 to proc corrosive for armor strip (can full strip at 14 stacks with 2 emerald +corrosive stack shards).
4. Tap 3 immediately after to reduce the cooldown of 4, and ideally before enemies all die (optionally, hold 1 and 3 before hand to infuse corrosive to add 3 corrosive procs)
5. Tap 1 ideally into the group of enemies. This will reduce cooldowns of both 3 and 4 further while also adding exactly 4 corrosive procs (three from infusion and 1 from Archon Continuity).
6. Tap 2 to Vial Rush and charge through groups of enemies, dropping vials that rapidly stack corrosive status for full strip on enemies standing in the pools (14 procs in 3-4s).

**Variants**

_None described._

**Strengths & weaknesses**

- **Strengths:** high effective health / sustained survivability; forgiving of mistakes.
- **Weaknesses:** lower ability- or weapon-damage ceiling; can still fall to gaps in the defensive layer.
_(Archetype-level; the source guide gives no explicit list.)_

**Patch / update history (from the guide)**

**Update Feb 2025**

Valence Formation is currently BUGGED? and no longer applies to damage over time including gas, electric, toxin, heat e.t.c and therefore no longer buffs Catalyze procs. This means if you are doing a PURE Catalyze DPS setup, drop Valence Formation entirely. If you are also wanting to use weapons, especially melees that utilize gas (e.g. slam afflictions) or electric (e.g. influence), then keep Valence Formation. Since the armor changes (armor capped at 2700 for 90% damage reduction), we no longer really require full strip for good damage which means the focus on corrosive procs and emerald shards is now optional.

Empty arcane slot is for Arcane Impetus, you just need to cast one of each of the 10 possible elements at least once in the mission then it will constantly refresh to get 10 stacks for 60% strength and 30% efficiency. Arcane Ice Storm also gives both duration and strength both of which are useful on Lavos, but can be difficult to stack in certain missions.

**Update April 2024**

Valence Formation is a new augment that applies a +200% elemental bonus to weapons, BUT, seems to also apply to statuses created by abilities including Catalyze. This means infusing Gas into Catalyze will allow subsequent Gas procs to benefit from a 3x multiplier.

The mecha set provides many benefits:
- Mecha Empowered gives +150% damage (2.5x damage multiplier) to a marked enemy (marked every 12s), which doubles dips on status effects for a final 6.25x on heat/gas DoT
- Mecha Pulse gives +60% armor for each enemy in 30m upon killing the marked enemy. In a dense map lke survival you can easily get 1000-2000% armor bonus, which scales extremely well with Lavos' high base armor, allowing you to hit between 3000 to 10,000 final armor.
- Mecha set bonus causes status effects to spread upon killing a marked enemy which basically applies whole additional set of boosted catalyze procs to 30m radius every 15s.

Archon mods work well with Lavos, but are NOT compulsory (the regular versions work fine too):
- Archon Vitality adds an additional heat proc created by Catalyze
- Archon Continuity adds corrosive status upon being hit by toxin procs via Ophidian Bite, which helps with Emerald shard armor strip and any additional elemental statuses boost Catalyze.
- Archon Intensify activates upon being healed by Ophidian Bite, giving a total of +60% strength (compared to only 44% from Umbral Intensify). Since you will tanking hits and constantly healing by 1, this should remain active almost always. Precision Intensify is however straight up better since it gives 90% strength to 4.

Archon Stretch and Archon Flow are NOT usable on Lavos since he has NO energy and does not benefit from energy orbs.

**Additional notes from the guide**

Flexible:
- Cunning Drift for more range
- Power Drift for more strength
- Coaction Drift double dips on aura, giving Mecha Empowered 198% status damage on marked enemies, which double dips for a final 8.9x multiplier.

**Sickening Sublimation (Gas and Sickening Pulse)**

- Group enemies
- Hold 1 and 4 to infuse Gas
- Tap 4 to nuke with Gas + Heat
- Hold 1 and 3 to infuse Corrosive
- Tap 3 to reduce cooldown of 4
- Tap 2 to cast Sickening pulse which will add 10 corrosive procs (giving full strip with 2 emerald shards), multiply electric status damage by 10x (from Transmutation probe), multiply gas status damage by 10x and increase its AOE (from gas infused Catalyze), double heat status damage (from Catalyze) and double toxin status damage (from Ophidian Bite).
- Hold 1 and 3 to further infuse corrosive and Tap 1 to tag 1 Toxin and 4 corrosive and reduce cooldowns of 3 and 4
- Optional: Spam  grouping to get new enemies into the existing Gas clouds

[[ streamable id="6t9gv0" ]]
.

**Supermagnetic Vortex (Melee Vortex)**

- Hold 1 and 2 to infuse Viral
- Tap 2 to Vial Rush for map traversal and to close melee distance and proc cold + viral everywhere
- Hold 2 and 3 to infuse Magnetic
- Tap 2 or 3 to reduce cooldowns more and prime with viral
- Hold 1 and 2 to infuse Viral
- Tap 1 to reduce cooldowns and proc tox + viral
- Repeat

**Tanking**

Since Lavos does not spend energy, he is unable to reset shield gate with the normal methods using Brief Respite/Augur mods. For non-endurance content, you can commit to full eHP tanking using a combination of armor, health and adaptation and using Ophidian bite to heal.

Lavos has a high base health so Archon Vitality/Vitality boosts health to 1480. Transmutation Probe converts all orbs into universal orbs which activate Arcane Blessing so you can gain an additional 1200 health very quickly for a total of 2680 health.

Lavos also has a high base armor of 675, meaning Mecha Pulse after affecting just 10 enemies in a 30m radius gives a 600% armor boost for 3150 extra armor for 20s. Compare this to Steel Fiber which only gives +100% for another 675 armor. Since Mecha set has a cooldown of only 15s you should be able to upkeep a large armor buff permanently provided you kill dense crowds consistently. If you affect 20 enemies, you can get 1200% armor or 5850 armor for 95.6% DR. This multiplied with Adaptation gives 99.56% DR and applied to 2680 health gives an effective HP of 609,090.

**Active Gating**

You can subsume a shield regenerating ability like Pillage or Condemn, and swap Adaptation for Rolling Guard. Pillage gives armor strip which is very beneficial to the Lavos's damaging abilities, while Condemn gives crowd control which is very useful in Endurance and preventing you from getting hit in the first place. You will also want to run Vazarin protective sling for additional i-frames as well as Huras Kubrow or Shade for invisibility.  Shade has the added bonus of having Guardian + Manifold Bond which allows it to constantly refill your shields passively whenever you get kills on enemies affected by multiple statuses, which is Lavos's specialty. An Endurance oriented variant using Pillage:

**Passive Gating/Recharge**

Another niche method is to use multiple sources of shield recharge delay reduction including warframe mods, Vazarin Guardian Break and Grimoire mod Fass Canticle, allowing you to minimize recharge delay and just passively recharge shields while staying mobile. Simply swap out Mecha Pulse and Adaptation for Vigilante Vigor and Fast Deflection as seen here.  Add Catalyzing Shields too as it is currently bugged to give 1.33s gate on any amount of shield regenerated, which synergizes very well with passive recharge. Precision Intensify is also now optional over Archon Intensify since you wont be healing anymore.

**Ensnare/Grouping**

Grouping is ideal on Lavos as it lets Gas procs from Gas infused Catalyze overlap and create exponential damage on groups of enemies, and also allows more enemies to get hit at once for both Swift Bite and Transmutation Probe in order to reduce cooldowns more efficiently.

Ensnare is a bit slower than the other grouping abilities but provides longer crowd control by keeping enemies locked in place for longer durations. This is ideal on Lavos as you often need to perform an ability rotation before you can nuke with catalyze, so you need to keep enemies in place for at least a few seconds. Coil Horizon is a good alternative as it provides electric status procs in case you didnt cast 3.

**Sickening Pulse**

This sends a spreading wave that basically doubles heat DoT, doubles toxin DoT, adds 10 stacks of corrosive (to help with full strip from 2 green archon shards) but multiplies gas and electic DoT by 10x. This is the best subsume for smaller maps with tight corridors or where you can force enemies to naturally group up as they come in, or if you have an alternate form of grouping like Magus Anomaly, Vazarin Snare, Telos Boltace, Nautilus Cordon, Melee Vortex etc.

**Roar**

Boosts all DoT status effects and double dips the roar bonus. Less spammy and applies passively to all damage from both your weapons and abilities.

**Expedite Suffering**

Compresses the total duration of slash and toxin procs and deals it in one instance, then applies a multiplier. This is a great tool for disruption when paired with a good natural slash weapon such as Flux Rifle, Convectrix, Spectral Vandal or any decent slash Melee weapon (e.g. nikana prime, dual ether, kronen prime etc).

For a specific Expedite build, use this:

**Thermal Sunder**

The cold cast of Thermal Sunder acts like expedite suffering but for heat procs, so it compresses all heat procs created by Catalyze into one big blast damage instance. This also gives grouping because applying cold sunder to heat procs with sunder causes an implosion. AOE cold procs also contirbute to catalyze damage even in the absence of of Vial Rush. **UNFORTUNATELY THIS IS IMPRACTICAL IN ACTUAL USE BECAUSE THERMAL SUNDER HAS A 15s BASE DURATION, MEANING THE ABILITY ACTUALLY HAS ABOUT 30s COOLDOWN**

**Pillage**

Pillage lets Lavos shield gate more effectively and also strips armor which allows status effects to scale more effectively against armor.

**MECHA SET KUBROWS**

The mecha set requires a kubrow, ideally Huras kubrow which will allow you stay invisible as long as you don't shoot:

Pharoah Predasite is a reasonable alternative:

**SENTINELS/OTHER**

Sentinels are capable of using Guardian and Manifold Bond, which is highly effective at keeping Lavos alive via shield gating.
Nautilus can be a useful passive grouping tool:
Helios can provide passive armor strip if you don't use emerald shards or pillage:
Hounds can perform the widest AOE priming for Catalyze:

**PRIMER**

An AOE primer can spread status procs to enable Catalyze even further (the missing status procs are viral, magnetic, blast, cold, because corrosive is provided by Archon Continuity):

Bubonico allows you to prime for both Viral AND Corrosive, which allows green shards to full strip much quicker:

Cedo is able to proc the most unique status effects in an AOE to boost Catalyze:
Kuva Ogris is also able to proc alot of unique status effects in an AOE:

The Grimoire is a useful utility weapon that can triple as an encumber primer, stat buffer from Invocation mods and even immortality source (Fass Canticle) or armor strip (Jahu Canticle)

**MELEE WEAPONS**

Telos Boltace - this weapon has a special ability where slide attacks group enemies with a 14m radius and 6s cooldown. Telos Boltace is also a Tonfa meaning it deals significant damage due to neutral combo on Sovereign Outcast and has very high status chance meaning it is a very strong user of Melee Influence.
Telos Boltace:

Dual Ichor Incarnon - this is currently the strongest light spam melee weapon in the game. You can pair this with Melee Vortex for grouping (use magnetic primer such as kuva nukor or infuse magnetic into abilities) or Melee Influence for AOE nuking.
Dual Ichor:

**GAS GROUPING CATALYZE CALCULATIONS**

Using a Cedo Primer giving blast, viral, rad, tox, electric, cold with heat and gas from catalyze gives about 8 unique status effects. If you apply this to a mecha marked enemy with 10 viral statuses, the highest gas proc that can be spread is

2000 x 1.45 x 0.5 x 2^8 x 4.25 x 6.25 = 9,860,000 gas damage per second

If you then apply this to 10 enemies ensnared together within 3m, each enemy will deal this amount of damage per second to each other enemy in a 3m radius, meaning each enemy actually takes about 99 million gas damage per second.

If you apply Sickening Pulse and use another form of grouping, we can max this to 10 gas procs which deals 99 million damage/s per enemy but in a 6m radius i.e. 990 million damage/s if 10 enemies grouped or about 2 billion damage/s at 20 enemies.

Without Mecha Empowered active, we deal about 1.6 million gas dmg/s per enemy, or 32 million gas dmg/s in 6m area if 20 enemies are ensnared.

**Who it's for**

Use this if you want Lavos as a tank option for level cap, steel path endurance, disruption, survival, farming / loot. It carries a written guide (above).

**Build overview**

This is a Celestial Clash focused build for maximising potential damage output of Celestial Clash while spamming most abilities. As a side effect of armor strip and roar buff you can also use weapons to kill effectively although there is a better dedicated weapon platform setup.

You will ideally need Shade Prime or Huras Kubrow to turn one of your brothers permanently invisible so they can use Arcane Crepuscular which is a huge damage boost to Celestial Clash. I recommend turning Sirius permanently invisible as Sirius deals more average damage due to strength from crepuscular being more valuable on Sirius since it also affects Roar.

**Mod configuration**

- Umbral Intensify — R10
- Equilibrium — R10 — – · Naramon

**Intended content — best at / less suited for**

Designed for: Farming / loot. The source guide does not spell out where it underperforms; as a tank build the usual tradeoff applies (see Strengths & weaknesses).

**Core build concept**

A **tank** Sirius & Orion setup: high Strength (3.13×), neutral Duration (1.275×), wide Range (1.45×), negative Efficiency (0.45×). Its engine is the combination in the mod configuration above — Umbral Intensify, Equilibrium, Archon Vitality, Transient Fortitude, Stretch, aura Blind Rage/Corrosive Projection, Arcane Crepuscular + Molt Augmented. See the written sections below for the intended damage/defence loop.

**Key stats & breakpoints**

**Duration**

Duration is really only needed on Sirius for Roar uptime and Light's Sanctuary Uptime as well as on Orion for Astral Shell and Event Horizon. However, since you are often casting the combos to charge up Celestial Clash, you will be recasting so often you barely need to actually run much duration on Orion.

**Efficiency/Economy**

The passive gives +45% efficiency on the next two casts after swapping frames and when a frame drops under 50 it will steal energy from the other frame. Arcane Energize triggers 150 energy gain to allies in an AOE meaning having it on Orion and picking up an orb as Orion also restores 150 energy on Sirius. Equilibrium is good consistent energy generation on Sirius since it frees the arcane slot for more valuable stat increases e.g. Molt Augmented/Arcane Concentration.

**Range**

This is a useful stat on both Orion and Sirius since is affects the range of Celestial Slash from both frames, as well as range of Event Horizon on Orion and Light's Sanctuary on Sirius. Keep in mind that Celestial Clash as an extremely high base range of 26m and is line of sight, so having just Stretch gives 37m which is big enough to cover most rooms already. You may want to adjust this to 235% range with Overextended if the tileset has much bigger rooms.

**Strength**

Strength is a very important stat on both Orion and Sirius mainly to boost Celestial Clash damage, but is most important on Sirius since it boosts both Roar and Celestial Clash. Umbral Intensify is mathematically better on Sirius due to boosting both Roar and Clash while Precision is better on Orion. Orion only needs 200% strength to full strip with one cast of Gravitic Slash which is easily reached.

**Modding notes**

The guide does not break down individual mods. Defining picks appear to be: Umbral Intensify, Equilibrium, Archon Vitality, Transient Fortitude, Stretch. Slots holding basic drift/utility or resistance mods are the flexible ones.

**Helminth**

You cannot cast any abilities while in Celestial Clash meaning you should run helminth abilities that run on duration that benefit both frames e.g. Roar.

Make Sirius your primary son and subsume Roar onto Sirius 3 so you can still use Jade Stars for a Weapon Platform setup. Roar will buff both frames.

I would suggest subsuming Roar onto Sirius in TWO configs slots as you can also use Roar in a dedicated weapon buff setup as seen here:

**Arcanes, Aura & Exilus**

- Arcane Crepuscular - more strength and critical damage which applies to Celestial Clash but needs you to run an invisible companion e.g. Shade/Huras. With shade invisibility bug you can make ONE of your brothers permanently invisible meaning 100% crepuscular uptime.
- Arcane Concentration - more duration for roar uptime on Sirius.
- Arcane Energize - optional for energy economy, might be sufficient to have it on only one frame so adjust to your needs
-  Molt Augmented - more strength for Celestial Clash damage and Roar
- Arcane Circumvent - allows you to strip overguard and armor while dodging in Celestial Clash but a little buggy
- Arcane Hotshot - Jade stars activates hotshot for crit cance which only affects weapons, not celestial clash

**Archon Shards**

2 Cast
3 Strength - for maximising Celestial Clash damage since it double dips on Sirius

Technically Ability Damage shards boost Celestial Clash more than strength but this requires an external primer to apply either radiation, corrosive or electric which is not as consistent as just using strength.

Note that Orion 1 cannot strip armor through overguard, making Corrosive Projection especially valuable against eximus and Thrax.

Completely flexible on both frames

**ORION**

Swap Molt Augmented to Arcane Energize

**CELESTIAL CLASH**

See Spreadsheet for damage calculations (Select FILE -> MAKE A COPY to edit):

According to calculations, Umbral Intensify is now better than Precision Intensify on Sirius due to Roar double dipping heat procs, and strength boosting both Roar and 4 on Sirius.

Things that affect or do not affect damage
- Roar YES
- Arcane Crepuscular YES applies both 30% strength and flat +3x crit multiplier to base 2x crit multiplier
- Ability Damage Shard YES

- Tenacious Bond NO
- Nourish NO
- Arcane Hotshot NO
- Vigorous Swap NO

**LAZY MODE**

Inverting controls makes it so you always swap forms on tapping an ability rather than holding. Now you can just simply always tap buttons to build up Constellation stars and then when you hit maximum you just alternate left and right mouse buttons to use Celestial Clash, which is the simplest 'pattern' of use.

1. Tap 1 repeatedly to swap forms and build up stars while simultaneously stripping enemies and picking up drops. Occasionally tap 3 too.
2. Occasionally Tap 2 to recast roar in Sirius and activate Astral Shell in Orion. When Roar is subsumed tapping 2 will not swap out of Sirius but will still swap out of Orion.
3. Once constellations are built up enter 4 and alternative between left and right mouse clicks.

**MAXIMUM DAMAGE POTENTIAL**

If you want to absolutely maximise celestial clash DPS with specific combos then you'll want to snapshot invisibility onto Sirius (see invisibility bug below) and build more stars with Sirius than Orion. i.e. do SSOSSOS or OSSOSSO.

**MOBILITY**

You can enter Celestial Clash and dash around in the air very fast with roll, which can be boosted with amalgam barrel diffusion. The movement speed while floating is also boosted by Okina Prime/Ruvox Incarnon. Exiting refunds the cost making this a free mobility tool.

**INVISIBILITY BUG**

There is also currently a bug with Shade where if you make one frame invisible, swap frames then wait for that one to turn invisible too, immediately break invisibility by shooting then swap back, the first frame will be permanently invisible even while attacking or if Shade dies. The other brother will often uncloak when enemies nearby die, if Shade dies or if you shoot.

Every time you swap warframes you become invulnerable for 1.5s and then once you enter Celestial Clash every time you attack you become invulnerable for about 0.6s. If you are actively casting abilities to build up constellations and using Celestial Clash you can basically chain i-frames constantly. Your Shield gate will also give you an extra 1.33s i-frame on break and naturally regenerate over time especially while the inactive frame is immortal.

Finally one brother e.g. Sirius will be permanently invisible if using Shade bug, while Orion's Astral Shell also negates an instance of damage on both frames.

**Who it's for**

Use this if you want Sirius & Orion as a tank option for farming / loot. It carries a written guide (above).

**Key stats & breakpoints**

**Duration**

Positive duration helps reduce the energy drain of gloom, but also benefits uptime of toxic lash and reduces decay of spores.

**Efficiency**

It may seem like 100% efficiency is too low, but Saryn's immense energy pool combined with hunter adrenaline +/-arcane energize allows reasonably easy energy maintenence. Feel free to add Streamline over Stretch if you prefer less drain or don't own arcane energize.

**Range**

As with most Saryn builds, range is essential for spreading spores. Gloom also affects more enemies with high range, but note that since energy drain from Gloom is capped at 10 enemies, higher range is unlikely to affect your overall energy drain.

**Strength**

At 139% strength, gloom gives 49% slow. You can increase this with growing power and/or pax bolt to hit 66% slow. Why do we not want the slow to hit the cap of 95%? WIth the high range that Saryn requires, slowing all enemies beyond walls will make missions take forever and be conterintuitive for survival missions. In addition, to regain energy with hunter adrenaline, we actually *want* enemies to shoot us at a reasonable rate.

**Additional notes from the guide**

**UPDATED FOR PERSISTENCE - TEXT MAY BE OUTDATED NOW**

This is a niche face tanking Saryn build that lets Saryn stand still, take damage and stay alive. This is made posible by the combination of Gloom (subsumed from Sevagoth) and Spores. Gloom gives you lifesteal from all damage sources with an infinite range, meaning as long as spores are doing damage, you can heal back any damage taken. With spores and gloom active, you should be healing approximately 7 to 8% lifesteal/second. At 1000 spore damage, this means you heal at a rate of 80 health PER enemy affected. If 10 enemies are affected at 1000 spore damage, you are healing at a rate of 800 health/second. This means you can basically heal your entire health pool every second, and as long as spores are active and an enemy does not take off all your health in one shot, you are effectively immortal by just standing still.

This differs slightly from other Gloom Saryn builds due to the use of Hunter Adrenaline and lower strength, with a focus more on taking hits to regenerate energy rather than achieving maximum slow crowd control and relying on arcane energize procs. Note that this build is NOT suited for endurance, where you will probably get one-shot regardless of heal rate at around level 500-1000 if you stand still and get shot.

You can alter polarities based on your preference.

- Primed sure footed/handspring for knockdown resistance
- Adaptation and Vitality provide higher EHP and healing buffer but can be replaced by more power strength or efficiency if preferred.

**Build overview**

This is a general use Styanax build for steel path and endurance steel path with high range for full strip with Tharros Strike and Final Stand explosions. Survivability in endurance is from a combination of overguard generated by the augment Intrepid stand (which gives extra 0.5s i-frame gate from depleting overguard) and shield gating (another 0.33 to 2.5s gate) which is complemented by the shield Regen from Rally Point. Axios Javelin has questionable targetting and can be replaced with Nourish to boost energy gain, raw weapon damage, final stand raw damage and allows final stand to have a small chance of creating viral status. You can add Tharros Lethality to add slightly more weapon focus to the build.

Styanax's passive is not specifically worth building excessive amounts of shield for since it is only additive to mods. Even with 2-3 shield mods, the maximum shield + overshield you can reach is about 4000, which equates to 100% additive crit chance or only half of a single Critical Delay, and 2/3rds of what Zephyr can Reach by simply jumping without having to maintain shields.

**Core build concept**

A **tank** Styanax Prime setup: moderate Strength (1.39×), long Duration (1.55×), wide Range (2.5×), negative Efficiency (0.45×). Its engine is the combination in the mod configuration above — Equilibrium, Intrepid Stand, Primed Flow, Tharros Lethality, Overextended, aura Corrosive Projection, Arcane Truculence + Arcane Arachne. See the written sections below for the intended damage/defence loop.

**Key stats & breakpoints**

**Duration**

Duration is important for easier upkeep of Rally Point, Nourish, as well as the duration and therefore total damage output of Final Stand.
On the other hand Tharros strike is not affected by duration at all.

**Efficiency**

Nourish allows you to run negative efficiency, either at 45%, since we can double energy gain from both Rally Point (approximately 10 energy/s) and other sources such as Equilibrium. Without Nourish, might want to keep efficiency neutral or adjust to preference as you only generate about 5 energy/s with rally point (300 energy/minute). Finally, Equilibrium is a huge source of energy since it converts health orbs into energy meaning each health orb is 55 energy. Every eximus kill guarantees 2 health orbs or 110 energy while Synth Deconstruct on Panzer/Hound causes lots of more health orbs to drop.

If you constantly spam 4 at 155% duration which lasts about 4s, this means you could be casting this 15 times per minute. Each cast costs 155 energy at 45% efficiency meaning in minute you would need 2325 energy to sustain. If you are not spamming 4 as much and don't feel like energy is an issue, you can drop Equilbrium and just rely on Nourish boosted Rally Point (which is about 600energy per minute).

**Range**

High range is needed for the pull range of Axios Javelin (if kept), range of Tharros Strike and Explosion range of Final Stand.

**Strength**

Strength is important for Tharros Strikes armor/shield strip, which requires either 200% strength to full strip in one cast or just 164% strength with Corrosive Projection in aura. Strength also boosts Rally Points shield on kill and energy Regen, as well as overall damage of Final Stand.

Arcane Arachne - after wall latch, boosts Final Stand damage by 2.5x for 30s (+150% additive to Vigorous Swap and Naramon's Void Levitation). For weapons, the +150% dmg is additive to Serration etc.
Molt Augmented - gives +60% strength after 250 kills, boosting all abilities. Better used in longer missions.
Molt Efficiency - more duration with shields active (easy with styanax since 3 gives shields)
Arcane Concentration - more duration
Arcane Avenger - adds +45% flat crit chance to weapons, often stronger than Styanax's passive, but might need Combat Discipline in aura to trigger consistently

**Strengths & weaknesses**

_(Archetype-level; the source guide gives no explicit list.)_

**Patch / update history (from the guide)**

**UPDATE FEB 2025**

Since the health and armor changes, Styanax 4 is even worse than before for DPS. Arcane Truculence is a nice choice to help maximise DPS since 10 viral status in 30m can boost damage up to 4.25x more consistently than Panzer priming.

**UPDATE JULY 2023**

The new augment Intrepid Stand allows Final Stand to generate overguard on each enemy hit, which scales with strength. Since overguard now has 0.5s gate, Styanax is effectively immortal as long as you are hitting enemies in 4.

**Additional notes from the guide**

Corrosive Projection - reduces armor from 100% to 82%, meaning you only need to strip the remaining 82% armor with Tharros strike which is hit at 164% strength.
Growing Power - boosts all abilities but needs additional aura forma.
Brief Respite - extra shield gating on demand rather than waiting for Rally point Regen

Totally flexible for Cunning Drift, Power Drift etc. Primed Sure Footed is optional since you are knockdown immune with overguard active, but are still susceptible whenever it breaks. Ice Spring is excellent for Parkour Velocity and matches Primed Sure Footed polarity.

1. Overguard
Intrepid Stand constantly produces overguard when you hit enemies with Final Stand. In lower levels this Overguard can last long enough that you don't even need to care about any additional survivability. In higher levels where Overguard is oneshot by every bullet, breaking overguard always gives 0.5s of invulnerability. If you immediately regenerate overguard again in that 0.5s gap due to Intrepid Stand you are effectively immortal while hitting enemies in Final Stand.

2. Passive Shield Gating
Rally Point generates 50 shield per kill scaling with strength, so roughly 100 shield near 200% strength. If you kill about 11 to 12 enemies in one go due to Final Stand, melee influence or any other AOE weapons this generates over 1100 overshield which gives 2.5s of i-frames upon breaking. This means even after Overguard breaks you often have another 2.5s of leeway to either click Final Stand again or kill a few enemies to generate more shield and continue the cycle. Killing just one enemy restores enough for a 0.33s shield gate which may be sufficient in itself.

3. Active Shield Gating
This is more necessary in endurance situations (i.e. levelcap cascade) where you instantly lose shields and overguard every hit, there are no enemies around to restore shields via Rally Point and you may not want to be casting Final Stand e.g. facing a single strong target. Having Augur mods (+/- Brief Respite) allows you to have on demand shield gate by casting Tharros Strike.

**Flexible Options**

Can swap over Umbral Intensify (if running red strength shards to hi 164% strength) or Equilbrium
- Tharros Lethality - optional to boost weapon crit damage after Tharros Strike for hybrid weapon platforming
- Natural Talent - speeds up cast animations, particularly of Tharros Strike and Final Stand. Use this if you don't have Amber cast speed shards.
- Rolling Guard - grants i-frames and status cleanse.
- Vigorous Swap - affects the damage of Final Stand, acting as a 2.65x damage multiplier, but requires you to swap weapons to activate, before pressing 4, although this is additive to Arcane Arachne.

**FOCUS SCHOOL**

Naramon - Lethal Levitation can replace or ADD to Arcane Arachne as it adds 200% damage in the same layer as the 150% from arachne, meaning a 3x multiplier alone (or a 1.8x multiplier with arachne on). This is easy to proc with Phahd amp as you just need to press 1 and then alt fire to hit 4 levitated enemies.

Madurai - gives bonus cast speed and strength

Vazarin - good backup immortality if doing endurance

**Who it's for**

**Build overview**

This is a hybrid light attack/heavy attack melee focused Voruna build using Shooting Gallery with Muzzle Flash to provide both crowd control and melee buff and focusing on Fangs of Raksh and Prey Of Dynar to spread status effects and nuke maps. Muzzle Flash provides 40+ seconds of passive crowd control, needing only 6 kills (from either you, your abilities or your allies) to charge up a blind that is triggered on your next attack (either melee or gun). This keeps the map perpetually stunned allowing you to run up and use light attack melees without getting damaged.

Finally, blinded enemies receive an additional 700% STEALTH DAMAGE MULTIPLIER to all melee attacks which itself is additive to Crit Damage (giving approximately +70-80% final melee damage boost after accounting for Shroud of Dynar), in addition to the very minor damage boost of shooting gallery itself (50% additive to Condition Overload for <10% final boost after accounting for status effects)

**Intended content — best at / less suited for**

**For Endurance**

Crowd control from Muzzle Flash provides the bulk of survivability while using light attack spam. If you take any breakthrough damage simple tap 1 to go invisible AND generate some shields for shield gate. Vazarin protective dash can be a final layer of ultimate survivability in an Endurance situation where you find yourself out of energy or unable to cast abilities (e.g. against Violence).

**Core build concept**

A **tank** Voruna setup: moderate Strength (1.39×), long Duration (1.55×), wide Range (2.5×), negative Efficiency (0.45×). Its engine is the combination in the mod configuration above — Muzzle Flash, Primed Flow, Equilibrium, Prey of Dynar, Overextended, aura Corrosive Projection, Arcane Strike + Arcane Impetus. See the written sections below for the intended damage/defence loop.

**Key stats & breakpoints**

**Duration**

Positive duration helps uptime of 1 and 3, but you don't need to go overboard as the base invisibility duration is very long and you will likely remove it immediately upon melee attacking. Furthermore, getting melee kills is able to increase the duration of both the melee buff of 1 and overall duration of 3. Archon Continuity is **optional** as 2 is able to create toxin procs which subsequently forces 1 corrosive proc even if corrosive was not created by 2, for extra Condition Overload damage and mild armor strip. I would suggest you DON'T use Achon mods initially as you don't want to use up mod capacity since it affects starting energy. You need exactly 9 mod capacity to have enough starting energy to cast Lycath Hunt at the beginning of the mission.

**Efficiency**

Voruna is able to run negative efficiency with Blind Rage on a melee focused build due to Lycath's Hunt (3) forcing health orb drops on melee kills and Equilibrium giving 55 energy per health orb. In addition Arcane Impetus now gives bonus free efficiency.

**Range**

Range is maximised for the spread radius of Fangs of Raksh (2), giving up to 17m range of status spread (and about 30m with Prey Of Dynar), as well as the range of Muzzle Flash. This allows you to nuke maps with either the 'status taxi' mechanic or simply via the damaging DoTs (blast, heat, electric, toxin, gas) created by Fangs of Raksh, as well as prime entire rooms with useful statuses such as viral, corrosive or cold.

**Strength**

Strength is mainly to boost the melee crit damage buffs from 1, status damage from 2 and dmg buff of shooting gallery so you don't need a huge amount of strength unless running a helminth like Roar.

**Modding notes**

The guide does not break down individual mods. Defining picks appear to be: Muzzle Flash, Primed Flow, Equilibrium, Prey of Dynar, Overextended. Slots holding basic drift/utility or resistance mods are the flexible ones.

**Helminth**

Melee damage boosting options include:
- Wrathful Advance - adds even more flat crit chance bonus to melees, allowing some melees to red crit easily
- Roar - boosts DoT and triple dips on status spread via Fangs of Raksh. This also applies to ulfrun if you are using it.

Crowd control options include:
- Shooting Gallery with Muzzle Flash - blinds enemies allowing you to freely spam light attacks without invisibility, and also forces stealth melee multiplier (700% crit dmg additive to crit multiplier)
- Silence - Stuns enemies for 2s and shuts off all eximus/acolyte abilities. Savage Silence augment also applies the stealth melee multiplier to stunned enemies. Drop range to 100 to 145% so you can permanently stun enemies while mobile since you can keep making enemies exit and re-enter silence range.
- Gloom - Swap Blind Rage for Transient Fortitude and Muzzle Flash for Umbral Intensify, Cunning Drift for Power Drift. This is because the drain from Gloom + casting abilities can be unsustainable at 45% efficiency even with Lycaths hunt, and you want more strength to get closer to the slow cap.

**Arcanes, Aura & Exilus**

Completely optional and up to preference:
- Impetus - gives strength and efficiency and can stack to maximum from Fangs of Raksh
- Crepuscular - only works for certain weapons that can 'hit and run', as you only leave invisibility AFTER hitting with melee but need to recast invis immediately e.g. Slam, Contagion
- Augmented - boosts strength to further boost Crit Damage buff of 1
- Strike - more melee attack speed
- Fury - more melee damage
- Blessing - if you prefer to tank, which also mega boosts the health of a pet running link health

**Archon Shards**

1 Tauforged Cast Speed shard helps with feel of spamming 1 and 2 constantly
1 Tauforged Azure Energy Max (to hit 500 energy for Violet shard bonus - this is ONLY required on base Voruna, Voruna Prime can hit the 500 energy without shard)
2 to 3 Tauforged Violet Melee Crit Damage shard optional if using melee weapons

**Playstyle & rotation**

1. Activate 3 and keep active (kill enemies afflicted by 5 statuses to Extend duration passively)
2. Activate 4 and refresh when expires, getting kills to charge it (very easy and passive)
3. Press 1 to go invisible and gain melee crit damage buff (need to refresh buff once roughly every 10s) and also mark an enemy with Prey Of Dynar
4. Press 2 on an enemy (ideally the marked enemy) to inflict 5 random status effects, then kill that enemy and spread status effects. If the initial 5 status effects matched any status effects you applied via your melee, these will be spread. See STATUS TAXI and ELEMENTS below for more details.
5. Repeat 1 + 2 combo on every new group of enemies
