For a niche but extremely strong nuke style, use Blood Altar Voruna with Gas Afflictions:

**Strengths & weaknesses**

- **Strengths:** high effective health / sustained survivability; forgiving of mistakes.
- **Weaknesses:** lower ability- or weapon-damage ceiling; can still fall to gaps in the defensive layer.
_(Archetype-level; the source guide gives no explicit list.)_

**Patch / update history (from the guide)**

**UPDATE JAN 2025**

Empty Arcane slot for Arcane Impetus which stacks up to 78% strength and 39% efficiency from just using Fangs of Raksh.

**Update Oct 2024**

Empty slot is for new Prey Of Dynar augment. This marks an enemy whenever 1 is cast and makes them glow. Casting Fangs of Raksh on that enemy will take 50% more damage at base while also multiplying the final spread of Fangs of Raksh by a fixed 2.5x multiplier. At 250% range this results in a 44m status spread if the marked enemy is killed.

**Update April 2024**

Muzzle Flash no longer blinds eximus or thrax through Overguard. This means it is slightly less effective as a crowd control, but continues to be a great option for crowd control that has no line of sight and still gives the 700% bonus stealth melee damage.

**Additional notes from the guide**

- Corrosive Projection for armor strip (effectively multiplies damage against armor by 1.8x)
- Brief Respite for shield gating
- Growing power for more strength
- Mecha Empowered if using a kubrow
- Enemy Radar for quality of life

Completely flexible:
- Cunning Drift for range
- Ice Spring for mobility
- Power Drift for strength
- Primed Sure Footed for knockdown immunity if you dont use 2 passive.
- Vigilante Pursuit for radar

**STATUS TAXI**

This refers to using Fangs of Raksh to 'taxi' status procs from your single target melee into the AOE range of Fangs. For example when using an weapon with forced slash on heavy like Hate and other scythes, this requires you to proc SLASH out of the 5 statuses on the INITIAL hit of Fangs. Proccing slash on a second hit or subsequent hits on the same enemy does NOT count. Once you inflict a STRONGER forced slash proc from heavy attack, that STRONG slash proc plus the 10 weaker slash procs will be averaged and then be trasnferred by Fangs to every enemy in an appproximately 18 m radius, OR 44m radius if performed a target marked by Prey Of Dynar, provided the enemy did NOT die to raw damage before the strong slash proc could be applied. If you add Melee Afflictions into the mix, you will be transferring the average of 10 weak slash procs with 7 strong slash procs in up to 44m radius. This also works with other damaging statuses such as electric, gas, toxin and heat however to transfer strong statuses created by heavy attacks consistently you will need the weapon to have extremely high status chance since most weapons do not have forced procs outside of slash.

**Statuses**

Slash is the preferred status on certain weapons with forced slash (scythes, claws, nikanas) since it is consistently guaranteed on every heavy, and melee afflictions can consistently multiply that by 7 again.

Gas is a great status for maximising KPM on a map since Gas procs lingers and have an AOE meaning they can kill new enemies that simply walk into clouds.

Electric is standard with melee influence setups so this goes well if you manage to proc electric with Raksh.

**Health Tanking**

If you prefer to health tank in casual missions rather than shield gate, add Arcane Blessing, Arcane Guardian/Reepar, Adaptation and Health Conversion. Just note this isn't THAT recommended due to high forma/mod cost and limitations of health tanking on a frame that can simply turn invisible, with no innate damage reduction.

You can also scale the health tanking to levelcap with arcane persistence however this requires heavy investment with multiple umbral mods/umbral forma and armor shards to hit the 700 armor breakpoint and is generally not worth the investment unless you really feel like it.

**Passive**

You can swap between passives based on preference and mission type e.g. use parkour velocity for quick missions or to get between points faster, use status immunity when using AOE weapons or for general survivability and use heavy efficiency when using x12 melee builds. Since we subsume off 4, you will not be using 4 passive.

**SECONDARY**

Use a primer secondary (e.g Epitaph/Kuva Nukor) with 2 augur mods (Augur Pact and Augur Seeker) to help with backup shield gating. Dedicated primers allow you to max viral status consistently relative to using Fangs of Raksh, and potentially add even more additional status effects if Fangs procs a different set of statuses (e.g. for total of 10-12 statuses).
- Epitaph -
- Kuva Nukor

**MELEES**

Voruna's Dynar ability gives a flat 100% crit chance AND status chance to melee weapons while also boosting flat crit damage, which helps weapons use melee influence even if they traditionally have low status chance and/or low crit chance. Fangs of Raksh also apply many statuses which helps with Condition Overload.

**LIGHT ATTACK SPAM**

If you just want to mindless spam light attack and still nuke maps, just use good melee influence light attack melees:
Keratinos fits thematically, deals innate viral, has 5x multiplier forced slash procs on heavy attack, and has an innate property where performing a x12 heavy give 2-3 m of range to all attacks for 3 minutes:
Innodem:
Praedos:
Nami Solo Incarnon:
Okina Prime Incarnon:
Furax Wraith Incarnon:
Dual Ichor Incarnon:
Tenet Agendus:
Ruvox Incarnon:
Verdilac:
Prisma Ohma:

**INFLUENCE CONTAGION**

This probably has the most synergy with Voruna as Contagion projectiles normally don't proc influence that well but Dynar gives a flat status boost. In addition contagion has multiplicative Condition Overload meaning Condition Overload multiplies with Primed Pressure Point/Arcane Fury, benefitting from all the statuses created by Fangs.

The best contagion users are:

**Build overview**

General Use Steel path build allowing Gyre to fry enemies through her electric abilities. Coil Horizon is used to group enemies which greatly boosts the effectiveness of electric status since they chain to another 5 enemies. Coil Horizon also deals electric damage + status innately AND triggers Rotorswell discharges for more damage.

Cathode Grace gives some slow energy Regen (approximately 180 energy per minute) but also boosts crit chance of both weapons and abilities. The augment Cathode Current is also used to Extend the duration of Rotorswell indefinitely and provide an additional discharge for more damage.

**Intended content — best at / less suited for**

Designed for: Steel Path, Circuit / Duviri. The source guide does not spell out where it underperforms; as a tank build the usual tradeoff applies (see Strengths & weaknesses).

**Core build concept**

A **tank** Gyre setup: moderate Strength (1.39×), neutral Duration (1×), wide Range (2.35×), negative Efficiency (0.45×). Its engine is the combination in the mod configuration above — Cathode Current, Equilibrium, Conductive Sphere, Catalyzing Shields, Primed Flow, aura Brief Respite, Arcane Aegis + Molt Augmented. See the written sections below for the intended damage/defence loop.

**Key stats & breakpoints**

**Duration**

Roughly neutral duration is all you need to give Cathode Grace about 8 to 10s initial duration. Once you get kills within that time frame, duration doesn’t matter at all since you can Extend both 3 and 4 indefinitely as long as you continue getting kills. Coil Horizon does not scale with duration and most of the helminth options do not need much duration either.

**Efficiency**

Gyre can generate approximately 300 energy per minute with Cathode Grace + Archon Stretch or up to 800 energy per minute with Nourish. You will want to be casting Coil Horizon and using a viral corrosive heat primer every 5-10s with each new group of enemies, requiring anywhere between 400 to 800 energy per minute. You can add more passive energy regeneration if you want, i.e. via Energy Nexus, Equilibrium, Grimoire Xata Invocation, Primary Exhilarate or Emergence Dissipate.

**Range**

Range is her most important stat since it affects the range of Arcsphere, range of Coil Horizon's grouping and range of passive Rotorswell aura to about 9m and range on on crit rotorswell discharge to over 20m. Use Overextended + Archon Stretch to hit this. Archon Stretch is also nice because it triggers from electric damage and gives 200 energy/min on top of cathode grace.

**Strength**

Strength is her second most important stat since it affects the damage of her electric dicharges from Rotorswell, damage of Coil Horizon as well as energy Regen and crit chance boost from Cathode Grace. Most armor strips also have a strength threshold you need to hit e.g. 200% for Tharros Strike, 167% for Terrify, 200% for Pillage two cast, 400% for pillage one cast, or 328% for pillage in one cast with Corrosive Projection.

After Transient Fortitude, Umbral Intensify and Molt Augmented, we hit 223% str, allowing full strip from Tharros Strike.

**Modding notes**

The guide does not break down individual mods. Defining picks appear to be: Cathode Current, Equilibrium, Conductive Sphere, Catalyzing Shields, Primed Flow. Slots holding basic drift/utility or resistance mods are the flexible ones.

**Playstyle & rotation**

**HOW TO PLAY**

1. Press 3 to activate Cathode Grace at the beginning of the mission. You will have approximately 10s to start getting kills to Extend the duration of 3, which caps at 60 seconds after approximately 13 kills, so don’t activate this when there are zero enemies around to kill otherwise you will enter a long cooldown. As long as you get kills you will not need to recast 3 (unless you get nullified or silenced by Violence). This combined with Archon Stretch will keep you constantly regenerating energy at approximately 5 energy/s or 300 energy / min.
2. Press 4 to activate Rotorswell at the beginning of the mission. As long as you get kills with Cathode Grace active, Rotorswell will also Extend its duration indefinitely and you not need to recast 4.
3. Press 2 to group and crowd control enemies whenever possible. This will effectively prevent enemies from shooting you (unless they have Overguard), and also exponentially magnifies the damage from electric status due to the chaining mechanics.
4. Press 1 to shield gate and shoot through the orb to apply Conductive Sphere buff (forced electric procs and added electric damage)

Gameplay with Pillage Variant on SP Circuit:

**Strengths & weaknesses**

**Additional notes from the guide**

Brief respite is required for active shield gate (unless you have augur mods on secondary/Burst Laser Prime)
Use Corrosive Projection instead if you have augur mods or pillage subsumed

Cunning Drift, Power Drift, Proton Pulse flexible in exilus
Primed Sure Footed is best for preventing knockdowns, so you may need Augur Secrets or a crimson shard if u want to slot this.

Since Gyre doesn’t have much health, armor or damage resistance, she relies heavily on crowd control and shield gating.

Coil Horizon and Rotorswell both provide soft CC. Coil Horizon drags enemies into a ball preventing them from shooting while Rotorswell is able to passively stun enemies briefly due to electric procs. This should reduce the frequency of you getting shot.

Whenever your shields break, you can immediately tap 1 or 2 to reset your shields. With Catalyzing Shields, Gyre has 130 shield. With Brief Respite, Augur Secrets and TWO additional Augur Mods on your secondary primer, one cast of Coil Horizon costs 50 energy which regenerates 135 shield, giving a full 1.33s iframes.

As final backup, it is recommended to run Vazarin protective sling for 5s iframe with no cooldown. Rolling Guard is optional for 3s iframes.

**Flexible Options**

If you don't own any of the above mods or want to make other changes, you can always add:
More strength - transient fortitude, umbral intensify, augur secrets
More range - Augur Reach

**Nourish**

Gives free viral to your weapons and also multiplies all energy gained via Cathode Grace and Archon Stretch. The base energy gain is approximately 5 energy per second at 200 str. WIth Nourish this increases to approximately 13 energy per second or about 800 energy per minute.

**Armor Strip**

This allows the electric procs to scale against steel path armored grineer and corrupted. At very high levels enemy armor can provide between 90% to 99.9% damage reduction. Removing 90% damage reduction is equivalent to increasing the effectiveness of electric damage by 10x. Removing 99% damage reduction is equivalent to increasing damage by 100x.

There are multiple good AOE armor strip options available:

- Tharros Strike: My preferred option because it is cheap to cast, full strips both armor and shields at only 200% strength and works on Acolytes and Demolysts. Tharros Strike's main issue is the lower range and non-radial area of effect, requiring you to aim towards enemies and missing any enemies behind you. This is somewhat overcome by grouping abilities such as Gyre's Coil Horizon, which groups enemies radially so you can strip all enemies in one cast. Tharros Strike also heals you.

- Pillage: Another great option, but requires 328% strength with Corrosive Projection to full strip armor, which means you need either Blind Rage or external strength boosts such as Madurai, Archon Shards etc. Pillage also provides shields/overshields back to Gyre allowing you to shield gate without Brief Respite + augur mods, as well as cleansing status. Pillage cannot strip both shields and armor simultaneously, so when facing an acolyte, you must remove shields first (takes 2 casts of pillage, or just shoot with a weapon), then cast pillage.

- Terrify: Terrify has the best radial non-line of sight armor strip for regular enemies and only requires 167% strength for full strip, but is NOT permanent and does NOT affect Acolytes or Demolysts. It also does provide crowd control but makes enemies run away from you which can sometimes be more frustrating than helpful, depending on the mission.

**Sickening Pulse**

This creates an expanding pulse with line of sight that effectively multiplies the total electric status damage currently on an enemy by 10x. This works very well when cast into a group of enemies all affected by electric status from rotorswell.

**Crowd Control**

- Shooting Gallery: With the augment Muzzle Flash, you can keep maps completely locked down as long as you get kills and also blinds/stuns Eximus THROUGH overguard. If you
- Resonator: Shuts down enemy aggression, but does not affect eximus or acolytes.
- Breach Surge: Blinds eximus with line of sight

Conductive Sphere applies FORCED electric status per shot (scaling with multishot) and multiplies the electric status damage but additively to elementalist mods/multiuplicatively to +electric mods (which is unlike most other similar buffs e.g. Lavos Valence Formation). This means weapons with high multishot work well and any weapon you do use, you MUST still mod +electric mods (e.g. stormbringer/Shocking Touch).

**Duration**

**Range**

Range does not affect the AOE of barrels or arc trap but is helpful to spread inkblot via 1 and 3 which provides health/energy orbs for energy as well as slow for crowd control and armor strip/crowd control from 4. You can keep this positive e.g. around 145% to 235% depending on preference. Plein Air has a sufficiently high base range that you don't need to maximise range for this on most maps.

**Strength**

Strength does not affect the %hp scaling of barrels or arc trap, or the damage of any of the other shadowgraphs, but will boost Roar if you subsume this on. You can boost the barrel to do 100% hp damage ignoring armor by running at least 180% strength Roar (to oneshot through overguard you will need approximately 200% strength Roar). You will need 200% strength to allow Plein Air to full strip, or just 164% strength with corrosive projection.

This allows you to hit any strength thresholds for both Plein Air armor strip (200%) and Roar oneshots for barrel.

**Energy economy**

**Efficiency/Energy Economy**

This can be anywhere between 45% to 160% depending on enemy density in the mission and how much you will spam abilities. For low density missions where you will be mobile and recast Barrel/Arc Trap ALOT (e.g. exterminate, bounties, cascade etc) you really want to maximise efficiency. Running Arcane Impetus allows you to get 8 stacks for a free 24% efficiency. You can add this to Streamline for 154% efficiency which is good for low density missions. For high density missions (e.g. survival) you would be fine running even as low as 45% efficiency meaning you can run Overextended (over Catalyzing Shield) and Blind Rage (over Streamline) if you want even more range. The inkblot passive will generate both health orbs and energy orbs. Equilibrium will convert health orbs fom passive or synth deconstruct into energy. Archon Stretch is optional as Arc Trap/Amphors can activate this for very slow but free energy regeneration. Archon Flow is also optional and will trigger when the cold barrel kills enemies for a very small measly orb.

**Playstyle & rotation**

1. Keep 3 active in each new zone to passively apply inkblot everywhere, enduring a source of energy
2. For Barrel spam: hold 2 to select Explosive Barrel and then tap 2, aim at it and tap 1 to teleport to it which instantly detonates it
3. For Arc Trap Spam: hold 2 to select Arc Traps and spam tap 2 everywhere (keep in mind you can only have 3 arc traps active)
4. To kill Acolytes, swap to Thermian RPG and shoot them
5. To survive try to spam 1 everywhere at least once every 3.5s to stay invulnerable, although if you have catalyzing shield + shield gate mods on you can also just survive by spamming 2.
6. Optional - cast 4 to make enemies float, then shoot the balloons to make them drop and take damage OR subsume over 4 with Roar and keep Roar active

_None described._

- **Strengths:** high effective health / sustained survivability; forgiving of mistakes.
- **Weaknesses:** lower ability- or weapon-damage ceiling; can still fall to gaps in the defensive layer.

**Patch / update history (from the guide)**

**UPDATE JUNE 2026**

Arcane Sculptor triggers off shadowgraph and sets efficiency to 175%, which allows you to build much higher range with Overextended and Blind Rage while having maximum efficiency.

**Additional notes from the guide**

- Brief Respite: backup survivability by regenerating shield gate in between casts of 1 so even when you come out of 1 you will not die to a oneshot and have more leeway to recast 1
- Corrosive Projection: if you keep Plein Air, reduces the strength for full strip to 164%. Not useful for Barrel Damage since it ignores armor and not useful for Arc Trap since Arc Trap calculates damage off EHP, but would be useful for general weapon use against armor.
- Mecha Empowered: used in conjunction with Huras Kubrow to allow gas barrels and arc trap electric statuses to occasionally nuke in a much wider range

Completely flexible based on preference:
- Ice Spring: great for mobility although you can run Archon Shards and Praedos for more parkour
- Preparation: helps with starting energy so you can immediately start spamming shadowgraphs without waiting for inkblots to start producing energy

**ABILITIES**

Passive - Enemies affected by "inkblot" have 50% slow and a 20% chance to drop a mix of 3 health and energy orbs on death, which basically helps upkeeps energy.

1. Forced perspective - cleanses status and gives 3.5s invulnerability  with a fixed 100m range. This also applies inkblot in a small radius which is useful for detonating barrels and providing energy back.
2. Shadow graph - pretty broken ability that has a multitude of effects. Explosive barrel, arc trap and thermian RPG are all scaling AOE damage options. Arc Trap is the simplest to use and deals 250 base damage + 2.5% enemy HP. Explosive barrel deals 65%hp damage and ignores armor but requires you to detonate it by shooting directly, applying corrosive (eg via inkblot or primer) or teleporting into them (which makes inkblot corrosive). Several shadowgraphs (amphors, death orb) can also apply more statuses for arcane impetus.
3. Self portrait - makes a much larger radius of inkblot than forced perspective which helps with energy production
4. Plein Air - lifts enemies up with balloons and strips armor but quite annoying to use since it moves them out of range of arc traps and barrels and even makes them harder to actually shoot.

**Invulnerability and shield gating**

Her 1 provides 3.5s of invulnerability meaning if you press 1 every 3.5s you will stay completely immortal. This however is a very high activity playstyle and interrupts whatever you're doing with a long teleport animation, so you need good cast speed to make this feel better. It is also nice to have additional backup i-frame generation from shield gating i.e. running catalyzing shield with at least Brief Respite in the aura OR one augur mod allows all abilities to return shields to max 1.33s gate. This means even if you are spamming 2 (with barrel or arc trap) you can shield gate without interrupting with 1, and also will always come out of 1's invulnerability phase with some shield so you don't immediately die upon exiting.

**Health Tanking**

Self Portrait provides up to 90% damage reduction so if you add armor and health you could sufficiently health tank lower levels (i.e. steel path up to level 500ish) although this is somewhat anti-synergistic with invulnerability provided by 1.

**ROAR**

This is the most common and important subsume since it can boost the %hp damage of Barrels to 100% and guarantee a oneshot on basically all enemies up to levelcap.

**BREACH SURGE**

This can improve kill rate by creating homing sparks that scale off the damage from barrels and arc trap (although sparks are capped at 5 million damage).

**TEMPEST BARRAGE**

Corrosive damage triggers barrels to explode and viral status increases %hp damage to oneshot threshold, but you need to cast a new Tempest Barrage in every area you place a barrel.

Enkaus: Follie's signature gun has direct synergy with inkblot since it instantly dissolves enemies below 35%:

**Who it's for**

Use this if you want Follie as a tank option for level cap, void cascade, survival, farming / loot. It carries a written guide (above).

**Build overview**

The augment Divine Retribution allows you to spread status among ALL speared enemies, then when spears end, all current status is compressed and multiplied in an "expedite suffering" like effect which is scaled by strength.

Reaping Chakram doubles the damage of chakram after each enemy hit and throwing chakram into divine speared enemies causes each chakram to duplicate and apply heat procs. Archon Vitality doubles the amount of heat procs applied each hit, and then when divine spears ends all heat procs are expedited killing all speared enemies ideally.

**Intended content — best at / less suited for**

**ENDURANCE SHIELD GATING**

Survivability in Endurance (levels 500-1000+) is mainly by using i-frames generated by activation of warding halo (3s) and breaking of halo (2s), combined with **shield gating** as well as crowd control from Divine Spears:
- With Brief Respite and THREE augur mods (can be spread across your warframe and secondary weapon), 150%+80% energy is converted to shields. At 45% efficiency, a single cast of chakram costs 39 energy which generates 99 shield which gives 1.33s iframes with Catalyzing Shields and about 0.8s without. A single cast of Divine Spears however costs 155 energy which generates 418 shield, giving 1.4s i-frames without catalyzing shields.

**Core build concept**

A **tank** Nezha Prime setup: moderate Strength (1.39×), neutral Duration (1×), wide Range (2.5×), negative Efficiency (0.45×). Its engine is the combination in the mod configuration above — Stretch, Blind Rage, Overextended, Equilibrium, Reaping Chakram, aura Brief Respite, Molt Augmented + Arcane Aegis. See the written sections below for the intended damage/defence loop.

**Key stats & breakpoints**

**Duration**

Low duration to neutral is preferred so Divine Spears will naturally end. Duration doesnt affect 3, and Blazing Chakram has a decent base duration of 15s. You could swap Augur Reach for Transient Fortitude to reduce duration even further.

**Efficiency**

Can be dumped due to Equilibrium converting health orbs generated by Chakram.

**Range**

Max range gives Divine Spears a 53m range, meaning you can spread statuses to enemies over 50m away.

**Strength**

Affects the debuff of chakram, size of warding halo and expedite multiplier of Divine Retribution.

**Modding notes**

The guide does not break down individual mods. Defining picks appear to be: Stretch, Blind Rage, Overextended, Equilibrium, Reaping Chakram. Slots holding basic drift/utility or resistance mods are the flexible ones.

**Helminth**

- Roar - this is the preferred ability since Roar double dips DoTs like slash from weapons, triple dips electric from influence melee, double dips heat from chakram and triple dips the final Expedite from Divine Retribution.
- Breach Surge - stuns enemies including Eximus allowing to do deal bonus stealth melee damage to them, and releases sparks on damage or death which 'double dips' with chakrams vulnerability debuff assuming both the initial spark and spark hit occur on enemies hit by chakram.
- Silence - stuns enemies briefly and prevents Violence from dispelling abilties as well as eximus from using abilities
-  Ensnare and other grouping options
- Gloom - crowd control and healing
-  Nourish - boost viral damage and multiplieis energy gain

**Arcanes, Aura & Exilus**

Arcanes: Molt Augmented, Arcane Aegis. Aura: Brief Respite. Exilus: Cunning Drift. The guide does not explain these choices.

**Archon Shards**

- 2 amber cast speed shards
- 1 tauforged azure Shield Capacity shard is optional - this boosts shield capacity so you maximum possible i-frame (without overshield) is closer to 1.3s rather than 0.7s at default. This means you could drop Catalyzing shields for more strength or reaping chakram.
- 2 Crimson Strength Shards.

**Survivability & failure conditions**

**CASUAL TANK**

In non-enduance (levels < 500), Nezha can tank using a combination of health, armor and damage reduction (90% from Warding Halo, 90% from adaptation). You will need to swap Stretch or Reaping Chakram for Adaptation, and add Arcane Guardian +/- Arcane Blessing over Molt Augmented/Eruption. For a full commitment Nezha Tank build, see here:

**Energy economy**

Nezha can sustain negative efficiency well due to Blazing Chakram and Equilibrium. Flow/Primed Flow is advised but not mandatory.
Blazing Chakram forces a 100% chance to drop a health orb on kill, and a 35% chance to drop an energy orb on kill, while Equilibrium converts health orbs to energy. This means every kill on an enemy affected by chakram gives 55 energy back and every 10 kills gives an average of 575 energy. When you add Reaping Chakram, the chance to drop health orbs is further increased.

**Playstyle & rotation**

1. Activate Warding Halo (3) when you are surrounded by enemies (can use Rolling Guard for positioning so you don't die while you do this). This will let you absorb damage and be immortal for 3s, converting it to halo health and give you a halo health of potentially into the hundreds of thousands. Upon breaking, warding halo gives 2s i-frames.
2. Optional if not subsumed: Keep Firewalker (1) active for passive heat procs and move speed
3. Cast divine spears (4) to lock down rooms of enemies for crowd control and allows Divine Retribution to spread all status effects. Shoot enemies with a status weapon to nuke all enemies affected by spears in 50+ metre range OR throw Chakram to deal dps.
4. Cast blazing chakram (2) to debuff enemies and spread heat status DPS. When cast on speared enemies, each chakram will multiply into two and the debuff effect will spread rapidly compared to un-speared enemies. Killing debuffed enemies also drops both health and energy orbs.
5. Whenever you lose shields, just cast abilities like chakram and divine spears to reset your shield gate.

PURE SPLINTER

This is a Gara build focused around splinter storm and building the splinter storm damage as quickly as possible so that you can melt high level enemies on Steel Path and other end game content by running into things.

A **tank** Gara Prime setup: high Strength (1.83×), long Duration (2.54×), wide Range (2.14×), negative Efficiency (0.45×). See the written sections below for the intended damage/defence loop.

**Key stats & breakpoints**

**Duration**

High duration helps the uptime of Splinter Storm so it doesn't run out prematurely and you lose all stacks.

**Range**

High range helps splinter storm Reach further so you don't need to get as close.

**Efficiency**

Since you will be spamming mass vitrify and breaking it with 1, you need to maintain some efficiency for energy economy. With Arcane Sculptor we can completely ditch efficiency to 45% since we are locked to 175% efficiency and won't even need Equilibrium.

Without Arcane Sculptor you will want to run 100 to 130% with Equilibrium. Seismic Bond on your pet further helps give free 30% efficiency since it procs while you are expanding 4. Archon Stretch procs from any electric modded on Shattered Lash.

**Strength**

Strength is important since it affects Shattered Lash damage, which subsequently feeds into both Mass Vitrify damage and Splinter Storm stacking. In addition, strength also boosts the damage vulnerability of crystallized enemies via 4 and the effect of any helminth abilities such as Roar/Nourish.

**Modding notes**

The guide does not break down individual mods. Defining picks appear to be: Overextended, Umbral Intensify, Augur Reach, Blind Rage, Primed Flow. Slots holding basic drift/utility or resistance mods are the flexible ones.

**Helminth**

- *Roar*: Gives a multiplicative damage buff to Shattered Lash
- *Nourish*: Gives Viral damage boost which applies to Shattered Lash (additively to elements so much less than Roar) but also gives energy multiplier to allow you to sustain energy, less important if running with Arcane Sculptor
- *Silence* : Provides passive CC, blocks eximus abilities and acolyte abilities, particularly against Violence so you don't lose all your stacked splinter storm.

**Arcanes, Aura & Exilus**

- Arcane Sculptor - locks efficiency to 175% for 12s after casting 3 or 4, solving all energy issues while at 45% efficiency
- Arcane Circumvent - rolling strips armor, shield and overguard and steals them for you, quite nice for splinter storm
- Molt Efficiency - free 36% duration to improve splinter storm duration
- Molt Augmented - free 60% strength to further boost shattered lash damage, useful in longer missions where you expect to get 250 kills
- Arcane Fury - similar to blade charger but doesn't require a primary, is easier to proc but provides slightly less stack
- Arcane Blade Charger - if you have a good primary weapon, AOE primary or high DPS sentinel weapon (e.g verglas), you can easily get this buff, which will boost the damage of mass vitrify explosion
- Arcane Aegis - If you have problems with surviving

**Archon Shards**

- One to Two Amber Cast Speed
- Three Crimson Duration Shards OR Melee Critical Damage Violet

**Survivability & failure conditions**

Not detailed. Survivability comes from whatever defensive mods/abilities are in the configuration above; the guide does not state what breaks it.

**Energy economy**

Efficiency sits at 0.45× per the stats line. The build/guide references an energy source — see mods/overview.

**Playstyle & rotation**

- Cast 2 on yourself (making sure you don't aim at an enemy, object or companion) to initiate splinter storm and achieve 90% damage reduction
- Cast 2 on your companion for 90% damage reduction and for second layer of splinter storm
- Cast 3 to activate buff
- Cast 4 and quickly stop it from expanding by pressing 4 again
- Tap or hold 1 to shatter the wall (tap for puncture if you modded for puncture which is one-handed cast and quicker)
- Repeat 4 + 1 combo constantly to stack damage into splinter storm, and make sure to refresh splinter storm duration by casting 4 before it runs out

**Patch / update history (from the guide)**

**UPDATE JANUARY 2026**

Added Arcane Circumvent so you can roll through enemies, strip defenses and steal defenses, then kill them immediately with splinter storm. Maximised range so when you roll through enemies and strip armor in 4m, you can still hit them with 7m splinter storm. Narrow Minded is flexible over Augur Message.

**UPDATE JULY 2024**

Full armor strip is no longer mandatory for Gara abilities to kill in high level SP and endurance, as just having corrosive + heat without any green shards is enough to allow Splinter Storm to easily kill levelcap enemies after a few stacks.

ALTERNATIVE BUILDS:
Hybrid Lash spam + splinter storm:
Pure Shattered Lash spam :

**Additional notes from the guide**

**Options**

*Aura slot* is flexible :
- Stteel Charge provides the most mod capcity and adds about 5-10% to shattered lash/splinter storm damage.
- Brief Respite for endurance runs where you need to abuse shield gating (in addition to decaying dragon key, you may want to change fleeting expertise to streamline to reduce efficiency further)

*Exilus slot* is flexible - If you don't have primed sure footed, can use handspring, vigilante pursuit,  power drift etc

Flexible options:
- *Rolling Guard* - useful mod for high levels giving i-frames on roll and clearing harmful statuses.
- *Adaptation* - for casual tanking, increases the tankiness of shields gained (90% splinter storm DR + 90% adaptation + 50% innate shield DR = 99.5% DR), giving a shield EHP of approximately 300k at max overshield.

**OTHER TIPS**

Use a sentinel as a companion rather than a moving pet. You can cast splinter storm on your sentinel and give it 90% damage reduction as well as creating a second damage source that gains the same stacks as Gara. Since the sentinel moves with you and overlaps your splinter storm radius, you effectively do twice the damage per tick compared to when splinter storm is on Gara alone. To cast on your sentinel, point your cursor directly up and press the *reverse camera* key (check key bindings) then spam 2 as the crosshairs pass over the sentinel. Furthermore, since the sentinel never runs away like other pets, you can keep 100% uptime on its splinter storm whenever you cast mass vitrify.

Recommended sentinels:
- Diriga - passive primes in close range and helps consistently produce health orbs for equilibrium
- Nautilus with Cordon and Manifold bond - allows you to passively group enemies so you can kill them quicker with splinter storm.
- Wrym prime with negate - prevents status procs including knockdown, very useful if you don't own primed sure footed.
- Dethcube prime with energy generator - makes energy orbs every couple of kills, very useful if you don't own a full set of arcane energize.
- Helios Prime with Vicious Bond and Deconstructor - allows you to passive armor strip enemies recently damaged by abilities, which is exactly what Gara specializes in. This allows you to use Nourish as subsume instead. You can also equip Seismic Bond which will trigger while Mass Vitrify is expanding, giving free 30% efficiency for 12s.

**Build overview**

Equinoxes 3 and 4 abilities in both day and night forms synergize well with gloom to control the Flow of time or create a room of near permanently stunned enemies. With the augment Peaceful Provocation, the day form 3 ability boosts equinoxes ability strength by 70% to hit a gloom slow of 94%, very close to the gloom cap. Equinoxes day form 4 ability creates a brief stun when enemies first enter the ability range which can be prolonged by gloom slow. Alternatively, the night form 3 ability creates up to 80% slow which can multiple with gloom to Reach close to 99% slow, practically freezing time entirely.  While in night form, 4 also allows you to regenerate shields to stay alive from any gunfire you might take from outside the slow zone. This means you have a choice between running in day mode for 95% slow, stun locking and nuking or night mode for time freeze (99% slow) and effective immortality.

**Key stats & breakpoints**

**Duration**

Duration can be dumped since we can hit the channelling cap using efficiency. To Reach the minimum drain, we just need to make sure duration stays above 40%. This can be done with a single Primed Continuity.

**Efficiency**

Max ranked Fleeting Expertise and Streamline are required to hit 190% efficiency to offset the negative duration while still achieving the minimum drain for channelled abilities. Since we have up to THREE channelled abilities active in this build, this is absolutely essential. Note that the game will still show 175% efficiency but calculate it as 190% efficiency. Primed Flow is optional but I have not found this to be essential as long as you can maintain a decent kill rate.

**Range**

We would like as high a range as possible but cannot fit many more mods. 175% can be hit with Stretch and Augur Reach. You may find 145% comfortable or add Cunning Drift to hit 190%.

**Strength**

A minimum of  202% str is required. When in day form, Peaceful Provocation on top of pacify and provoke allows you to boost ability strength by 70% to Reach 272% strength, which is 95% slow from gloom. If you then switch to night form while gloom is active, Peaceful Provocation now gives an additional  80% slow after taking damage. This additional 80% slow actually multiplies with gloom's 95% slow to become (1 - 0.20x0.05) or 99% slow.

*NOTE*: With new Focus and Arcanes, you can a combination of Madurai or Zenurik with Molt Vigor or Molt Augmented to boost ability strength by between 45% to 100%. E.g. Using Madurai + Molt Augmented (100% str) allows you to drop strength mods for Primed Flow and Rolling Guard.

If you don't own Molt Augmented, replace Primed flow or Augur reach with Umbral Intensify.

**Modding notes**

The guide does not break down individual mods. Defining picks appear to be: Peaceful Provocation, Fleeting Expertise, Augur Reach, Primed Continuity, Transient Fortitude. Slots holding basic drift/utility or resistance mods are the flexible ones.

2 cast speed shards mandatory
3 energy max allows you to replace Primed Flow for Rolling Guard

**Playstyle & rotation**

1. Start off in DAY mode, and activate 3 to get an initial 40% boost to ability strength.
2. Activate gloom while 3 is active for an initial 83% slow. Activate 4 to stun enemies and build up damage.
3. Damage and kill enemies until you hit a 70% total boost to ability strength (shows in the UI)
4. Dispel and recast gloom to hit 94% slow.
5. Deactivate 4 when you want to nuke after building sufficient damage, and immediately reactivate it to restun enemies (not that enemies that have been stunned once cannot be stunned again within the same cast of 4, you must dispel and recast it)
6. Switch over to NIGHT mode, activate 3 and 4, and take some damage until the Peaceful Provocation buff displays 80%. At this point, you will have 79% on top of 94% slow giving 99% slow. (try not to take any health damage as you might die. Kill enemies while 4 is active to generate lots of shields, which can be hit safely to charge up Peaceful Provocation)

**Duration**

Positive duration helps uptime of 1 and 3, but you don't need to go overboard as the base invisibility duration is very long and you will likely remove it immediately upon melee attacking. Furthermore, getting melee kills is able to increase the duration of both the melee buff of 1 and overall duration of 3. Archon Continuity is **optional** as 2 is able to create toxin procs which subsequently forces 1 corrosive proc even if corrosive was not created by 2, for extra Condition Overload damage and mild armor strip. I would suggest you DON'T use Achon mods initially as you don't want to use up mod capacity since it affects starting energy. You need exactly 9 mod capacity to have enough starting energy to cast Lycath Hunt at the beginning of the mission.

**Efficiency**

Voruna is able to run negative efficiency with Blind Rage on a melee focused build due to Lycath's Hunt (3) forcing health orb drops on melee kills and Equilibrium giving 55 energy per health orb. In addition Arcane Impetus now gives bonus free efficiency.

**Range**

Range is maximized for the spread radius of Fangs of Raksh (2), giving up to 20m range of status spread (and about 49m with Prey Of Dynar). This allows you to nuke maps with either the 'status taxi' mechanic or simply via the damaging DoTs (blast, heat, electric, toxin, gas) created by Fangs of Raksh, as well as prime entire rooms with useful statuses such as viral, corrosive or cold.

**Strength**

Strength is mainly to boost the melee crit damage buffs from 1, status damage from 2 and dmg buff of shooting gallery so you don't need a huge amount of strength unless running a helminth like Roar.

**Modding notes**

The guide does not break down individual mods. Defining picks appear to be: Equilibrium, Blind Rage, Prey of Dynar, Augur Reach, Overextended. Slots holding basic drift/utility or resistance mods are the flexible ones.

**Helminth**

Not discussed. The build references a subsume — check the overview.

**Arcanes, Aura & Exilus**

Completely optional and up to preference:
- Impetus - gives strength and efficiency and can stack to maximum from Fangs of Raksh
- Crepuscular - only works for certain weapons that can 'hit and run', as you only leave invisibility AFTER hitting with melee but need to recast invis immediately e.g. Slam, Contagion
- Augmented - boosts strength to further boost Crit Damage buff of 1
- Strike - more melee attack speed
- Fury - more melee damage
- Blessing - if you prefer to tank, which also mega boosts the health of a pet running link health

**Archon Shards**

1 Tauforged Cast Speed shard helps with feel of spamming 1 and 2 constantly
2 Tauforged Violet Equilibrium shards can help replace Equilibrium if you need more mod space
If focusing on Melee Weapons: 2 Tauforged Violet Melee Crit Damage shard
If focusing on Ulfrun: 2 +ability damage on corrosive status, corrosive status has the higher chance to proc from Fangs of Raksh since Archon Continuity can make it via Toxin status too

**Survivability & failure conditions**

Not detailed. Survivability comes from whatever defensive mods/abilities are in the configuration above; the guide does not state what breaks it.

**Energy economy**

Efficiency sits at 0.45× per the stats line. The build/guide references an energy source — see mods/overview.

**Playstyle & rotation**

1. Activate 3 and keep active, kill enemies with melee to drop health orbs which generate energy via Equilibrium and kill enemies afflicted by 5 statuses to Extend duration passively and indefinitely
2. Press 1 to go invisible and gain melee crit damage buff (need to refresh buff once roughly every 10s) and also mark an enemy with Prey Of Dynar. Attacking will remove invisibility meaning you need to go immediately back into invisibility if you are using 'Hit And Run' tactics with heavy attacks, heavy slam, exodia contagion, or if you are spamming light attacks only return to invisibility and shield gate if you get hit.
3. Press 2 on an enemy (ideally the marked glowing enemy) to inflict 5 random status effects, then kill that enemy and spread status effects. If the initial 5 status effects matched any status effects you applied via your melee, these will be spread. This means for everytime you use 2 you have a 5/13 chance or 39% chance to match one status and spread. See STATUS TAXI and ELEMENTS below for more details.
4. Repeat 1 + 2 combo on every new group of enemies
5. OPTIONAL if you keep 4, enter 4 and get kills by attacking. Rebuild stacks by spreading bleed procs.

**Variants**

_None described._

**Strengths & weaknesses**

- **Strengths:** high effective health / sustained survivability; forgiving of mistakes.
- **Weaknesses:** lower ability- or weapon-damage ceiling; can still fall to gaps in the defensive layer.
_(Archetype-level; the source guide gives no explicit list.)_

**Additional notes from the guide**

- Corrosive Projection for passive armor strip (effectively multiplies damage against armor by 1.8x)
- Brief Respite for shield gating if not running catalyzing shield and you want to maximise shield gate iframes
- Growing power for more strength
- Mecha Empowered if using a Kubrow and Mecha set
- Enemy Radar for quality of life

Completely flexible:

- Ice Spring for mobility
- Power Drift for strength
- Primed Sure Footed for knockdown immunity if you don't use 2 passive.
- Vigilante Pursuit for radar

I have added extra unnecessary forma to hit exactly 9 mod capacity to have enough starting energy to cast Lycath Hunt at the beginning of the mission and start generating energy immediately. If you don't use Archon Mods or just run energy pads/Preparation/energy on start shard, you can save multiple forma (only 3 forma needed).

**MELEE AFFLICTIONS + STATUS TAXI**

This refers to using Fangs of Raksh to 'taxi' status procs from your single target melee into the AOE range of Fangs. For example when using an weapon with forced slash on heavy like Hate and other scythes, this requires you to proc SLASH out of the 5 statuses on the INITIAL hit of Fangs. Proccing slash on a second hit or subsequent hits on the same enemy does NOT count. Once you inflict a STRONGER forced slash proc from heavy attack, that STRONG slash proc plus the 10 weaker slash procs will be averaged and then be transferred by Fangs to every enemy in an approximately 18 m radius, OR 49m radius if performed a target marked by Prey Of Dynar, provided the enemy did NOT die to raw damage before the strong slash proc could be applied.

If you add Melee Afflictions into the mix, you can rapidly multiply all damaging statuses such as slash, electric, gas, toxin and heat as long as you proc those on the initial 5 statuses, and then spread all multiplied statuses. Dual Daggers such as Okina Prime Incarnon or Tonfas such as Praedos are the best melees for Melee Afflictions application due to the heavy applying 2 instances of knockdown in one hit, meaning each hit adds 14 statuses.

**Statuses**

Slash is the preferred status on certain weapons with forced slash (scythes, claws, nikanas) since it is consistently guaranteed on every heavy, and melee afflictions can consistently multiply that by 7 again.

Gas is a great status for maximizing KPM on a map since Gas procs lingers and have an AOE meaning they can kill new enemies that simply walk into clouds.

Electric is standard with melee influence setups so this goes well if you manage to proc electric with Raksh.

**Health Tanking**

If you prefer to health tank in casual missions rather than shield gate, add Arcane Blessing, Arcane Guardian/Reaper, Adaptation and Health Conversion. Just note this isn't THAT recommended due to high forma/mod cost and limitations of health tanking on a frame that can simply turn invisible, with no innate damage reduction.

You can also scale the health tanking/healing to level cap with arcane persistence however this requires much more investment with multiple umbral mods/umbral forma or armor shards to hit the 700 armor breakpoint:

**Flexible slot**

Equilibrium is flexible if you can replace it with equilibrium shards if you don't care about maximising Fangs range:
- Ulfrun Endurance: If you want an Ulfrun ability focused build
- Catalyzing Shield: Maximizes consistency of shield gating as it gives 1.33s on any amount of shield break
- Vigorous Swap: If you are focusing on Contagion Zaw or Glaives as this double dips vigorous swap
- Nira's Hatred: If you are focusing on Slam melee, make sure to add Nira's Anguish in exilus too
- Muzzle Flash/Savage Silence: if you are subsuming Shooting Gallery or Silence respectively

**Passive**

You can swap between passives based on preference and mission type e.g. use parkour velocity for quick missions or to get between points faster, use status immunity when using AOE weapons or for general survivability and use heavy efficiency when using x12 melee builds. Since we generally subsume off 4, you will mostly not be using 4 passive.

**MELEE PLATFORM**

For regular melee use, subsume over 4
Melee damage boosting options include:
- Roar - boosts DoT and triple dips on status spread via Fangs of Raksh.
- Wrathful Advance - adds even more flat crit chance bonus to melees, allowing some melees to red crit easily

Crowd control options include:
- Shooting Gallery with Muzzle Flash - blinds enemies allowing you to freely spam light attacks without invisibility, and also forces stealth melee multiplier (700% crit dmg additive to crit multiplier)
- Silence - Stuns enemies for 2s and shuts off all eximus/acolyte abilities. Savage Silence augment also applies the stealth melee multiplier to stunned enemies. Considering dropping range to 100 to 145% so you can permanently stun enemies while mobile since you can keep making enemies exit and re-enter silence range.

**ULFRUN**

Since you can't subsume over 4 if using Ulfrun, you can only really subsume over 3.
- Brightbonnet - replaces energy generation aspect of Lycath but also boosts strength allowing you to snapshot Ulfrun
- Roar - boosts Ulfrun, double dips slash procs made by Ulfrun and double dips statuses made by 2 BUT since you lose Lycath energy will be a huge issue. You will need to run Equilibrium + Synth Deconstruct and maybe additional sources like Zenurik, Dethcube etc

**SECONDARY**

Use a primer secondary (e.g Epitaph/Kuva Nukor) with 2 augur mods (Augur Pact and Augur Seeker) to help with backup shield gating. Dedicated primers allow you to max viral status consistently relative to using Fangs of Raksh, and potentially add even more additional status effects if Fangs procs a different set of statuses (e.g. for total of 10-12 statuses).

**MELEES**

Voruna's Dynar ability gives a flat 100% crit chance AND flat 100% status chance to melee weapons while also boosting flat crit damage, which helps weapons use melee influence and status builds even if they traditionally have low status chance and/or low crit chance. This means if a melee only has 5% base status chance, while mods like Weeping Wounds would only bring this up to 27%, Dynar brings this to 105%. Fangs of Raksh also apply many statuses which helps with Condition Overload.

**LIGHT ATTACK SPAM**

If you just want to mindless spam light attack and still nuke maps, just use good melee influence light attack melees:
Keratinos fits thematically, deals innate viral, has 5x multiplier forced slash procs on heavy attack, and has an innate property where performing a x12 heavy give 2-3 m of range to all attacks for 3 minutes:

This probably has the most synergy with Voruna as Contagion projectiles normally don't proc influence that well but Dynar gives a flat status boost. **Patch / update history (from the guide)**

**UPDATE 2025**

New Augment Cataclysmic Gate turns Sol Gate into a huge area of effect (scaling with range) with much bigger damage, now allowing Sol Gate to nuke large areas.
Adding Breach Surge will allow the heat procs to scale even higher being able to one-shot even level cap enemies.

**Additional notes from the guide**

**BREACH SURGE**

Heat proc damage ramps up over time and each tick of heat status damage and kill of enemies then feeds into Breach Surge sparks which scale off the damage that produced it. The spark is capped at 5 million damage however, there are additional factors that can apply to push this way OVER 5 million damage.
1. Roar: applies a final multiplier to breach surge
2. Vigorous Swap: swapping weapons constantly will multiply spark damage by 2.65x for 3s. This is OPTIONAL
3. Arcane Crepuscular: while invisible (by jumping) or by Shade/Huras Kubrow, surge sparks gain an additional flat +3 crit damage onto the original 1.5x multiplier for a final multiplier of 4.5x.
4. Worthy Comradery: applies a +75% critical chance bonus to breach surge on headshots, which occassionally happen since breach surge seek heads.

**MANIFOLD AND CONTAGIOUS INHERT**

Shock motes for some reason inherits Manifold Bond equipped on your companion and allows shock motes to proc the statuses contained on sentinel weapons. If you mod heat onto that weapon then shock motes will proc heat. If enemies subsequently die to heat procs, these will be spread via Contagious Bond within 9m since the game treats the heat proc as originating from your companion. If roar is active, each spread multiplies by the roar amount in a positive feedback loop until the final spread heat procs deal damage cap. Normally the heat procs created by shock mote/manifold are very weak and cannot kill, however, you can stack heat procs from Sol Gate Cataclysmic Gate ONTO the initial heat proc from Manifold Bond and kills via heat procs will still count as companion kill.

**Who it's for**

**Core build concept**

A **ability dps** Equinox Prime setup: low Strength (0.4×), short Duration (0.4×), wide Range (2.8×), high Efficiency (1.6×). **Key stats & breakpoints**

**Duration**

Both Terrify and Rest & Rage have long base durations, meaning you still have around 8 to 10s to kill something before they wear off which is long enough.
Duration has no effect on Pacify and Provoke. Duration does affect the drain of channeling abilities like Maim but if you maximise efficiency to 190%, you still minimise drain to 25% of normal even at 40% duration.

**Range**

Maximising range gives Maim the highest possible coverage. Note, Maim has falloff that scales linearly with distance, meaning at about 50m (assuming 280% range), you deal 0 damage, while at 40m which is roughly the range of Terrify, you deal 21% of the stored damage. This means to consistently kill an enemy at the furthest range of terrify and assuming a map full of identical armored enemies, you need to kill about 7 to 8 enemies worth on average before releasing the Maim.

**Strength**

Strength does NOT affect how much damage is stored by Maim or multiple how much damage is released when Maim ends. It only boosts the tiny slash procs that get created when you first cast Maim. Strength also boosts the damage vulnerability of Rage.

Terrify now full strips at just 167% ability strength with a base duration of 25s. Adding Corrosive Projection lowers this even further to 137%. After getting 250 kills with molt augmented and a single tauforged strength shard, we have a strength of 115%. Casting Pacify and Provoke gives 20%x1.15 = 23% strength, for a final strength of 115% + 23% = 138% strength, exactly enough to full strip with terrify in a single cast.

**Additional notes from the guide**

**COMPANION**

Dethcube with Tazicor equipped to tag enemies for:
- Synth Deconstruct: drops health orbs with 25% chance, which is converted to 55 energy by equilibrium
- Energy Generator: drops energy orb after 10 kills, giving 25 energy every 10 kills of tagged enemies
- Seismic Bond: gives free 30% efficiency while 4 is active, giving minimised ability drain
- Viral status: boosts all damage by up to 4.25x at 10 viral
- Magnetic status: boosts damage to shield and overguard by up to 4.25x at 10 magnetic

Other companions like Wyrm Prime with Tazicor, Diriga with Burst Laser Prime or Panzer can also run Synth Deconstruct and Seismic Bond while priming viral.

Corrosive Projection is required to reduce strength requirement of terrify to full strip

Cunning Drift maximises range
Primed Sure Footed if using AOE guns to prevent knockdown

**Maim DAMAGE**

The amount of damage stored by Maim is equal to 75% of the amount of health and shields LOST by the enemy (rather than the total damage you actually display). This means if you deal 200 million damage to an enemy with 1 million health and maximum armor (so 10 million ehp), you only store 750k damage. If you then release this damage against another fully armored enemy with 1 million health standing right next to you, you will only be dealing 750k damage out of their 10 million ehp (i.e. 7.5% of their health bar). Maim also has linear falloff to 0% damage at 50m. If you full strip with Terrify first, then you are dealing 75% of their health bar to an enemy standing right next to you but only 16% health bar to the same enemy standing 40m away. In order to consistently oneshot enemies at the very edge of terrify radius, you will therefore need to store at LEAST the health of 7 identical enemies to kill that same enemy at 40m. Since enemies do not all have the same health, you will probably want to try to store the health of about 10 to 20 enemies to be safe before releasing Maim. Since enemy health increases with level, the number shown on the UI will not be a reliable indicator of when you need to release unless you memorise a few rough benchmark numbers to hit.

if we assume the health of a steel path corrupted heavy gunner, these are the rough values needed to kill them at 40m.
Level 150: 561,605 health, needs about 3 mil stored Maim damage
Level 500: 1,313,210 health, needs 7 mil stored Maim damage
Level 1000: 2,121,915 health, needs 11 mil stored Maim damage
Level 9999: 10,317,272 health, needs  52 mil stored Maim damage

Survivability is via active shield gating, crowd control from Terrify and quickly killing enemies with weapons + Maim. Currently, Catalyzing Shields is bugged to give the full 1.33s shield gate after regenerating ANY Amount of shield, meaning a single Augur Reach while at max efficiency is enough to provide full gate after a cast of any ability e.g. Terrify. You want to be pressing Terrify and Maim very often to shield gate. Arcane Aegis is a flexible arcane that can provide backup survivability. Rolling Guard is a final layer of backup survivability, giving i-frames and status cleanse with cooldown.

**FLEXIBLE SLOTS**

Primed Flow is flexible for something else if you don't feel like energy is an issue.

You want to use strong AOE weapons that can collect lots of enemy health quickly in order to build up maim and therefore release quicker.

Slam melees have high AOE and damage to oneshot enemies

**Build overview**

Excalibur has recent been buffed as Exalted Blade can use acolyte mods and melee influence arcane, and in turn Slash Dash has been buffed as it uses Exalted Blade stats and can also use melee influence.

This maximum comfort variant build utilises 'passive shield gating' with Catalyzing Shield + Fast Deflection + Vigilante Vigor and Arcane Aegis (optional). This combination causes ANY amount of shield restored provide the maximum 1.33s shield gate, while reducing shield recharge delay to approximately 1s. This means if you do not get hit in a window of 1s approximately, you will passively recharge 1 shield which is sufficient to full gate again. Press 1 to become invulnerable to damage while dashing which further helps. Use ANY rank Arcane Aegis e.g. rank 0. This is flexible for Arcane Strike if you prefer. This allows you to mindlessly attack in any combination of slash dash or Exalted Blade spam without watching your shield levels. If you add Grimoire with Fass Canticle and damage enemies with Grimoire and use slash dash to kill, you can proc Fass Canticle and turn completely immortal for 15s duration each time.

**COMPANION**

Hound:
Moa:

**HOW DOES ABSORB NUKE?**

While absorb is active all damage dealt to you, all damage dealt by your mind control ally and all damage dealt by enemies affected by Chaos to each other is stored as a number (shown in the UI). Upon ending, all damage is dealt to enemies in a maximum range of 50m, which itself scales with both the modded range AND the damage absorbed.

The range of Absorb Nuke is given by the formula : 15 x range% + ( SQRT (5 x damage absorbed) / 50 ) and is capped at 50m. This means even at 34% range, after absorbing or having your mind control deal about 1 million damage (1,125,751 exactly)  you will hit the 50m cap.

If you can therefore buff Mind Control to ridiculous levels where each shot can deal millions to even billions of damage, you can nuke up to damage cap in a 50m range without line of sight given long enough.

You can buff mind control by:
1. Shooting enemies with strong weapons e.g. Prisma Angstrum incarnon, Felarx, Kunai incarnon, Furis incarnon, Laetum.

**WEAPONS**

Nyx's new passive gives up to 200% crit chance additive bonus to Primary and Secondary Weapons. Weapons can also be used to deal damage to mind control on initial cast to buff their damage.

**PRIMARY WEAPONS**

Burston Prime Incarnon:
Felarx Incarnon:

**SECONDARY WEAPONS**

We can use strong secondary weapons with multiplicative Galvanized Shot weapons + priming to charge mind control. Note that many things on weapons do not affect mind control damage absorption (check wiki) e.gg element mods, viral status, enemy armor although just a normal weapon build is sufficient since you can use it for normal shooting and mind control buffing.
For a special build only for maximising mind control use Ballistica Incarnon with Outburst + x12 crescendo Furax :

Ballistica Incarnon, Prisma Angstrum Incarnon, Kunai Incarnon, Kuva Seer, Epitaph can all hit approximately 20,000% to 40,000% with multiple factors stacked e.g. primary status primer (such as bubonico), arcane precision + arcane velocity + reinforced bond + amalgam furax + buff (e.g. roar/nourish) you can hit upwards of 40,000% mind control.

Amalgam Barrel Diffusion is optional to boost roll speed while in assimilate.

**MELEE WEAPONS**

Ruvox: incarnon passives can give up to 60% movement speed and an extra mid air jump which greatly improves the feel of mobility in Assimilate. Ruvox Slam and influence with the passive spears can allow you to trigger a large mind control amount (approximately 10,000% to 80,000%):

Jat Kittag and Sampotes with slam influence can achieve a similar thing with the same build as Ruvox, but does not give passive mobility benefits.

**Build overview**

This is an Endurance focused Rhino Build that uses a combination of spamming Stomp to AOE stun enemies and restore iron skin, as well as rely on i-frames from Iron Skin activation and breaking for survival. If you can get targeted by a strong enemy such as Jade eximus then absorb damage, you could potentially gain hundreds of millions of iron skin which could last a while if you keep refreshing it with Reinforcing Stomp, even at levelcap.

On casting Iron Skin, you have 3 seconds of invulnerability where you absorb damage and convert that to Iron Skin. This should then last at least 3 seconds since it absorbed 3s worth of equivalent damage. Upon breaking you have a further 0.5s iframes from Overguard and another 1.33s of iframes from Shield Gate.

Gladiator Resolve also gives an extra 110cc at 12x combo but could be replaced with Umbral Fiber which boosts strength more and gives enough armor to shrug off heat procs which would normally turn off arcane persistence, except this would require a second Umbral Forma.

**Why Gloom?**

At minimum range on Mesa, Gloom has a max radius of 5.4m. Gloom only drains energy when enemies enter that range and since Mesa is generally a ranged warframe, Gloom basically has zero energy cost while giving free lifesteal on your Regulators. This means you can be extra lazy and stand still in peacemaker while healing any damage taken. As long as you can heal more than 500 hp per second with Gloom, Mesa basically can't die.

- Nourish, Neutron Star and Molecular Fission work together to automatically tag enemies within 23m (46m with manual activation) with 75% slow, 2x damage debuff, viral status and heat status meaning you don't need to cast 4 as often. - Survivability is from a combination of crowd control from slow, prolonged stun from Neutron Star heat procs, rolling guard and active shield gating with Null Star/Nourish as needed. Secondary Fortifier and Arcane Aegis are optional additions. In early levels, damage reduction from null star applies to overguard/shields and makes survivability trivial. Spamming 1 has a 3s cooldown, but refills approximately 0.8s shield gate.
- Place Wormholes for long stretches of straight space between Exolizer rooms. These last forever so don't need to be recast.

Arcane Hot shot is optional, do NOT use this alongside Laetum devouring attrition.

Adding strength, vulnerability and viral status we can multiply this to over 200k damage in AOE with a small chance to proc a corresponding blast status. Do NOT use Arcane Hotshot if using these.

**Build overview**

342% duration gives 30s Critical Surge and 17s Energized Munitions.

Critical Surge buffs can be stacked infinitely as long as the buff is LESS than 250%. If you hit the 250% cap, this instance will NOT stack with the existing buffs.
For example, if you get four 200% Critical Surge buffs, each will be on their individual timer of 30s but will NOT disappear or be overriden by each subsequent buff, resulting in at least 20s of overlapping buffs giving 800% cc. The minimum distance you need to be from a mote in order to teleport is 10m. This means you need to be sufficiently far away (>10m) but not TOO far otherwise you will exceed the 250% cap. This is why Rank 1 Critical Surge is used, because at rank 1 each meter travelled only gives 5% cc x strength. At 224% strength, you need to exceed 22m teleport distance to hit 250%, giving you plenty of leeway (10m to 22m) to hit a value under 250%.

**Build overview**

Target Fixation allows you stack the damage of divebomb infinitely with each enemy hit. The base damage of divebomb is given by 4500 x 0.2 x height x strength, with 15m height being the cap giving a final damage of 13,500 at 100% strength, or 19,400 damage at 144% strength. After you hit 1000 enemies which should take around 10 to 20 minutes depending on map type and density, you will be dealing 19.4 million damage on every divebomb in a 10m radius.

**Arcane Steadfast is currently bugged to allow you to RETAIN Target Fixation bonus indefinitely while on the ground, as long as you have some stacks of Arcane Steadfast.**

**Patch / update history (from the guide)**

**VYTHELAS BUFF**

Vythelas's heat buff is identical to Cyte's resupply (and a cousin of Saryn/Oraxia).

Note that HEAT MODS are mandatory as they double dip the heat DoT and FACTION MODS are ideal too as they TRIPLE DIP the heat DoT.

Vythelas Heat DoT = 0.5 x 30% x stregnth x base damage x (1 + HEAT MOD + other elements) x (1+ HEAT MOD) x (1+FACTION)^3

**Additional notes from the guide**

**THERMAL SUNDER**

Thermal Sunder with Thermal Transfer augment gives +75% heat x strength buff on casting heat sunder, which feeds into Vythelas heat buff twice.

**NOURISH**

Nourish boosts raw damage by +45% viral x strength, that still affects Vythelas heat DoT while viral status boosts all damage by up to 4.25x, and allows you to drop viral mods on weapon.

**ROAR**

You can subsume Roar over 3 and still benefit from Vythelas passive BUT this will remove the strength scaling meaning it is stuck at the base 30% heat and fire rate buffs. Roar triple dips the heat DoT as it counts as faction. This overall probably ends up the weakest option since you also lose the damage vulnerability of 3.

- Coda Bubonico (aerial alf-fire spam):

- Phantasma (swap electric to heat mod):

**Helminth**

1. Roar - passive buff to 1 and 3 damage, allowing you to spam 1 to kill enemies. This is great with Huras Kubrow because you can stay invisible while spamming 1 since it does not count as weapon damage which breaks stealth.

2. Expedite Suffering - allows you to compress the slash procs built up by 1 to insta-kill enemies, or compress toxin procs built up by 3 + your weapon. Bubonico alt-fire with toxin is recommended for this because it has a passive 15s status duration which can be boosted to over 30s by Citrine's 3. Compressing 30s of toxin procs can deal tremendous amounts of damage in an AOE.

3. Sickening Pulse - add 10 stacks of corrosive, great for use with 2 emerald shard. Also multiplies electric status damage by 10x, doubles heat status damage and doubles toxin status damage.

**Playstyle & rotation**

1. Activate as many unique allies as possible, allowing Prismatic Gem to hit the most enemies. The more "allies" you have, the more beams can spawn. Allies include: 1 companion (+3 Duplex Bond clones, can split into 3 hound clones if you use diversified denial), 1 tenno specter, air support charge (kahl spawns 3), 1 on call crew, allied invasion specter (up to 6), 1 lich/sister (for total of 18 active beams).
2. Keep 3 active and spam 1. Keep 2 active optional (depending on which you subsume over)
3. If using Sickening Pulse - cast sickening pulse whenever many enemies hit at least 4 corrosive procs to full strip
4. If using Expedite Suffering - spam 1 and use expedite or shoot toxin bubonico and use expedite
5. If using Roar - keep roar active

.

**Build overview**

This is a non-Rubble Heap dependent everyday use Atlas that doesn't require enemy density and require build up of rubble to 1400.

With 755 energy you can cast Landslide about 75 times before running out of energy and not gaining any energy from orbs.
You just need to pick up a single energy orb to be able to fuel another 5 landslides. Archon Stretch also refills energy slowly at 2 energy/s when activated by electric modded Landslide.
Seismic Bond also activates while 2 or 4 are active allowing you to hit maximum efficiency so each landslide only costs about 7 energy.

**Core build concept**

A **tank** Nyx Prime setup: high Strength (1.99×), long Duration (2.54×), tight Range (0.34×), negative Efficiency (0.45×). Its engine is the combination in the mod configuration above — Assimilate, Mind Freak, Pacifying Bolts, Blind Rage, Narrow Minded, aura Ready Steel, Arcane Agility + Molt Efficiency. See the written sections below for the intended damage/defence loop.

**Key stats & breakpoints**

**Duration**

Higher duration gives long uptime for mind control so you don't have to keep swapping targets and finding new enemies as often. Duration also affects channelling efficiency of Assimilate, where minimum drain can be hit at 280% duration and 130% efficiency. Narrow Minded + Primed Continuity + Molt Efficiency lets you hit 290% duration, and molt efficiency has 100% uptime due to Assimilate making you invulnerable to shield damage. Seismic Bond can give bonus 30% efficiency to hit 130% efficiency and is activated by using 4.

**Efficiency**

High duration with nourish is sufficient to sustain energy.

**Range**

Mind control has a very high base range, so even at 34% range you can cast on enemies in 20m. Psychic Bolts and Dispensary are not affected by range. The range of Absorb is affected by both damage absorbed and modded range, by the following equation 7.5 x range% + ( SQRT (5 x damage absorbed) / 50 ) and is capped at 50m.This means will hit the 50m cap even at 34% range as long as you absorb over approximately 1 million damage.  NOTE: The range equation only counts damage absorbed by enemies shooting you and ignores damage dealt by mind control or confused enemies, meaning low range is only effective above a certain level where enemies start dealing 1 million damage almost instantly (e.g lvl 1000+).

**Strength**

Strength helps Mind Freak and Nourish, but only 125% strength threshold is required for full strip so any extra you add is just minor bonus.

**Modding notes**

The guide does not break down individual mods. Defining picks appear to be: Assimilate, Mind Freak, Pacifying Bolts, Blind Rage, Narrow Minded. Slots holding basic drift/utility or resistance mods are the flexible ones.

**Helminth**

1. Nourish
- adds raw damage bonus to you mind control if you cast nourish within range of them, which feeds into absorb, and easy to recast on any new mind control allies
- adds viral damage/status to your weapons so you dont need to mod viral on your weapons
- multiplies all energy gained from energy orbs and via equilibrium so you can sustain absorb easily

2. Roar
- boosts mind control ally if you cast within range, but cannot be recast mid-duration without augment
- boosts weapon damage and double dips status
- boosts companion damage particularly if using verglas + contagious bond, as faction damage can create a cascading effect to hit damage cap

3. Molt/Firewalker
- makes you go faster while in Assimilate

Arcanes: Arcane Agility, Molt Efficiency. Aura: Ready Steel. Exilus: Nira's Anguish. The guide does not explain these choices.

**Archon Shards**

1 cast speed
2 duration tauforged - further boosts uptime of mind control and reduces drain of assimilate
2 parkour velocity tauforged

**Additional notes from the guide**

**COMPANION**

Choose any ROBOTIC companion e.g. Sentinel, Hound, Moa because [Assimilate] makes them 100% immortal (but does not apply to beast pets). Make sure to equip Seismic Bond to get free 30% efficiency.
Diriga : Arc coil does consistent melee range priming and for synth deconstruct:
Nautilus Prime: Passive grouping pulls enemies closer to you so you don't have to move around as much, also can run Reinforced bond:
Hound:
Moa:

**Aura and Exilus**

Flexible:
- Ready Steel and Nira's are designed to use with Ruvox to maximise Mind Control building. Ready Steel lets you hit 6x combo on Ruvox with Galvanized Reflex and activate incarnon mode. Nira's Anguish boosts slam damage.
- Motus Signal : boosts double jump height which you get from Ruvox

**Assimilate**

Staying in Assimilate makes you and your sentinel completely invulnerable and also immune to knockdowns, allows you to shoot/attack, while severely limiting your mobility to jumps and rolls (i.e. preventing parkour and sprinting). You can somewhat help overcome the mobility problem by boosting parkour velocity (which affects roll speed) and movement speed:
- Ruvox: Running Ruvox allows you to gain +60% movement speed at 12x combo and also 1 extra mid-air jump.
- Dispatch Overdrive on Ruvox further contributes to movement.
- Arcane Phantasm - boosts movement speed by 45% on melee block
- Arcane Agility/Consequence - boosts parkour speed
- Mobilize - parkour velocity
- Amalgam Barrel Diffusion - increase dodge speed for further rolls
- Molt/Firewalker subsumes

**Non-Assimilate**

Pressing Absorb without Assimilate locks you into a floating animation and prevents attacking, but absorbing over 64,000 damage upon ending provides 6s of i-frames and 400% additive damage buff. This means at higher levels, you can simply double tap absorb whenever you need on demand 6s i-frames while also being fully mobile.

Note that you can still run the Assimilate augment and simply turn off Assimilate when you want to be mobile. This still let's you enter Assimilate on demand when required and also control your nuking.

**BUFFING MIND CONTROL**

1. Use high single target raw damage weapon e.g. Felarx, Phenmor, Burston incarnon, Furis incarnon and shoot mind control in head after priming

2. Use blast electric influence slam  e.g. Ruvox, Sampotes, Jat Kittag with Magus Anomaly or Nautilus for grouping

3. Release existing Assimilate on next mind control target

**WEAPONS**

[Nyx]'s new passive gives up to 200% crit chance additive bonus to Primary and Secondary Weapons. In addition you will need weapons to add damage multiplier to mind control, which feeds back into Absorb damage.

**Who it's for**

Use this if you want Nyx Prime as a tank option for general steel path (per build title). It carries a written guide (above).

**Additional notes from the guide**

**ELEMENTAL WARD**

Use Toxic elemental ward for additional damage on holster to boost breach surge and glaives/contagion a tiny bit more.

**SURVIVABILITY (PASSIVE SHIELD Regen)**

Catalyzing Shields sets shield gate to 1.33s regardless of how much shield is generated. Shield recharge delay reduction mods reduce recharge delay to 1s. When shields break you have 1.33s i-frame to get out of enemy fire/reposition or kill enemies, then if you don't get shot for 1s you will starting generating shield. Even just generating 1 shield and getting shot again will give another 1.33s gate. Note, if take constant damage during the 1.33s shield gate it will reset the 1s recharge delay timer so you could be vulnerable after the shield gate ends (e.g. if you get shot at 0.5s into the shield gate, you will recharge at 1.5s which is 0.2s after shield gate ends).

Vex Armor's Fury buff also for some reason applies twice to Glaives and Contagions (i.e. Double Dipping). This means a 600% damage buff is actually a 4800% damage buff (49x) to Glaives and Contagion.

The best weapons to use are:
5x Falcor/Xoris heavy influence (use same build as each other):
5x Coda Pathocyst influence:
12x Rebound Falcor influence:
Exodia Contagion (raw damage):
Exodia Contagion (influence):

**Modding notes**

**WHY NO HEALTH MODS??**

Trinity has a passive that gives 50% of energy max as health max to you and allies, meaning Primed Flow boosts health to 690 on Trinity Prime. This is enough for exactly one persistence gate which is actually all you need to be immortal since you always outheal. If you feel unsafe you can slot Vitality or Arcane Blessing for a bit more buffer room.

**Energy economy**

**WHY GLOOM AND WHY OVER ENERGY VAMPIRE?**

Energy Vampire cannot restore energy while gloom is active and Hunter Adrenaline keeps you at maximum energy permanently.
Gloom heals based on damage dealt and Link reflects enemy damage back at enemies, and counts for Gloom healing.
This means everytime you take damage you heal. Arcane Persistence limits health loss to 500hp per second so essentially OUTHEAL all damage you take while Gloom and Link are both active.

If you somehow slip up and link drops you still have a free life if you have a well of life active.
