**Additional notes from the guide**

**COMPANION**

Need either Huras Kubrow or Shade to keep you invisible.

Huras has the benefit of Primed Pack Leader generating overguard keeping it alive more consistently. Mecha set is also optional.

Shade has the benefit of Duplex Bond priming statuses for you via Tazicor to take advantage of multiplicative CO and maximise damage.

**Landslide BUILD**

Similar to normal build but are using Primed Pressure point and Condition Overload together since they multiply on direct hits:

**RUMBLED QUIRKS**

- Costs 0 energy to throw rocks
- Rocks deal 100 direct damage and 75 radial damage in FIXED 3m AOE NOT affected by range mods
- Has 35% critical chance but 1x base critical damage and 15% status chance, therefore needs flat crit multi bonuses like Crepuscular and Tenacious Bond
- Affected by mods on Landslide
- Is not boosted by Rubble Heap above 1400 rubble
- Condition Overload is MULTIPLICATIVE to Primed Pressure Point and other base damage (e.g. Arcane Fury) on direct hit.
- Condition Overload does NOT affect the AOE component
- Direct hit component can headshot (triple damage and double dip Xata) and benefits from the headcrit bonus (double critical multiplier)
- Does NOT break invisibility from Shade/Huras and can benefit from Arcane Crepuscular
- Can trigger Melee Influence, Melee Afflictions (on non-overguard), Melee Vortex, Melee Duplicate, Arcane Fury
- Throwing does NOT stack Melee Exposure
- Not affected by Attack Speed mods
- Cast speed affects throwing speed
- Precision Intensify boosts the damage

**Who it's for**

Use this if you want Atlas Prime as a hybrid option for level cap. It carries a written guide (above).

**Additional notes from the guide**

**COMPANION**

Huras Kubrow can keep you invisible and run mecha mods to contribute to nuke:

You also run a Primary Statstick for Kubrow to allow it to DPS and even nuke independently, e.g. Paris prime incarnon :

**MELEE**

Blast:
If you want to use Sandstorm alone to passively kill enemies, you can mod a weapon with pure blast and run Diriga with Arc Coil priming viral and magnetic.
Silva and Aegis Prime is a weapon with pure heat meaning you can mod it for 100% blast with a single cold mod to maximise blast DPS.

Electric:
If you are running a priming companion such as Panzer/Diriga that can prime viral for you and would like to do a combination of sandstorm DPS and direct melee DPS, you can simply run a pure electric melee with Melee Influence, which doubles as an Elemental Sandstorm DPS statstick AND a DPS melee. Once sandstorm ends, enemies are often grouped and knocked down, making it very easy for the next few melee hits to naturally perform ground finishers. Weapons in the fist, sparring and claws category have the highest ground finisher multiplier of 30x, followed by tonfas at 20x.

Okina Prime is one of, if not THE strongest influence light attack melee in the game and has the bonus of boosting movement speed by 30% which affects sandstorm movespeed.
Okina Prime Incarnon:

Furax Wraith is the strongest fist melee in the game and can use both melee influence and perform ground finishers for 30x multiplier
Furax Wraith Incarnon:

Prisma Ohma is the strongest tonfa melee for melee influence (and one of the strongest non-incarnons too) and is innate electric meaning the effect on electric weighting for sandstorm damage is highest. Tonfas also have a 20x ground finisher multiplier.
Prisma Ohma:

**Build overview**

This is a variant of Vauban specifically for high mobility missions and catered to a very high activity shield gating playstyle in endurance e.g. Cascade levelcap.
You will essentially be spamming all abilities particularly Photon Strike once every second to nuke and shield gate simultaneously, casting Bastille every 20s or every new area/group of enemies to strip and crowd control simultaneously, and using Overdriver/Vector mines to boost weapon damage and movement speed. Flechette mines are good stationary scaling DPS you can pop down a few of to lock down an area (e.g. one exolizer) while you are off at another one.

**Core build concept**

A **ability dps** Vauban Prime setup: moderate Strength (1.44×), neutral Duration (0.95×), wide Range (1.45×), high Efficiency (1.6×). Its engine is the combination in the mod configuration above — Rolling Guard, Catalyzing Shields, Archon Stretch, Primed Flow, Umbral Intensify, aura Corrosive Projection, Molt Augmented + Arcane Concentration. **Modding notes**

- Corrosive Projection - reduces armor by 1.8x on armored enemies, without needing to wait for Bastille to fully strip since it strips so slowly
- Primed Sure Footed - best in slot for knockdown prevention but can run Ice Spring/Lightning dash instead for mobility
- Fleeting Expertise - maximise efficiency so you can spam all abilities CONSTANTLY, particularly Photon Strike and Bastille, flexible for streamline
- Primed Continuity + Arcane Concentration - recover the loss of duration a bit so Nourish, Minelayer and Bastille still have a decent duration
- Umbral Intensify + Augmented - strength boosts all abilities
- Archon Stretch - gives range for all abilities, more would be best but we don't have the space, and if you are extremely mobile you may be only facing small groups of enemies that are covered by the range already
- Primed Flow + Equilibrium/Energy Nexus - for maximising energy economy and regeneration, Equilibrium is flexible for Energy Nexus particularly if running external energy sources, energize or equilibrium shard as this will allow you to generate energy even while moving between groups of enemies or rooms
- Catalyzing Shield - locks shield gate to 1.33s regardless of how much shield is generated but you MUST be running an Augur Mod either on your secondary or Burst Laser Prime on Sentinel since we do not have space for it on the frame
- Rolling Guard - extra i-frames and status cleanse (optional if you run Wyrm Prime or Vazarin Protective Sling), flexible for Augur Reach

**Build overview**

Pure Weapon Platform Persistence Tank Melee Platform Variant

This variant allows you to fully tank with arcane persistence, which limits health loss at 500hp/s as long as armor is over 700. This can be reached with three umbral mods as Voruna has decent base armor. Voruna's passive also makes her immune to status which blocks heat, corrosive and magnetic that normally disrupts arcane persistence. With Arcane Blessing + Physique + Gladiator Resolve we can hit a final health of 3000 which is equivalent to 6s of i-frames before needing to heal.

**Additional notes from the guide**

Spam 1 and 2 everywhere while killing to shield gate. Run Brief Respite + Augur mods on Pistol/Burst Laser Prime for a bit of active gating so every time you cast 1 or 2 you get a little shield back i.e. casting 2 gives about 0.6s shield gate. Getting kills will passively let Rally Point restores shields, giving up to 2.5s shield gate at over 1100 overshields. Catalyzing Shields is OPTIONAL over Rolling Guard if you are at levelcap and want to have more consistent active gate rather than rely on Rally Point shields i.e. consistently get 1.33s on demand casting 1 or 2 rather than a small gate on demand but higher cap of 2.5s with Rally Point kills.

Rolling Guard is OPTIONAL but gives status cleanse which becomes important in endurance against bleed status or heat status as well as bonus i-frames.

**Who it's for**

Use this if you want Styanax Prime as a weapon platform option for level cap, steel path endurance. It carries a written guide (above).

**Build overview**

Pyrotechnics hits enemies multiple times if they are ragdolling e.g. from Vortex. This allows you to kill enemies in Vortex quickly and on demand, usually quicker than even Flechette orbs can do, however this will fall off around level 500 to 1000. At this point, Flechette orbs become strong enough to oneshot enemies that you can't kill with pyrotechnics.

Heat procs from pyrotechnics can proc arcane hotshot which sets flechettes cc to 200% cc.

**Additional notes from the guide**

**WHY Umbral Vitality??**

Umbral Vitality increases Umbral Intensify by 11% to 55% and also boosts Arcane Bellicose by 11% to give 20% strength (for a total of 22% strength compared to Amar's Hatred which only gives 15% strength). This allows you to hit the 410% strength threshold with only 3 tauforged crimson shards rather than 4.

If you run Madurai Power transfer which gives 40% strength and don't mind keeping it active, you can reduce the strength shard requirement and add energy max shards etc.

**Who it's for**

Use this if you want Rhino Prime as a hybrid option for steel path. It carries a written guide (above).

### 167. Nezha Prime — Nourish Endurance Nezha

**Type:** Hybrid · **Difficulty:** Advanced · **Investment:** Extreme

| MR / rank / cost | MR 0 · rank 30 · 240 platinum / 146740 endo |

**Build overview**

Why Nourish over chrakram?
Chakram has terrible targetting and sometimes hits one enemy then bounces away. If you press it again too soon hoping to retry, you may end up teleporting to somewhere you didn't want to go. It also has limited effectiveness at low strength on this build, as low strength is used to take maximum advantage of Warding Halo breaking and iframes. Finally it can cause 'reverse heat inherit' which is where if you apply a heat status from chakram then shoot that same enemy with Furis, all subsequent statuses applied via Furis ignores any +heat mods on the weapon (e.g. Primed Heated Charge + Scorch) which is effectively a 3.25x REDUCTION in status damage. Nourish somewhat helps the energy economy aspect while viral status multiplies all damage to health by up to 4.25x which is spread via divine retritbution, and finally in cascade, Nourish has no frame vulnerability (i.e. cannot be knocked back to frame while in operator).

**Companion**

Diriga will help you prime Synth Deconstruct for Equilibrium and Seismic Bond (which procs while Divine Spears is active).

Divine Retribution is best paired with status weapons like pure heat Furis or melee weapons with influence/afflictions.
- Furis:
- Coda Mire Slam:
- Arca Titron Slam:

1. Active shield gating: Spam 1 constantly to shield gate actively since it has a very fast cast. With Catalyzing Shield this resets your 1.33s gate on demand.
2. Warding Halo: At low strength, Warding Halo will be as small as possible and therefore break easier than normal. Upon breaking warding halo gives 2s iframes. Immediately recasting will give a further 3s iframes.
3. Passive shield gating: Arcane aegis and Guardian on a pet are additional OPTIONAL layers of passive survivability

**Intended content — best at / less suited for**

**Core build concept**

Its engine is the combination in the mod configuration above — Umbral Intensify, Piercing Roar, Narrow Minded, Nira's Hatred, Augur Message, aura Blind Rage/Corrosive Projection, Arcane Concentration + Molt Efficiency. See the written sections below for the intended damage/defence loop.

**Key stats & breakpoints**

Final values: Armor 160 · Energy 250 · Health 776.273 · Shield 455 · Sprint Speed 1.15 · Ability Range 0.34 · Ability Duration 3.21 · Ability Strength 2.58 · Ability Efficiency 0.45. The guide gives no breakpoint analysis — treat these as the author's chosen point, not hard requirements.

**Modding notes**

The guide does not break down individual mods. Defining picks appear to be: Umbral Intensify, Piercing Roar, Narrow Minded, Nira's Hatred, Augur Message. Slots holding basic drift/utility or resistance mods are the flexible ones.

**Helminth**

You will need to use buffs that apply to allies if you are casting from Sirius to apply to Orion
- Roar: best general damage buff which double dips status damage and doesn't mess with status weighting for status weapons, and also triple dips melee influence. This is best used for weapons like Torid incarnon, Furis incarnon, any melee influence weapon as well as most weapons modded with viral while paired with armor strip from Orion 1.
- Nourish: adds viral damage to weapons allowing you to mod corrosive +/- heat/blast/cold. Good for raw damage weapons that run raw corrosive damage e.g. dual toxocyst incarnon which will strip armor passively with corrosive without needing to use Orion 1.
- Thermal Transfer: adds non-combining heat, cold or blast elemental buff to weapons
- Shock Trooper: adds non-combining electric damage buff to weapons. Especially good for melee influence on weapons

To match with the main Celestial Clash build you can keep Roar subsumed over 3 on SIRIUS as the Primary Son. We will use Sirius as a dedicated 'buff' holder. You can activate Roar from Orion at any time by holding down 3 or swap manually to Sirius then activate Roar (this is preferred if running Arcane Concentration).

If not using Roar you can consider subsuming over Sirius 4 and run Precision Intensify instead of Umbral Intensify. Drop Piercing Roar for either more strength or the other augments.

**Arcanes, Aura & Exilus**

Arcanes: Arcane Concentration, Molt Efficiency. Aura: Blind Rage, Corrosive Projection. Exilus: Power Drift. The guide does not explain these choices.

**Archon Shards**

_Not specified in the source guide._

**Survivability & failure conditions**

Not detailed. Survivability comes from whatever defensive mods/abilities are in the configuration above; the guide does not state what breaks it.

**Energy economy**

Efficiency sits at 0.45× per the stats line. The build/guide references an energy source — see mods/overview.

**Playstyle & rotation**

This build uses Orion as the 'main' weapon platform and Sirius as the 'buffer'. This is because Orion's 1 and 3 abilities require maximising range with Overextended which reduces maximum duration and strength, while Sirius can run maximum duration and strength for a buff.

Keep default controls as you will mostly stay in Orion.
1. Spam 1 everywhere to strip armor
2. Keep 2 active for free damage negation
3. Cast 3 sparingly for grouping, or not at all since this carries enemies away from you, prevents headshots for incarnons and also ragdolls thrax specters into it prevent amp headshots.
4. Hold 1 to swap to Sirius to get on-demand 1.5s i-frame if needed. On swap you will activate arcane concentration, then immediately tap 3 for the buff (e.g. Roar) to snapshot the boosted duration. Hold 1 to swap back to Orion. Once your buff on Orion runs out, repeat step 4.

**Variants**

_None described._

**Strengths & weaknesses**

- **Strengths:** large weapon multipliers; scales with gun/melee investment and endurance.
- **Weaknesses:** thinner ability utility; relies on a good weapon and on keeping buffs up.
_(Archetype-level; the source guide gives no explicit list.)_

**Additional notes from the guide**

**SIRIUS**

The only role here is to apply the buff and then return to Orion. Therefore we want to maximise duration first with all available mods and arcanes that boost duration meaning you don't need to switch frames very often, then maximise strength for the buff value. Efficiency, energy and range don't matter at all.

**ORION**

Orion just needs to cast Gravitic Slash and Event Horizon which both require maximum range and needs to hit 164% strength for Gravitic Slash to full strip in 1 cast with Corrosive Projection. The rest can go into survivability (shield recharge, catalyzing shield, Rolling Guard), quality of life (Ice Spring), damage (Vigorous Swap) and energy economy (equilbrium, Flow) which are all generally flexible and dependent on personal preference.

Arcane wise run Crepuscular if abusing Shade invisibility but, Hot Shot for use with Jade Stars to boost crit chance or whatever matching damage arcane you want (e.g. Precision, Rage, Velocity, Fury etc).

**Shade INVISIBILITY**

Currently (likely due to a bug), turning invisible with Shade then swapping brothers, waiting for second brother to turn invisibility then immediately shooting to break invisibility and finally swapping back to first brother, will make the first brother permanently invisible not even breaking from attacking.

This means to make Orion permanently invisible what you want to do is start in Orion and wait till he is invisible, swap immediately to Sirius and then wait until Sirius turns insvisible. As soon as Sirius turns invisible, BREAK the invisibility by shooting your weapon then immediately swap back to Orion. From now on, nothing can break Orion's invisibility state.

**Who it's for**

Use this if you want Sirius & Orion as a weapon platform option for farming / loot. It carries a written guide (above).

**Additional notes from the guide**

**Why not Galvanized Aptitude?**

Currently Galvanized Aptitude only applies to the base damage before the base damage boost from Final Fusillade/Plentiful Mayhem evolution, meaning it only has 50% of the advertised effect i.e. approximately 80% damage at 2 statuses (vs 165% from Serration). It is multiplicative on the incarnoff mode direct hit and doesn't apply to the AOE component of incarnoff, but does apply to the AOE component of the incarnon mode.

**Flexible options**

1. Primed Bane: multiplicative to +dmg, double dips status damage for 2.4x. You need to swap this depending on the mission, and note some factions like Scaldra and Techrot do not currently have faction mods.
2. Rifle Elementalist - 1.9x multiplier to the blast status damage.
3. Primed Firestorm - increases the AOE at the end of the primary beam, which potentially increases how many total enemies can be hit (by approximately 1.5 to 2x)
4. Hammer Shot - more crit dmg and status chance
5. Magnetic Capacity - magnetic status significantly boosts damage against overguard (e.g. thrax and eximus).

**ELEMENTAL VARIANTS**

Blast Corrosive: Best for trash clearing against armored enemies (e.g. grineer/corrupted). Use Primed Cryo Rounds for raw damage, blast status has a 5m AOE at 10 stacks or on death which accelerates trash clearance while High Voltage forms corrosive with innate toxin which allows you to strip some armor to boost damage against armored enemies. If you have external electric e.g. from a violet shard, you could drop High Voltage for Rifle Elementalist, Primed Bane, Magnetic Capacity etc.

Viral Electric: Better against single targets compared Corrosive Blast but slightly slower trash clear, however once you add violet primary electric shards this can become much stronger.

Pure Blast: Use this for trash clearing against enemies without armor or if using armor strip from another source. You can drop High Voltage for Rifle Elementalist or another flexible option.

Pure Toxin: This gives theoretically the highest single target DPS but only with some external priming and armor strip (e.g. viral + heat + corro):

**Final recommendation**

Use this if you want Torid as a gun option for level cap, void cascade, farming / loot. It carries a written guide (above).

- Evolution III - Ready Retaliation - +100% reload speed for 6s when reload from empty. This actually also affects the transformation time, cutting it down from 3.4s to approx 1.7s if you manage to reload from empty.

**Build overview**

Felarx is a full-auto projectile shotgun that feels like an automatic Exergis, that transforms into semi-automatic dual pistols. We will mostly be using the Primary Shotgun mode due to the higher base damage, innate multishot and better feel of full-auto trigger, but the build would also work well for the incarnon mode. The non-incarnon mode also has infinite body/enemy punchthrough.

Due to the Devastating Attrition perk giving 2000% damage multiplier on 50% of non-crits, we build Felarx for a raw damage non-crit build and take advantage of shotgun's access to TWO Primed elemental mods (Primed Charged Shell and Primed Chilling Grasp). You can either build for raw Viral + Electric or raw Corrosive + Cold. Corrosive has a 50% bonus against Grineer while Viral has a 50% bonus against Corrupted enemies, however Corrosive Cold can be used alongside the common subsume Nourish to get Viral Corrosive Cold. Viral or Corrosive Heat is a slightly less effective alternative due to lack of primed heat mod and relatively low status chance.

**MOD CHOICES**

- Galvanized Hell : +230% multishot at max stacks,
- Galvanized Savvy: +80% dmg per status, so potentially +400% dmg after 5 statuses, or even more with priming. Apparently multiplicative with +dmg sources like Primed Point Blank and Primary Deadhead
- Primed Ammo Stock : turns magazine size from 6 to 13. If you reload from empty, you can gain +130% fire rate from full clip.
- Primed Tactical Pump : cuts long reload speeds. Use Shotgun Barrage instead if you use Evolved Autoreloader perk (stack with Synth set for about 60% reload per second of holster, or basically full reload in 1.7s upon switching to a primer or melee).
- Shotgun Barrage: gives fire rate, can swap out if you have external fire rate e.g. Reinforced Bond.
- Primed Cleanse Grineer : Multiplicative 55% to other +dmg sources. Flexible for Primed Point Blank (only slightly worse overall DPS, best used for Acolytes/Thrax/Factionless or if you don't like swapping faction mods).
- Primed Charged Shell/Contagious Spread/Primed Chilling Grasp : maximum elemental damage for raw corrosove + cold. Switch order to make viral + electric if desired, or add Incendiary Coat or Blaze over Primed Chilling Grasp to make Corrosive/Heat. Add Incendiary Coat over Primed Charged Shell and reorder mods to make viral heat. Primed Chilling Grasp is flexible for Chilling Reload. Contagious Spread is alternative to Toxic Barrage (needs more forma for tiny damage boost). Can use non-primed versions or 60/60 versions of any elementals if you don't own them or can't fit them.

**Arcane & Exilus**

Flexible choice
- Primary Deadhead : +360% dmg after just 3 headshot kills which multiplies with Galv Savvy, recoil bonus and extra 30% headshot multiplier.
- Primary Merciless : +360% dmg but needs 12 kills and drops stacks quickly, ammo maximum and reload bonus go very well with Felarx

**Incarnon Genesis evolutions**

**EVOLUTION CHOICES**

1. Incarnon Form : Land headshots to build up charge.
2. Frictionless Flight : +50% Projectile Flight Speed OR Kinetic Baffle -50% recoil (combines with Deadhead to be 100% recoil reduction). This is mostly personal preference, if you are okay with the minor recoil it has.
3. Evolved Autoreloader: allows you to bypass the insane reload time, allowing full reload in 2s of swapping weapons (or just 1.7s with two Synth mods). Combine with a Primer or use a melee to quickly switch between weapons. Mounting Momentum is an alternative that gives +10% fire rate for each shell reloaded. If you reload 13 shells from empty, you can get up to +130% fire rate for the next 13 bullets, but the total reload is still about 3s long. If you want this, drop shotgun spazz for primed tactical pump. The non-incarnon form actually has infinite body punchthrough, making the dual mode chamber perk useless.
4. Wracking Wrath: +20% status chance, -10% crit chance. Improves chances of Devastating Attrition proc
5. Devastating Attrition: 50% chance to deal 2000% damage on non-crits. Presumable similar to Devouring Attrition, being multiplicative to base dmg sources.

**Weapon identity & damage engine**

This is a standard Viral Electric Phantasma build which is best used for general use and against groups of enemies, as electric procs have a small AOE (3m), are uncapped and scale with elemental mods. Armor strip helps against higher level Steel path grineer/corrupted enemies.

Heat is an alternative option which scales higher against single targets and can benefit from Heat inherit mechanics. Simply swap Primed Charged Shell for Incendiary Coat.
If you plan on using a Viral Primer, swap the viral mods for Shell Shock + Vigilante Armaments.

**Crit / status / multishot mechanics**

**Mod notes (defining mods, Galvanized, faction, flexible slots)**

- Galvanized Savvy : Gives +80% damage per status effect. Phantasma procs impact, radiation, electric and viral giving a maximum of +320% dmg without external priming. Also gives +80% status which is essential for status effects, the key damaging component of phantasma, but is additive to Primary Merciless.
- Galvanized Hell: Gives +230% multishot at max stacks.Multishot is essential on beam weapons as it increases both beam damage and status chance thereby basically double dipping in the damage of status effects (such as electric).
- Viral (Toxic Barrage and Frigid Blast): viral status boosts damage of electric procs by up to 4.25x at 10 stacks. You want to use maxed mods for the bonus to status chance.
- Electric (Primed Charged Shell): this is the key damaging elemental mod giving +165% electric damage to each electric proc and increasing electric bias
- Primed cleanse grineer/corrupted: this double dips on status effects, multiplying the damage of electric procs by +140.25% (i.e. 2.4x). Ths is flexible for vigilante armaments or magnetic strafe if you dislike faction mods.
- Shotgun Barrage/Repeater Clip: firerate directly multiplies DPS by 1.9 to 2.05x.
- Shotgun Elementalist: boosts status damage by 90% and also increases clip size which is a nice bonus.

Exilus:
Personal preference but Phantasma can be an ammo hog. Use primed ammo mutation if you feel ammo is an issue.
Otherwise leave the default polarity and use Galvanized Acceleration.

Arcane:
Up to preference as many options are viable.
- Primary Crux: gives ammo efficiency and huge status chance, very nice quality of life since you reload less. Overall DPS is the lowest but this would **feel** the best to use.
- Shotgun Vendetta: +180% multishot is better than merciless after only 2 status effects due to how multishot double dips status damage, however is only better than deadhead with headshots after 6 statuses (i.e. using an external primer). Use this if you aren't planning on aiming at heads or not using electric.
- Primary Deadhead : The bonus 1.3x headshot multiplier double dips when electric procs hit the head, dealing 1.69x damage (note elec procs no longer double dip the usual 3x headshot multiplier and instead have a base multiuplier of 1x). Use this is you are planning on aiming at heads AND using electric.
- Primary Merciless : Fine alternative when not aiming at heads.

**Patch / update history (from the guide)**

**UPDATE MAY 2025**

Since armor and health changes, enemies have twice as much health but now have capped armor so slash procs are no longer as strong as other statuses such as Electric, Heat, Toxin, Blast and Gas. All of these have a certain niche in specific situations and can all be viable. I have chosen Electric as the default as it is the most consistent and flexible in most situations.

**UPDATE Nov 2023**

Ideally run with a Companion primer (eg hound, diriga, Panzer Vulpaphyla) or a secondary/melee primer (eg epitaph/Kuva Nukor) to give viral procs to magnify slash procs (up to 4.25x at max 10 stacks of viral) as well as give additional statuses to power Galvanized Aptitude.

With the companion update, companion priming is better and easier than ever with Diriga and Hounds, in addition to panzer.
Diriga primer:

**UPDATE May 2023**

The new bow arcane Longbow Sharpshot gives +300% separate multiplier on the next shot after a headshot, giving potentially 4x damage multiplier (separate to aptitude AND Serration AND bane) when chaining headshots.  Primary Deadhead is still fine to use if you don't like chaining headshots.

- Rifle Elementalist
- Hammer Shot

**ELEMENTAL VARIATIONS**

- ELECTRIC: Best 'general use' element because it ticks INSTANTLY when procced meaning it has the potential fastest TTK, has a small AOE which helps with clearing groups of enemies, benefits from electric mods and is best used alongside Roar or Shock subsume with Shock Trooper. Electric also has a bonus against murmur enemies.
- HEAT: Best element against armored enemies but has a 1s delay, but strips armor by up to 50% after 2s which is equivalent to a 3.6x damage boost. Can benefit from heat inherit meaning if you prime first with a secondary weapon with Faction Mod bonuses and Heat mod bonuses, they can be inherited by Nataruk. This is the way to maximise single target DPS but requires setup. Best used with Roar subsume.
- TOXIN: Best against corpus since toxin completely bypasses large shields and directly oneshots health.
- GAS: Nice AOE clearing element as it creates persisting zones of damage, but requires two mod slots and does not benefit from elemental mod bonus. Nice for stationary or camping missions where new enemies will continuously walk into clouds.
- BLAST: Has the fastest AOE clearing potential but is also the most inconsistent since it requires you to either proc 10 blast statuses within 1.5s (which is impossible on Nataruk), or have enough raw damage to oneshot enemies while also proccing one blast proc (mostly possible against lower level trash).

**Final recommendation**

Use this if you want Nataruk as a gun option for farming / loot. It carries a written guide (above).

**NOTE**: Galvanized Aptitude is NOT used because it ignores the 40 base dmg bonus of evolution 2 which makes up about 75% of total base damage (although it does apply to the AOE component due to it being hitscan). With the base 2 statuses on incarnon mode you are getting only 40% damage instead of 155% from amalgam serration.

- Primary Acuity: gives headshot damage (additive to headshot multiplier) but is currently bugged to give 5.25x extra headshot multiplier on top of the 3x base, as well as +350% critical chance on headshots. FLEXIBLE for Galvanized Chamber when you don't want to focus on headshots or don't like the slower charge rate.
- Critical Delay + Primary Acuity + Galv Scope: on headshots gives a final cc of 485% which means you have a high percentage of tier 5 red crits.  Technically swapping Crit Delay out for Bladed Rounds or Hammer Shot would give more final DPS however crit delay helps maintain a level of crit when you are only hitting bodyshots. Galvanized Scope is flexible instead since it relies on stacks and can be inconsistent - e.g. for hammer shot or magnetic capacity
- Vital Sense: mandatory CD
- Viral (Malignant Force + PCR): raw viral damage has 50% bonus on corrupted, and any viral status you proc further boosts damage to health up to 4.25x at 10 stacks. See below for different elemental combinations
- Gilded Truth: 80% fire rate and you can proc truth effect (25% parkour velocity for 30s, a bit of healing and gas procs), and you can get punchthrough via Fortress Salvo evolution if you have armor >450. Primed Shred and Vile Acceleration are alternatives.

**Additional notes from the guide**

**ACUITY VS Galvanized Chamber**

Primary Acuity mod states it gives +350% headshot multiplier but this is actually +525% multiplier additive to the base 300% headshot multiplier and also gives +350% critical chance on headshots which is additive to other crit mods. Since it locks multishot to 1, it will charge the incarnon charge slightly slower but still not feel too bad to use. If you really dislike the charging rate, just swap Primary Acuity to Galvanized Chamber instead.

Burston Prime Incarnon form has a 50/50 split between direct hit and a small AOE component. This AOE component does NOT benefit from either the headshot multiplier (from either base or Primary Acuity) OR from Multishot, however it does benefit from the critical chance from Primary Acuity.

Overall, Primary Acuity is stronger for a single target use where you are getting a high proportion of headshots  e.g. killing select strong targets such as Thrax, Demolysts e.t.c, while Galvanized Chamber is better for general use where you expect to get a decent amount of body shots too.

**Flexible Options**

Swap Galv Scope:
- Magnetic Capacity: adds magnetic dmg which has a boost against overguard
- Primed Bane: multiplicative 55% DPS boost, which double dips on any heat statuses you proc
- Hammer shot: more crit damage and status chance
- Hellfire/thermite rounds - boosts heat status DPS by a little bit

**ELEMENTAL COMBINATIONS**

- RAW VIRAL (Primed Cryo + Malignant Force) : good for general use since it uses primed cryo round for high raw elemental damage, and viral status boosts all damage to health by 4.25x
- RAW MAGNETIC (Primed Cryo + Stormbringer) : best for Thrax killing in combination with Nourish
- RAW CORROSIVE (Stormbringer + Infected Clip):  best for Grineer demolysts with external viral priming
- BLAST: Decent trash clear option, best combined with either corrosive for armor strip or nourish providing viral status.

**Final recommendation**

Use this if you want Burston Prime as a gun option for general steel path (per build title). It carries a written guide (above).

- Internal Bleeding -  slash procs bypass armor, Fulmin's semi auto mode has forced impact on every shot, meaning every shot has a 70% to make a slash proc, which bypasses armor. The fire rate just needs to be below 2.5 for maximum slash chance. This means you cannot run any fire rate buffs that exceed 44% (either from mods or external buffs like Haste mote, Harrow etc, arcane acceleration etc).

**Arcane & Exilus**

- Primary Deadhead: gives the most possible damage as +360% is multiplicative to galve aptitude but additive to Serration, also gives 1.3x headshot multiplier which applies to fulmin (base 1x multi) and double dips elec procs on headshots (to 1.69x)

**Mod notes (defining mods, Galvanized, faction, flexible slots)**

- Damage: Currently Galvanized Aptitude is BUGGED on Incarnon's, not taking into account any flat base dmg buffs such as from Fortifying Bloodshed (+10) or Fresh Havoc (+12), meaning Galv Aptitude only has approximately 30% of its intended effect (+24% dmg per status). At 5 statuses, this is equivalent to only +120% damage. Therefore we use Serration/Amalgam Serration which provides overall more damage which is non-conditional. Amalgam variant is optional but gives better mobility for quality of life.

- Multishot: Galvanized Chamber alone provides +230% multishot at maximum stacks. Do NOT stack Vigilante Armaments as you are getting diminishing returns and run out of mod space, getting from only 230% to 290%. At 230%, every bullet now produces 3 bullets with a 30% chance for 4 bullets.

- Crit Chance: Hata-Satya augment increases CC by 1.2% per bullet hit. With max multishot, each shot produces 3 bullets minimum meaning a 3.6% increase per hit. From full spool, you need to land at most 42 hits to match point strike which is +150%. With 30% chance to get 4 bullets, this could be cut down to about 30-40 hits. By 60 hits, your crit bonus will be +252% which equates to 106% crit chance, or Guaranteed yellow crits.  This means you want to aim and make sure you hit your target to maximise the crit gain on remaining bullets in your magazine. The maximum possible crit bonus of +500% or 180% final CC (mostly orange crits), can be reached after hitting about 100-140 enemies or after more than half the clip has been emptied. Stacking Point Strike on top of this gives a +53% difference at 60 hits or +45% difference at max bonus, which is nice but doesn't produce as great an effect as other mod options.

- Crit Dmg: Vital Sense - mandatory crit damage

- Viral: Raw viral damage At max viral stacks (x10), we magnify damage to health by slash procs by 4.25x.

- Heat: Wildfire gives occasional heat procs that strip armor, deal damage . Wildfire also gives a bit of extra magazine size whicih makes incarnoff feel better.

- Primed Shred/Vile acceleration: Punchthrough lets you hit more enemies and build up Hata-Satya even faster. If you have Fortress Salvo activated, you can swap this to Vile Acceleration instead if you prefer

- Arcane: Primary Crux gives extra status chance but most importantly gives ammo efficiency for incarnoff use. Primary Merciless provides the base damage and procs on bleed DoT kills, while Deadhead does not. Primary Plated Rounds gives a higher possible dmg buff +466% but this only lasts for 10s and doesn't affect the Incarnon mode. This means you will need to empty the entire clip in one go to take full advantage of the buff which is bit of ammo waste.

**Additional notes from the guide**

**Evolution II**: Both evolutions work well:

- Fortifying Bloodshed is very nice for constant passive shield gating as every kill via Bleed DoT generates 100 shield.  This is amazing for shield gating and endurance setups.

- Fortress Salvo gives +4 puncthrough which is AMAZING, but requires you to either mod armor or run a frame with high base armor. The following frames require NO additional armor mods or abilities to hit 450 (Atlas/Atlas Prime, Lavos, Nidus/Nidus Prime, Valkyr/Valkyr Prime), while the following frames need can hit >450 armor with an ability active (Chroma/Chroma Prime with Vex Armor or Cold Ward active, Oberon with Iron Renewal/Hallowed Reckoning, Wukong with Defy, Vauban with Bastille, Inaros with Scarab Swarm, Rhino with Ironclad Charge). Other universal sources of armor that easily exceed 450 armor include any of the base armor mods, Warcry/Defy/Elemental Ward/Parasitic armor subsume, Arcane Guardian/Reaper/Ultimatum/Tanker, Mecha Pulse with Mecha set/kubrow,

**Evolution III**: Down to preference but Kinetic Battle -50% recoil feels the best.

**Evolution IV**: After maths, Fresh Havoc gives on average 30% more DPS compared to Fatal Aflection and Zeroed in. This simply requires you to reload from empty 2 times for a persistent +12 flat base dmg buff that lasts until you die.

![](

**TL:DR - Highest possible DPS on most frames is incarnon Soma Prime running Hata-Satya and no Galv Aptitude**

**ALTERNATIVE SLASH**

- Slash: Hunter Munitions over Wildfire can be used to create slash procs and requires crits to function. Slash procs bypass armor so you will mostly be relying on slash procs to kill heavily armored enemies like Grineer/Corrupted. This means you don't need to keep shooting them, even just a short burst of 10 bullets could be enough to let slash procs build up and kill an enemy. Kills via bleed also trigger Fortifying Bloodshed which regenerates shields constantly for shield gating. If you don't care about shields, you could swap this to Hellfire which technically deals higher total raw DPS.

- Faction mod: Primed Bane Of Grineer is multiplicative with damage mods meaning it results in a separate +55% damage bonus with +360% from merciless, giving  11.73x damage (compare this to Serration which only adds 165% to 360%, giving 625% total). Furthermore, banes 'double dip' on slash procs, meaning slash procs actually receive a 2.401x multiplier. If you don't own the *primed* version, you should still use regular Bane Of Grineer since slash procs receive a 1.69x bonus.

Riven:
Generally due to the poor disposition, you do NOT want more damage or multishot since they just add with diminishing returns.
MS/CD/CC/punchthrough/firerate are the most desired stats for soma. Ideally, you coul also have toxin +/- cold so you can replace one or both of the elemental mods.

**ELEMENTAL VARIATIONS FOR FACTIONS**

- Grineer/Corrupted: Use Viral Heat or Viral Hunter munitions
- Corpus: Use pure toxin to bypass shields.
- Murmur: use Raw radiation or Viral Electric

**Final recommendation**

Use this if you want Soma Prime as a gun option for steel path endurance. It carries a written guide (above).

**Additional notes from the guide**

**Strun Wraith VS PRIME?**

Strun Prime is about 13% better than Strun Wraith for overall AOE DPS and higher final status chance (400% on prime and 317% on wraith with same build)

**EVOLUTION II** : Blazing Barrel - gives multishot

**EVOLUTION III** : Rapid Reinforcement gives +60% reload speed to the insanely long base reload speed of the non-incarnon form of 4.6s. Stacks with +30% from Primary Merciless so the final reload speed is 2.4s. Reload speed also affects the transformation speed into incarnon mode. Alternatively, Galvanic Reload is very nice if you also enjoy the incarnoff mode since its basically ammo efficiency.

**EVOLUTION IV** : Elemental Balance gives +11.3% status chance to EACH pellet on the base form. Since Strun Prime has 12 innate multishot, you end up with a total base status chance of 46 + 12*11.3=182% upon transforming since the incarnon form only has 1 base multishot. This means with just two 60% status mods, we can hit 182 x (1+0.6+0.6)=400.4 % status chance, i.e. guaranteed FOUR status effects per shot, before multishot. With 3 multishot we basically get TWELVE guaranteed statuses per trigger pull. At approximately 40% slash bias, we can get approximately 4 to 6 slash procs every fire.

**FLEXIBLE/ALTERNATIVES**

- Shotgun Elementalist is next best in slot after Primed Cleanse, and is technically better than Primed Point Blank when at max stacks of Merciless
- Motus Setup provides more potential DPS than Critical Deceleration but requires you to bullet jump every 4s.
- Shotgun Savvy provides status chance which increases overall slash and viral procs, but does not boost the weighting.
- Galvanized Savvy gives slightly less status chance than Shotgun Savvy, but provides +80% dmg for each status when using BASE FORM ONLY. Galvanized Savvy does NOT apply to the AOE of the incarnon form. You can use this if you like using both forms.

- Corrosive Blast: for general AOE killing as an alternative, better with grouping:
- Toxin for corpus: toxin bypasses shields

**Why not Viral?**

Viral 60/60 mods is a good option to give raw damage and status chance, as well as a useful status effect, however, all other mods are essential and give higher overall value from two slots particularly if you consider external sources of viral e.g. companion priming from Diriga, Hounds, Tazicor. Hitman's Opportunity will be your main perk to pick. This gives +70 base dmg and an extra +100% damage (additive to Galvanized Aptitude). This works normally on Incarnon mode, being additive to Galvanized Aptitude and multiplicative to Serration/Merciless.

**Element choice & faction notes**

**Where is the heat damage?**

Temple's 3rd ability Ripper's Wail applies heat damage as a separate non-combining mod (similar to Shock Trooper and other augments) and boosts heat DoT but additively to other +heat mods like Thermite Rounds and Hellfire.

**Why not viral?**

If you aim down sight on Lizzie you can simultaneously shoot the priming waves and primary flamethrower without interruption.  For general use you will want to just spam Viral waves (aim and tap 1) everywhere to boost all damage to health up to 4.25x at 10 stacks. You could also subsume on Nourish for free viral without needing to use alt-fire.
Against eximus and thrax you can tap 2 for magnetic which boosts damage to overguard and shields
Since you have corrosive status coming from Archon Continuity already, this means you don't need to mash so many keys at once and can focus on just priming viral.
Cold priming can be somewhat helpful in giving flat CD boost of 1x at 10 stacks but this is not mandatory. Cold may also be useful to build stacks of Primary Frostbite, in case you don't own any Primary Blight. This means you just need to spam both viral and cold into enemies.

**Status weighting**

_Not specified in the source guide._

**Mod notes (defining mods, Galvanized, faction, flexible slots)**

- Galvanized Chamber: mandatory multishot, which double dips beam status DPS
- Galvanized Aptitude: boosts status chance and also gives +80% damage per status, additive to strength on Temple. With 300% additive equivalent damage, Galvanized Aptitude with Blast Toxin Heat Corrosive Viral (5 statuses) provides a further +400% damage, which is a relative 2x multiplier on top of the existing strength multiplier.
- Critical Delay: gives critical chance, optional if you run Hotshot but is nice to have so you still have a base level of crit chance in case hotshot has 0 stacks and if 2 is not active
- Thermite Rounds + Rime Rounds: Makes blast and adds status chance. Primed Cryo Rounds would give more raw damage but Ripper's Wail already gives way too much additive elemental damage, and this comes at the cost of status chance which is more important.
- Infected Clip/Malignant Force: Makes toxin and adds more status chance, toxin is needed to proc Primary Blight and Archon Continuity
- Primed Bane or Elementalist: multiplicative to damage, smite double dips status against a specific faction and elementalist multiplies status damage by 1.9x
- Vile Acceleration: Gives firerate which directly multiplies damage by 1.9x. This can be flexible if you offload with external firerate boosts (e.g. abilities, arcane acceleration, reinforced bond)

**Arcane & Exilus**

- Primary Blight: gives multishot and crit damage, procs from toxin status modded on but if you are having issues with stacking this due to killing enemies too quickly from raw damage or way too much heat weight from maximum Ripper's Wail, try using other options
- Primary Frostbite: also gives multishot and crit damage, can proc from either the altfire OR from a companion priming cold + shivering contagion e.g. via Tazicor equipped on a sentinel modded with Corrosive Cold
- Primary Merciless: additive to strength and galv aptitude, reload bonus has no effect
- Primary Crux:  gives up to 300% status chance after headshot, ammo efficiency has no effect

_None described._

**Additional notes from the guide**

**Why there is no modded critical damage?**

The critical damage comes from Primary Blight which gives 144%, even higher than Vital Sense. This stacks almost instantly from the toxin procs on Lizzie.

Critical chance comes from the combination of Arcane Hot Shot on the Warframe (even just r1 gives 100% cc while r5 gives 300% cc modded), Critical Delay (200%) and flat critical chance from Overdrive (around 100 to 200% flat depending on strength). The final CC we end up with should be over 300% which is guaranteed red crits.

**Why Blast + Toxin?**

Toxin is modded to activate Primary Blight which gives both multishot and critical damage. Multishot is VERY important on beam weapons like Lizzie because multishot DOUBLE DIPS status DPS on continuous weapons. Blast is modded into order to allow Toxin to not combine with innate heat to make Gas, and Blast itself can be a useful trash clearing status that helps kill densely packed enemies. As a final bonus, Archon Continuity modded on the warframe causes toxin procs from Lizzie to simultaneously proc Corrosive status which contributes to both armor strip and Galvanized Aptitude.

**FLEXIBLE OPTIONS**

- Vital Sense/Hammer Shot: add even more critical damage, hammer shot also provides status chance
- Magnetic Capacity: gives magnetic without needing to shoot the alt fire, could be good quality of life for pure thrax killing
- Vigilante Armaments: gives more multishot which double dips status DPS
- Serration/Amalgam Serration: more additive damage which is overall a pretty small boost

**Lizzie QUIRKS**

Lizzie seems to be almost exactly like Ignis Wraith. It is a flame thrower beam weapon with a 10m range that can be boosted by Sinister Reach to have a final range of 22m. At the end of the beam there is 4m spherical AOE that like all hitscan AOE will IGNORE multishot entirely. This effectively means the actual final Reach of the beam is 26m but the enemies at the final 4m end will only receive about half to a third damage, while the enemies between 18 to 22m will actually receive about 1.5x more damage.

**Final recommendation**

Use this if you want Lizzie as a gun option for general steel path (per build title). It carries a written guide (above).

Sporothrix has a low crit chance but very high crit damage and high status chance (almost 400% after mods), meaning it can proc over 10 statuses per shot with multishot. The bulk of the damage comes from the direct hits, while the AOE provides free viral priming and some minor spread damage.

This is ideally used with an external flat crit chance buff since it has 1% cc but a whopping 3 cd, although the weapon innately can get +25% flat cc from 5 puncture procs which is enough to already benefit from the crit damage. Other sources include Arcane Avenger, Harrow, Citrine, Sevagoth, Adarza Kavat.

**Patch / update history (from the guide)**

**UPDATE MARCH 2025**

Magnetic progenitor is the most flexible allowing you to still make blast, electric, heat and toxin variants easily.

**UPDATE SEPT 2024**

Blast has been buffed and can deal good AOE status damage on weapons with very high status, provided they can stack 10 blast within 1.5s

**Additional notes from the guide**

**BUILD BREAKDOWN**

Galvanized Aptitude: applies to the direct hit component which accounts for 90% of total DPS and stacks 80% dmg per status. At 6 innate statuses, Galvanized Aptitude gives +480% damage which is much higher than serration and Semi-Rifle Cannonade. This is also gives 80% status chance which is very good for Sporothrix. The small AOE component predominantly applies innate viral status in a tiny 2m range and does not really require much boosting.

Galv Chamber: Mandatory multishot

Thermite + Rime Rounds: makes blast for AOE clearing, see below for elemental variations e.g. pure electric, heat or toxin

Rifle Elementalist: multiplicative 1.9x to status damage e.g blast or electric procs

Hammer Shot: Gives even more status chance as well as crit damage which boosts average DPS.

Volatile Variant: gives more explosion radius, punchthrough and status chance, great for clearing crowds better. Optional if you want to use this specifically for single targets.

Primed Bane of Grineer/Corrupted: Applies separate 1.55x multiplier to base damage and double dips status procs for 2.4025x multiplier.

Primary Crux: gives ammo efficiency and further boosts status chance

**FLEXIBLE OPTIONS**

Vital Sense: Even more crit damage, especially important if running flat crit chance boosts

Target Acquired: If you headshot, you get a 1.6x multiplier, separate to base dmg and bane mods, but additive to the 50% headshot bonus when zoomed, giving a final dps boost of 40%. This is still higher than what Serration gives, but less than Vital Sense when at 5 puncture procs for external crit chance.

Amalgam Serration/normal Serration: Gives more damage without needing to build stacks, but is ultimately additive to Primary Merciless and Galv Aptitude meaning it only gives about 21% final DPS boost.

Semi-Rifle Cannonade: gives more dmg than Serration, less damage than galv aptitude, but also locks fire rate which may not be desired if running external fire rate

Vile Acceleration: Increase fire rate which boosts DPS by 90%. Can offload if using external fire rate sources.

Pure Electric (best for murmur): swap Thermite Rounds and Rime Rounds for Stormbringer + High Voltage
Pure Heat (best for single targets): swap Rime Rounds for Hellfire
Pure Toxin (best for corpus): Swap thermite rounds and rime rounds for Infected Clip and Malignant Force

**Final recommendation**

Use this if you want Coda Sporothrix as a gun option for general steel path (per build title). It carries a written guide (above).

- Blast DoT has wider AOE clearance but slightly worse single target DPS. Works best alongside Roar to. Swap Vile Acceleration and High Voltage for Primed Cryo Rounds + Thermite Rounds to make blast, ideally offloading fire rate to external fire rate- Elemental mods: see below for element options, but usually you will run between 1 to 2 element mods depending on the combo and any shards.

To make Blast:
- Primed Cryo Rounds + Thermite Rounds (need to drop vile accel) - primed cryo gives higher blast weighting and more raw damage vs rime rounds which gives a bit more status chance. Ultimately it is best to have higher raw dmg

- Vile acceleration: increases charge rate significantly - can offload if you run external fire rate eg reinforced bond, arcane acceleration, buffs

- Point Strike and Galvanized Scope can give even more crit chance but is additive to acuity

**Element choice & faction notes**

**Electric/Corrosive**

The key element is electric from Primed Charged Shelll, which combines with toxin on primary fire to make corrosive damage, which is effective against Grineer and also electric to the viral damage on secondary fire. This ultimately gives Galvanized Savvy up to 6 different elements split between primary and alt-fire.

When combined with a grouping ability such as Nidus Larva, Khora's ensnare or Vauban's vortex, the electric procs from the alt-fire create tons of chaining arcs of electricity whch deals massive damage to a group. Any heavily armored enemies that survive the electical storm onslaught can be easily finished off by primary fire's high crit chance projectiles boosted by the viral procs created by the secondary fire.

If you prefer to only use alt-fire to nuke trash mobs with Electric, replace Galvanized Savvy with Shotgun Elementalist, Critical deceleration with Shell Shock and Primed Ravage with primed ammo stock

**Cold/Viral**

Adding Chilling Reload or Primed Chilling Grasp creates viral on the primary fire and adds cold on the alt-fire. (note Primed Chilling Grasp would NOT fit unless you change the innate - polarity to a D). Cold on the alt-fire allows you to slow enemies by up to 80%, applying even through Overguard (but capped at 4 stacks), as well as boosting crit damage by a flat 0.5 to 1x. You can consider using Primary Frostbite in the arcane slot too.

**Additional notes from the guide**

**Progenitor**

Magnetic and Radiation are both good as they provide another element for Galvanized Savvy and don't mess up elemental combinations you wish to make.
Magnetic status is great against shields and overguard and means you can run Shotgun Barrage instead of Magnetic Strafe for more fire rate, while also running Atomic Fallout for a little extra magazine capacity which helps with overall feel.
Radiation status is only useful for Galvanized Savvy and means you can replace Atomic Fallout for Magnetic Strafe or Primed Ammo Stock/Tactical Pump. Note that some enemies such as Demolysts are immune to radiation status entirely so if you are using Bubonico against these, a radiation progenitor would be useless.

**Pure Toxin**

An anti-corpus version uses pure toxin on both primary and altfire to bypass shields, simply replace Primed Charged Shell with Contagious Spread.
See anti-corpus version:

Here is a brief rundown of the mods:
- Galvanized Hell : Gives up to +230% multishot
- Galvanized Savvy:  Adds 80% extra status chance, good for alt-fire, and increases damage of primary fire based on amount of status procs - giving up to +80% damage for each status. Since alt-fire has such high status, all enemies will be afflicted with viral and electricity equating to +160% extra damage. After a few shots of primary fire, it will likely proc IPS + corrosive,  giving a maximum damage bonus of +480% damage at 6 statuses. Note that as of writing this (Update 30.7), Galvanized Savvy damage bonus does NOT apply to secondary fire AOE, but does apply to the primary fire, and is infact multipicative to primary merciless and primed point blank.
- Primed Point Blank: Adds 165% damage which is multiplicative to Galv Savvy, but additive to Merciless/Deadhead.
- Critical Deceleration : +200% crit chance, much greater than that offered by blunderbuss, but at the cost of fire rate
- Shotgun Barrage/Magnetic Strafe: to offset the fire rate penalty from critical deceleration and increase DPS. Magnetic adds an extra element for Galv Savvy and has good bonus against shield/overguard.
- Primed Ravage : Critical damage
- Atomic Fallout: magazine capacity improves the feel of shooting so you reload less and radiation adds another element for Galv Savvy
- Primed Charged Shell : gives high raw corrosive damage for primary fire and electric procs for secondary fire. Use **Shell Shock** if no Primed Charged Shell.

**Flexible Options**

You can replace any of the above mods if you dont own them or prefer not to run them with the following:
- Primed Tactical Pump/Seeking Fury - improves quality of life and reload increases recharge speed
- Primed Cleanse Grineer: Double dips on slash and electric procs by increasing base damage and DoT proc amount. Use regular **Cleanse Grineer** if no primed version. Can swap out for cleanse corrupted or infested if required depending on faction.
- Primed Ammo Stock - improves quality of life as you can dump more magazine before needing to recharge

**Final recommendation**

Use this if you want Coda Bubonico as a gun option for general steel path (per build title). It carries a written guide (above).

_Not specified in the source guide._

**Mod notes (defining mods, Galvanized, faction, flexible slots)**

- Serration: Mandatory base damage, amalgam version gives extra sprint speed and is OPTIONAL. Galvanized Aptitude does NOT apply to lightning strikes.
- Vital Sense: Mandatory crit damage
- Primary Acuity/Galvanized Chamber: see above, interchangeable with each other depending on preference
- Critical Delay: Crit delay is mandatory if using Galv Chamber, not mandatory if using acuity
- Galvanized Crosshairs: even more additive critical damage, synergizes with headshots and can be stacked by lightning strikes that headshot, but is limited by stack issues as all stacks drop off when one expires. Flexible slot.
- Stormbringer + High Voltage: gives raw elemental damage multiplier (i.e. 1.9x multiplier) and also boosts electric status damage (also 1.9x mutliplier). High Voltage helps electric damage and status chance further if you have a free slot. High Voltage is flexible if using lots of +Violet Electric Damage shards (e.g. 3 or more) for Hammer Shot
- Primed Shred: boosts fire rate and adds punchthrough which helps build sniper combo and spawn lightning strikes. Flexible for Vile Acceleration if using more single target or can even swap off if using reinforced bond and external fire rate sources.

- Vigilante Supplies: gives a tiny chance of boost crit to next tier, rank 0 saves forma. use max rank if you can fit

**Arcane & Exilus**

- Primary Crux: gives huge status chance boost to improve electric status proc consistency and ammo efficiency improves overall feel and quality of life.
- Primary Deadhead: gives big base damage boost (+360%) on headshot kills and headshot multiplier (1.3x) is additive to target acquired and also double dips electric status on headshots

**Additional notes from the guide**

**ACUITY VS CHAMBER**

Acuity is INTERCHANGEABLE with Galvanized Chamber.
- Acuity hits hardest on headshots by applying +350% headshot damage (additive to base 3x headshot multiplier but actually applies 525% bonus rather than the listed 350%, meaning a final multiplier of 2.75x on headshots) and +350% critical chance (additive to other crit chance mods). This also applies to lightning strikes when created from a headshot, however, you do get punished greatly for missing headshots.
- Multishot allows you to spawn more potential lightning strikes per shot and is more consistent in DPS particularly if you are NOT hitting consistent headshots

This is largely up to personal preference and how much you want to oneshot single targets (use acuity) vs clearing crowds (use multishot).

**FLEXIBLE OPTIONS**

- Primed Bane: Highest DPS option: multiplicative to all other bonuses by 1.55x and double dips status damage for 2.4x , need to swap to appropriate faction and is additive to Roar
- Target Acquired: multiplicative 1.6x multiplier on headshots (additive to primary deadhead) and double dips electric statuses that occur on headshots (2.56x multiplier).
- Hammer Shot: gives critical damage and status damage

**Final recommendation**

Use this if you want Vadarya Prime as a gun option for farming / loot. It carries a written guide (above).

Use alt-fire to launch a homing Glaive with 6m AOE. Do NOT use Galv Acceleration or +projectile flight speed as this messes with the Glaive's homing pathing.

Elements are optional. Magnetic allows Primary Obstruct to jam enemy weapons for crowd control and Gas creates lingering passive status everywhere.
Viral boosts all damage to health but doing viral radiation is wasted since Atomic Fallout exists.
Corrosive boosts damage to armored enemies but doing corrosive blast is somewhat wasted on a primer as blast status clears itself after 1.5s

Total possible statuses = viral + radiation + magnetic (modded), blast (innate), heat, electric, toxin, cold (innate one per disc), slash (direct glaive hit) =9 on direct hit

Final status chance = 50% x (1+2.4+0.9+1) = 265% after double/bullet jump

For pure viral priming, drop Scattering Inferno and Shell Shock for Lingering Torment and Vigilante Armaments.

- Electric has +50% bonus against Murmur and is a strong DoT status for both single target and multiple targets as it has a small 3m AOE effect. Electric can also be boosted by Shock Trooper and Violet Archon Shards. Having Shock Trooepr or Violet Archon shards for +primary electric damage allows you to drop Stormbringer for Rifle Elementalist (more damage in general) or Magnetic Capacity (stronger against Thrax/eximus)

- Heat has a +50% bonus against Infested and is strong single target status which constantly refreshes all existing stacks upon application and also slowly strips armor by 50% after 2s. Swap Stormbringer for Hellfire.

- Viral status boosts all damage to health by up to 4.25x at 10 viral

Best damage subsumes are Roar which double dips status DPS and Shock with Shock Trooper which boosts electric and allows you to replace Stormbringer.

**Final recommendation**

Use this if you want Torid as a gun option for farming / loot. It carries a written guide (above).

**Build overview**

This variant helps gaurantee one shots on levelcap Thrax for cascade while still allowing Acid Shells to oneshot enemies on spreading.

This is a build specifically to be used with Saryn's Toxic Lash + either Roar or Full strip with spores. This is because by itself, Acid Shells isn't very good in Steel Path, as it currently ignores SP modifiers and scales off the max health of a non-SP enemy (i.e. it is 2.5x weaker than advertised in SP). Also while Acid Shells scales with HP, it deals corrosive + blast damage in AOE which require full armor strip to be effective. When used with Saryn however, Acid Shells is capable of inducing a chain reaction that can spread across an entire map. When an enemy is killed with Toxic Lash active, Acid Shells will deal 450 corrosive dmg + 45% HP blast dmg in a 15m radius, and each enemy hit will have a toxin DoT created that scales off the Acid Shells damage. If this new enemy hit subsequently dies from the Tox DoT, it will create another Acid Shells explosion centered on this new enemy. As long as enemies stand within 15m of each other, this chain reaction can spread across a map.

**Mod configuration**

- Acid Shells — R5
- Magnetic Strafe — R3
- Clip Delegation — R5 — D · Vazarin
- Critical Deceleration — R5
- Contagious Spread — R5 — – · Naramon
- Shotgun Elementalist — R5
- Galvanized Savvy — R10
- Galvanized Hell — R10 — V · Madurai
- Narrow Barrel — R5 — V · Madurai

**Weapon identity & damage engine**

This variant helps gaurantee one shots on levelcap Thrax for cascade while still allowing Acid Shells to oneshot enemies on spreading.

This is a build specifically to be used with Saryn's Toxic Lash + either Roar or Full strip with spores. This is because by itself, Acid Shells isn't very good in Steel Path, as it currently ignores SP modifiers and scales off the max health of a non-SP enemy (i.e. it is 2.5x weaker than advertised in SP). Also while Acid Shells scales with HP, it deals corrosive + blast damage in AOE which require full armor strip to be effective. When used with Saryn however, Acid Shells is capable of inducing a chain reaction that can spread across an entire map. When an enemy is killed with Toxic Lash active, Acid Shells will deal 450 corrosive dmg + 45% HP blast dmg in a 15m radius, and each enemy hit will have a toxin DoT created that scales off the Acid Shells damage. If this new enemy hit subsequently dies from the Tox DoT, it will create another Acid Shells explosion centered on this new enemy. As long as enemies stand within 15m of each other, this chain reaction can spread across a map.

REQUIREMENTS:
- Saryn TOXIC LASH with ROAR
- Tauforged Emerald Shards for +45% toxin status damage (additive to elementalist which is why it isn't slotted)
- Arcane Rage on Primary Slot
- COLD Progenitor to create Viral

With everything at maximum stacks (Clip Delegation, Primary Blight, Galvanized Savvy, Galvanized Hell), a single Point Blank headshot can onetap a levelcap thrax before the toxin from toxic lash can even proc and a bodyshot will onetick (requires 1s for toxin status tick). Without full stacks it might take two headshots or 1-2 extra seconds of waiting for toxin statuses.

**Crit / status / multishot mechanics**

If you prefer not to rely on building stacks, or maintaing a duration, use Primed Point Blank. If you run primary merciless, this slot should be replaced with Elementalist or Shotgun Barrage.

Toxic Barrage/Contagious Spread - Toxin mods *DOUBLE DIP* on toxic lash procs by multiplying the toxic lash damage and toxic DoTs

Shotgun Elementalist - boosts toxic lash status dmg by another 1.9x, but this is additive to emerald +toxin status shards. The magazine capacity also feels nice.

Magnetic Strafe - adds fire rate and magnetic status. Magnetic status helps oneshot Thrax as magnetic has a bonus against overguard.

Clip Delegation - optional but helps guarantee Thrax one-shot while at full stacks. Flexible for Toxic Barrage, Primed Cleanse

Critical Deceleration - adds critical chance

**Additional notes from the guide**

**PROGENITOR**

The Progenitor type is completely optional since it DOESN'T affect Acid Shells or Toxic Lash. You could do MAGNETIC which is the most flexible element (allows you to run all elemental combos for any use case particularly if you plan on using it outside of Saryn/Oraxia/Cyte) or COLD (allows you to make viral with just Toxin mods for Saryn/Oraxia or magnetic with just electric mods/violet shards which is good for Cyte).

**CALCULATIONS**

After testing, the Progenitor Bonus, Critical Multiplier and Base Damage all do NOT affect the Toxin DoT of Toxic Lash when triggered by Acid Shells AOE explosion. The formula for Toxic Lash DoT scaling from Acid Shells AOE is :

(450 + 45% HP) x  (1+toxin mods) x ( 1+ toxin mods + other elemental mods) x (1+faction mods)^3 x (1+status damage)

As you can see faction mods TRIPLE DIP, toxin mods DOUBLE DIP while elemental mods and status damage mods single dip on the Tox Lash DoT.

Note the HP is for base starchart values, ignoring the steel path 2.5 modifier.

**Final recommendation**

Use this if you want Kuva Sobek as a gun option for level cap, base star chart, void cascade. It carries a written guide (above).

**Additional notes from the guide**

**ELEMENTAL COMBINATION**

- Corrosive Heat: highest single target DPS option against armored enemies. Element mods gives raw elemental damage that multiplies with damage. Corrosive strips some armor by up to 80% at 10 procs, heat strip armor even more (multiplying with corrosive to 90% strip maximum) and also applies damage over time. Hellfire is flexible for Magnetic Capacity, Galvanized Scope, Vital Sense.
- Blast: helps with AOE clearance, best used alongside Xata's whisper to boost the blast procs, add Primed Bane to maximise this

**WARFRAME SYNERGIES**

Coda Hema consumes health on reload and Necrophagic Vigor gives maximum buff if your frame has at least 720HP. Coda Hema also heals you to maximum on headshot.
To take full advantage of Coda Hema then we want a frame that naturally builds high health and benefits form healing:
- Inaros (persistence)
- Oraxia (persistence)
- Grendel (persistence)
- Chroma (persistence)
- Nidus (persistence)

**Final recommendation**

Galv Hell - helps get the initial kill to start chain reaction, but does NOT affect Acid Shells or the chaining Resupply DoT.

Primed Cleanse Grineer/Corrupted/Corpus/Murmur - faction mods TRIPLE DIP on Resupply procs. If you want to use this against thrax or narmer which currently do not have a faction mod, consider dropping this for Magnetic Strafe, Shell Shock, Clip Delegation, Frail Momentum

Primed Charged Shell +/- Shell Shock - Electric mods DOUBLE DIP on electric Resupply DoTs but would be additive to any Violet shards you run.

Shotgun Elementalist - boosts Resupply status dmg by another 1.9

Shotgun Barrage - more fire rate so you can spam shots through walls. Add arcane tempo on frame for even more fire rate.

**Weapon identity & damage engine**

This is ONLY for use with a Mecha Kubrow (e.g. Huras) :

If no riven, just run Amalgam Serration for sprint speed.

Paris Prime has a base SC of 20%, and the Incarnon evolution IV Elemental Balance adds 60% base SC to give a final BASE status chance of 80%.

Modding all possible status chance mods including a riven and Bhisaj-Bal gives a maximum possible +status of +635%, making the final modded SC of Paris Prime equal to 588%.

Mecha Overdrive on kubrow claws transfers 60% of this value as FLAT status chance to the base 5% status, giving you 5% + 588% x 60% = 358%.

Ideally run with Arcane Tempo + Reinforced Bond + Tenacious Bond and Energized Munitions

**Crit / status / multishot mechanics**

Final: Range 300 · Ammo Max 120 · Magazine 42 · Fire Rate 7.934 · Crit Chance 0.45 · Crit Damage 4.2 · Reload Speed 1 · Base Damage Mult 2.65. No mechanic breakdown in the guide.

**Element choice & faction notes**

**WHY MAGNETIC?**

The two primed elemental mods on shotguns (Primed Chilling Grasp and Charged Shell) each provide a +165% raw damage boost, while an Incendiary Coat is equivalent to a 90% x 1.5 = 135% raw damage boost, which is lower than a primed elemental despite the weakness of hemocyte to heat. If you however do NOT own Primed elemental mods, you should run Incendiary Coat + Blaze instead.

For example final damage multipliers between different combinations of mods are as follows:
Primed Point Blank + Primed Charged Shell + Primed Chilling Grasp: (1+1.65)x(1+1.65+1.65)=11.395
Primed Point Blank + Primed Charged Shell + Primed Cleanse: (1+1.65)x(1+1.65)x1.55=10.8849
Primed Point Blank + Incendiary Coat + Blaze: (1+1.65+0.6)x(1+0.9x1.5+0.6x1.5)=10.5625

You can free up even another Primed Element mod if you run any Violet +elec primary shards and replace this with atomic fallout, shotgun elementalist for more magazine capacity, or Primed Tactical Pump/Chilling Reload for more reload speed.

**Build overview**

One of the strongest weapons in the game currently. The primary fire feels like a lex prime but hits a truck. Getting 12 headshots charges up it's Incarnon mode (can be shortened to about 3-4 shots with multishot). Switching to Incarnon mode with alt-fire makes it feel like a pocket Acceltra with small AOE on impact but with significant damage. This build is a raw damage non-crit build using Devouring Attrition.

**Mod configuration**

- Primed Heated Charge — R10 — – · Naramon
- Pistol Pestilence — R3

- Augur Pact — R5
- Accelerated Isotope — R3 — V · Madurai
- Lethal Torrent — R5 — V · Madurai
- Hornet Strike — R10 — V · Madurai
- Galvanized Diffusion — R10 — V · Madurai

*Exilus:* Lethal Momentum
*Arcane:* Secondary Fortifier (R5)

*Resulting stats:* Range 0 · Ammo Max 210 · Magazine 12 · Fire Rate 5 · Crit Chance 0.22 · Crit Damage 2.2 · Reload Speed 1 · Base Damage Mult 4.1

**Weapon identity & damage engine**

One of the strongest weapons in the game currently. The primary fire feels like a lex prime but hits a truck. Getting 12 headshots charges up it's Incarnon mode (can be shortened to about 3-4 shots with multishot). Switching to Incarnon mode with alt-fire makes it feel like a pocket Acceltra with small AOE on impact but with significant damage. This build is a raw damage non-crit build using Devouring Attrition.

**Crit / status / multishot mechanics**

Final: Range 0 · Ammo Max 210 · Magazine 12 · Fire Rate 5 · Crit Chance 0.22 · Crit Damage 2.2 · Reload Speed 1 · Base Damage Mult 4.1. No mechanic breakdown in the guide.

**Element choice & faction notes**

Elements are whatever the mod list produces (see configuration). The guide gives no per-faction swap advice.

**Status weighting**

_Not specified in the source guide._

**Mod notes (defining mods, Galvanized, faction, flexible slots)**

- Galvanized Diffusion: Mandatory +230% multishot at max stacks, meaning you get at least 3 bullets per shot with a 30% chance for 4. This allows you to basically do 3x more damage AND charge incarnon mode 3x faster. If you want the mobility boost you can just run Amalgam Barrel Diffusion instead.

- Hornet Strike: Mandatory +220% damage which is multiplicative with devouring attrition and additive with secondary deadhead/flare. Galvanized shot is not used here since it does NOT work on the AOE component (which is responsible for 75% of total damage).

- Lethal Torrent: Brings multishot to 3.9 so 90% of shots give 4 bullets, and gives fire rate (combined Rapid Wrath gives +80% fire rate total)

- If viral: Pistol Pestilence + Frostbite: makes viral and adds status chance so you can proc both viral and heat faster. Each viral proc boosts damage to health and viral dmg also has a bonus against corrupted.
- If corrosive: Primed Convulsion + Pistol Pestilence makes corrosive heat with high raw damage, and a little status chance from pistol pestilence to proc useful statuses

- Primed Heated Charge: Big elemental mod bonus on pistols to multiply raw damage. Heat procs also strip armor by 50% and can stack indefinitely, with each new stack refreshing all existing stacks.

- Augur Pact - useful for Augur set bonus for shield gating and gives minor additive damage boost. This is FLEXIBLE - see below.

- Accelerated Isotope - more fire rate and radiation damage. This is FLEXIBLE - see below.

Exilus:
Flexible
- Lethal Momentum - boosts projectile speed
- Steady Hands - recoil

**Arcane & Exilus**

- Secondary Fortifier: nice quality of life since it steals overguard (which blocks knockdown from the AOE) and Laetum is generally strong enough already, and very good for killing Thrax and Eximus. This is the recommended general quality of life option.

- Cascadia Flare: Gives an extra +120% additive damage bonus compared to deadhead (i.e. a +20% final DPS increase on bodyshots) but at the loss of -recoil and multiplicative headshot multiplier (reducing final headshot DPS by 10%). This is the recommended option for maximum DPS when not aiming for heads.

- Secondary Deadhead: Long upkeep times of +360% damage and gives -recoil and +headshot multiplier. Notably, this forces a 1.3x headshot multiplier that is multiplicative with the 3x base headshot multiplier on direct hit component (making it 3.9x) and the 1x base multiplier on AOE component. This is the recommended option of maximum DPS while aiming for heads.

- Secondary Merciless: Doesn't need headshots to upkeep, but stacks fall off quicker, and you get a neat reload bonus that helps with transform speed. Not as recommended

**Incarnon Genesis evolutions**

**Evolution Choices**

- Evolution I - Incarnon mode

- Evolution II - Rapid Wrath: +20% Fire rate. Can use recoil perk if you don’t use one of Secondary Deadhead or Steady hands, or prefer to use Lethal Momentum in exilus.

- Evolution III - Lethal Rearmament: +90% reload speed on headshot at 3 stacks. This also shortens the transformation animation to Incarnon mode from approx 3s to 1.5s.

- Evolution IV - Elemental Excess +20% status, -10% crit chance. Reducing crit chance increases the likelihood of Devouring Attrition boosted shots.

- Evolution V -  Devouring Attrition: 50% chance to do 2000% damage on non-critical hits. This is currently **multiplicative** to base damage mods such as Hornet Strike

**Warframe & companion synergy**

_Not specified in the source guide._

**External buffs assumed**

Not required for this build. The guide mentions rivens — see its text.

**Playstyle & target priority**

_Not written out._

**Steel Path / level-cap performance**
