**Variants**

_None described._

**Strengths & weaknesses**

_Not listed in the source guide. As a gun build its ceiling depends on the external buffs above._

**Patch / update history (from the guide)**

**UPDATE SEPT 2024**

Swapped arcane to Secondary Fortifier for free overguard and bonus against eximus/thrax.

**UPDATE JUNE 2024**

With the armor/health scaling changes, status rework and damage vulnerability rework, Viral Heat and Corrosive Heat are now the top status combinations. This is because heat is able to strip 50% armor after 2 seconds which currently reduces a 90% DR from armor cap to about 63% DR, which is equal to a 3.7x damage boost. Viral status boosts all damage to health by up to 4.25x at 10 stacks and 2x at 1 stack. In addition, corrupted enemies are now weak to viral by 50%. On the other hand Corrosive strips armor too and has a bonus against Grineer, and has access to Primed Convulsion.

**UPDATE APRIL 2024**

Xata's Whisper double dipping Devouring Attrition has been officially nerfed.

Other build options:
Crit Viral Heat Overwhelming Attrition (higher potential single target DPS):

**Additional notes from the guide**

**DEVOURING VS OVERWHELMING ATTRITION AVERAGE DPS COMPARISON**

This table compares average DPS calcs between Devouring Attrition vs Overwhelming Attrition. Calculations made with underframe.

![](

**TL,DR**

Use Devouring Attrition if you don't want to aim at heads and just spam AOE shots and are not running any external crit buffs.
Use Overwhelming Attrition if you want to be more precise and aim at heads consistently or have external crit buffs (e.g. crepuscular, warframe buffs)

**Flexible Options**

Augur Pact is your flexible slot:
- Primed Expel (flexible option): A further 1.55 multiplier to hornet strike/deadhead and Devouring Attrition and double dips on heat procs giving them 2.4x multiplier. Use regular expel mod if no primed version as it is still a 1.3 or 1.69x multiplier. No effect on Thrax/Archon/Acolytes etc
- Anemic Agility - increases sustained DPS but additive to lethal torrent and accelerated isotope
- Magnetic Might: adds magnetic damage and crit damage. magnetic status helps damage against overguard/shields. The crit dmg isn't very impactful on a non-crit build.
- Primed Fulmination - increases small AOE
- Magnum Force - more additive damage but reduces accuracy/increases spread, which can make getting headshots to charge incarnon mode more difficult but also allows incarnon mode to spread to a slightly wider area
- Galvanized Shot - this is a LAST RESORT option because it is a) additive to hornet strike and secondary deadhead and b) only applies to the non-AOE component which is only 25% of total damage. This basically means galv shot is effectively only a +40% dmg per status boost and only to a single enemy at a time. You could potentially use this if offloading viral from nourish since there just arent many other mod choices.
- Riven:
           Best Positives : multishot, damage, fire rate
           Okay positives : status chance, toxin, reload speed
           Best Negatives : crit chance

**ELEMENTAL VARIATIONS**

Corrosive Heat: good general use with highest raw damage, particularly when used alongside nourish since you get all good elements
Vira Heat: in a Vacuum this is the best elemental combo against armored enemies as heat strips some armor and viral multiplies all dmg
For Archon/Angel/Eidolon/Murmur: Use pure radiation or viral radiation

**Final recommendation**

Use this if you want Laetum as a gun option for steel path, eidolons. It carries a written guide (above).

Incarnon form becomes a fully automatic dual pistol with ricochet which retains part of the Frenzy Buff (on headshot, 3s buff of +150% fire rate (multiplies with fire rate mods), +100% toxin (acts like a 9th mod and additive to +elements) and -recoil by approximately 60%). Note the infinite ammo buff does NOT work on the Incarnon ammo.

Also note the ricochets from incarnon mode tend to easily hit the head REGARDLESS of whether your initial shot was a body shot or headshot, likely due to high spread and coverage as the ricochets do not actually 'seek' headshots. This makes the frenzy buff, crosshairs buff and deadhead buffs extremely consistent.

**Mod notes (defining mods, Galvanized, faction, flexible slots)**

- Galvanized Diffusion: Mandatory multishot +230%. You can swap this to Amalgam Barrel Diffusion if you want stackless and enjoy the rolling speed.

- Galvanized Shot: Base dmg mod +120% for every unique status, so +480% after impact, puncture, viral, slash. Note that currently, Galv Shot only applies its damage bonus to the original base dmg of 75 rather than 125. Also gives status chance which helps apply useful statuses like corrosive to apply strip. Can swap this to Hornet Strike if you want stackless damage.

- Primed Pistol Gambit + Galvanized Crosshairs: Boosts final CC to 188% after max stacks while aiming down sights. Adding Cascadia Overcharge or Secondary Outburst boosts final CC to above 200% for red crits. Finally adding Arcane Avenger to this can give guaranteed red crits. NOTE, stacking this many crit chance source is always an overall REDUCTION in total DPS.

- Primed Target Cracker: Mandatory CD mod brings CD to 6.3

- Primed Convulsion: Combines with the innate tox from Frenzy to form +190% Corrosive dmg. This saves a slot allowing you to run a bane more crit chance or damage.

- Lethal Torrent: Boosts fire rate and multishot. This is approximately a 46% final DPS boost with Frenzy active and 89% DPS boost without Frenzy active.

- Merciless Gunfight:  Punchthrough causes the initial enemy hit to STILL ricochet, and the second enemy hit creating a new ricochet instance. Every enemy punched through basically adds an additional instance of ricochet, basically doubling or tripling the amount of enemies hit potentially. Even the ricochet bullet appears to be able to puncthrough and reaches FURTHER than it would without puncthrough, basically extending the overall range of ricochet. This is flexible if you are using it more for single target.

**Arcane & Exilus**

Secondary Deadhead: Simplest option, procs from direct headshot kills which is very easy via ricochet, and gives extra 1.3x headshot multiplier, separate to the 3x normal headshot multiplier.

Secondary Fortifier: Removes overguard extremely quickly and gives it to your frame. Very good survivability quality of life and also kills Thrax/Eximus extremely quickly. Doesn't require stack maintenance.

Secondary Outburst: Absolute highest overkill DPS option but requires a bit of buildup/maintenance with either a weapon with Melee Crescendo + Finishers (to have permanent x12 combo) e.g. Furax Wraith and Vazarin snare ground finisher, Heavy Slam Magistar that can maintain 8-9x combo, Ceramic Dagger (for permanent x8-12x combo but needs primary kills instead of finishers) or just a gunblade/regular melee that you can build combo to x12 quickly but manually.

**Additional notes from the guide**

**Evolution II**: With Merciless on, Fevered Frenzy (+100% ms after 20 ability cast) gives ALOT more final DPS after 5 status effects (almost 250% more) compared to Carnage Reign. Without merciless on, Fevered Frenzy is 2% better. With Encumber on, Fevered Frenzy is identical to Carnage Reign. This is because like Galvanized Shot, the +33% damage from Carnage Reign is currently bugged in that it does not count the extra 60 base dmg. If one day this is fixed, Carnage Reign should be a bit better when running Overcharge or Encumber (by about 6-8%).

**Evolution III**: Marksman's Hand combines with Frenzy buff to completely Negate recoil even without Steady Aim in exilus. This frees up the exilus for anything of your preference.

**Evolution III**: Commodore's Fortune (+20% base cc) increases base CC to 31%, making final CC after mods 89%.

**Flexible options**

- Magnetic Might: gives magnetic and critical damage. Magnetic status is very good against overguard e.g. Thrax and Eximus

- Primed Expel: Boosts raw dmg by 55% which is multiplicative to Galv Shot/Deadhead (optional). Can slot over Seeker or Lethal Torrent if you like.

**Exilus**: Currently there is no real need to run an exilus because Steady Aim isn't necessary. This is totally up to personal preference, but you could run Targeting Subsystem to reduce spread or Spry Sights to increase movespeed while aiming, or just leave it empty to save forma.

**ELEMENTAL VARIANTS**

Corrosive: Use against armored Grineer due to each corrosive status stripping armor as it is applied and Corrosive having a +50% damage bonus.

Viral: Use against Corrupted and any ARMOR STRIPPED Grineer. Raw Viral damage has a 50% bonus against corrupted and any viral status procs multiply damage to health by up to 4.25x at 10 stacks. Replace Convulsion with Deep Freeze or Frostbite if you have no capacity.

Toxin: Use against Corpus because toxin bypasses shields to hit corpus +50% dmg. Replace Convulsion with Pathogen Rounds.

Radiation: Use against Murmur, swap Seeker or Primed Pistol Gambit for Primed Heated Charge

**Final recommendation**

Use this if you want Dual Toxocyst as a gun option for general steel path (per build title). It carries a written guide (above).

**Mod notes (defining mods, Galvanized, faction, flexible slots)**

Galvanized Shot: Mandatory +120% dmg per unique status, i.e. +480% dmg after proccing puncture, radiation, heat and viral.

Galvanized Diffusion: Mandatory +230% multishot at max stacks. Double dips status damage on beam weapons like Ocucor

Sentient Surge: Mandatory augment, allows you to maintain four tendrils without reloading and increases both CC and SC by up to +240% at 4 tendrils active.

Primed Target Cracker: For crit damage. this is flexible for Primed Expel Grineer/Corrupted or Pistol Elementalist. Note: with Puncture changes, Ocucor can now give itself +25% flat crit chance after 5 puncture procs, which makes Primed Target Cracker about 3% better than Primed Expel even without Arcane Avenger. If you run external crit damage eg Dagath's Grave Spirit or Tenacious Bond, Primed Expel would give higher DPS.

Lethal Torrent: Mandatory for fire rate and additional multishot which double dips status damage. If you run external fire rate eg  Wisp's Haste mote, Harrow's Penance,  Arcane Velocity or Reinforced Bond, Primed Expel would give higher DPS.

Pistol Pestilence + Ice Storm: Gives both status chance and viral status which boosts all health damage by 4.25x at 10 stacks. Ice Storm increases the amount of ammo reloaded per kill.

Primed Heated Charge: Boosts raw DPS and heat status DPS, which is your main source of damage. Heat procs have infinite scaling because they do not have a limit on most enemies.

Exilus: Either Ruinous Extension to Extend beam length or Primed Ammo Mutation if you have ammo issues.

**Arcane & Exilus**

Cascadia Flare: Easiest to maintain +480% dmg, you lose all stacks if it expires but you can build it back up to max in seconds

Secondary Fortifier: Great option for increasing survivability as you steal overguard without aiming. Swap Primed Heated Charge for Primed Convulsion.

Secondary Encumber: Theoretically gives 13 unique status effects after 2-3 seconds, meaning you get +1560% dmg from Galvanized Shot (1080 on top of the innate statuses), but only after a ramp up. Note however, only one enemy out of the initial target + four tendrils can be affected by encumbers status proc at any one instance so the overall effectiveness is reduced. This is a good option on single target applications in endurance where enemies take longer than 2-3 seconds to kill.

Secondary Merciless: Third best option, giving +360% dmg which decays every 3s

**Additional notes from the guide**

**INVOCATION**

Invocation slot is flexible for either a DPS option (magnetic might/primed expel/Accelerated Isotope) or a Utility option e.g. Xata Invocation (energy Regen), Netra Invocation (for efficiency), Ris Invocation (for duration) or Vome Invocation (for strength).

Canticle is also totally flexible, Lohk Canticle for more Noctua dps, Khra Canticle for more energy, Jahu for strip against armored enemies

**HORNET STRIKE/CASCADIA FLARE OR Galvanized Shot?**

Noctua has a strange damage formula where Galvanized Shot scales a separate 200 base damage that is NOT affected by strength:

250 x strength% x (1+damage%) + 200 x (1+Galvanized Shot%)

What this means effectively is that if you run Galvanized Shot with Secondary Encumber, the effect of strength becomes less significant on Noctua damage (which means arcane impetus doesn't provide much boost to noctua), and conversely if you run high strength and damage sources like Arcane Precision/Cascadia Flare, the effect of Galvanized Shot becomes less significant on Noctua damage (although note you still need to build strength for Pageflight which has a huge effect on status DPS).  Ultimately the max DPS difference between the two options (Galvanized Shot + Encumber vs Pistol Elementalist + Flare) is very minimal with Elementalist + Flare coming out only 2% better (assuming 13 statuses). However since Secondary Encumber takes a long time to stack to 13 statuses, the immediate burst DPS of elementalist + flare is significantly higher.

TLDR:
- If you want to boost all of Dante's abilities while still having high enough Noctua DPS, use Galvanized Shot + Secondary Encumber + Arcane Impetus
- If you want to focus PURELY on Noctua DPS, use maximum ability strength and +damage sources like cascadia flare/hornet strike/arcane precision: see viral heat DPS build

**Final recommendation**

Use this if you want Noctua as a gun option for general steel path (per build title). It carries a written guide (above).

**Element choice & faction notes**

**PROGENITOR: MAGNETIC**

Magnetic is used for both DPS and Priming as it allows you to run pure single elements such as electric, heat and toxin and swap between them without it combining. Magnetic status also boosts damage against overguard and shields and can create a corresponding strong electric proc upon breaking overguard that SCALES with enemy level.

**Electric vs Heat:**

Electric Status:
• Deals status damage instantly
• Double dips external headshot multipliers like deadhead (1.3x1.3=1.69x)
• Has a small AOE of up to 3m, improving crowd clearing ability
• Modded electric applies into the electric status created by magnetic status breaking Overguard/Shield
• Has bonus against Murmur

Heat Status:
• Deals status damage after 1s delay
• Stacks infinitely as each new status refreshes the duration of whole stack
• Benefits from heat inherit (inherits faction and heat damage bonuses from the first proc)
• Strips armor by up to 50% after 2s, which is equivalent to a 3.7x damage boost against armored enemies

TLDR:
• Electric is best against clearing crowds of weaker enemies or single unarmored enemies quicker
• Heat is best against bulky armored single target enemies that take a while to kill (e.g. unstripped demolyst)

**FLEXIBLE OPTIONS**

- Galvanized Crosshairs (only used if not running Secondary Enervate): At max stacks gives +320% critical chance making a final crit chance of 92%. Even at such as high crit chance, you still have approximately 5% chance per shot to activate a stack of Overwhelming, meaning approximately one shot in every 20 shots activates the buff (consider you can shoot about 12 shots per second with multishot and fire rate, meaning you will have a 20s buff refreshed every 2s). Primed Pistol Gambit is an alternative to Crosshairs. *NOTE* You only get the +320% crit chance when AIMING down sights. This means you can actually exceed 100% crit chance with stacking Primed Pistol Gambit or Cascadia Overcharge, but still activate overwhelming attrition by shooting while not aiming down sights. If you run Secondary Enervate you can completely drop all crit chance mods.

- We do not *need* to run Hornet Strike because Overwhelming Attrition is additive to it, but if you have empty slots these can be added. You should basically NEVER run Galvanized Shot because 75% of laetum's damage is AOE and completely ignores galvanized shots +dmg bonus.

- Primed Expel: A further 1.55 multiplier to hornet strike/deadhead and Devouring Attrition and double dips on heat procs giving them 2.4x multiplier. Use regular expel mod if no primed version as it is still a 1.3 or 1.69x multiplier. Flexible if you dont like faction mods.

- Primed Fulmination: boosts the small base AOE

**Red Crit Laetum - Harrow + Xata's Whisper**

The void damage instance of Xata's Whisper currently counts as as non-crit non-status component of Laetum's damage and therefore will proc Overwhelming Attrition regardless of your crit chance. This means you can run Harrow with Xata's Whisper and achieve **RED CRITS** while still getting the +1200% dmg of Overwhelming Attrition.

At 308% crit chance (achievable with Harrow Covenant + Arcane Avenger + Primed Pistol Gambit + Deadhead) on headshots, your final average multiplier actually becomes approx 1200x and you get guaranteed red crits.

![](

With Galvanized Crosshairs fully stacked, Cascadia Overcharged, Covenant and Avenger active, you can hit 403% final crit chance, meaning guaranteed tier 4 red crits (although you need to drop Secondary Deadhead and run the -recoil perk to maintain -100% recoil which actually reduces overall average DPS with final multiplier of approx 1100x). This is an example of a case where forcing yourself into the next tier of crits actually reduces your DPS.

Here is an example of Red Crit Laetum with Harrow:

[[ streamable id="1cqbhi" ]]

**Final recommendation**

Use this if you want Laetum as a gun option for farming / loot. It carries a written guide (above).

**Element choice & faction notes**

**PROGENITOR: MAGNETIC**

Magnetic is the most flexible element since it allows you to build heat, electric or toxin DoT without it combining, while also giving a bonus to overguard and shields (especially good against Eximus and Thrax).

**Electric vs Heat:**

Electric Status:
- Deals status damage instantly
- Double dips external headshot multipliers like deadhead (1.3x1.3=1.69x)
- Has a small AOE of up to 3m, improving crowd clearing ability
- Modded electric applies into the electric status created by magnetic status breaking Overguard/Shield
- Has bonus against Murmur

Heat Status:
- Deals status damage after 1s delay
- Stacks infinitely as each new status refreshes the duration of whole stack
- Benefits from heat inherit (inherits faction and heat damage bonuses from the first proc)
- Strips armor by up to 50% after 2s, which is equivalent to a 3.7x damage boost against armored enemies

TLDR:
- Electric is best against clearing crowds of weaker enemies or single unarmored enemies quicker
- Heat is best against bulky armored single target enemies that take a while to kill (e.g. unstripped demolyst)

**Status weighting**

- Primed Pistol Gambit: mandatory critical chance
- Primed Target Cracker: mandatory critical damage
- Lethal Torrent: optional fire rate + multishot. Flexible if running external fire rate e.g. arcane velocity, amalgam furax, reinforced bond
- Supportive element (viral): Raw viral damage has a 1.5x bonus against corrupted enemies. Viral status also boosts all damage to health by up to 4.25x at 10 stacks. Ice Storm is optional but increases magazine size which improves overall sustained DPS.
- Damaging element (heat/electric): The Primed elemental mods (Primed Heated Charge or Primed Convulsion) both add a large amount of raw elemental damage, while the damage over time from heat or electric also contribute a bit to overall DPS.

- Steady Hands: helps with recoil, flexible for ammo mutation

**Arcane & Exilus**

- Secondary Deadhead: gives more base damage after direct headshot kills, and also applies a multiplicative 1.3x headshot multiplier to the regular 3x headshot multi. Electric status can double dip this on headshots for a 1.69x multiplier.
- Secondary Fortifier: strips overguard much quicker and also steals overguard. Best against Thrax and Eximus, while also giving free survivability. Good overall quality of life.
- Secondary Encumber: applies random statuses which helps maximise the damage bonus from Galvanized Shot, but takes a while to ramp up meaning most enemies are dead before you see any benefit. Would be best on extremely bulky targets like demolyst.
- Secondary Outburst: gives the highest possible DPS boost but is a little annoying to upkeep since you need a melee with either initial combo from Galvanized Reflex (5x on most slam melees, 8x on Magistar), 12x from Melee Crescendo which requires finishers or 12x from Ceramic Dagger which requires primary kills.

- Primed Heated Charge: Gives raw heat damage which has a 25% damage bonus against cloned flesh, heat procs which deal damage over time and procs Cascadia Flare to provide base damage

- Akimbo Slip Shot: gives ammo efficiency, but requires you to mod base damage with hornet strike e.g. over Lethal Torrent
- Outburst: highest damage but needs stacking crescendo, need to swap Primed Target Cracker for Hornet Strike
- Enervate: good for stackless damage (not relying on conditionals like flare), need to swap Primed Pistol Gambit for Hornet Strike

Final: Range 0 · Ammo Max 210 · Magazine 10 · Fire Rate 5.333 · Crit Chance 0.459 · Crit Damage 3.36 · Reload Speed 1 · Base Damage Mult 3.2. No mechanic breakdown in the guide.

**Element choice & faction notes**

Elements are whatever the mod list produces (see configuration). The guide gives no per-faction swap advice.

**Status weighting**

_Not specified in the source guide._

**Mod notes (defining mods, Galvanized, faction, flexible slots)**

• Galvanized Diffusion: mandatory for +230% multishot at max stacks
• Hornet strike: optional non-conditional base damage additive to Flare but doesn't drop to 0 if you take breaks from getting kills
• Primed Pistol Gambit: mandatory critical chance
• Primed Target Cracker: mandatory critical damage
• Lethal Torrent: optional fire rate + multishot. Flexible if running external fire rate e.g. arcane velocity, amalgam Furax, Reinforced Bond
• Supportive element (viral): Raw viral damage has a 1.5x bonus against corrupted enemies. Viral status also boosts all damage to health by up to 4.25x at 10 stacks. Ice Storm is optional but increases magazine size which improves overall sustained DPS.
• Damaging element (heat/electric): The Primed elemental mods (Primed Heated Charge or Primed Convulsion) both add a large amount of raw elemental damage, while the damage over time from heat or electric also contribute a bit to overall DPS.

Why not Galvanized Shot?
Currently Galvanized Shot is bugged on most Incarnon weapons, only applying to the base damage (60) and ignoring the dmg from the perks eg +50 from Fatal Affliction. Additionally, Galv Shot does NOT apply to the AOE component which actually accounts for approx 65% of total damage (excluding headcrits and headshot multi). The +120% dmg per status is also additive to +40% dmg per status from Fatal Affliction, slightly reducing the overall impact of Galv Shot. Finally, Despair has a very lopsided weighting with 80% puncture at base, meaning after mods we have final weights of approximately 1% impact, 4% slash, 20% puncture, 31% viral and 43% heat. The chances of proccing impact or slash are so minimal that we effectively consider Despair as having 3 statuses to boost Galvanized Shot in most cases. Using an external primer and applying at least 5 statuses total does allow Galv Shot to overtake Hornet Strike and Primed Expel.

Flex choices:
- Magnetic Might: magnetic dmg and crit dmg
- Primed Fulmination: increases 4m AOE to 5.76m.

**Arcane & Exilus**

Cascadia Flare gives a large amount of base damage
Secondary Deadhead gives the highest multiplier if you aim at heads alot (5.98x) and also forces a 1.3x headshot multiplier on the AOE component when you get headshots.
Secondary Fortifier gives free overguard

- Lethal Torrent: This is a flexible option, but can also offload firerate to external sources such as arcane velocity, frame buffs, reinforced bond.

- Primed Expel: multiplicative to galv shot and flare, double dips heat DoT as well as Xata's whisper

**VARIATIONS**

- Corrosive Heat : best for non-full stripped Grineer/Corrupted/Thrax
- Viral Heat: best for full stripped Grineer/Corrupted/Thrax (Swap Primed Convulsion for Cold mod)
- Radiation: best for murmur/corpus robots (Swap Tox mod out for one of the flex options like Lethal Torrent/Anemic Agility/Expel Mod)
- Magnetic Heat: for Thrax especially with Nourish

**Additional notes from the guide**

**HORNET STRIKE/CASCADIA FLARE OR Galvanized Shot?**

Noctua has a strange damage formula where Galvanized Shot scales a separate 200 base damage that is NOT affected by strength:

250 x strength% x (1+damage%) + 200 x (Galvanized Shot%)

What this means effectively is that if you run Galvanized Shot with Secondary Encumber, the effect of strength becomes less significant on Noctua damage, and conversely if you run high strength and damage sources like Arcane Precision/Cascadia Flare, the effect of Galvanized Shot becomes less significant on Noctua damage (although note you still need to build strength for Pageflight which has a huge effect on status DPS). Ultimately the max DPS difference between the two options (Galvanized Shot + Encumber vs Pistol Elementalist + Flare) is very minimal with Elementalist + Flare coming out 2% better (assuming 13 statuses). However since Secondary Encumber takes a long time to stack to 13 statuses, the immediate burst DPS of elementalist + flare becomes significantly higher.

**Final recommendation**

Use this if you want Noctua as a gun option for farming / loot. It carries a written guide (above).

**Element choice & faction notes**

**What is Heat Inherit?**

The status effect of heat causes enemies to take heat damage every second over 6 seconds according to the formula

**0.5 x modded base damage x (1+heat damage) x (1+faction damage) x critical multipliers**

Each additional application of a heat status adds a stack of heat damage AND refreshes the 6 second duration. However, every subsequent heat proc uses the heat damage and faction damage from the very first stack applied. This means if you use a 'heat primer' with max +heat damage mods and +faction damage mods, then switch to a 'DPS weapon' with only one heat mod that can consistently reapply heat status but with damage, crit and faction mods, every heat proc will actually 'inherit' the heat/faction mods from the primer while taking the modded base damage and critical multipliers from the DPS weapon.

This interaction can also allow abilities that deal heat status to inherit heat and faction mods that they normally do NOT possess, thereby boosting their damage significantly. For example, the following abilities can make use of heat inherit:
- Gauss: Thermal Sunder (heat cast)
- Ember: fireball, fireblast and inferno
- Hildryn: Blazing Pillage
- Citrine: Pristmatic Gem
- Voruna: Fangs of Raksh
- Nova: Neutron star
- Protea: Blaze Artillery
- Excalibur: Exalted Blade (with heat)
- Baruuk: Serene Storm (with heat modded)
- Nezha: Chakram/fire walker

**Additional notes from the guide**

Evo 2: Headcracker - up to 70% fire rate for 4s (has a 50% chance to activate on headshot) or Prolific Perforation for up to +80% cc if you hit enemeis with punchthrough. I would use headcracker if using Ballistica as a single target boss killer and Prolific Perforation for crowd clearing.
Evo 3: Rapid Reinforcement - +50% reload speed affects incarnon transformation speed and we already run lethal momentum for projectile speed
Evo 4: Critical Parallel - for raw damage variant OR Elemental Balance for status variant. With elemental buffs like Nourish, you would be best going with raw damage variant like Corrosive Heat. With Roar you might be better with status variant like viral heat, blast, gas.

CORROSIVE HEAT
Highest single target damage on enemies that take less than 2s to kill, which is basically 99% of enemies up to levelcap. As pistols have two primed elemental mods, running Corrosive + Heat gives you the highest raw elemental damage multiplier and is able to oneshot basically everything in the game, while also providing useful statuses as corrosive partially strips armor, heat partially strips armor and deals damage over time. Adding Nourish to this makes it even stronger.

VIRAL HEAT
You can swap Primed Convulsion for Frostbite and evolution 4 to Elemental Balance for a more heat status focused build, which becomes stronger than raw damage once enemies take longer than about 2s to kill due to the accumulation of heat procs. The only enemies that might fit this criteria would be a levelcap demolyst and eximus units. Run Roar for buff.

VIRAL ELECTRIC
If you have external armor strip or are fighting unarmored enemies, Viral Electric would be clearing groups slightly faster and has slightly quicker single target damage than viral heat (as electric ticks at 0s, then at 2s, rather than only after 1s like heat). Use 60/60 tox + cold to make viral and Primed Convulsion for electric. Run Elemental balance evolution. Swap arcane to Deadhead or Fortifier. Run Roar or Shock Trooper for buff.

BLAST
Has best immediate AOE clear as blast status explodes in a 5m radius. Swap Pistol Pestilence/Primed Convulsion for Frostbite + Primed Expel, Pistol Elementalist or Hornet Strike. Swap arcane to Deadhead. Run Elemental balance evolution. Run roar for buff.

GAS
Has best lingering AOE clear as gas status deals damage in 3m going up to up to 6 m radius (at 10 stacks). Swap Primed Convulsion for Primed Expel, Pistol Elementalist or Hornet Strike. Swap arcane to Deadhead. Run Elemental balance evolution.

**Final recommendation**

Use this if you want Ballistica Prime as a gun option for level cap, bossing. It carries a written guide (above).

**Mod notes (defining mods, Galvanized, faction, flexible slots)**

- Sovereign Outcast Stance: Arguably the most important mod. The neutral light attack combo (Rogue Edict) has a ridiculous average damage multiplier of 859.6%/s, one of the highest in the game (behind Final Harbinger) that also has FOUR forced slash procs on every 3rd hit each with a 200% multiplier. The forward block combo (Villain Rule) also has a Slam attack on 4th hit which helps gain more combo via Shockwave Synergy, so you can seamlessly weave in slams into your combos.

- Condition Overload: +80% damage per status effect. This is NOT capped by the number of unique statuses i.e. with impact, puncture, slash statuses alone you get +240% damage per hit. Paired with a primer such as Kuva Nukor or Epitaph, you can get up to 8 unique statuses for +640% damage per hit.

- Galvanized Steel: boosts crit chance by 110% and crit damage by 120%

- Weeping Wounds: +440% status chance at x12 combo, giving 108% status. This means with each hit you are guaranteed a status (in addition to forced slash status procs from Rogue Edict).

- Blood Rush: +440% critical chance at x12 combo allows crit chance to hit 108%.

- Primed Smite Grineer/Corrupted: multiplicative to base damage (condition overload) and triple dips procs spread via influence (1.55 x 1.55 x 1.55 = 3.72x)

- Galvanized Elementalist: boosts status damage by 80% and status chance by 120%

- Voltaic Strike + Shocking Touch: adds electric to proc Melee Influence and boosts elec DOT by 150%, as well as status by 60%

- Discpline's merit: consistently gives tennokai every 4 hits, can also use Dreamer's Wrath

**Arcane & Exilus**

Arcane: Melee Influence. Exilus: none. Not explained in the guide.

**Incarnon Genesis evolutions**

- Evolution I : Incarnon mode - heavy attack at 5x combo to transform into Incarnon mode, where you will receive a passive +40% attack speed and +2 range. This basically allows you to drop attack speed and range mods on the melee.

- Evolution II:  Whirling Fury - additional +20% attack speed to bring total of +60% attack speed without mods OR Drifting Grace for sprint/slide if you prefer the mobility boost.

- Evolution III: Shockwave Synergy - gain 4 combo for each enemy hit by a slam attack. Helps regain combo quicker, particularly on the last attack of forward block combo of Soverign Outcast.

- Evolution IV: Evolved Ascension - +30% parkour velocity. Gives a good boost to bullet jump.

- Evolution V: Universal Readiness - 5 combo on ammo pickup. This allows you to keep at x12 combo at all times even when predominantly using guns. Kinetic Harmony is an alternative if you DON'T use Tennokai.

**Patch / update history (from the guide)**

**UPDATE JULY 2024**

With health and armor changes, slash has been relatively nerfed while raw damage has better TTK, particularly if you end up using a viral heat or corrosive heat primer. Melee Influence allows you to spread non impact/puncture/slash status effects in a 20m radius, after being activated by electric status. This effectively allows you to clear maps fast. For single target damage, use Primed Fever Strike over Shocking Touch and Melee Duplicate.

**UPDATE DEC 2023**

For a more light attack slash focused build, use Melee Duplicate, you want to sit around 137% critical chance to maximise the damage from melee duplicate. This means you should NOT slot Sacrificial Steel or a riven with +cc. This is because Melee Duplicate triggers on any tier 1 crit but the duplicated hit has a chance to be a tier 2 crit. This means you want slightly higher than 100 CC with a balance of low enough CC that tier 1 crits happen but high enough CC that enough Tier 2 crits occur on the second hit. The formula for maximising the final multiplier can be found by CC = (3 x CD - 4)/(2 x CD - 2). At 5 crit damage we get 137.5% CC. If you add cold status (from Epitaph priming for example), we get 5.5 crit damage which gives 139% CC. If we add Dreamer's Wrath, we get 6.14 for 140% CC. Rank 10 Blood Rush + Gladiator Might hits 130cc and every puncture status adds 5cc until 155cc. This means you will be floating within the right range depending on puncture procs.

For a more x12 heavy oriented Tennokai build, use Melee Animosity to get an additional +420% CC, giving a total of 302% final CC or guaranteed red crit on heavy.

**Final recommendation**

Use this if you want Praedos as a melee option for steel path, disruption, bossing, farming / loot. It carries a written guide (above).

**FRAME SYNERGIES**

We can stack +dmg from Primed Pressure Point because Condition Overload ignores the +dmg boost of Swordsmanship's Flourish as well as some of the stance multiplier from Reaping Spiral.

If using with Ash, can use Melee Crescendo for x12 heavy spam

**Final recommendation**

**Build overview**

Innodem is one of the top 5 melee weapons for light attack melee influence due to its high base damage (360), high range (1.8m base + 3m incarnon activation + 1m perks + 3m primed reach = 8.8m while airborne) and high follow through (0.9 - meaning each enemy hit only causes the follow-through damage to be 90% against the next enemy).

Build combo by spamming light attack (neutral combo of Pointed Wind or Stinging Thorn) until x12, then heavy attack Tennokai when prompted to activate Incarnon form as well as deal forced bleed status on heavy attacks (from x12 multiplier + 250% slash). Keep jumping while using light attack to take advantage of the aerial based perks, or even jump and aim attack for throw projectiles.

**Mod notes (defining mods, Galvanized, faction, flexible slots)**

**MOD CHOICES**

Range and attack speed are optional since the Incarnon bonuses are enough to replace them (+65% attack speed and +3m range), but you can double stack them if you prefer.

- Pointed Wind : Neutral combo Parting Edge has high multiplier of 774% dmg/s with short animation duration. NOTE, CURRENTLY Condition Overload is bugged with stances, and Parting Edge only has 50% effectiveness with Condition Overload (meaning only about 387% dmg/s. The Foward combo Viper's Bite 560% dmg/s but with 100% effectiveness with CO, meaning you should probably stick to forward combo until this bug is fixed.

- Condition Overload: +80% damage per status effect. This is NOT capped by the number of unique statuses i.e. with impact, puncture, slash statuses alone you get +240% damage per hit. Paired with a primer such as Kuva Nukor or Epitaph, you can get up to 8 unique statuses for +640% damage per hit.

- Galvanized Steel : gives +110% critical chance and +120% critical damage

- Weeping Wounds: +440% status chance at x12 combo, giving 108% status. This means with each hit you are guaranteed a status (in addition to forced slash status procs from Pointed Wind).

- Blood Rush: +440% critical chance at x12 combo allows crit chance to hit 108% on light attacks.

- Galvanized elementalist : status damage and more status chance

- Primed Reach: Makes Innodem have a devastating final range of 8.3m (8.8m while airborne), which doesn't suffer as much with Follow Through due to the high innate 0.9 followthrough of daggers (this means each enemy hit reduces the damage to the next enemy by only 10%).

- Primed Smite Grineer: 55% final multiplicative damage , double dipping on procs to +140% (i.e. 2.4x multiplier) and triple dips melee influence procs (i.e. 3.72x multiplier)

- Shocking touch: needed to add electric for melee influence and boosts both raw dmg and electric DoT by 1.9x

- Melee Influence: allows you to nuke maps with electric DoT.

**Arcane & Exilus**

Arcane: Melee Influence. Exilus: none. Not explained in the guide.

**Incarnon Genesis evolutions**

**EVOLUTION CHOICES**

1. Incarnon Form : Heavy attack at 5x combo to activate Incarnon form. This gives +3m range, +40% attack speed, aerial projectiles and Incarnon Resilience buffs on finisher
2. Orokin Reach: +0.5m range to maximise range. Feel free to swap to +30% sprint speed if you prefer the speed boost.
3. Skyborne Hunter: Increase range of aerial attacks by 0.5m.
4. Swooping Lunge : up to +150% dmg at 3 stacks after airborne kills. Kills from slash DoT while you are airborne count, making this very easy to build up by simply jumping around a bit.
5. Armed Inspiration or Stunning Brutality: Armed inspiration gives passive combo gain without even attacking, which can be useful if you plan on using guns more than melee. Stunning Brutality is pretty niche and provides a 10m stun when you perform a finisher. Blood annointed is now the least useful evolution due to Tennokai, since you can now perform x12 heavies without spending any combo.

**FLEXIBLE OPTIONS**

- Voltaic Strike: add 60% electric dmg and 60% status further boosting influence damage

- Spring Loaded Blade: adds more range so you can hit even more enemies each swing, and daggers have high follow through of 0.9 to take advantage of range

- Organ Shatter: +90% crit damage. We no longer need amalgam since Tennokai heavy are independent on wind up.

- Quickening: +40% attack speed for final 80% extra attack speed, which really helps since the dagger is very slow at base. Extra combo count also means you can build to x12 incredibly quickly.

- Gladiator Might: +60% crit damage with +110% crit chance at x12 combo allowing crit chance to hit 143% cc on light attacks.

**SYNERGIES**

**Element choice & faction notes**

**PROGENITOR ELEMENT: ELECTRIC**

This is one of two specific Glaive playstyles where you wind up, throw and heavy detonate when the Glaive gets close to a group of enemies. Galvanized Reflex allows you to stay permanently at 5x combo which boosts each heavy attack by a 5x multiplier. Volatile Quick Return increases the maximum radius of explosion. Pathocysts heavy forces a single viral proc which can be rapidly spread by melee influence to give a group of enemies 10 viral instantly. Coda Pathocyst has the highest base damage of all existing glaives meaning its raw damage on heavy explosion hits the absolute hardest, however the area of damage is very small at a base of 4.9m. We use Melee Influence to improve its AOE clear capability since any statuses created can be spread in 20m.

**Patch / update history (from the guide)**

**UPDATE**

Melee Influence + Amalgam Argonak makes this even stronger for AOE nuking, at the cost of a bit of crit chance. You must slot three elemental mods to force blast/gas + electric due to the innate heat on the projectile.

Use this build for Argonak and stacking gun and blade with 100 kills:

**Additional notes from the guide**

**EMPTY SLOT FOR Galvanized Reflex**

Ceramic Dagger transforms into Incarnon form after using heavy attack after reaching 6x combo. Gun and Blade and Adept Reflexes evolutions give 120 initial combo after 100 kills which is equivalent to 7x combo. Adding Galvanized Reflex to this gives you permanent 11x combo (or 12x with Ready Steel). Heavy attacking while incarnon mode is active throws a projectile with approximately 5m AOE with forced impact and innate heat status. You can make gas electric or blast electric to proc influence OR if using Volt/Shock Trooper you can mod pure blast or pure gas and rely on external electric to proc influence.

This is specifically for using the incarnon heavy attack projectiles to kill enemies. Grouping + armor strip is ideal to make this scale, otherwise the damage isn't very good against armored enemies. Armor strip can be applied by Amalgam Argonak passively or actively through warframe abilities.

At the time of testing, Condition overload works while Sacrificial Pressure/Primed Pressure Point DO NOT seem to apply any damage to the projectiles. Once it works, Primed Pressure Point is flexible over Condition Overload. Ability based damage buffs like Vex Armor, Rift Torrent, Eclipse seem to work fine.

Evo II: Gun and Blade : 100 IC after 100 primary kills
Evo III: Adept Reflexes 20 IC makes final combo 150 after 100kills + corrupt charge, giving you permanent 8x heavy attack multiplier (but requires about 2-3s to recharge)
Evo III: Absolute Dominion: +30% SC gives you as base status of 50%. After Weeping Wounds and status chance mods you hit 330% status chance.

**Mod notes (defining mods, Galvanized, faction, flexible slots)**

**PRIMED PRESSURE POINT/SACRIFICIAL PRESSURE + SACRIFICIAL STEEL/Galvanized Steel**:
The choice of variants depends on external factors like rivens, wrathful advance and violet archon shards.
1. Primed Pressure Point + Galvanized Steel: best combination when used with a crit chance riven/best in slot riven i.e. CC/DMG or CC/DMG/IC or Wrathful Advance.
2. Sacrificial Pressure + Sacrificial Steel: best combination if no crit chance on riven but you are running multiple Violet crit damage shards (i.e. 2 or more)

Use this spreadsheet to check exactly which versions of pressure point/steel are better, in addition to other mod choices and riven stats since everything is dependent on your frame buffs, shards and other external factors:

Use this calculator to check actual damage and simulate if you can one-shot levelcap Thrax:

**Blood Rush**: At 8x combo, Blood Rush gives +280% CC, which pushes Magistar into higher crit tiers for higher consistency and average DPS.

**Organ Shatter**: Gives 90% Crit damage. NOTE: This is the flexible slot if you have violet shards.

**Primed Fever Strike**: Gives +165% toxin damage which contributes to raw damage, and toxin damage bypasses shields which is important because enemies with shields like corpus/corrupted have a shield gate that cannot normally be bypassed by slam damage.

**SEISMIC WAVE**: Gives 200% damage which is multiplicative to Pressure Point/Sacrificial Pressure

**Galvanized Reflex**: At maximum stacks gives 80 initial combo which combines with 30 from Corrupt Charge and 30 from incarnon form bonus to hit 140, giving 8x permanent heavy multiplier which multiplies heavy slam damage by 8x. Also gives heavy attack efficiency which effects how much combo is consumed each slam and therefore how quickly you regenerate combo back to 8x before you are ready to slam at maximum damage again.

**Corrupt Charge**: This is flexible and depends if you have any outside source of initial combo. This is because without Corrupt Charge, Galvanized Reflex fully stacked only gives 5x combo before incarnon mode is activated, and you need to hit 6x combo to activate the incarnon mode. Running Corrupt Charge allows you to hit 6x combo immediately and activate incarnon form to jump to 8x initial combo. Alternatively you can run Ready Steel in the Aura, use Rauta to gain combo by shooting, block to gain combo or just swing the Magistar manually each time you need to reactivate the incarnon form. If you prefer this, swap Corrupt Charge out for Organ Shatter, Focus Radon or Riven.

**MELEE EXPOSURE**: high raw elemental damage bonus

**Build overview**

Primed Smite gives the highest possible DPS boost since it double dips standard DoT and triple dips influence DoT however is only limited to one faction at a time. If you know you are fighting a specific faction in an endurance mission you can consider adding this over Galvanized Elementalist to maximise DPS, or over Shocking Touch if running Shock Trooper, or over Primed Fury if running external attack speed boosts.

Nami Solo Incarnon is currently one of the strongest if not THE strongest melee weapon when considering multiple enemies, primarily due to THREE reasons:
1. The Lone Blade evolution which gives it a **Follow Through OF 1**. The Follow Through stat refers to how much damage is preserved on a single swing after passing through each enemy. For example, most melees have a Follow Through stat of 0.6, meaning for each enemy hit, the second enemy to be hit in the same swing will only take 60% of the initial damage while the third enemy will take 60% of 60% (i.e. 36%) and so on until the damage drops close to 0 on the tenth enemy if you hit 10 enemies. Having a Follow Through stat of 1 however means NO DAMAGE IS LOST. Note you must HARD SWAP melee (i.e. hold weapon swap) rather than quick melee swap.
2. Passive range bonus of 3m giving a final range of 8.5m with Primed Reach, second highest base in the game (behind Bo Incarnon).
3. High base status chance with status chance incarnon evolution

**Additional notes from the guide**

+Elemental damage bonuses (Primed Fever Strike and Melee Exposure) do not actually affect the component of 'true damage' on Bladestorm that bypasses armor and is instead bonus damage that is attenuated by armor (i.e. reduced by 10 at max 2700 armor). This will deal the full damage against unarmored enemies and the overguard component of enemies. Primed Fever Strike is therefore flexible for Primed Smite Grineer if specifically fighting only armored Grineer to maximise damage instances.

**ATTACK SPEED**

Attack Speed is now capped at 55% and Berserker Fury works but requires you to maintain stacks.
Spoiled Strike + Berserker Fury = 75% - 20% = 55%.

If you don't like the initial ramp up/slowness and don't plan on using status priming, you can swap Berserker Fury for Primed Fury and Condition Overload for Magnetic Rush.
Spoiled Strike + Primed Fury + Magnetic Rush = 55% + 20% - 20% = 55%

**Final recommendation**

Use this if you want Shadow Clones Prime as a melee option for level cap. It carries a written guide (above).

- Primed Fury: Mandatory attack speed. The incarnon mode forces a -35% base penalty, but evolution 2 gives +45% bonus, meaning Primed fury ends up at a net positive of about 1.3. This is flexible for Berserker Fury or Quickening.

- Primed Smite: Mandatory for maximising Influence DPS because this TRIPLE DIPS the final DoT damage spread via Melee influence, for 3.72x multiplier.

- Shocking Touch: Mandatory to add electric to proc influence and adds 1.9x multiplier to electric DoTs. If using with Lavos and Valence Formation, swap shocking touch for Primed Fever Strike and infuse Electric, which will make Ruvox deal Corrosive status and force Electric status.

- Seismic Wave: Multiplicative with Primed Pressure Point on slam damage, giving 3x multiplier to each slam. Flexible for Primed Reach if you don't plan on slamming too much.

**Mod notes (defining mods, Galvanized, faction, flexible slots)**

- Condition Overload - compulsory mod since it is multiplicative to +dmg for the projectile, and increases with more status effects e.g. +600% damage at 5 statuses (which can be achieved with Verdilac alone) or +1200% at 10 statuses (which can be achieved with combining a primer and Verdilac's innate statuses).

- Organ Shatter - compulsory mod for crit damage

- Weeping Wounds - useful to increase status chance to 126% at max combo

- Blood Rush - compulsory for crit chance (162% at max combo)

- Primed Fury - attack speed affects regular combo gain and the animation of projectile throwing. Flexible for Berserker Fury or drop from build entirely if you run external attack speed (e.g. arcane strike or warframe ability buffs like volt, gauss, warcry).

- Primed Pressure Point - Condition overload is *MULTIPLICATIVE* with other +dmg sources. If you have any +dmg source from outside e.g. Arcane Fury/blade charger, you can drop this mod entirely for Nira's Contempt or Gladiator might

- Primed Smite Grineer - further multiplier to both Condition Overload and +dmg, meaning with +600% from CO (5 status),  and +55% from smite. In addition, smite double dips DoT proc damage to give it a second +55% boost, or 2.401x final multiplier and triple dips on the spread influence DoTs.

- Shocking Touch - required to make electric + corrosive

Other flexible options - if you drop Primed Fury due to external sources, or hate faction mods, you can run any of the following alternatives:
- Galvanized Elementalist - increases status dmg by 85% and also boosts status by 120%
- Gladiator might - increases crit chance by 110% at max combo and crit damage by 60%
- Sacrificial Pressure - further boosts crit chance
- Primed Reach - helps build combo but does not increase the radius of projectile or gas clouds

**Weapon identity & damage engine**

Melee Duplicate is ideal as long as you don't run Wrathful Advance. Other crit bonuses like Zephyr, Avenger are okay since they increase the final average multiplier but reduce consistency.
If you run Wrathful Advance, swap Melee Duplicate for Melee Exposure.

Melee Duplicate + Subsumed Eclipse is approximately 20% better than Melee Exposure + Subsumed Wrathful Advance on all frames except Kullervo/[Mirage].

Condition Overload is optional but is MULTIPLICATIVE on direct hits, so use this for Thrax/Demolysts specifically.

Primed Fury or attack speed increases projectile speed and initial throw animation.

Ideal Riven stats are DMG/CD/AS/TOX and a harmless negative e.g. -finisher. Replace Gladiator Might.

Note, we use Seekalla to make it a Heavy Blade so it can use the Rending Crane stance. Currently, contagion inherits the damage multiplier of the first attack on the neutral combo of a stance. Rending Crane's neutral attack has the highest first hit multiplier of 400%.

Use Corrosive for Grineer, Viral for Corrupted, Toxin for Corpus and swap banes accordingly
For Thrax, swap Primed Smite for Condition Overload (multiplicative on direct hits).

### 25. Kestrel Prime — Kestrel Prime | Extreme Bounce Influence

**Type:** Melee · **Difficulty:** Intermediate · **Investment:** Medium

| Assumption | Value |
|---|---|
| Content | General Steel Path (per build title) |
| Forma | 3 (V×4, –×3) |

| Single-target / AoE | AoE |
| Last tested | build last edited 2025-12-16 |
| MR / cost | MR 11 · 183 platinum / 106440 endo |

**Build overview**

This is one of two specific Glaive playstyles where instead of exploding the Glaive with heavy attack, you just repeatedly throw it and wait for it to bounce around then come back. Kestrel Prime has a innate effect of bouncing 8 times vs most other glaives that only bounce 3 times. By letting it bounce around it can slowly build combo eventually hitting 12x, where it can benefit from combo mods like Weeping Wounds and Blood Rush. With the mod Volatile Rebound, each time the Glaive bounces into an enemy it will cause a mini explosion which due to melee influence will cause damaging electric status to spread exponentially. Each mini explosion deals about half the damage of a full heavy but does not scale off heavy combo, which puts each explosion at about 10x weaker than a x5 heavy explosion but since you can Rebound multiple times per throw this overall averages out in a dense crowd. This playstyle is not quite as immediately devastating as a heavy detonation spam build but offers a fun alternative that is equally as good at killing large groups of enemies.

- Primed Pressure Point — R10 — V · Madurai

**MOVEMENT TECH**

The three attack speed mods are for stance momentum inherit (aka "Mexian" named after conclave player who discovered it).
You must be using Stinging Thorn

To perform Mexian:
1. Hold aim + Forward + quick melee to perform forward block attack which should make you charge forward
2. Press swap weapon mid animation
3. Jump
4. Roll/dodge

If you rebind quick melee to mouse wheel up and swap weapon to mouse wheel down
On PC the inputs should be roughly: right mouse, wheel up, wheel down, space, shift

If you have mouse 4 and mouse 5 buttons could use those instead.

**Incarnon Genesis evolutions**

- Evolution I : Incarnon mode - heavy attack at 5x combo to transform into Incarnon mode, where you will receive a passive +40% attack speed and +2 range. This basically allows you to drop attack speed and range mods on the melee.

- Evolution II:  Drifting Grace for extra moibility (+20% sprint and slide) OR Seismic Slam +50% slam radius if you are constantly slamming to trash clear or want to build up Shockwave Synergy even faster

- Evolution III: Shockwave Synergy: Gain 4 combo per enemy hit with a normal slam. This means if you slam 20 enemies you can gain 80 combo which is equivalent to 4x multiplier. If you just light slam a big group of enemies 3 times you will hit 12x combo. This means you can launch a huge 12x heavy slam every 3 normal slams.

- Evolution IV: Evolved Ascension - +30% parkour velocity

- Evolution V: Universal Readiness - collecting ammo increases combo

PROGENITOR: Impact progenitor adds 60% of total base damage into the impact, and impact mods multiplying on top of these have a much greater effect on damage than any other progenitor.

Coda Motovore has a passive that makes physical mods such as impact apply 6x higher than normal i.e. Primed Heavy Trauma is +990% impact.

Primed Fever Strike is used so Toxin can bypass shields which normally blocks slams due to shield gate. If you just want maximum possible damage number use Saxum Thorax instead.

Melee Duplicate makes yellow crits duplicate, but the sweet spot for average crit chance is around 120%cc which is what we hit with Galv Steel. If you are running Wrathful Advance then swap for Melee Assimilation or Careen.

Condition Overload is optional but is MULTIPLICATIVE on direct hits. This is flexible for Molten Impact or Primed Smite.

Primed Fury or attack speed increases projectile speed and initial throw animation.

Ideal Riven stats are DMG/CD/AS/TOX and a harmless negative e.g. -finisher

**MOVEMENT TECH**

If you want to use Ruvox as a full movement stick, Gaia's Tragedy or Seismic Palm are required and you need to slot about three attack speed mods. The three attack speed mods are for stance momentum inherit (aka "Mexian" named after conclave player who discovered it). You may also want to swap Melee Influence to Melee Crescendo and perform finishers to get x12 combo:

To perform Mexian:
1. Hold aim + Forward + quick melee to perform forward block attack which should make you charge forward
2. Press swap weapon mid animation
3. Jump
4. Roll/dodge

If you rebind quick melee to mouse wheel up and swap weapon to mouse wheel down
On PC the inputs should be roughly: right mouse, wheel up, wheel down, space, shift

If you have mouse 4 and mouse 5 buttons could use those instead.

**Final recommendation**

Use this if you want Ruvox as a melee option for general steel path (per build title). It carries a written guide (above).

**Weapon identity & damage engine**

Helps crowd clearing on dense maps.

Shadow Clones have a base status of 5%. The listed status in the build editor is NOT accurate.

With Volcanic Edge and Weeping Wounds at x12 combo we get +500% status chance which is 5 x 6 = 30% status.

Proton Snap is a flat 50% final status chance after wall latch for 20s which gives a final 80% status chance.

Gas has about a 60% weighting meaning the final chance of proccing 1 single proc of gas is 48%.

So hitting a room of 20 enemies with Bladestorm we expect an average of 10 individual single stacks of Gas clouds, each dealing significant damage to new enemies that walk through.

**Build overview**

This is ONLY for use with a frame that can add non-combining electric damage e.g. Volt with Shock Trooper, any frame with Shock Trooper subsumed on, Gyre with Conductive Sphere or Lavos with Valence Formation. This is because Ceramic Dagger Incarnon heavy shoots two projectiles one which is pure heat AOE explosion and combines with electric to make radiation. If you add non-combining electric you will then be able to spread radiation + electric with influence instead of just radiation from the AOE explosions.

Add Argonak with amalgam argonak to strip armor passively.
Use this build to stack Gun and Blade:

**Additional notes from the guide**

Evolution II : Gathering Momentum
Evolution III: Seismic Slam
Evolution IV: Ternary Vault
Evolution V: Vulnerability Serum

**MOVEMENT TECH**

If you want to use Ruvox as a full movement stick, Gaia's Tragedy or Seismic Palm are required and you need to slot at least two to three attack speed mods. The attack speed mods are for stance momentum inherit (aka "Mexian" named after conclave player who discovered it) which allow you convert the forward momentum from a block attack which is affected by attack speed, into forward movement. If you can perform finishers e.g. with vazarin or grouping you can get x12 crescendo and benefit from +60% movement speed from Gathering Momentum.

To perform Mexian:
1. Hold aim + Forward + quick melee to perform forward block attack which should make you charge forward
2. Press swap weapon mid animation
3. Jump
4. Roll/dodge

If you rebind quick melee to mouse wheel up and swap weapon to mouse wheel down
On PC the inputs should be roughly: right mouse, wheel up, wheel down, space, shift

If you have mouse 4 and mouse 5 buttons could use those instead.

**Final recommendation**

Use this if you want Ruvox as a melee option for general steel path (per build title). It carries a written guide (above).

Claw build:

MANDATORY MODS:
Viral Quills - spreads AOE viral procs and minor damage
Martyr Symbiosis - sacrifices itself to save you.
Panzer Devolution OR momentous bond

Resourceful Retriever - bonus loot

Tenacious Bond - gives free 1.2x flat crit damage to your weapons. Headshots also reduce revive timer by 3s.

Tek Assault - 60% chance to not die, OPTIONAL mod

Seismic Bond - OPTIONAL, but gives 30% bonus Ability Efficiency on warframes with "CHANNELLING ABILITIES" as Viral Quills deals damage. Note that the game has a VERY generous definition for channeling abilities as nearly every frame has an ability that seems to count. See Arcane Intention wiki page for a full list:

Hunter Recovery - optional mod for free healing. Viral quills constantly heals your health while active since it deals damage.

Calculated Redirection + Reinforced Bond -  bonus 60% fire rate

Tandem bond - good on frames requiring melee combo eg Baruuk, Gara, Khora, Atlas. Viral Quills count as an extra 3 melee combo per spore, meaning Panzer attacking gains up to 18 combo per enemy hit (assuming up to 6 spores). You can reach x12 combo in 10 seconds if you add grouping.

Mystic Bond - allows free casts on frames that don't use brief respite for shield gating, and viral quills helps trigger mystic bond

Medi pet kit - reduces revive timer if you don't use Panzer Devolution

**MANDATORY MODS**

Arc Coil - zaps 7 enemies in 10m with electric damage/status, which can carry other elements via Manifold Bond. Seems to have little or no cooldown.

Synth Deconstruct - enemies tagged by the 10m AOE of Arc Coil can drop health orbs, which can be converted to energy by equilibrium

Vacuum - self explanatory

Primed Regen - reduces recovery time

Seismic Bond is used because a SURPRISING amount of abilities satisfy the condition to activate a free 30% efficiency, which shares a list with Arcane Intention:

Primed Animal instinct - loot radar and more enemy radar

Sacrifice - can revive you

Tenacious Bond - OPTIONAL but requires vulklok, vulcax or prime laser rifle with riven, gives flat 1.2x crit multiplier.

Electro Pulse - zaps 1 enemy in 15m, but also appears to activate Melee Influence (?bug). This is FLEXIBLE

Contagious Bond - enemies killed by verglas will spread all status effects on that enemy

Duplex Bond - every 100 energy spawns a clone,  kills by clone can drop energy orbs and clones also contribute to priming

Mystic Bond - OPTIONAL can give nearly constant free casts with Diriga + Arc Coil but then prevents shield gating that relies on Brief Respite etc.

**UPDATE 2024**

Negate is now affected by Manifold Bonds cooldown reduction
Coolant Leak has been buffed to 10m and benefits off status application from Manifold bond, meaning you can crowd control enemies, passively prime enemies and apply synth deconstruct.

Guardian + Manifold Bond - Guardian completely refills your shield on depletion, resetting your shield gate. Killing enemies with 3 or more statuses reduces cooldown of Guardian by 5s, meaning every 6 kills on statused enemies resets Guardian's 30s cooldown, allowing you to essentially shield gate passively.

Negate - effectively gives status immunity, preventing dangerous toxin or heat procs at high levels and also preventing knockdown, particularly when run with Manifold Bond.

Reinforced Bond + Calculated Redirection - Boosts Wyrm's shield to above 1200, making Reinforced Bond constantly active regardless of current shield level giving a +60% fire rate boost for free. Calculated Redirection is optional on frames that can make your sentinel immortal (eg Zephyr), as you can simply reload to hit >1200 then.

Mystic Bond - OPTIONAL mod that allows free ability casts after the sentinel uses abilities with cooldowns, which is accelerated through the use of Guardian + manifold or negate. This is only suggested on frames that don't require Brief Respite/Augur mods for shield gating as Mystic Bond will interfere. Works particularly well on Zephyr.

Momentous Bond - OPTIONAL mod that allows you to quickly revive sentinel after eximus kills.

Tenacious Bond - OPTIONAL mod that gives free flat 1.2x crit multiplier, requiring you to equip a sentinel weapon with >50% CC (Vulklok or Vulcax with Crit delay, or Prime Laser Rifle with Crit delay + CC riven).

Primed Animal Instinct - optional loot radar

Seismic Bond is used because a SURPRISING amount of abilities satisfy the condition to activate a free 30% efficiency, which shares a list with Arcane Intention:

Crowd Dispersion is OPTIONAL crowd control and can proc Manifold Bond, but usually NOT recommend because it throws enemies away making it hard to actually shoot them.

Sacrifice is an optional mod that allows sentinel to revive you

**Build overview**

A Primary Statstick is mandatory so Hunter Synergy and Mecha Overdrive inherit the critical chance and status chance from the primary weapon. Examples include Paris Prime Incarnon, Boar Prime Incarnon and Kuva Kohm, which basically use all available crit and status chance mods. For example, Paris runs:

Maul + Precision Conditioning : base damage
Bite: huge cc and cd
Hunter Synergy: adds flat cc after Bite as 30% of your primary weapons final cc
Mecha Overdrive: adds flat sc as 60% of your primary final sc and adds status duration
Immunity Resistance: +50% status damage
Radon Claws: adds another +80% cd on top of Bite , flexible for Shock Collar which adds a tiny bit of elec and status on top of the huge amount granted by Shocking Claws
Shocking Claws: turns all damage into electric and adds huge elec and sc

**Build overview**

Guardian restores your shield gate for free.
Whiplash Mine groups enemies slowly in 20m, and has its cooldown reduced by Manifold Bond.
Blast Shield restores Moa overshield and knocks enemies down in 5m, which can proc Manifold Bonds status application.
Manifold Bond is required to reduce cooldowns of Guardian, Whiplash Mine and Blast Shield
Reinforced Bond +Blast Shield gives consistent fire rate boost
Aerial Bond lets you quickly revive your sentinel by jumping and killing
Momentous Bond lets you quickly revive by killing eximus AND allows Blast Shield to apply multiple statuses via Manifold Bond

FLEXIBLE OPTIONS:
Use Contagious Bond if using Verglas for a bit of occasional priming.
Duplex Bond is flexible for companion DPS if you run a frame that spends alot of energy.
Use Tenacious Bond over Contagious Bond if you run Vulklok or a weapon with > 50% cc.
Mystic Bond is flexible on frames that DON'T rely on energy expenditure for shield gating.

A Primary Statstick is mandatory so Hunter Synergy and Mecha Overdrive inherit the critical chance and status chance from the primary weapon. Examples include Paris Prime Incarnon, Boar Prime Incarnon and Kuva Kohm, which basically use all available crit and status chance mods. For example, Paris runs:

**Weapon identity & damage engine**

To hit 50% cc for Tenacious Bond you need a Primary that has at least 59% CC after mods.

A Primary Statstick is mandatory so Hunter Synergy and Mecha Overdrive inherit the critical chance and status chance from the primary weapon. Examples include Paris Prime Incarnon, Boar Prime Incarnon and Kuva Kohm, which basically use all available crit and status chance mods. For example, Paris runs:

Maul + Precision Conditioning : base damage
Bite: huge cc and cd
Hunter Synergy: adds flat cc after Bite as 30% of your primary weapons final cc
Mecha Overdrive: adds flat sc as 60% of your primary final sc and adds status duration
Immunity Resistance: +50% status damage
Radon Claws: adds another +80% cd on top of Bite , flexible for Shock Collar which adds a tiny bit of elec and status on top of the huge amount granted by Shocking Claws
Shocking Claws: turns all damage into electric and adds huge elec and sc

Elusive Posture stops kubrow getting killed as easily
